tei:titleStmt.tei:title: gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba
gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ /oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /ba

tei:div.tei:p: gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /'bri gung ti sgro'i zab gter yid bzhin nor/ gsang ba ye shes chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de yang ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal zhal nas/ e ma: ma cig jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi: ma 'ongs sprul par lung bstan pa: lab kyi ma cig sgron ma dang : snye lam shel bza' sgron gcig ma: bre 'tsham zhang lcam bo chung ma: zangs ri'i jo mo mkhar sgom ma: sna nam a phyi chos sgron ma: kho mo bdag gi sprul pa 'byung : da lta'i gnubs ban dzñā na ba: yang mthar grogs bgyid yid la gcags: ma 'ongs rgyal ba don 'grub ces: de la rim rgyud mang mtha' ru: gsang ba'i gcod mchog 'di 'byin po: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa 'byung : de dus zab chos 'di 'phrad shog: rgya 'di las kyi mkha' 'gros srungs: dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: zhes bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gsang ba ye shes zhes gsang ba chos bzhi'i nang tshan snyan brgyud gcod kyi gdams pa 'di nyid gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang*/ ma cig lab sgron gyi sras rgyal ba don 'grub zung gi rnam 'phrul o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong nam ma hā gu rus mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas par zab chos mkha' 'gro snying thig gi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i bod yul gyi tshogs khang chen mor grags pa nas gdan drangs pa'i snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i chos sde ste/ 'di la kha byang lung byang lung bstan zab rgya dang bcas pa/ snyan brgyud gcod yul bskyed rdzogs mtha' rten gyi man ngag gegs sel bogs 'don dang bcas pa zab rgyas bzhugs pa yongs rdzogs lag tu ma son la khyad par kha byang lung bstan dang*/

gter gzhung mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud phal cher/ gtum mo'i gzhung khrid sogs rdzogs rim skor slar mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod du bsdus par mngon la/ da lam thor bu rigs gang rnyed kyi them byang 'god pa la gsum/ rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor/ chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor/ yan lag kha skong gi skor ro/ ༈

dang po rtsa ba gter gzhung gi skor la/ ka)gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: bla ma'i gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i rta ring*/ 1-12 kha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: snyan brgyud gcod kyi gdams pa gsang ba 'khor lo/ 13-53 ga) ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: phrin las sgrub pa ka la'i dbyangs ring*/ 54-67 nga) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs bskang ba mu tig phreng ba/ 68-109 ca) tshogs zhing byang chub myur lam/ 110-117 cha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gter srung las kyi ma mo 'jig rten pa ltar du sgrub pa/ 118-136 ja) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gter srung las kyi ma mo ye shes pa ltar du sgrub pa/ 137-167 nya) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gcod yul srung ma rol pa skya bdun/ 168-198 ta) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gcod gdams thogs bcas thogs med/ 199-214 tha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar/ 215-238 da) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: me bskul ye shes rab 'bar/ 239-246 na) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: god brub dmigs rim chu srin kha tham/ 247-252 ༈ gnyis pa chog khrigs sna tshogs kyi skor/ pa) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gcod tshogs chog khrigs yum chen dgongs don spyi 'gros dang mthun par bklag chog mar bkod pa mtsho rgyal thugs bcud/ 253-386 pha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ mtsho rgyal snyan brgyud rgyun gcod ngag 'don khol phyung*/ 387-412 ba) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gcod yul gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin gyi phung po/ 413-427 ma) rje btsun khros ma'i phrin las chog khrigs ye shes sgo 'byed/ 428-460 tsa) rje btsun khros ma'i rgyun khyer bde chen rab 'bar/ 461-464 tsha) a phyi'i bskang bstod/

465-466 dza) mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'dod rgu yid 'jo gter bum/ 467-469 wa) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ lhan thabs zangs ri mched bdun gyi gsol mchod/ 470-472 zha) bshags pa kyai maḥ rtog med rang byung shes pa sogs la/ 473-474 za) bsngo smon phaṭḥ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyin pa/ 475-476 'a) gcod bsngo sangs rgyas myur lam/ 477-478 ya) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gshin gcod 'phrul gyi lde mig gshin po rjes 'dzin chog khrigs bltas chog tu bkod pa/ 479-565 ra) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ dur gcod baṃ gyi tshogs 'khor thar lam dkar po'i ngag 'don bsgrigs chags su bkod pa/ 566-635 la) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gter srung las kyi ma mo'i bsang mchod yid bzhin gter 'byung*/ 636-642 sha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ bsun bzlog gi ngag 'don chog khrigs bar chad kun sel/ 643-692 sa) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar gyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg khol du phyung ba dag byed bdud rtsi'i zegs ma/ 693-724 ha) gsang ba yid bzhin ḍākki nor mchog las/ bsnyen yig dmigs gnad zin bris/ 725-741 a) mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi zin bris 'dod 'byung ratna'i bum chen/ 742-769 bcas chos tshan sum cu dang*/ ༈ gsum pa yan lag kha skong gi skor la/ ki) gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs/ 770-790 khi) gsang ba ye shes kyi gsol 'debs/ 791-792 gi) gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa bde chen gsang lam/ 793-821 ngi) changs bu brgya rtsa/ 82-827 ci) mu khri'i gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshe 'tshub lhong byung skabs rtsa gsum gling pas thol byung du gsungs pa'i gcod dmigs/ 828-829 chi) sbyin sreg zin bris gcod kyi gdams pa zhal shes la/

830-831 ji) gcod kyi sa 'bebs grangs don bsdus pa/ 832-837 nyi) man ngag bya 'bod byed tshul/ 838-838 ti) nges don gcod kyi go don bshad pa/ 839-850 slar smras pa/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsam̐ng bam̐ zab mo'i lam/ /ḍam̐'akkim̐'i snying thig yim̐d bzhim̐n nom̐r bu mchom̐g /mtsho rgyal snyam̐n brgyudam̐ gcod gdams khyad par can/ /mjal ba'i skal bzang 'di ko e ma rmad/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e waṃ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /zhes pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: bla ma'i gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i rta ring bzhugs so: rje btsun dam pa khyab bdag 'gro ba 'dren: rgya gar rig 'dzin grub thob padma 'byung : bod yul mun sel jo mo mtsho rgyal lcam: gsang ba ye shes nam mkha'i gos 'chang ma: zhi byed a ti'i grub thob brgyud par 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang sku gcig ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid: dpal ldan bla ma rig 'dzin chen po mtsho skyes rdo rje la: gsol ba 'debs pa ni: thun mong ma yin pa snying khung rus pa'i gting nas gsol ba 'di ltar du gdab bo: na moḥ mdun du mtsho gling bdal khyab 'o ma can gyi dbus su me tog u dum wa ra'i padma'i sdong po mdangs dang ldan pa 'od du 'bar ba'i ze'u 'bru'i dbus su rang gi smin mtshams thad sor: gyad dang seṅge glang chen rta mchog rma bya shang shang gis btegs pa'i khri yi steng du: padma dang nyi ma zla gdan dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su: rje dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid: gu ru padma 'byung gnas sku mdog dmar la smug pa:

zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: rnam pa a tsa ra'i cha lugs can dbu skra dmar ser lcang lo g.yas su 'khyil zhing : thor tshugs la thod skam lnga dang : rin po che'i rtse phran gyis spras shing : mu tig gi zer bu 'phyang ba: thugs rje'i spyan rtsa nyi zla ltar 'bar zhing zlum la phyogs bcur gzigs pa: shangs nas ye shes lnga'i rlung 'jam zhing ring la glog ltar 'gyu bas nyon mongs pa'i 'khri ba had kyis gtor ba: zhal ras 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan dgyes shing bzhad pa: gsung dbyangs drug cu phyogs bcur sgrogs pa: rig 'dzin dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mkha' 'gro dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul ba: snyan cha nor bu rin po che'i mu ku ṭa spras shing rtag par brgyad khri bzhi stong gi chos sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs pa: tshems rtse rno zhing a ra dmar ser rgya skar gyi mdor sleb tsam zil ba: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdau rje rtse lnga pa gdeng thabs kyis mkha' la phyar bas: snang srid zil gyis gnon pa: g.yon pas bhandha bdud rtsi lngas gtams pa lte ba'i thad sor bsnams pa: sgrub la mchog dang thun mong gi rig 'dzin dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba: gru mor dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i brda: yum gyi mtshon pa kha ṭwāṃ ga brten pa: sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug dang : dar dmar gyi ga sha kha: stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba: zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol stabs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa: srid pa gsum rab tu g.yo zh-ing snang srid thams cad dbang du sdud pa: lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bran ltar mchis pa'o: de'i steng du mkha' spyod kyi rig 'dzin sprin ltar du gtibs pa: g.yas su yi dam dpa' bo rgya mtsho he ru kas gar bsgyur ba: g.yon du mkha' 'gro dpa' mo rgya mtshos brda skad sgrog cing glu dbyangs len pa: mdun du dam can chos skyong rgya mtsho las la bskul bas ha ha'i gad mo sgrog cing phrin las sna tshogs thogs med du sgrub pa:

gzhan yang khor yug kun tu ma sring ḍākki rnams kyi g.yas thams cad thod pa'i cang te'u nam mkha' la 'khrol zhing : g.yon bdud rtsi'i bum ril thogs nas brda gar gyis nyams dgu 'khrab cing : dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan rlung gis nam mkhar na ra ra bun bun bskyod pa: gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku yi cha la sa bon gyi yig 'bru gtams pa las: 'od zer sna tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i skyabs yul ye shes pa spyan drangs nas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur: gzi brjid dang bkrag mdangs cher 'od du 'bar bas skyabs mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas su bsam mo: de nas mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba phur tshugs su gdab pa ni: na mo gu ru: rig 'dzin kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: bla ma kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: yi dam kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: mkha' 'gro kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: chos skyong kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: sku lnga lhun grub kyi ngo bo rje btsun padma 'byung gnas la gsol ba 'debs: thugs rje spyan gyis gzigs shig: rje btsun padma 'byung gnas: gsol ba snying nas 'debs so: rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir: thugs rje yal bar ma dor: rje btsun padma 'byung gnas: gsol ba snying nas 'debs so: mos pa'i bu la byams brtse: byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol cig: rje btsun padma 'byung gnas: gsol ba snying nas 'debs so: bla ma mkhyen no: zhes brgya tsam bzla: na mo: sangs rgyas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no: dam chos kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no:

dge 'dun kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no: chos sku kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no: longs sku kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no: sprul sku kun 'dus kyi ngo bo padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no: 'di phyi re ltos skyabs gnas: rje btsun khyed las med do: dal 'byor rnyed dka' dran zhing : mi rtag 'chi bas bskul nas: las 'phro dge bas bsu bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: 'khor ba snying po med pas: tshe 'di blo yis btang nas: chos la nges shes skye bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: tshe rabs bag chags 'thas pas: dgra la sdang ba med cing : 'gro kun snying rjes skyong bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: mthun 'jug zhen pas bcings nas: ngan goms lam la 'khrid pas: gnyen la byams chags bral bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: 'dod yon bdud kyi zhags pas: mtho ris sgrog tu 'ching mkhan: rnam g.yeng mdud pa khrol bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: zang zing sgyu ma'i nor rdzas: 'dzin chags ri gzar rdo zlum: 'phang med sbyin tshogs nus par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: 'khor ba gshin rje'i btson ra: thar med las kyi g.yeng las: ldog nas tshul khrims ldan par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: bdag rgyud 'khri bas bcings nas: khong khro'i 'dam du tshud la: byams pa'i bzod rtsis brlan par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: nyon mongs tshad pas gdung nas: byang chub myu gu bskams la: bsam gtan char rgyun 'bebs par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: bag med le lor 'byams nas: dge bcu gtan 'dun dor la: bde dge'i brtson 'grus brtsam par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: ma rig kun rmongs nags ljongs: 'thug por 'khor bar 'khyams la: shes rab sgron mes gsal bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: da lan yad yud mi lus: rin chen gling du bslebs nas: don med lag stong min par:

smon lam bzang po 'debs so: long med rgyud la skye nas: gnyan sa ri khrod 'grims te: phung po gzan skyur nus par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: lha 'dre sems su shes nas: snang ba bdud gcod nus shing : 'gal rkyen grogs su 'char bar: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: bdag 'dzin rtsad nas chod cing : byams dang snying rjes bskyangs nas: gcod yul mtha' ru phyin par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: ka dag ye grol rtogs nas: nyag gcig rtsad nas chod de: lha 'dre'i 'gro don nus par: smon lam bzang po 'debs so: rje btsun padma 'byung gnas: gnas la nye ring med pas: thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig: sa cha gang du 'gro yang : thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig: gnas mchog gang du 'dug kyang : thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig: gsol 'debs thun mtshams 'di ru: thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shig: byin rlabs dbang bzhi stsol cig: bla ma dam pa mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: bla ma mkhyen no: zhes lan gang mang gis gsol ba gdab bo: dus dang rnam pa kun du blo khyed shes 'dun pa ling gis bkal nas: skyid rung sdug rung dro rung grang rung : legs rung nyes rung : na rung shi rung : bor rung brlag rung : yod rung med rung : ci byung yang pha padma 'byung gnas mkhyen no snyam pa'i ngang nas tshig don ltar 'bras bu 'grub par nyin mtshan kun tu yengs med rgyun gyis sgom bsring bar bya'o: 'di nyid mi med lung stong ngam: skyo ba skye ba'i sa ru gdung ba'i dbyangs dang bcas nas dung dung 'bod par bya: a ma'i shog dril kha skong ngo : sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo rtsa gsum gling pas 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas durma kha zhes me sprel lor gdan drangs shing*/ bdud 'dul sngags gling du bsgyur ba'o// kha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: snyan brgyud gcod kyi gdams pa gsang ba 'khor lo bzhugs so:

gsang ba rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma la 'dud: e ma: stong nyid snying po'i rgyun bzang dpag dka'i gter: zad med smin grol 'gro la cig car du: rtag par dgyes phyir 'gyed pa'i dga' ston che/ kho bos gsal bkod dbyangs can brda yis zungs: snyan brgyud za ma tog gi sgrom du sbos: las kyi dbang mo che yis rgya srungs shig: las 'phro'i nyer len mi nor skal ldan la: rtags dang dus su 'phrod pa'i smon lam gtso: de yang zab mo rdo rje'i tshig rkang snyan brgyud gcod kyi gdams pa: shin tu nyams su len par byed pa la don gnyis te: tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yi ling gis btang nas: phyi ma bde 'gro mtho ris tsam min par rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ched du gnyer ba'i phyir: lus dang srog la mi 'phong mi lta zhing : phung po gzan du bor nas 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod par bya ba mi mthun grogs su khyer nas ltas ngan g.yang du len pa bar chad dngos grub tu shes pa: lha 'dre sems su rtogs shing bdud bzhi grogs su bstan pa'i las brtsams te: gsang gcod rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len khrigs chags su bsdebs pa'i gdams pa la 'jug pa ni: thog mar gnyan sa gsum las phyi snod 'byung sdud kyi gnas yul: nang bcud sgyu lus kyi dur khrod: gsang ba tshogs drug gi 'dre dgu ste: gsum po gang du mos pa: gang zag gi blo dang bstun nas: tshogs rdzogs mchod pa bskang ba la sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa ni: lus sems rlung gsum dus gcig dril nas: dbang po bstan pa'i phyir: phaṭḥdrag po gcig bya: dmigs pa ni ya gi sangs rgyas man chod dang : ma ki na rag dmyal khams yan chod du 'khod pa'i lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang bye brag pha mas gtsos pa'i sems can: khyad par rigs drug tu 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i yid lus bag chags kyi zhen pa la a 'thas pa'i stong gzugs 'byung po mkha' la rgyu zhing sems can la 'tshe ba dang :

lhag tu khas zhan dbang chung gi rigs dman pa rnams: thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir: da len snying rje rlabs po che yi spobs pa lhur len nas sgyu lus bag chags kyi g.yar khang 'di lta bu nam yang 'dor rgyu las med na: da res mchod sbyin rtsom par bya'o snyam nas 'dun pa brtan pos 'di ltar brjod par bya'o:

na mo: skyabs yul gyi sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: tshogs zhing mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can dang chos srung rgya mtsho la: ma gyur gyi sems can bskyab tu gsol: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de'i tshe rang sems snang srid la khyab pa'i shugs kyis: snod bcud kyi skye 'gro mtha' dag gi sgra de thos pas thal sbyar pus btsugs bgyis nas byang chub tu sems bskyed par bsam: phaṭḥ srid rtse dang mnar med yan chod du: phan byed lha dang gnod byed kyi 'dre: sdang dgra dang byams gnyen ma lus kun: bla med kyi lam la 'god par bya: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med bzhin rang gshis kyi rig pa ngo 'phrod nas bde sdug chags sdang legs nyes thams cad dang bral bar bsgom: phaṭḥ tshogs drug gi nam mkha' yangs pa ru: 'ja' sprin dbus pad sdong 'bar ba'i rtser: skyabs yul gyi gu ru padma 'byung : sangs rgyas dang byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: byin rlabs kyi 'od phung sprin ltar gtibs: de 'og tu pad nyi'i gdan steng du: ma cig ni ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: gnas gsum gyi ḍākki'i tshogs kyis bskor: dbu rigs lnga dang thor tshugs shigs se shig: phyag ḍā dril gyi snyan dbyangs 'u ru ru: sku rus rgyan dang cod pan spungs se spung : zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs khrigs se khrig: snang chu zla ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas: gnad pho nya'i 'od zer 'bru gsum 'phros: zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun rgyud bskul nas: dpal rtsa gsum dang chos srung bka' sdod bcas: mdun skyabs yul gyi lha dang dbyer med gyur: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams glo bur gyis sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par bsams la: phaṭ phaṭḥ phyi tshogs drug gi dbang po rnam lnga mchod: nang dug lnga yi 'byung ba khams lnga mchod:

don ye shes kyi rig rtsal rnam lnga mchod: gzhi blo bral gyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi phung khams skye mched rnams skyabs yul la phul bar bsam: phaṭḥ rang rig rnam shes ma sar sgo nga tsam: spyi bor skar mda' 'gyu bzhin gyen du 'phros: rje btsun mthing 'od 'bar ma'i thugs kar thim: gsal stong bde chen rnal 'byor ma ru shar: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ rang ngam gzhan gyi rnam shais skar mda' chad pa ltar 'phros pas spyi bo'i mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar ma'i thugs dang dbyer med du bsam: de nas rang gi bem po de mdun du gan rkyal du 'gyel ba la gri gug tshad tsam gyis pags pa dang yan lag thams cad so sor phral nas maṇḍal phun sum tshogs pa mdun du bskyed la 'bul bar bsam: phaṭḥ gri gug gdeng tsam pags pa phyal gyis bshus: bkram pas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir gyur: mgo bo khang bzang bem po ri rab dang : yan lag gling bzhi nying lag gling phran brgyad: don snod bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: khral khrol lhag ma maṇḍal bkod pa'i khyon: mig gnyis nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa: gdul byas tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod sprin 'di: phyogs dus skyabs yul rnams kyi spyan sngar 'bul: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i spyan sngar 'bul: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal spyan sngar 'bul: grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar 'bul: 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma'i spyan sngar 'bul: dam pa bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rjes zungs: phan dge bla med mchog la yi rang ngo : snang srid lha 'dre grol bar chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen du bzhugs: zag med sgyu lus phul ba'i dge rtsa yis: rje btsun gu ru yab yum 'grub gyur nas: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du 'du bar shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces mdun bskyed lha tshogs rnams mnyes shing tshim par gyur nas:

mdun du 'khod pa'i sa phyogs su gnas pa rnams byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob par bsam: phaṭḥ skyabs yul lha tshogs gu ru'i sku la thim: gu ru 'od zhu mtsho rgyal la thim pas: ḍākki rgya mtsho om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'bru gyur: rang la thim pas snang stong mkha' 'gror gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas mdun gyi skyabs yul rnams rang la 'bru gsum gyi rnam par thim: sku gsum dmigs med kyi dbang thob nas rig pa skye med du ye shes mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo chags pa'i nyams can zhig tu bsgom zhing mos pas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab po: na mo: gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla padma steng : 'ja' tshon 'od phung gtibs pa'i dbus: kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dang : dga' rab rdo rje shrī sing : 'jam dpal bshes gnyen padma 'byung : ye shes mtsho rgyal manda ra: sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa: grub thob brgyud pa byin rlabs can: bdud kyi gcod yul rin po che: gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs: ro snyom lam du lhong ba dang : brtul zhugs spobs pa mthar phyin nas: rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba yis: lha 'drer 'gro don nus pa ru: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rjes zungs: rje yab yum nyid ltar byin gyis rlobs: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs kyi rnam pas mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar spyi bor bzhugs pa rnams: kun tu bzang po nas rim bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar 'od du zhu rigs bdag bla ma yang rang rig mkha' 'gro'i tshangs bug nas mar thim nas rang rig dang dbyer med du bsgom: phaṭḥ rang rig skad cig gsang ba ye shes sku: mthing nag rab 'phros zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing smin ma me ltar 'bar: dbu skra dmar ser srid gsum dbyings la bskyod: phyag g.yas zangs gri g.yon pas bhandha bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan gar stabs ro gdan 'gying : thugs las spros pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga yis:

gri gug thogs nas pags pa phyal gyis bshus: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi lag tu thogs: bhandha bcad pas stong gsum khyon tsam gyur: de nang sha khrag spungs pas ltem gyis gang : lan gsum dam tshig phyag rgyas dkrugs pa yis: skye bdun snying po lta bur bdud rtsir gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas rkang dung lan gsum lag mthil du brdabs pas 'byung po phra mo rnams ma dngangs zer ba'i brda: thung 'bud lan gsum nyon cig nyon cig nyon cig ces: yang gsum 'dus 'dus 'dus zhes drag 'bud dgyes pa'i ha ha ha zhes gsum dang dgu bya: rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma mdog ma nges pa phyag g.yas g.yang gzhi me 'bar ba dang g.yon mi rkang gi gling bu thogs pa grangs med 'phros nas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad rang dbang med par rlung rags pas sbur ma bskyod pa ltar mdun gyi sha khrag phung po la 'khor bar bsam: phaṭḥ bdag nyid rnal 'byor drag mo'i thugs ka nas: ha ri ni sa las skyes mkha' 'gro ma: g.yang gzhi me 'bar thogs pa grangs med 'phros: g.yang gzhi brdabs nas rkang gling 'bud pa'i tshe: srid rtse mnar med dmyal khams yan chod kyi: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdus: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rkang gling lan gsum 'bud: phyogs kyi mtha' thams cad me dpung 'khrigs nas bros dbang med par bsgom: phaṭḥ na moḥ ma dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma: ye shes mtsho rgyal drag mo'i sku: phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi bsnams: g.yon pas mi rkang gling bu 'bud: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: g.yang gzhi mkha' la phyar ba'i tshe: steng gi lha srin zil gyis gnon: bar du phyogs bzhir g.yab pa'i tshe: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du bsdus: drag tu sa la rdeb pa'i tshe: 'og gi bgegs srin dam la btags: mchog chen gling bu bus pa'i tshe: srid gsum lha 'dre da 'dus shig:

dbang du bsdus la zil gyis gnon: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : mi lpags g.yang gzhi rtsal ma zhan: mchog chen gling bu ngar ma yal: mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs dpung ma nyung : baṃ tshogs mchod pa bcud ma yal: bya rgod sha thed rol pa bzhin: rang dbang med par da 'dus shig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas dbang du bsdus nas za la re zhing 'thung la rngam pa: ston chen gyi mgron 'tshogs pa ltar bskyed: yang rang gi thugs ka nas las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma grangs med 'phros nas bhandha'i skyogs thogs te phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rnams su gang bzhugs dang 'khod pa'i mgron la mchod cing sbyin par bsams la: phaṭḥ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byed du ma yi: phyag na bhandha lcang lo'i skyogs thogs nas: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod sprin du ma 'bul: snang yul tshogs drug dgongs pa rdzogs gyur cig: phaṭḥ kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' sogs: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul: dga' rab shrī singha sogs: rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la 'bul: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung sogs: gang zag snyan brgyud rnams la 'bul: manda ra ba mtsho rgyal sogs: mkha' 'gro gter brgyud rnams la 'bul: bo dhi sa twa chos rgyal sogs: grub thob rje 'bangs rnams la 'bul: sangs rgyas ye shes de wa sogs: bka' bab gcod yul brgyud par 'bul: che mchog he ru ka pa sogs: rgyud sde bzhi yi lha la 'bul: phyag bzhi phyag drug zhing skyong sogs: chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung mar 'bul: ma gza' rdor legs zhing skyong sogs: bya ra gter srung rnams la 'bul: lha klu sde brgyad gzhi bdag sogs: dregs pa sha za rnams la 'bul: bgegs rigs dmyal ba yi dwags sogs: lan chags 'byung po rnams la 'bul: bu lon sha 'khon ma sod pa'i: sngon las 'phral rkyen rnams la 'bul: gre bo gson 'dre pho mo sogs: bsam ngan log sbyor 'chang la 'bul:

mi min the'u rang yul 'dre sogs: 'byung po nad bdag rnams la 'bul: ban bon dmod pa'i byad ka sogs: rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la 'bul: srid pa bar do'i sems can sogs: yid lus 'gyu ba rnams la 'bul: sgyu lus ting 'dzin mchod sbyin 'di: 'dod pa'i mkho dgur gyur nas kyang : longs spyod mdzod la spyod par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ phaṭ grangs mang nyung dmigs pa ma zin par bya: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bdud rtsi ru dmigs nas phul: dregs pa sha za'i tshogs rnams la sha khrag gi phung por bskyed nas phul: gzhan yang gang 'dod pa der bsgyur te phul nas dga' mgu ngoms nas re kha khengs shing sngon las 'phral rkyen du gyur pa'i lan chags kyang byang : tshogs rdzogs dge ba 'di yi rgyu la brten nas kun kyang byang chub thob par bsam: de nas gtang len bya ba ni: phaṭḥ khyed snang srid kyi lha srin gzhi bdag dang : rigs drug gi skye gnas rnam bzhi'i tshogs: grangs med du pha mar 'du shes nas: dus de tsam zhig drin lan 'jal ba la: gdon khyed rnams la nyes tshogs ci mchis pa: bdag sems bskyed 'dis smin nas 'khor bar shog: nged rnal 'byor la bde skyid gang mchis pa: khyed gnod byed la phan dge 'byung bar shog: rgyu dge bcu yi las 'bras dkar po 'dis: khyed gnod byed kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar shog: lar gcod yul gyi tshogs rdzogs mchod sbyin 'dis: rkyen lha 'dre'i re kha khengs par shog: rgyu 'khrul snang gi lha 'dre stong gzugs la: bdag gnyis 'dzin gyi re dogs chod par shog: gzhi snang srid kun chos skur grol nas kyang : lam tshogs drug kun sgyu mar shes pa yi: gcod zab don gyi 'bras bu smin pa yis: rgyu de bzhin gyi byang chub lam 'god shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ: ces pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rigs drug mgron du gyur pa thams cad la phog pas bde skyid phun sum tshogs:

gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rang la thim pas skye ba dang tshe rabs kyi lan chags thams cad lus 'di'-i thog nas 'khor bar bsam: sems bskyed de yi 'bras bus tshe rabs kyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing mkha' spyod o rgyan gyi gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro: thun skabs 'dir cung zad tsam mnyam bzhag bya zhing phan sems bskyed: de yan rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bya: yang rang ngam gzhan la gdon bgegs dang lha srin cho 'phrul che na drag gcod dmar 'gyed kyi gdams pa bstan pa ni: rang gi rig pa gnas 'gyur te: ma cig khros ma nag mor gsal gdab: mdun du slar yang rang ngam gzhan gyi bem po che zhing snum pa ri rab tsam du bskyed: dbang sdud kyi dmigs rim gong bzhin la: bye brag dbang du mi 'du ba rnams lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu'i tshogs spros te 'gugs shing bsdoms nas bros dbang ma rnyed de mdun du mchis par bsam: lhong tshad ma byung na dmigs pa 'di gang mang byas pas nges par lhung tshad 'byung ngo : gang zag 'bring po yin na rang gzhan gnyis lus sbyin so sor bya: dbang po rab yin na mi ro rang ro bsre zhing lus sbyin tshar gcig byas pas rung : de nas dbang sdud kyi gzhung bsrang ba ni: dom ra dang ḍā ru rkang gling g.yang gzhi bcas tshang nas nad pa yon bdag 'dra yin na mkha' 'gro'i brda 'gros lan gsum bskor nas rngam stabs bya: rkang gling lan gsum 'bud: rang nyid yin na langs mi dgos so: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ phaṭḥ ma 'di nas lho nub mtshams shed na: ma la ya zhes gling gi cha: nye ba'i dur khrod u tsa la: bam ri thod pa'i sku mkhar klong : laṅka srin po sprin ltar gtibs: sha za gdong dmar rlung ltar 'tshubs: de 'dra 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog tu: yum chen thugs kyi sras gcig ma: gsang ba ye shes de ru bzhugs: ye shes mtsho rgyal de ru bzhugs: khros ma nag mo de ru bzhugs: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi de ru bzhugs:

gnas nyul shugs 'gro de ru bzhugs: las kyi ma mo de ru bzhugs: de 'dra 'jigs pa'i dur khrod nas: tshogs bdag chen mo tshogs la byon: sha chen bam gyi mchod pa bzhes: ltag sprod thod rngas spyan 'dren no: mi rkang gling bus spyan 'dren no: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro da gshegs shig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ spyan drangs la rang rig dang dbyer med gcig tu gyur par bsam: phaṭḥ ma dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma: sku mdog smug nag mdangs dang ldan: phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi rdeb: gling bzhi ri rab chol bur 'debs: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus: dbang du bsdus la zil gyis gnon: g.yon pas mi rkang gling bu 'bud: bus pas srid gsum kun kyang sngangs: gnas gdon lus gdon dbang du sdus: pho gdon rgyal po dbang du sdus: mo gdon 'dre mo dbang du sdus: yul 'dre 'byung po dbang du sdus: dbang du bsdus la zil gyis gnon: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : skad cig nyid la da 'dus shig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas snang srid lha srin thams cad dbang med du 'dus par bsam: de nas mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul bya ba ni: phaṭḥ ma skye med bde chen mkha' 'gro ma: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: gsang ba yum chen sprul pa ste: ye shes rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbang sdud nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: drag mo'i gnyan 'bod sha ra ra: phra men las byed khyugs se khyug: tshogs bdag chen mo tshogs la byon: dur khrod bam gyi mchod pa bzhes: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus: phaṭḥ ma skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ma cig sku yi sprul pa ni: ḍākki bde chen dkar mo ste: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbang sdud nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: drag mo'i gnyan 'bod sha ra ra: phra men las byed khyugs se khyug: tshogs bdag chen mo tshogs la byon: dur khrod bam gyi mchod pa bzhes: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus:

phaṭḥ ma skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ma cig gsung gi sprul pa ni: ḍākki dmar mo sgra sgrogs tai: padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbang sdud nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: drag mo'i gnyan 'bod sha ra ra: phra men las byed khyugs se khyug: tshogs bdag chen mo tshogs la byon: dur khrod bam gyi mchod pa bzhes: snang srid lha srin dbang du sdus: phaṭḥ ma skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ma cig thugs kyi sprul pa ni: ḍākki khros ma nag mo ste: sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbang sdud nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: drag mo'i gnyan 'bod sha ra ra: phra men las byed khyugs se khyug: tshogs bdag chen mo tshogs la byon: dur khrod bam gyi mchod pa bzhes: snang srid lha srin dbang du sdus: phaṭḥ ma skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ma cig yon tan sprul pa ni: ḍākki ser mo don grub ste: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbang sdud nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: drag mo'i gnyan 'bod sha ra ra: phra men las byed khyugs se khyug: tshogs bdag chen mo tshogs la byon: dur khrod bam gyi mchod pa bzhes: snang srid lha srin dbang du sdus: phaṭḥ ma skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ma cig phrin las sprul pa ni: ḍākki sna tshogs mthar phyin ste: karma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbang sdud nyams dbyangs 'u ru ru: drag mo'i gnyan 'bod sha ra ra: phra men las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus: phaṭḥ

de nas rang nyid thugs ka nas las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis gri gug dang bhandha thogs pa grangs med par 'phros nas baṃ gyi cha thams cad so sor phral zhing dum bur gtubs nas: mchod yul gong ma dang sbyin yul 'og ma rnams la bsngos par bsam: rang gi lag g.yas kyi sor mo lnga ging pho lnga g.yon lnga ging mo lnga bsam zhing gtor ba'i tshul bya: phaṭḥ ma mkha' spyod dpa' bo sprin ltar gtibs: ḍākki rgya mtsho glog ltar 'khyugs: sde brgyad dmar po rlung ltar 'tshubs: ging chen las byed mun ltar gtibs: 'byung po mi min chu ltar khol: sha gzan bya ltar lding zhing 'jums: khrag 'thung gad mo lhang lhang dgod: rus mur mche ba krig krig rngam: lhag nyul rkan sgra thag thag rdeb: 'tshub cing gtibs pa'i dmag tshogs la: ti ra bam gyi mchod pa 'bul: phaṭḥ pags pa bshus shig pho nya mo: mgo bo chod cig zangs gri ma: yan lag phrol cig phra men ma: nang rol drongs shig sha za ma: gtubs shig chod cig khrag 'thung ma: mchod cig phul cig las byed ma: sbyin zhig gtor cig gnas nyul ma: tshim par byos shig dur khrod ma: lhag mar dbang zhig nyul le ma: da lta nyid du mchod cing bsngo: phaṭḥ rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum phrag rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: gter bdag gzhi bdag ma lus rnams: bam chen tshogs la da rol cig: phud bdag rnams kyis phud bzhes shig: tshogs bdag rnams kyis tshogs bzhes shig: lhag sdud rnams kyis lhag sdus shig: phaṭḥ mgo bo steng phyogs lha yis khyer: lha yi dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: mgrin pa bar snang gza' yis khyer: gza' yi dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: khog stod ya bdud bgegs kyis khyer:

bgegs kyi dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: sked pa bar snang srin pos khyer: srin po'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: khog smad sa bdag rgyal pos khyer: sa bdag dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: lag g.yas dri za'i rgyal pos khyer: dri za'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: lag g.yon me lha rgyal pos khyer: me lha'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: rkang g.yas gnod sbyin rgyal pos khyer: gnod sbyin dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: rkang g.yon dbang ldan rgyal pos khyer: dbang ldan dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: don snying dpe dkar rgyal pos khyer: dpe dkar dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: glo ba btsan rje rgyal pos khyer: btsan gyi dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: srog rtsa gshin rje rgyal pos khyer: gshin rje'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: mchin pa bdud rje rgyal pos khyer: bdud kyi dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: mtsher pa dmu bdud rgyal pos khyer: dmu yi dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: pho long dam can rgyal pos khyer: the'u rang dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: mkhal nag ma mo sman gyis khyer: ma mo'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: mkhal dkar mo 'dre srin mos khyer: mo 'dre'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: rgyu ma klu bdud rgyal pos khyer: klu bdud dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: mkhris pa sha za rgyal pos khyer: sha za'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: sha chen ban byad rnams kyi khyer: ban byad dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: khrag chen bon byad rnams kyi khyer: bon byad dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: rtsa rgyus nad bdag rnams kyis khyer: nad bdag dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: chu rgyus lam 'dre 'khyams po'i khyer: lam 'dre'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: pags pa bse rag 'byung pos khyer: 'gong po'i dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: keng rus lhag sdud rnams kyis khyer: lhag sdud dmag tshogs tshim gyur cig: dur khrod bdag mo'i pho nya ba: dur bya dur phag dur khyi dang :

dur gyi ce spyang lag ring sogs: gnyan sa dur khrod 'di nyid la: gnas pa'i dregs pa che phra dang : 'byung po ming nas ma smos sogs: khyab par rgyu ba ma lus rnams: baṃ chen tshogs la dgyes par rol: sha 'dod rnams kyis sha zo la: khrag 'dod rnams kyis khrag 'thungs shig: rus 'dod rnams kyis rus 'chos la: skra nyag ma tsam yang med par mdzod: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas srid pa'i rtse mo dang mnar med yan chod kyi mgron rigs rnams sha khrag mchod pas dgyes shing tshims ha ha'i gad mo dang bcas pas mnyes par bsam: de nas lhag ma'am phran bu zag pa'i rigs rnams khas zhan gral du ma 'khod pa rnams la sbyin pa ni: phaṭḥ 'dir 'dus shig glo bur lhags pa yi: khas zhan dang dbang chung zha long lkugs: ma go dang ma thos ma mthong zhing : tshe rabs su rnam smin 'khor ba'i rigs: sdug bsngal gyi rdzing bu bskyil ba rnams: bam tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di khyer la: 'dod yon gyi longs spyod thob nas su: sdang sems kyi 'tshe ba rab zhi zhing : phan dge yi lam bzang ston mdzad des: rigs drug kun sdug bsngal zhi ba dang : byang chub kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ sha khrag lhag med du rol nas khas zhan dang dbang chung rigs rnams kyang byang chub thob nas dbang chen du gyur par bsam: de nas bdud rtsi dkar 'gyed bya ba ni: rang lus sngar ltar ro de che ba tsho ba dkar la snum pa zhig tu bskyed nas thams cad dkar phyogs la mos par bsam: phaṭḥ rang rig mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal ni: zhi 'dzum mdzes ldan dkar gsal gzi brjid 'bar: dbu skra lcang lo thor tshugs rigs lngas brgyan: zil bu'i lhag ma 'phyang bas sku rgyab kheb: phyag g.yas seng ldeng ḍā ru nam mkhar 'khrol: g.yon pas dngul dkar dril bu snyan 'gyur sgrog: dar mtshon sna lnga spel ba'i na bza' bklubs: rin chen rus rgyan g.yer kha'i 'ur skad 'byin: me long dang ni sngags kyi rgya rtags 'chang :

phyed skyil ling tsam mkha' la gar ba'i nyams: dbyings rig 'ja' lus mkha' spyod ngang du gsal: phaṭḥ mdun du stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i dbus: bhandha lcang lo skra yi ba dan can: mtshan ldan nang du rang lus bdud rtsi ni: dkar zhing 'khyil ba zlum pa'i gzi 'od can: ro bcud kun ldan zag med bdud rtsi ni: rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: mchog gi rig 'dzin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs: yi dam rgyud sde lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: bla med 'bras bu thob par byin gyis rlobs: ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: rten 'brel phyogs med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs: dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: dam tshig nyams chag sel bar byin gyis rlobs: chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: gcod yul bstan pa bsrung bar byin gyis rlobs: nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: skye 'gro longs spyod 'phel bar byin gyis rlobs: lha srin sde brgyad rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: gdug sems phrag dog zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: 'dzam gling bkra shis 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs: rigs drug pha ma rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: lan chags bu lon 'khor bar byin gyis rlobs: bgegs rigs 'byung po rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: sha 'khon sdig sgrib byang bar byin gyis rlobs: tshe rabs 'brel thogs rnams kyi zhal du 'bul: dkor sgrib rnam smin byang bar byin gyis rlobs: khas zhan glo bur lhags pa'i zhal du 'bul: zad med longs spyod thob par byin gyis rlobs: srid pa bar do'i sems can zhal du 'bul: ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs par byin gyis rlobs: kun kyang mchod sbyin 'di yis tshims byas nas: bla med byang chub lam bzang rnyed pa dang : theg chen sa bcu'i rtse mor rab bsnyegs nas: pad 'byung yab yum go 'phang thob par shog:

phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces bdud rtsi la longs spyad de thams cad byang chub kyi sems rgyud la skye bar bsam: de nas chos 'chad cing lam bstan pa ni: thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang yang dag pa la 'god pa ni: rang nyid gnas 'gyur te rje btsun gu ru padma 'byung gnas yab yum zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang kha sbyor gyi rnam pas: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ hoḥ rang rig gi ngo bo ka dag 'di: rje btsun gyi rgyal po padma 'byung : zung 'jug gi rang bzhin dbyangs can ma: thabs shes kun ye nas 'bral med la: snod bcud kun gnyis su mi lta zhing : phan byed kyi lha dang gnod byed kyi bgegs: rjes shes kyi dran pa so mar zhog: zhe sdang 'di rtsa bral gyi me long la: chu zla ltar sgyu ma shes par gyis: nga rgyal gyi khengs pa mnyam pa nyid: gnas lugs la bdag gzhan ris med spyod: gti mug kun mtshan bral gyi 'od gsal la: kun gzhi la 'khor 'das ga la yod: 'dod chags kun so so ru don rtogs nas: chags bya dang chags byed med par spyod: phrag dog ces mtshan 'dzin du ji ltar grub: gnad don 'dis 'gro kun gyi bya ba grub: phyi yul gyi tshogs drug lha 'dre rnams: rang sems kyi cho 'phrul yin par shes: sngon dbang gi las la grub pa yi: rnam rtog gi lha 'dre a 'thas rnams: rtsa bral gyi shes pa gtan la phob: tshe rabs su 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i tshogs: dus da len du yang dag gi don rtogs nas: bzang 'dzin gyi lha la mi re zhing : ngan 'dzin gyi bdud la mi dogs par: dri med kyi rig pa gtan la phob: mtho srid rtse nas mnar med yan chod kyi: dbyings rig gi sbubs su 'khod pa rnams: nges don gyi gcod yul don rtogs nas: drang don gyi dmigs gtad mi 'tshal bar: snod gzugs kun gcig dril thim nas kyang : skye med kyi rig pa a dkar de: zung 'jug gi yab yum mkhar brgyud nas: stong nyid kyi rtsol med lam zhugs te:

zang thal du kun bzang gi mkha' ru thim: 'khrul med kyi mngon sangs rgyas par shog: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces pas lha 'dre rnams dran rig gnas su phebs te: gcod yul rnams kyis dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ltar mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus te thim: mthar lha 'dre thams cad 'dus pa'i a dkar po zhig tu gyur nas rang nyid pad 'byung yab yum gyi thugs kar bsdus te dbu ma'i lam brgyud nas rlung dal gcig 'bud pa dang : a de sna bug nas thon te dpal kun tu bzang po'i thugs kar thim par bsams la: cung zad mnyam par bzhag: de nas rang dang nad pa'i rnam par shes pa ni: rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas rim par mar phab nas snying khar bsdu: phaṭḥ rang rig mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas rnam shes mar phab pa zhabs kyi mtheb srin nas don te spyi bor thim pas snying gar 'od dmar mdangs dang bcas chags par gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas spyi bo'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams rang la thim: rang nyid snang stong sgyu ma dang chu zla bral ba bzhin: 'ja' tshon nam mkha'i dkyil du ldog pa ltar ci yang mi gnas pa lhod kyis mnyam bzhag bya'o: de nas rjes kyi bya ba bsngo smon gyis rgyas gdab pa ni: phaṭḥ na moḥ chos sku yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin ma: mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes: bde chen las kyi dbang mo: ḍākki nyi zla dngos grub: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: gu ru shrī singha: slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen: pha brgyud padma 'byung gnas: ma brgyud ye shes mtsho rgyal: sras brgyud sangs rgyas ye shes: 'gro mgon rtsa gsum gling pa: chos sku mthing 'od 'bar ma: longs sku rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: sprul sku seng gdong drag mo: rdo rje bde chen dkar mo: rin chen ser mo don 'grub: padma dmar mo lcags sgrog: karma sna tshogs mthar phyin: buddha khros ma nag mo: gter srung dbang gi ḍākki la sogs pa: grub thob gcod yul brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs par mdzad du gsol:

rgyu ma rig pa'i gti mug: lam 'dod chags kyi 'khri ba: 'bras bu zhe sdang dang khong khro: rkyen tshe rabs kyi lan chags: nad bgegs srin dang 'byung pos cho 'phrul: 'byung 'khrugs rlung mkhris dang bad kan 'dus pa bzhi: gdon pho gdon dang mo 'dre: gza' klu rgyal po rnams gcod yul gdams pa zab mo 'di la brten nas: da lta nyid du zhi bar mdzod cig: myur ba nyid du zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol: thogs bcas bdud las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs shig: thogs med bdud la bsre nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: rkyen thog tu ro snyom nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: snang ba bdud gcod nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: re dogs spang blang zad nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: snang ba sku gsum du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs shig: pho gdon gyis chos sku thob par byin gyis rlobs shig: mo gdon gyis longs sku thob par byin gyis rlobs shig: spyi gdon gyis sprul sku thob par byin gyis rlobs shig: lha 'drer 'gro don nus par byin gyis rlobs shig: gnyan sa ri khrod zin par byin gyis rlobs shig: dgra gnyen phyogs ris bral bar byin gyis rlobs shig: tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig: 'ja' lus chos sku 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig: gcod yul bstan pa mtha' ru rgyas par byin gyis rlobs shig: lus la sku yis byin gyis rlobs shig: ngag la gsung gis byin gyis rlobs shig: yid la thugs kyis byin gyis rlobs shig: mchog thun gyi 'bras bu 'grub par byin gyis rlobs shig: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ phaṭḥ gcod yul zab mo'i nyams len gyis: 'gro kun srid mtsho las sgrol zhing : rnam mkhyen thar pa'i lam zhugs nas: kun kyang byang chub myur thob shog: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces pas rang gnas su gshegs la nad par gang rung gi srung ba yod na 'dogs te 'gro dgos pa rnams la gcod khrid yin na srung ba med par:

me dang zhun sgron spangs te: lha 'dre'i phyogs su mgo gtad la nyal: ri gcod yin na skyabs yul lam bzang bsam ngan gzhig ci yang med par nyal: rmi lam bzang ngan gang mi brtag cho 'phrul sna tshogs ky-i rtags ni: steng nas ri zhig 'og nas mtsho rdol pha ma spun zla dang bral yang mi langs shing skad mi smra: zhag gang tsam gcaud bya yang : zang zing le lo ru mi btang : phyi lhong lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul byung na snang srid sems kyi rol par shes par bya: nang lhong sems kyi cho 'phrul zug ngu byung na rnam rtog sgyu ma yin par shes par bya: gsang lhong lus kyi na tsha byung na nad ro snyom bya zhing na dga' shi skyed spro ba shin tu che bar bya: mi mthun grogs su 'khyer: ltas ngan g.yang du len: bar chad dngos grub tu myong : lha 'dre grogs su btsal: lha srin yon bdag tu brten: mi rung pa kun la thog brdzis bya: khyad par nyams len gtso bor 'don: thogs bcas bdud la 'dzem zhes pas: rbab la khad kyi rdo: nyil la khad kyi sa dang gangs ri: chad la khad kyi lam: rdeb la khad kyi brag phug: 'gyel la khad kyi shing : phyur la khad kyi mtsho: mi rgod dam gcan gzan gdug pa'i 'gyu srang : dgra dang chom po sogs thogs bcas bdud las spang : de ltar zhib tu blta ba'i dus: sngar med par byung na lhong yin pas rtogs pa lhod kyis rang babs su bzhag: cho 'phrul gyi rigs rnams la snying rje bsgom pas stong sangs kyis yal nas lta ba'i gdeng tshud pas cho 'phrul mi 'byung ngo : byung yang mi 'jigs: gcod ces bya ba ni: lta ba yi bogs 'don pa dang : rtogs pa'i gdeng len pa'i chad du bgyis pa ste: lus srog phangs pa med kyi rnal 'byor pa la: tshe 'dir snang gi 'khri ba chod pa dang : tshe phyi ma'i g.yang sa chod ces gsungs: de ltar gcod yul zab mo nyams su blangs pa'i rnal 'byor la: mchog thun gyi 'bras bu 'grub nges pas the tshom med par nyams su longs shig:

gzhan yang dmigs 'bum rgyas pa ni gang rung nas blangs kyang rung : rgyun gyi nyams len dgos pa'i rigs cha tshang zhing don dril pa dang : dmar 'gyed dur gcod rnams ni zur du gcod gzhung nas blang : kha tshar dmigs pa gang nas 'jug kyang rung de ni go rim gsal bar bkod pa'o:

sa ma ya: e ma zab pa'i mthar thug yid bzhin nor bu las: gcod yul zab mo gsang ba snying thig ni: snang srid lha 'dre ar la gtad pa'i thabs: brtul zhugs spobs pas snang srid khyon 'gengs 'di: bud med ye shes mtsho rgyal bdag gis bris: ke'u ri gsang ba phug gi gnas su sbas: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma ru: kho mo'i thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: bka' yi rgya 'di ma mo gsum gyis srungs: dam nyams bdud rigs log lta can la gsang : gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: them rgya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing shing sbrul lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser las zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ ga) ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: phrin las sgrub pa ka la'i dbyangs ring bzhugs so: de nas bsgrub pa'i phrin las gzhung du 'jug pa ni: dang po ni: na mo: bde chen rab dga' ye shes g.yo ba'i mchog: grol lam pho nya'i bde stong bskyed pa'i phyir: nyon mongs rab dben chags med zung 'jug can: mchog gi dpal mo'i sku la skyabs su mchi: gnyis pa: hoḥ dga' ba rab g.yo mchog gi dga' ba ster: dga' bral lhan skyes dga' ba'i gzi 'od 'byin: dga' ma dbyangs can dpa' mo bsgrub pa'i phyir: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten par sems bskyed do: gsum pa: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi nang mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon khengs shing : 'dun pas bsgyur zhing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: phyi mchod sna bdun nang mchod sman raka phud: pañtsa mchog gi mchod pa bla med spel: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na king ni ri ti bha su ta āḥhūm̐: gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: hūm̐ spha ra na phaṭḥ

saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: kro ti ḍākki nī: ru tra ti ra baṃ: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo: hūm̐: e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa: dbyings kyi rang bzhin gdengs kha che: rtse mo phra ba thur du zug: de dbus zla gam zlum po'i nang : rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas gsal: om̐ sarba ga ga he dhā tu ko3 haṃ: sarba kā ye bhi wa shu mūm̐ hrīḥlam̐ tam̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas gzhal yas khang rgyan rdzogs su legs par ltos so: ko lakṣa ka ro ṭa: hūm̐ bhyoḥ gzhal yas phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: mtshan tshang gdan bcas bskyed pa'i dbus: ma cig thugs rje khros ma'i sku: mthing nag khro zhing rab tu rngam: ngur ba'i phag zhal spyi bor brgyan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum la gshe: sgeg pa dgod pa dpa' mo'i chas: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rtse gsum tri shul gru mor brten: chas ni dur khrod rgyan dang ldan: brkyang bskum gar gyi nyams gyur can: 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ri ni sa las: bzhi ldan phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang drag mo'i chas: bskyed pa'i gtso mo lta bur gsal: om̐ badzra ratna padma karma buddha badzra wā ra hī hūm̐ bhyoḥ de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: ma cig thugs rje khros ma la: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: yang 'khor ḍākki bye ba 'bum: zhing dang nye zhing ma lus nas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur phyir: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: gus pas phyag 'tshal gdung bas dad: yum chen dam pas dgyes brtse bas: sgo gsum dag pa chen por bsgyur: rab tu dwang bas bstod par bgyi: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ

na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ sarba ḍākki pū ra hūm̐: badzra a gad ṭa hūm̐: na mo kro ti kau rī hūm̐: na mo badzra sarba kā ya wākka tsitta shuddhe hoḥ na mo ḍākki nī lam kau rī rā ga sarba wi ṭa hūm̐: de nas bgyis pa'i mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba ni: spyan drangs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams nyi zla padma'i steng du zhabs khro bo rol pa'i gar dang bcas te bdag la dgyes pa'i tshul du bzhugs: bdag gi kyang de nas bzung gsang ba'i lha mo nyid dang grogs mo'i dgyes chags kyi nyams su sems: rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par 'phros: phyi nang gi mchod pa la phog: mchod rdzas phyi mchod kyi lha mo bcu drug gis rang rang gis: mchod sprin thog pas dbyangs dang bcas 'bod pa'i nyams kyis phul: nang mchod rnams kyang rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar ltar yon tan kun tshang gi ngo bor gsal bas dgyes par 'bul: phrin las de'i 'du tshan gyis byed pos bdag sgrub pa po la mchog thun gyi dngos grub ma lus bde blag tu bstsal bar bsgom: hūm̐: phyi mchod lha mo rab dga' bcu drug gis: dpag yas sprin ltar gtibs pa'i 'dod yon tshogs: chags pa'i dbyangs dang rang bzhin brda skad kyis: bskul bas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: badzra lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa t-i pū dza āḥhūm̐: nang mchod rnams la: hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo ya kha 'khyil ba'i nang : bdud rtsi bcud ldan dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang po: bum ril snod du rakta chi li li: dung khang zhal bur bha ling ri ltar spungs: rin chen snod mchog dza gad phyur ru ru: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings la bsnyegs: sman phud la sogs kha mngar skyur ba'i ro: ster ba'i rdzas bcud bla med bskyed pa 'di:

yum chen thugs rje khros ma'i zhal du 'bul: sku sprul bde chen dkar mo dgyes phyir 'bul: gsung sprul dmar mo sgra sgrogs dgyes phyir 'bul: thugs sprul gsang ba ye shes dgyes phyir 'bul: phrin las sna tshogs mthar phyin dgyes phyir 'bul: yang sprul ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes pas dgongs shing brtse bas bzhes nas kyang : bla med gsang ba ye shes don rtogs shing : dgyes pa'i grogs su ḍākkis dbugs dbyung stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta n+yaṃ sarba ga ṇa la tsakra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi bdud rtsi 'di: zag med bde ba bskyed pa'i rdzas: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ 'og min mkha' spyod zhing mchog nas: thugs rje bskul ba'i yum chen mo: drag mo khros ma nag mo'i sku: shin tu gtum pa'i rngam byed ma: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: mtshon cha 'bar ba phyag na thogs: drag mo khro gnyer sgeg pa mo: zhabs gnyis gyad 'gros sa gsum g.yo: gtum mo g.yul las rgyal byed ma: rab 'jigs dpa' mo nyid la bstod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dkar mo zhi ba'i 'od zer can: ser mo rgyas pa'i gad rgyangs can: dmar mo dbang gi mdangs chags ma: ljang mo bdud las rab rgyal ma: yang sprul mo rnams 'tsher du 'bar: rgyan rnams sku la rab tu rdzogs: gtsigs pa'i gdong la khro gnyer rngam: 'jigs pa'i gar rnams shin tu bsgyur: khro zhing brtse bas dgod pa mo: rigs bzhi yang sprul tshogs la bstod: badzra pu ru sha ya hoḥ sngags chings dmigs rkang ni: rang nyid yum chen thugs rje khros ma nag mor gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag spus bris pa tsam gsal zhing sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba'i tshe: sngags kyi rang sgra las bung ba rtsi bcud la myong ba'i dgongs pa ltar rang sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam:

sngags phreng de nyid gnyis mched kyi rnam pas lus kyi nang thams cad khengs: slar yang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pa'i snang srid thams cad khyab ste: phyogs bcu'i zhing mu med par mchod pa phul: de rnams kyis byin rlabs thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus te: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par rang la thim pas dbang bzhi thob: sgrib bzhi dag: sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la skyes par bsam: slar yang 'od zer 'phros skye 'gro snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad 'od zer lnga ldan lcags kyus bsdus te rang la thim pas rang nyid kyang bkrag mdangs gzi brjid thams cad ches cher 'bar bar bsgom: slar yang sngags phreng 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa me yi rang bzhin can 'phros: snod bcud thams cad gang zhing bdud bgegs 'byung po thams cad sbur ma mes khyer ltar bsregs: de rnams kyi tshe bsod bsdus te rang la thim pas nus pa'i shugs bskyed: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad mkha' 'gro zhi ba dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis gtams par bsam: de nas rtsa bsnyen mkha' 'gro rigs 'dus ni: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa sarba karma hūm̐ phaṭḥ mkha' 'gro dbang sdud sngags ni: om̐ baṃ badzra wā ra hī ḍākki kā li ha ri ni sa pa shaṃ ma ma thun har har tsaka tsaka swā hā: zhes rdzas 'khor sngags: mkha' 'gro yid 'phrog sngags ni: om̐ ḍākki kā li bi dhe dha ri ha ri ni sa hūm̐ bhyo: mkha' 'gro bde ba g.yo ba'i sngags ni: om̐ ḍākki su khaṃ ha ri ni sa rā ga dha ra thun thun: mkha' 'gro rnams 'bral mi phod pa'i sngags ni: om̐ ḍākki ha ri ni sa mu la pa shaṃ dza dzaḥ mkha' 'gro dbang bsgyur gyi sngags ni: a swa ra swa ra tī ku ru kulle yo gi ni pa shaṃ sarba 'dus 'dus swā hā: zhes pa'i sngags rnams rang gang mos ltar so so kha bsgyur sogs gang rigs bya bar 'os: de nas dbang bzhi blang ba ni: bum pa bhandha me long gtor tshogs rdzas kyi dngos grub bcas thogs nas:

hūm̐: bde chen g.yo ba mchog gi mdzes 'phro ma: gsang gsum rab dga' cha shas sngo bsangs ma: gang gus gdung bas nā da rab tu g.yo: mthong na mi mthun spang ba'i ga ṇa'i dpyid: 'dzan po kun kyang yid kyu'i rab dkar bsu: chu gter rlabs su 'dar ma'i phreng ba yi: ka ti ka yi 'khor lo rab bskul ba: rā sa me yi brdas bskul sgra skad kyis: rtsi bcud myong ba'i ro mchog ci bzhin du: zag med lha mo khyod kyi phrin las mdzod: cha shas 'dab brgya'i utpal dri bsung gis: g.yo la rtag tu kun snang ngoms med bzhin: yid bzhin dpa' mo khyod kyis bsu bar mdzod: oṃ: ha las grub pa'i bum pa bdud rtsi bcud: riḥ bhandha zag med mkha' dbyings khyon dang ldan: niḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma sring 'ja' ltar lhags: saḥ 'dod yon kun ldan mchog gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pas dbang bzhi blang : rjes shes ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: snang srid thams cad mkha' 'gro'i zhing : rang lus 'byung ba bsdus bcas bral: sgra rnams brag cha'i gdangs bzhin snang : 'gyu ba dran rig ka dag ngang : rol rtsal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: gsal stong 'dzin med lam du shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes pas gzhi yi rgyal po gnas par bya'o: sa ma ya: kho bo sngags 'chang rtsa gsum gling pas me sprel lo 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shog ser las zhal bshus so// //'di nyid gter gzhung du 'dug kyang dbu mjug gi yig chung rnams ma tshang bar snang ngo*// // nga) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs bskang ba mu tig phreng ba bzhugs so: gsang ba ye shes bdag med rdo rje'i sgra: skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba chos kyi dbyings: kun byed ma ṇis 'khor 'das yongs la khyab: mi bskyod bral ba'i rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang mkha' 'gro 'bum bskang bya ba ni:

thog mar dus dang gnas skabs sogs gcod gzhung spyi dang mtshungs shing : bye brag tshogs bskang bya ba ni: ḍā ru rkang gling dril bu mda' dar me long rigs lnga cod pan dom ra rus rgyan rtags sam gri gug thod phor kha ṭwāṃ maṇḍal: tshogs mchod tshogs gdan g.yang gzhi: phud phor thod ting zur gsum lha grangs: mchog phur gyi mañdzi gsum thod skam gyi tog yod pa: mchog phran gyi bran thur: gzhan yang sha chen gyi gsur sogs drag mchod: rigs gang 'dzoms mkho ba'i yo byad kyi rdzas ci 'byor bshams: de nas tshogs mchod ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: gsum/ phaṭḥ gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ phaṭḥ gsum/ de rnams kyis sbyangs spel bsgyur gsum gyi dmigs pa bya: phaṭ gsum gyis spel ba'o: rol mo btang zhing dang po dngos gzhi ni: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyo maḥ rang nyid yum chen thugs ka nas: yi ge ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gsum 'phros: ram̐ḥgyis dngos 'dzin thams cad bsregs: yam̐ḥgyis bag chags ma lus gtor: kham̐ḥgyis gtsang rmer 'dzin pa 'khrud: phaṭ kyis rtog med gcig tu bsre: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces bsregs sbyangs gtor nas ro gcig tu bsres pas dngos po dag cing gtsang bar bsgom: bhyoḥ ma ka nas dag pa'i bhandha ru: dpa' bo dpa' mo dgyes pa'i rdzas: la brten 'dod yon tshogs kyis bkang : om̐ gyis byin brlabs gtor gzhong snod: āḥyis byin brlabs 'jig rten bcud: hūm̐ gis byin brlabs dpag med spel: 'bru drug ro drug nus ldan gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces phyi nang snod bcud mchod pa'i ngo bor bsam: de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni: bhyo maḥ spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du: rig 'dzin rje btsun chen po la: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re:

zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ 'og min mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: yum chen shes rab phar phyin la: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ rnam dag longs sku'i zhing khams nas: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro la: rnal 'byor mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug:

snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ bde chen lhun grub zhing khams nas: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal la: sa spyod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ u tsa la yi dur khrod nas: ma cig khros ma nag mo la: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod nas: ma cig bde chen dkar mo la:

rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ lho phyogs gad rgyangs dur khrod nas: ma cig ser mo don 'grub la: rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ nub phyogs pad brtsegs dur khrod nas: ma cig dmar mo sgra sgrogs la: padma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li:

tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ byang phyogs ku la'i dur khrod nas: ma cig sna tshogs mthar phyin la: las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ shar lho rab rgyu dur khrod nas: brgyud 'dzin 'jig rten mkha' 'gro ma: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung :

tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ lho nub gtum pa'i dur khrod nas: za byed sha za mkha' 'gro la: srog gcod mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ nub byang kun rgyu'i dur khrod nas: phra men dur khrod mkha' 'gro la: dbugs len mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ byang shar shin rgyu dur khrod nas: gnas nyul dus mtshan mkha' 'gro la: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor:

tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ shar du zhi ba'i las mdzad phyir: drag mo seṅge'i gdong can la: dkar mo 'gugs byed 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ lho ru rgyas pa'i las mdzad phyir: drag mo stag gi gdong can la: ser mo 'ching byed 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re:

mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ nub tu dbang gi las mdzad phyir: drag mo dom gyi gdong can la: dmar mo sdom byed 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ byang phyogs drag po'i las mdzad phyir: drag mo phag gi gdong can la: myos byed mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul:

bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol: bhyo maḥ pho brang phyi nang khor yug la: mi pham rdo rje gtum mo la: 'bum phrag grangs med mkha' 'gro'i bskor: tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldem: dar gyi cod pan pu ru ru: ḍā ru cang te'u khro lo lo: mi rkang gling bu tse re re: zhing chen g.yang gzhi shams se sham: sha chen dud pa chi li li: tshil chen zhun mar ta la la: bam chen tshogs 'khor ye re re: mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dpa' bo'i gar byed shigs se shig: dpa' mo'i glu len kyu ru ru: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: snang srid lha srin spungs se spung : tshogs bdag chen po tshogs la byon: do nub dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul: bskang ngo ma sring thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur mchog thun dngos grub stsol:

de nas chas kyi bskang ba ni: bhyo maḥ chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i pho brang nas: rnam dag 'gags pa med pa'i lam ston ma: yum chen shes rab phar phyin thugs dam bskang : thugs rje 'pho 'gyur med pa'i pho brang nas: rnam dag dam tshig gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : zab lam ka dag bde stong pho brang nas: 'od lus sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar sgyur ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : dbus phyogs gtum drag tshal gyi dur khrod nas: yum chen thugs sprul khros ma nag po'i sku: sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : shar phyogs me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: yum chen sku sprul bde chen dkar mo'i sku: rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs rlung nag 'tshub rgyas dur khrod nas: yum chen yon tan ser mo don 'grub sku: rin chen mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : nub phyogs chu klung 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas: yum chen gsung sprul dmar mo sgra sgrogs sku: padma mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : byang phyogs nags tshing g.yo ba'i dur khrod nas: yum chen phrin las sna tshogs mthar phyin sku: las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : mtshams dang khor yug nyer bzhi'i dur khrod nas: yum chen yang sprul sna tshogs ḍākki ma: grangs med mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : bskangs nas dam tshig nyams pa sos su gsol: hūm̐ bhyo maḥ mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi las kyi rgya rtags phyir: dbu skra ral pa dbyings su bskyod pa la: rig 'dzin dbang rtags rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: do nub dam bskang tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: 'gal 'khrul bshags nas nyes ltung bsal du gsol: maḥ spyi bor phag zhal nag po ngur ba la: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum:

thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa ru: rigs lnga'i 'gro don rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dar tshon sna lnga'i cod pan 'phur ba la: dbyings rig 'du 'bral med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: spyan rtsa dmar zlum glog ltar 'gyu ba la: thugs rjes phyogs bcur gzigs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: shangs nas drag po'i rlung dmar 'tshubs pa la: ma rig dbyings su gtor ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs pa la: srid gsum dgyes par rol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: snyan nas drag po'i 'brug stong ldir ba la: chos nyid rang sgra sgrog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: do nub dam bskang tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: 'gal 'khrul bshags nas nyes ltung bsal du gsol: maḥ a ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba la: shes bya'i bud shing bsregs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhag gi zo ris thal chen khrag thig la: dur khrod mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar phyar ba la: nyon mongs srog rtsa gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: g.yon pas bhandha bum ril bsnams pa la: 'khor ba'i klad khrag rol pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: glang chen ko rlon stod du g.yogs pa la: gti mug gnas su dag pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sked la dkris pa ru: nga rgyal mtshan ma dag pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: sbrul rigs lnga yis lhu tshigs brgyan pa la: zhe sdang 'khrul 'dzin gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs bklubs pa la: phrag dog mtshan ma zhig pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba ru: 'dod chags srid pa gtor ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum gru mor bsten pa la: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: skye rga na 'chi'i thod pas brgyan pa la: srid gsum 'khrul rgyun gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: me long rin chen g.yer khas brgyan pa la:

rnam rtog dbyings su grol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: brkyang bskum zhabs kyis bam ro brdzis pa ni: rtog med don dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: padma nyi zla'i khri gdan brtsegs pa ni: skyon bral yon tan rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: me ri dmar nag dbus su 'gyings pa ni: ye shes dbyings su rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dur khrod pho brang klong du bzhugs pa ni: 'khor 'das sgyu mar rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: do nub dam skong tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes: 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nyes ltung bsal du gsol: de nas rdzas kyi bskang ba ni: bhyoḥ ma dur khrod gnas yul spyod par gshegs tsa na: snang srid thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i phyir: gtum mo dom gyi sbub ras thugs dam bskang : rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i thugs dam bskul ba'i phyir: thod pa ltag sprod phyag rgyas thugs dam bskang : rtag tu ma rig mun pa bsal ba'i phyir: dri med 'od ldan me long thugs dam bskang : nyams dbyangs lta gdeng gdangs kyi rgyun chag phyir: sgra snyan dngul dkar dril bus thugs dam bskang : ma sring mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'bod pa'i phyir: mchog chen gri rkang gling bus thugs dam bskang : lha srin sde brgyad dbang du bsdu ba'i phyir: gdong dmar zhing chen g.yang gzhis thugs dam bskang : rtag tu ro snyom rdzas la spyod pa'i phyir: bhandha lcang lo 'phyangs pas thugs dam bskang : nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir: dpal ldan mdung rtse gsum pas thugs dam bskang : zag med bde bas yum dang sbyor ba'i phyir: 'khor lo bzhi ldan ga shas thugs dam bskang : dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs dpon yin pa'i phyir: rus rgyan g.yer kha spras pas thugs dam bskang : dus min rdo rje srin po sba ba'i phyir: mu kha ang rag g.yogs pas thugs dam bskang : dregs pa thams cad las la bskul ba'i phyir:

rtsal chen stag gi sham thabs thugs dam bskang : bka' brgyud rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtib pa'i phyir: rigs lnga dar dpyangs thod pas thugs dam bskang : ma sring mkha' 'gro'i glu bro gar bsgyur phyir: mda' dar sna tshogs gzugs pas thugs dam bskang : rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i phyir: 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang : snang srid dkyil 'khor pho brang rdzogs pa'i phyir: maṇḍal bsod nams rgyu 'tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'phang med sbyin pas 'gro don mthar phyin phyir: ti ra bam chen bsnyil bas thugs dam bskang : gnas yul zhing skyong phra men dgyes pa'i phyir: klad khrag zhag g.yo 'khyil bas thugs dam bskang : ma cig dbang sdud drag mo yin pa'i phyir: dur khrod dpal chas gar dgus thugs dam bskang : phyogs med gnyan sa ri khrod 'grim pa'i phyir: zhi ba'i nyams dgu brda 'gros thugs dam bskang : rtag tu brtul zhugs las la brtson pa'i phyir: gnyan gcod gar bzhi ldan pas thugs dam bskang : 'khor 'das thams cad chig chod yin pa'i phyir: zil gnon gnad bdun 'chang bas thugs dam bskang : zhi byed gcod yul dgongs spyod rdzogs pa'i phyir: sa lam brtan pa thob pas thugs dam bskang : bskang bya skong byed skye med klong du ho: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas tshogs 'bul ba ni: lha grangs ltar so sor gtubs nas: mchod g.yog pas btegs shing : rgyan bkod mdzes pa'i chas dang ldan pas: kyaiḥ ma mi min gyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: ma yum chen thugs las sprul pa'i sras: ma cig jo mo mtsho rgyal ma: ma gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: ma skye ba med pa'i thugs ka nas: ma mchod sprin lha mo grangs med 'phros: ma phyag na bhandha'i gzhong pa thogs: ma 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyis bskang : ma dgyes pa chen po'i mchod pa 'di: ma bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs la 'bul: ma byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus pas skyong :

ma yi dam dpa' bo rgya mtshor 'bul: ma mchog thun rnam gnyis dngos grub stsol: ma ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: ma rten 'brel sna tshogs phyogs bcur spel: ma dam can chos skyong tshogs la 'bul: ma bdud bzhi tshar gcod phrin las sgrub: ma nor lha gter bdag tshogs la 'bul: ma tshogs gnyis bsod nams ye shes skyed: ma snang srid lha 'dre'i tshogs la 'bul: ma 'dod yon mchod pas dgyes gyur cig: ma yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs la 'bul: ma phog thug 'gram 'khrug sor chud cig: ma rigs drug pha ma'i tshogs la 'bul: ma bu lon lan chags 'khor gyur cig: ma bgegs rigs 'byung po'i tshogs la 'bul: ma sha 'khon sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: ma ming nas ma smos tshogs la 'bul: ma khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces mchod yul gong ma rnams dgyes shing sbyin yul 'og ma rnams bu lon lan chags 'khor bar dmigs so: de nas bstab pa bya ba ni: tshogs dum bu drug: gtor chung drug: sha dum drug: liṅga drug bcas snod du bshams la: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen khros ma'i thugs ka nas: steng 'og khyab pa las bzhi'i pho nya 'phros: byams dang snying rje dga' ba btang snyoms kyi: tshad med bzhi po rgyud kyis rab bskul nas: tshe rabs byang chub sgrub la mi dbang ba'i: phung po las dang nyon mongs 'chi bdag bdud: rlung mkhris bad kan 'du ba 'khrugs pa yi: tsha grang 'thab pa'i dgra gshed byed pa dang : dug lnga a 'thas 'khyams pa'i lan chags rnams: skye med chos skur ldog phyir gzugs su mchis: ba ling gtubs pa 'di dang dbyer med gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan bag chags gyur pa'i bdud thams cad mdun gyi gtubs pa la thim par dmigs: gtub pa 'bul ba'i tshe las ngan 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang bral bar bsgom: bhyoḥ ma mi min gyi ye shes mkha' 'gro ma:
