dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma chos dbyings klong nas skur bzhengs la: ye shes chen po'i zhal phyes shig: ho bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bdud gti mug phung po zhal du bstab: gdon rgyal 'gong dam sri zhal du bstab: nad snying rlung sems 'phyo zhal du bstab: gnas dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i: sems skye med chos skur thob par shog: phaṭḥ bhyoḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma me long klong nas skur bzhengs la: ye shes chen po'i zhal phyes shig: ho bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bdud zhe sdang phung po zhal du bstab: gdon lha dang mo 'dre zhal du bstab: nad bad kan dmu chu zhal du bstab: gnas dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i: sems skye med chos skur thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma mnyam nyid klong nas skur bzhengs la: ye shes chen po'i zhal phyes shig: ho bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bdud nga rgyal phung po zhal du bstab: gdon bdud dang gshin rje zhal du bstab: nad mkhris mdze nad sri zhal du bstab: gnas lha yi sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i: sems skye med chos skur thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: nub padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma sor rtog klong nas skur bzhengs la: ye shes chen po'i zhal du bstab: ho bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bdud 'dod chags phung po zhal du bstab: gdon mo 'dre dang srin mo zhal du bstab: nad grang ba srin glang zhal du bstab: gnas mi yi sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i: sems skye med chos skur thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma bya grub klong nas skur bzhengs la: ye shes chen po'i zhal phyes shig:

ho bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bdud phrag dog phung po zhal du bstab: gdon klu srin sa bdag zhal du bstab: nad glo 'cham 'dus pa zhal du bstab: gnas lha min sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i: sems skye med chos skur thob par shog: bhyoḥ ma mi min ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: mtshams 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma rang bzhin klong nas skur bzhengs la: ye shes chen po'i zhal phyes shig: ho bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: bdud nyon mongs sna tshogs zhal du bstab: gdon the'u rang yul 'dre zhal du bstab: nad gag lhog gnyan gzer zhal du bstab: gnas yi dwags sdug bsngal mi myong ba'i: sems skye med chos skur thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bstab pa rnams so sor phul: nad pa sogs la gcod tshogs gtong na 'di la tshar grangs gang mang lus sbyin bcas bya: de nas dga' ston gyi tshogs la rol ba ni: rnal 'byor pho mos glu dbyangs bcas: kyai maḥ dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid ma: ma cig jo mo mtsho rgyal la: gus pas lus kyis phyag 'tshal lo: gdung ba'i ngag gis gsol ba 'debs: mos pa'i sems kyis skyabs su mchi: 'bral ba med par thugs rjes gzigs: 'bral med snying gi padmor bzhugs: bdag dang 'dir tshogs skal ldan la: ye shes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: thun mong 'dod yon dngos grub stsol: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: zad med gter gyi dngos grub stsol: khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub stsol: srid gsum zil gnon dngos grub stsol: lha 'drer 'gro don nus pa dang : gcod yul bstan pa rgyas pa dang : tshogs gnyis mthar phyin 'byung 'gyur shog: om̐ sarba siddhi gu ru ḍākki ya pha la pha la swā hā: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas tshogs chang btung ba ni: om̐ skye med chos sku ngo mtshar che: āḥ'agag med longs sku gsung dbyangs sgrog: hūm̐ thugs rje sprul sku'i byin rlabs bskul: om̐ āḥhūm̐:

ka ni skye ba med pa'i don: pā ni 'gag med ye shes dbyings: la ni bde stong zung du 'jug: don gsum ldan pa'i snod mchog tu: dam tshig bla med rdzas kyis bkang : rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi 'di: 'bru mchog dza gad chang la btags: lha mo lnga yi rgyud bskul nas: 'chi med bcud du byin brlabs te: skal ldan dad mos rnams la stsol: e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung : ḍākki'i dam tshig a la la ho: zhes pas dwang du blang bar bya/ om̐ a mṛ ta dzñā na pañtsa siddhi siddhi hūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de yang gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: jo mo mtsho rgyal la lus med mkha' 'gros gnang ba'i gab sbas rin chen gter mdzod nyi shu ma dang : ma hā gu ru'i snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang zangs shog drwa mig can sogs mang du bzhugs pa'i nang nas: mkha' 'gro 'bum tshogs 'bum bskang brda bskang rgyan bskang rdzas bskang rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgril ba shog dril bar pa'i sde'o: 'di nyid rnal 'byor blo gros kyi bum bzang 'chang ba'i skal ldan gyi dur khrod brgya dang brgyad dam: gnyan sa brgya ri brgya tshogs brgya yang zer: ci ltar bya yang lus sbyin dang spros pa bya ba'i tshogs 'khor 'di rgyu bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i dgos ched: phung po gzan skyur drwa ba 'phrul gcod rtog pa don gcod nam: mdzod chen gyi sgo 'byed ka dag zang thal gyi nyams len skyong ba ste: 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'i dgos ched do: e maḥ mtsho rgyal rdo rje'i tshig rkang las: rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa'i tshe: gnyan sa dur khrod tshul du 'gro: lus ni ro yi tshul du 'gro: lha 'dre gcan spyang tshul du 'gro: rang rig mkha' 'gro'i tshul du 'gro: gtong len gcod pa'i tshul du 'gro: rjes shes snyems med ngang la bzhag: thabs kyis bskul ba'i gzugs phung dang : shes rab ldan pa'i rig pa gnyis: lhan cig 'dzoms pa'i gnyan sa gsum:

rten 'brel gdan thog gcig nas rnyed: lta ba lha med 'dre med gnyis: ma yengs mi bsgom gzer bu thogs: snyems snyems pa yi bdud dang bral: snyems thag yum chen klong du chod: jo mo'i zhal gdams sa ma ya:

phaṭḥ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyin pa yis: zag med bde bas tshim par shog: bag yod tshul khrims bsrungs pa yis: mtshan tshang sku lus thob par shog: bzod pas khong khro spangs pa yis: byams dang snying rje 'byung bar shog: ma yengs rtse gcig bsam gtan gyis: ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog: le lo spangs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis: stobs bcu mnga' ba gshegs par shog: shes rab chen po'i rgyud sbyangs nas: rtag tu ye shes 'grogs par shog: byams pa chen po'i rgyud bskul bas: sems can pha mar rtogs par shog: snying rje chen po'i shul mtshon pas: rigs drug 'khrul snang grol bar shog: dga' chen khyab bdag ston pa yis: 'gro ba'i mgon du bdag 'gyur shog: btang snyoms bdag gzhan ris bral gyis: phyogs med 'gro don nus par shog: tshogs lam thabs kyi dge bskul bas: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rnyed par shog: sbyor lam shes rab rtsal sbyangs pas: yang dag lam mchog rnyed par shog: mthong lam 'pho ba chen po yis: nam yang phyir mi ldog par shog: sgom lam a ti'i sa thob nas: bla med rgyal sa zin par shog: kun bzang pad 'byung man chad nas: rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod kyis: dge ba'i smon lam gang btab pa: gcod thun 'di ru 'grub par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces dmigs med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma gsang ba chos bzhi las: ma cig jo mo mtsho rgyal gyi: ma 'ongs sprul par lung bstan pa: lab kyi ma cig sgron ma dang : snye lam shel bza' sgron gcig ma: bre 'tsham zhang lcam bo chung ma: zangs ri'i jo mo mkhar sgom ma: sna nam a phyi chos sgron ma: kho mo bdag gi sprul pa 'byung : da lta'i gnubs ban dzñā na ba: yang mthar grogs bgyid yid la gcags: ma 'ongs rgyal ba don 'grub zhes: de la rim rgyud mang mtha' ru: gsang ba'i gcod mchog 'di 'byin po: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa 'byung : de dus zab chos 'di 'phrad shog: rgya 'di las kyi mkha' 'gros srungs:

dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor/ 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong bod yul gyi tshogs khang lung par grags pa nas gdan drangs shing lcags pho khyi lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas bod kyi sgra skad du bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ca) tshogs zhing byang chub myur lam bzhugs so/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ḍākki las: khol phyung tshogs kyi lhan thabs ni: tshogs mchod lha grangs ci bzhin bkod: hūm̐: rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma dang : bla ma rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bla ma'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: yi dam la: hūm̐: yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : yi dam rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: yi dam dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: mkha' 'gro la: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : ḍākki rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig:

'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: dam can la: hūm̐: dam can dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : dam can rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dam can dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: chos skyong la: hūm̐: chos skyong dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : chos skyong srung ma 'khor bcas la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: chos skyong dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: gter bdag gter srung la: hūm̐: gter bdag dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : gter srung tha tshig gnyer ba la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: gter srung dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: nor lha la: hūm̐: nor lha'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : nor lha dngos grub gter mdzad la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dzam lha'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig:

'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: phyi rgyud la: hūm̐: phyi rgyud dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang : dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gnas bdag la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: gtsang rigs gzhi bdag thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: rigs drug la: hūm̐: skye srid gnas bzhi'i pha ma dang : rigs drug 'khor ba'i lan chags la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: skye 'gro yid can thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: lan chags la: hūm̐: skye ba tshe rabs snga phyi dang : phyis 'byung bcas pa'i lan chags la: zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bgegs rigs lan chags thugs dam bskang : nyams chag thams cad skong gyur cig: rtog sgrib thams cad byang gyur cig: las ngan sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba stongs gyur cig: 'bras sku gsum thob gyur cig: bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lhan chad mthol bshags bzod par gsol: hūm̐: bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam gnyan po bskang : bskang du med de skye med stong pas bskang : mchod du med de gnyis med lta bas mchod: sbyor du med de snang stong dbyer med sbyor: sgrol du med de dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: bshags su med de snang srid sgyu mar bshags: dmigs su med de 'khor gsum yang dag bsngo:

hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can dang : chos skyong srung ma gter bdag phyi rgyud bcas: rigs drug lan chags sbyang dgos la sogs la: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dge ba 'di phul bas: tshe rabs kun tu gnod sbyin rtag myos dang : tshangs pa'i tshe dang ston pa'i chos ston ltar: zag med bde bas nam yang tshims par shog: sha stag sdug gis mnar ba'i sems can kun: sa bcu go 'phang 'bras bu rnyed gyur cig: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya: sogs yi ge brgya pas chad lhag bkang : 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skabs rmi ltas log pa dang*/ dam tshig chag nyams gyur na tshogs brgya bsdus pa 'di ga bya rung : brgya phyag zhig kyang bya: tshogs gzhung gcig tshogs brgya bya'am tshogs phud brgya grangs bya: tshogs chen gcod tshogs skabs su yang rung : spyir ni nyams chag bskang bshags dri med shel phreng bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i mkha' 'gro'i chos tshan nas khol phyung bgyis pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // cha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gter srung las kyi ma mo ye shes pa ltar du sgrub pa bzhugs pa'i dbu'o: bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang ma cig dbyings phyug rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i phrin las cho ga bgyis pa ni: thog mar bkra shis dge ba'i yar tshes su: stegs bu mtshan ldan pad 'dab bzhi pa bkod: de yi steng bum pa rgyan bzang : bhandhar gtor ma zlum po pad 'dab bzhis bskor ba: mdun du gtor zor gsum: me long sin dhu ra yi dkyil 'khor bkod: mda' dar la sgrub rten rin chen sna tshogs bla 'khor bcas brgyan: gzhan yang mchod rdzas phun sum tshogs par bsham: spyan gzigs sna tshogs bkod: rigs ldan gyi mkha' 'gro lnga'am gcig la: rigs lnga dar dpyangs rgyan spyod mdzes par spras te: mchod pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub tu gzhug: gzhan yang ri rlung sogs bkra shis phun sum tshogs par bsham:

shing sna chu sna me tog 'bru sogs dgos pa rnams bsdus la mchod pa'i rdzas su bsgom: bde ba'i gdan la 'khod de dkyil 'khor la 'jug par bya ste: sa ma ya: dang po sngon du 'gro ba ni: na mo: bde chen ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul las: bde stong zag med 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma: bde ba'i lang tsho 'khril ba'i nyams ldan ma: bde ba rab g.yo dga' bzhi lhan skyes stsol: gnyis pa: mchog gi dpa' mor rtag tu gus 'dud na: mchog dga' dbyangs can brda grogs dpal lha mo: mchog thun yon tan spel mdzad rnal 'byor ma: mchog gi dngos grub stsol phyir grogs su byon: gsum pa: dga' ma khyod kyi bzhin ras rab dkar gyis: dga' chen yid kyi padmo rab tu g.yo: dga' bral nyi ma'i gdengs ka'i ze'u 'bru'i bcud: dga' ba lhan skyes rdo rjes skar ltar skyol: bzhi pa: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum dang : hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hrīḥ.āḥ phyi snod gling bzhi yangs pa bhandha'i mkha': nang bcud mchod pa'i lha mo gar mo dang : sman gtor rakta dbang po'i me tog sogs: phyi nang spyan gzigs blo yi sprul pa'i tshogs: zag med mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon du spel: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐: māṃ sa go ro tsa na bha su ta kiṃ ni ri ti āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: lnga pa: om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐ bhrūm̐: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐: ru tra ti ra baṃ: bhrūm̐ las dur khrod sa gzhi'i dbus: thod mkhar gzhal yas dbyings su bsnyegs: nang rnams rin chen brtsegs pa mdzes: phyi nang 'od kyi drwa ba'i phreng : 'ja' 'od lug rgyud gtibs pa'i dbus: padma nyi zla bam gyi steng : hrīḥlas yum chen dbyings phyug ma:

bde gshegs rdo rje rigs kyi gtso: sku mdog dkar dmar 'od du 'bar: zhi 'dzum rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: phyag g.yas mda' dar me long bsnams: g.yon pa'i thod pa nor bus bkang : sku las sna tshogs mdzes pa yi: dar dkar lhub can cod pan 'phyang : mu tig du ma'i chun pos spras: zhabs gnyis bshibs te bzhengs pa'i tshul: yid 'ong lang tshos rab tu skyud: rjes chags zim bu'i spyan dkyus g.yo: ye shes lus can 'od kyi sku: bde chen dgyes pa'i dpa' mor bskyed: phyogs bzhi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bzhi: zhi ba dbyings kyi dpa' mo'i tshul: haḥ rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: shar na mthing gi zhal bzang ma: phyag na lcags kyu ne'u le thogs: riḥ rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: lho na mi g.yo blo bzang ma: phyag na rgyal mtshan nor bu thogs: niḥ padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: nub tu gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma: phyag na mda' dar bum pa bsnams: saḥ las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: byang nas cod pan mgrin bzang ma: phyag na rdo rje bhandha bsnams: thams cad rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: prog zhu mu tig phreng ba phreng : dkar ser dmar ljang na bza' bklubs: sna tshogs mdzes pa'i cod pan 'phur: zhabs gnyis 'gying 'gros dal bu'i gdan: gtso 'khor gzi 'od 'bum du 'khyil: bde chen ye shes rgyas par bsgom: gzhan yang ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: nyi ma dang ni gza' skar bzhin: sprul pa nyid sprul tshogs dang bcas: ma 'dres yid la 'ja' ltar gsal: om̐ dharma ḍākki shwa ri mūm̐ḥha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang rigs bzhi'i gnas: khyad par gzho stod ke'u ri gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ye shes rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs: phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal dam bsre ba ni:

hūm̐ hrīḥ bde chen gsang ba dbyings kyi pho brang nas: thugs rje ma 'gags rang rtsal 'gyed pa'i phyir: ma cig ye shes mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: rang mdangs rol pa'i cho 'phrul gar bsgyur phyir: phrin las rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: bka' dang dam tshig las su mi 'da' phyir: yang sprul ma sring 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki dzñā na dharma tā re karma shwa ri yo gi ni hri da ya ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ hrīḥ chags med padma nyi zla bam gyi gdan: zung 'jug rol pa'i gar gyis bzhugs su gsol: bzhin bzang rab dkar dga' ma zhi tshul can: zla rgyas bzhin ras g.yo ba'i dpal ldan ma: phyag bgyis dam bsre ma cig bu gdung ltar: dbyangs can ye shes mkha' 'gros skyong bar mdzod: sku gsum dam tshig 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: zung 'jug dga' bzhi'i grol lam pho nya stsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ sa ma ya shuddhe hoḥ mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes ḍākki'i dkyil 'khor la: lha rdzas me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: sman raka gtor mchod dza gad su ra chang : dbang po'i me tog tshogs kyi longs spyod bcas: gzhan yang phyi nang spyan gzigs dkor cha dang : rten rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas mchod pa'i rdzas: rtag gtor rten gtor thun gtor nar ma phud: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: ma sring rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul lags na: ye shes dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : zhal bzang rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : blo bzang rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : 'gro bzang padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : mgrin bzang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang :

ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sor chud nas: g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ badzra ḍākki dzñā na dharma tā re karma shwa ri yo gi hri da ya ha ri ni sa ye hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: pū dza hoḥ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: pū dza hoḥ om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta āḥhūm̐: pū dza hoḥ om̐ ga ṇa tsakra sarba i daṃ a mṛ ta bhi shwa me gha pū dza hoḥ badzra pū ra hoḥ badzra shuddhe hoḥ

de nas bdud rtsi mchod pa ni: dbyings phyug lha mo dngos su gsal zhing : om̐ dzñā na dharma shwa ri tā re ḍākki nī om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ha badzra dzñā na ḍākki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ri ratna sa ma ya ḍākki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ ni padma prañdzā ḍākki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ sa karma gu hya ḍākki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ bhi shwa karma ḍākki nī ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ karma ma tri tra ya ni ye om̐ āḥhūm̐: ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams bdud rtsis mnyes shing tshims nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma lus pa bdag la stsal du gsol: om̐ kā ya siddhi wākka siddhi tsitta siddhi gu hya siddhi hoḥ zhes ljags su myong ngo : de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : sgyu ma longs sku'i cho rol ma 'gags phyir: sna tshogs sprul sku rigs lnga'i skur ston pa'i: bzhin bzang lha mo rab dkar zla ba'i mdog: nya rgyas lta bu'i gzi byin 'bum du 'khyil: khyod kyi cha shas bde ba'i 'od zer gyis: nyon mongs g.yo ba'i tsha gdung nags klong skem: me long snang srid pra yi 'khor lo thogs: dam tshig gsang ba'i mda' dar tshe dpal 'gugs: mtshan ldan snod mchog dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nang : yid bzhin bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal pos bkang : sku la dar dkar tshon zung le brgan gsol: rin chen rgyan spyod lta bas mi gzhigs spras: mu tig do shal se do sor gdub mdzes: gzhon sha'i dkar 'dzin chu gter ge sar bzhad: rab rgyas tshogs pa'i mdangs las rab 'grogs bzhin: ye shes lus can las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshul: dbyings phyug 'dod rgu'i mchog gi dpal lha mo: grub pa'i dbang mo khyod la bdag bstod do: ma cig sa gsum skye dgu mgon gyi mchog: sgrub pa'i ma gdung bu ltar brtse bas skyongs: brtse gzigs rnam pa kun tu khyod bsgrub na: phrin las sngon sgrub thugs rjes phyes ma ring :

rtag tu yid kyi dpa' mos bdag skyongs shig: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha mo 'jo sgeg mdzes ma 'phro: lcags kyus lha 'dre mi gsum gzhan snang 'gugs: rin chen ne'u les dgos 'dod char ltar 'bebs: dar dkar gos gsol rin chen rgyan gyis spras: dbang sdud lha mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i lha mo ser bzhad lang tsho ldan: bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan ba dan mkha' la bsgrengs: yid bzhin re skong dgos 'dod nor bu bsnams: dar ser gos gsol rin chen du mas spras: bsod nams dpal bskyed lha mo khyod la bstod: hūm̐: dbang gi lha mo dbyangs can rjes chags nyams: mda' dar 'dzin pas snang srid tshe bcud sdud: 'chi med bum pas sgrub la rig 'dzin stsol: dar dmar gos gsol rin chen phreng bas spras: tshe 'phel dbang gi lha mo khyod la bstod: hūm̐: drag po'i lha mo gtum zhing 'bur tshugs lta: bar gcod bdud las rgyal ba'i rdo rje gdeng : ma rungs bdud bzhi 'joms shing bhan dmar rol: dar ljang gos gsol ratna'i zar bu bskyod: sna tshogs phrin las sgrub pa'i lha mor bstod: hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa'i ma sring mkha' 'gro ma: sgyu ma'i gar gyis cho 'phrul rnam 'gyur 'dzin: rol rtsal ma 'gags cir yang snang ba'i lha: dbyings phyug sprul pa'i phra men ma tshogs la: dwang bas dgyes pa bskyed nas bdag bstod do: de ltar sgrub pa'i sngags phreng rnams bzlas pa'i tshe: rang nyid padma 'byung gnas su gsal ba'i mdun du mkha' 'gro ma rim par gsal btab pa'i thugs kar hrīḥdang ha ri ni sa'i srog yig la: sngags phreng dmar po 'od zer lnga ldan g.yon du 'khor bas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul bas sku yi gzi brjid nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs ltar cher 'bar brtan g.yo la phog: brtan g.yo'i tshe bsod gzi brjid bkrag mdangs yon tan tshur bsdus mkha' 'gro la bstim: mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga nas yig 'bru'i rnam par sngags phreng dang 'od zer 'phros pas rang nyid gnas lnga la thim:

rtsa rlung bde drod nyams rtogs thams cad rtsol med du sbar: lus ye shes lha yi rnam pa'i rol par gyur: ngag gsung dbyangs drug cu: yid ka dag zang thal mi dmigs pa'i ngo bo mngon du gyur: par bsam la/ rtsa sngags ni: om̐ badzra ḍākki nī dharma dzñā na tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas sngags phreng bdag mdun dbyer med du 'khor ba 'gal me ltar ro: rang nyid kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams su yang mkha' 'gro ma til gyi gang bu kha bye ba ltar gsal gdab la: las sngags ni: om̐ shwa ri dharma tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ phrin las sngags ni: om̐ ḍākki dharma shwa ra tā re hūm̐ phaṭḥ spro bsdu tshe bdag dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: phyi nang snod bcud kyi mkha' 'gro dang rnal 'byor rnams la phog pas thams cad rang gi dbang du 'du bar bsam: khyad par 'jig rten gyi mi yi rigs ldan bu mo lnga sogs dmigs gsal rnams kyi snying khar 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas dbang med du rang gi mdun du 'dus par bsgom: ye shes 'jig rten thams cad bla yid bdag gi bzung bas nam yang mi shor bar bsgom: gcig dril tshe sgrub sngags ni: om̐ shwa ri dharma tā re dzñā na ā yur puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: bsod nams spel ba'i sngags ni: om̐ yo gi ni shwa ra tā re puṇye siddhi ye swā hā: dbang sdud ni: om̐ gha mu a tā re dhe ma sarba pa shaṃ ma ma thun thun swā hā: rigs bzhi'i sngags gcig dril ni: om̐ badzra ratna padma karma hrīḥha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ ra ga he sha dhe wi ma ma thun thun swā hā: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i srog gi snying po ni: om̐ ḍākki nī hrīḥha ri ni sa tsitta hri da ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥswā hā: de ni dmigs pa spro bsdu las ye shes mkha' 'gro ltar bsgrub pa'i rim pa'o: de yang mthar mkha' 'gro ma rnams rang la bsdu: rten yod na rang dang rten gnyis ka bsdu: skabs su mkha' 'gro'i gtang rag gi gtor 'bul ni:

phud rgod dang gtor ma bcas bsham: hūm̐: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas: rigs lnga ye shes mkha' 'gro skur bzhengs shig: deng 'dir bdag la dgyes pa'i mdangs ston phyir: thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs: sngon tshe ke'u ri gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu: rig 'dzin chen po padma 'byung gnas dang : bde chen rig ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis: zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye tshe: mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i lha tshogs 'ja' ltar shar: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub: sgom pa'i lha tshogs gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan: gnas gsum la sogs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: de ltar sngon gyi tha tshig dran dgongs phyir: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgyes pa'i mdangs phyung bsgrubs pa'i rtags bstan te: phrin las sngon sgrub byang chub sa lam spel: 'gro ba'i tshe bsod mnga' thang dbang du sdud: yid la 'dod rgu dpal 'byor phun tshogs nas: dbyings phyug lha mos bstan pa'i mel tshe sgron: rig 'dzin bdag gi sgrub pa'i grogs dan mdzod: om̐ dzñā na ḍākki dhe wi kā li ha ri ni sa ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: zhes mchod gtor 'bul: bdag byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar: mkha' 'gro dang rtag tu 'bral ba med pa'i smon lam 'debs: hrīḥ bde chen ye shes rgyas pa'i dpal lha mo: zab lam rdo rje rigs kyi rnal 'byor dang : rtag tu 'bral med zung 'jug spyod pa yis: phrin las dpal du bdag gis deng 'grub shog: om̐ gu hya mu ṭa mu la maṅga la tiṣṭha ye swā hā: zhes me tog gi rab tu gnas: sgrub rten la rtag tu bzhugs par bsam: sa ma ya: de yang ting 'dzin go cha bzhi ldan zhes: thun mthar mi dmigs mnyam bzhag lha ru ldang : dbang gi rigs lnga'i sgrub thabs 'di: ma gcig mkha' 'gro ye shes tshul 'chang ma:

sgrub pa'i 'grigs chags kho mo mtsho rgyal gyis: gzho stod ti sgro mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du: rin chen zab gsang shog ser logs su bkod: mi nub rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbas: rgya 'di las kyi ma mo gsum gyis skyongs: ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus tshod lnga bdo la: skal ldan las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog: gangs khrod pho brang tshogs khang-i atsha rgyaḥ sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: dam rgya: gnyan rgya: kho bo rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i tshogs khang yang rdzong nas/ me sprel lor gdan drangs shing bdud 'dul sngags pa gling du shog ser nas gsang zhal bsgyur ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ja) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: ma cig dpal ldan lha mo 'jig rten ltar sgrub pa'i las byang mngon spyod nus ldan bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: ma cig dus mkhyen dbyings phyug lha mor 'dud: sa ma ya: de yang sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: dpal ye shes dang las la grub pa'i ma cig 'dod khams gtso mo'i phrin las gsol mchod ni: thog mar bla ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor sngon du song nas: lha mo'i gsol mchod bgyis pa la: lcags zangs bhandha la sogs pa rin po che'i snod kyi nang du: gtor ma zlum po 'khor bzhis bskor ba: mdun du dmar gtor gsum dang mtheb skyu bcu gnyis bha ling nyer brgyad kyis bskor ba: sman raka phud rgod sogs dgyes pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs bsham: spyan gzigs sku 'bag bla rten bcas bkram: khyad par dam tshig gsang ba'i me long mda' dar sba lcag srog 'khor: thun gtor zor gtor bcas spyi ltar bsham: rol mo'i bye brag rnams kyang rgyas par bsgrigs te: dri spos sogs legs par btang zhing : rang nyid bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal gsal btab ste: mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ

om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dzaḥ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ e dzeṃ khaṃ: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: hūm̐ ti gu hya niḥ hrīḥbhrūm̐ sarba ātma ko3 haṃ: hoḥ de nyid yongs su gyur pa las rang rang gi snod so so'i nang du phyi nang gi mchod pa yig 'bru sa bon 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod rdzas sman raka gtor ma tshogs kyi yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ om̐ sarba pū dza me gha spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa skad cig gis 'dod khams dbang phyug ma bskyed pa ni: hoḥ skad cig gis rang nyid che mchog padma drag po gsal ba'i mdun du: e mthing nag gi rang bzhin nam mkha' mu mtha' med pa: de'i shugs las rlung me chu sa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi 'khor yug khyab pa: de'i steng du dur khrod kyi sa gzhi dang bam gsar rnying ri ltar spungs pa'i dbus su: thod mkhar me rlung rab tu 'khyil ba'i gzhal yas khang : rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa: de'i lte bar padma nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la: yi ge hrīḥm bhyo yongs su gyur pa las: ma cig 'dod khams dbang phyug sku mdog dmar po khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan pa: snang srid kun la dbang ba'i ma mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa: dbu la rin po che'i prog zhu la thod skam dang ldan pa: phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u nam mkha' la 'khrol bas ma mo mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud pa: g.yon bhandha khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa: dam sri bdud kyi snying khrag rol pa: sku la dar dkar gyi za ber dang tshon ldan zung du bklubs pa: rin po che rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras pa:

chu rta sngon po rlung gi shugs can la sga stan dang dar stan gyi steng du g.yang gzhi dang g.yer kha za ram gyis brgyan pa chibs te: skad cig gis stong gsum bskor ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'o: de'i shar du drag byed las kyi lha mo sku mdog dkar dmar rgya bong sngon po la chibs pa: phyag na me long dang gter sgrom thogs pa: dar mthing gi ber chen gsol ba'o: lho ru rgyas byed srid pa'i lha mo gtsug na nor bu sku mdog ser mo g.yas rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang : g.yon thod pa nor bus bkang ba 'dzin pa: le brgan ser po'i phod ka gsol zhing 'brong chen kham pa la chibs pa: nub tu bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi lha mo dmar ser g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa: dar dmar gyi phod kha gsol ba: rta dmar rlung gshog la chibs pa: byang du khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lha mo sku mdog dmar nag g.yas zangs gri dang g.yon lcags kyu gdengs shing : rus pa'i rgyan drug gis spras te khyung dmar la chibs pa: de rnams kyi mdun du las byed sprul pa'i ma mo gsum spu gri dang nad rkyal thogs nas gcer mo g.yang gzhi gyon te gar bsgyur ba'o: thams cad kyang rab tu gzi brjid dang 'bar zhing rgyan du mas spras te: rin po che'i prog zhu thod rtsal can gsol zhing gtso mo ltar bskyed pa'o: rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ gi 'od zer lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas: rang bzhin dbyings kyi pho brang : u tsa la yi dur khrod: mu le mthing gi mtsho nang : spu rangs ta dang gangs ri: la phyi tsā ri ti sgro sogs: khyad par gyi gnas chen gang du bzhugs kyang : thugs rje dang thugs dam gyi dbang gis rgyud bskul nas thogs pa med pa spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas nas: hūm̐ bhyoḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang du: mkha' 'gro sde lnga zhes su grags:

bde gshegs rgyal bas dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og bar bskal gnyis pa la: gsang chen me ri 'bar ba ru: rdo rje phag mo zhes su grags: lag na rdo rjes dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og bar bskal gsum pa la: u tsa la yi dur khrod du: mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mor grags: yang dag rdo rjes dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og bar bskal bzhi pa ru: ri rab gling bzhi dbang bsgyur ba: mu le mthing gi mtshor brten bca': ma cig 'dod khams dbang phyug zhes: rdo rje gzhon nus dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig lnga pa la: rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: lha mo rdo rje gshog rgod drag: rdo rje khro bos dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig drug pa ru: bal yul yang le shod kyi gnas: ma mo e ka dzā ṭir grags: rdo rje drag pos dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig bdun pa la: bod yul gzho stod ti sgro ru: dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol mar grags: thod phreng rtsal gyis dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: de 'og tha tshig brgyad pa ru:

mchims phu dpal gyi bsam yas su: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes la: mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya gtad nas kyang : gter gyi srung ma gnyer bskos tshe: rdo rje g.yu sgron ma ru grags: padma 'byung gnas dbang bskur bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar bdag gis bstod: da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin gyis: dur khrod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na: thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus nyid du: nyi zla bam ro'i gdan la bzhugs: rtag tu dam tshig bsre ba'i phyir: dbyer med bdag gis phyag bgyid do: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ padma sūrya tsand+ra ti ra baṃ: tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pū ru sha ya hoḥ

de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa la: 'dod yon phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dbang po rnam lnga'i me tog ri ltar spungs: sha chen tshil chen ngad ldan dud sprin 'khrigs: lha ba zhag dang rkang mar sgron me sbar: dmar chen rlabs su g.yo ba'i dri chab gtams: bcud ldan ba liṃ dgyes pa'i zhal zas bkram: rkang gling thod rnga sgra snyan 'brug ltar sgrogs: sna tshogs phyi yi mchod pa bkram pa 'di: dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma gtso dang 'khor: dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: hūm̐: ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : drag mo 'dod khams gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang : lha mo gtsug na nor bu'i thugs dam bskang : yid bzhin dbang gi lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud srid pa'i lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya bshan pa ma gsum thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing bar chad sel ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pū dza su ra hūm̐: hūm̐: bhandha'i snod du bdud rtsi mtsho ltar 'khyil: bha ling rgyan gyi gtor ma dbyings su snyogs: rakta'i rba rlabs lbu ba phyar ma phyur: bsgral zhing gtub pa'i dbang po ri ltar spungs: dza gad sman phud bcud g.yo gya ma gyu: ro brgya'i bcud chags tshogs kyi yo byad bkram: shing 'bras 'bru bcud 'bras rgun bstar ba'i ro: rjes su chags pa'i dri dang dgyes pa'i phud: spyan gzigs lang tsho rnam par spyod pa'i yul: spyod ldan mkha' la 'khrigs pa'i sprin phung la:

'khu ba'i rnam par rang rang rten pa'i rdzas: rta bdun dbang po'i lang tsho ltar 'bar ba'i: dri med chu shel mdzes pa'i a darsha: mkhregs med rab mdzes sba lcag mnyen zhing ldem: 'gugs pa'i 'debs zor 'bebs pa'i mda' mo la: tshon ldan rnam par bkra ba'i pañtsa li: yid la rtag tu chags pa'i bla 'khor bskrun: dri za'i dbyangs len ping ka'i rgyal mtshan bsgrengs: shugs ldan rlung gi 'dab can mig sman tshogs: dal 'gros spu yis mdzes pa'i khyu mo'i khyu: phyi mo zla ba ma ma'i gdong rwa can: mgrin bzang chu 'dzin mdangs ldan sgra dpangs mtho: nī laṃ ind+ra rnyil ba'i phreng phreng po: gdengs can bdag po'i bang mdzod 'phya ba'i dpyid: rtag myos lha ltar 'bad med ci bzhin tu: 'gog med nā da'i dbang mo gtso dang 'khor: dus 'dzin mdza' mor btud de dga' mar 'bul: hūm̐: ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : drag mo 'dod khams gtso mo'i thugs dam bskang : lha mo gtsug na nor bu'i thugs dam bskang : yid bzhin dbang gi lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : dbang sdud srid pa'i lha mo'i thugs dam bskang : pho nya bshan pa ma gsum thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing bar chad sel ba dang : mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ru tra ma ra ṇi sha ma ni ma hā maṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na kiṃ ni ri ti bha su ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: om̐ sarba pū dza su ra hūm̐: zhes pas mchod pa phul zhing bstod pa'i phrin las bgyis pa ni: thugs nyid ye shes klong nas ma g.yos par drag mo'i cha tsam 'dzin pa'i gzi brjid bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes ngang : dbang phyug bdun ldan gtso mo'i gtso: chos nyid chos can rnyog bral ba'i: sgrol ba'i nyon mongs zhi ba mo: ma khyod rtag tu bdag gis bstod: bdud sde mthar byed mnyes mnyes mo: mnyes shing gtum mos srid pa g.yo: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las bzhi: las mkhan pho nya mo la bstod: dung dung gdung zhing sgrub pa la: mchog dang thun mong ma g.yel par: mchog gi dngos grub mchog stsol mdzod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ gtum drag tshal dang tshang tshing 'khrigs: gsang chen he yi dur khrod nas: dbyings phyug lha mo skur bzhengs shig: rigs bzhi ma mo skur bzhengs shig: bshan pa ma gsum skur bzhengs shig: bzhengs shig bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dam tshig chen po'i dus la bab: rang bzhin mi dmigs chos dbyings kyang : thabs kyi cho 'phrul skur ston ma: mkha' la dbang sgyur dpal 'bar ma: dkar mo snang srid dbang mo che: khros ma dkar mo srid pa'i rgyal: sprul pa dmar mo khrag mig ma: nag mo khros ma bdud kyi lcam: srin mo glog gi phreng ba can: yaksha'i bu mo re ma ti: gdol pa'i bu mo dung skyong ma: gshin rje'i bu mo ya ma nag: sngags bdag ral gcig kha mo che: u ma dhe wa lha min mo: sde brgyad yongs kyi gtso mo ste: mngon spyod las la chas pa'i tshe: phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug gdeng : dgra bgegs gzugs phung mgo lus phral: g.yon pas klad khrag zhal du gsol: dam sri snying nas bkums par byed: mkha' la myur mgyogs lam lam 'gro: cang shes rlung gi shugs can zhon: stong gsum dmigs pas yud kyis bskor: lha dang lha min gtso mo mdzad: res 'ga' srin mo'i cha lugs 'chang : bong bu gwa dmar bzhon pa yis: rlung nag 'tshub ma'i sna yang 'dren: dgra la khrag nad dmar yams 'bebs: stong gsum nad kyi bskal pa bsnyil: srid pa 'di yi srog gi bdag: rngam zhing byad mar rbad pa'i tshe: kha nas lce spyang sprul pa 'gyed:

pu tra sngon mo spyang ki'i gdong : pu tra nag mo khyi yi gdong : pu tra dmar mo stag gi gdong : pu tra ser mo gzig gi gdong : pu tra las byed dred mong gdong : pu tra mthar byed dom gyi gdong : pu tra nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi: gtso mor gnas tshe g.yag gi gdong : gnas yul dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: nyid kyi sprul pa ma mo bzhi: dkar mo nyi zla'i phreng ba can: ser mo srid gsum rmang nas bsnyil: dmar mo rgya mtsho chol bur gtor: ljang mo dug gi kha rlangs g.yo: las byed ma mo bshan pa mo: dmar mos khrag gi ral pa bsigs: nag mos nad rkyal dgra la 'phyo: sngon mos spu gris dam sri bkums: phyag gnyan bshan pa 'bum 'bum 'phyo: lha mo dus mtshan dmag gi rgyal: dgra lha ma khyod dbyings nas bzhengs: 'dir gshegs sha khrag gtor ma longs: rakta dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi gser skyems mchod pa 'bul: dgra bgegs sdig can bsgral ba yi: tsitta snying dang dbang po lnga: gzugs phung bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul: khyad par dam sri 'byung po dang : log lta dam nyams bdud kyi rigs: lha mo khyed la gtad pa'i yul: nag mo khyed kyi khong pa nas: dug gi rlangs pa phyur du phob: nad kyi sa mkhar dgra la chos: mtshon gyi gru gu dgra la 'phyo: lha yi byang bu dkar po la: dgra bo'i bla rtags myur du phob: bdud kyi byang bu nag po la: dgra bo'i mi nor myur du phob: btsan gyi byang bu dmar po la: dgra bo'i rten yul myur du phob: gshin rje'i khram ldan nag po la: dgra bo'i pha sde myur du phob: bstan pa'i ru tra sdig can 'di: srid rtse mnar med ri rab zom: nyi zla'i khong dang ban bon gur: gling bzhi gling phran gar gnas kyang : ma mo khyod kyis sgrol bar gyis: khyad par dam nyams dgra bo 'di'i: mi rabs bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: dam sri dam nyams bdud kyi rigs: bka' la 'khu zhing dam g.yel ba'i:

sdig can dgra bo shor ra re: rbad pa'i mngon spyod dus la bab: bka' las ma 'da' dam tshig can: sngon tshe pad 'byung spyan snga ru: tha tshig dmod de las bcol ba'i: gzu dpang lha mo khyed bskul bas: dus las ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la bdud du babs pa'i tshe: dkar mo snying gi phreng ba thogs: ser mo gshin rje'i khram shing thogs: dmar mo zangs kyi sho rdel thogs: nag mo rtsis kyi sho bkra thogs: 'chi bdag srin mo khrag ral ma: gling bzhi 'di yi srog gi bdag: spu gri nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: gnas chen lnga la dbang yang bsgyur: dregs pa'i bu mo mthu rtsal can: rbad do mngon spyod phrin las mdzod: za byed 'bar ma mche ba can: nag mo glog zhags rdeb ma ste: srin mo sha za kha mo che: pha rol rgol ba'i dgra bgegs kyi: mi khyi rta gsum zhal du 'bul: srin mo mched gsum dus la bab: dgra la glo bur rbad pa'i tshe: lcags kyi spyang ki sngon mo la: btsan bdud srid pa'i bu mos zhon: zhal nas khrag gi kha rlangs 'thul: dgra la dmar nad char du 'bebs: khrag gi ral pa bsigs pa las: nyi zla mi snang 'od kyang nyams: spu gri dgra la btab pa'i tshe: 'dzam gling khrag gi rba rlabs 'khrugs: nad rkyal dgra la 'phyo ba'i tshe: klu nad mdze dang lhog yams 'bebs: rngams shing drag tu bskul ba'i tshe: snang srid rlung gi gshog par rgyu: khyed rnams las kyi ma mo ste: tho rangs skya rengs rta la zhon: btsan gyi bu mos dus la bab: dgra la gzer thum sbos gris sod: mun rub smag rum rta la zhon: srin po'i bu mos dus la bab: dgra bo'i tsitta myur du chod: nam phyed bying rmugs rta la zhon: bdud kyi bu mos dus la bab: dgra bo'i rnam shes phye mar gtor: mā ra ya las grub pa mo: mā las spros pa'i pho nyas khug: ra las spu gri 'bar bas sgrol: ya las gtub gtor bzhes su gsol: byad ma dgra bgegs kyi bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi khā hi:

bhyo bhyo ma mo rakmo tri dgra bo'i bla srog rnam shes la kha kha khā hi khā hi: liṅga zhig dang gtor ma sha dum zhig 'bul: de nas zor thogs te: dpal ldan re ma ti ltar bskul ba ni: 'di bai ro tsā nas yer pa zla ba phug tu bzhugs pa'i tshe: btsun mo bza' ba dmar rgyan la mdze nad par bu ma mo'i nad rkyal skor sgrub pa'i gnas de nyid du sbas pa las: khrigs bsdebs 'di yi cha lag tu: gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la grogs kyi dga' ston du: nus pa me ltar du 'bar ba'i bskul yin pas: da grogs po khyod la sbyin: ngas kyang nus rtags thon pa yin: khyod la rang mthu che zhing nus pa dang ldan pa yod rung : ma 'ongs pa'i don du bdag gis bka' 'bogs: khyod kyang dga' mgur spyod cig gsungs nas gdams mo: de yi bskul btang ba la: gtor ma tshe yungs kyis brgyan: rtsang nyi shu rtsa gcig gzugs: rdzas phung shul gyi sa dang dur rdo: klu gnyan gnas pa'i rdo dkar nag khra gsum gyi: dkar po la: a tri bi shu tsa ka su na ke hu se bhyoḥ khra bo la: ma tri shu ba e tri shug nan bhyoḥ nag po la: ke du tri spra na he phu lu bhyoḥ gtor ma'i zur gsum du bzhag: 'di'i skabs su dmigs bsal yod na dgra bo'i rkang rjes g.yon pa'i sa bsres pa'i liṅga zhig bzos par: 'gugs gzhug gang mang bgyis nas de'i snying khar zor btab pas chog: bskul ring thung gnyis zor phyogs gcig 'phang ba gtor dril yin: gtor mar dpal 'bar btsugs la: bskul gtong ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ he ru ka yi gnas bcu yi: rdo rje gdan gyi byang shar mtshams: mu le mthing gi mtsho nang nas: 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma: pha ni dbang phyug ma hā dhe: ma ni klu mo gdol pa'i rigs: de gnyis 'tshogs pa'i ma mo che: sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba la: zhal gdangs spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu: a la la yi gad mo sgrogs: zhal du mi ro krig krig gsol:

dbu skra dmar nag dud sprin gtibs: sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol: sku smad re lde nag po dkris: thod rlon sbrul nag chun pos spras: dbu la rma bya'i sgro phod bskyon: phyag g.yas spu gri dmar po phyar: g.yon pas dgra bgegs klad khrag rol: bong bu gwa dmar rta la zhon: srin po pho mo'i sga stan spras: mtshon gru nad rkyal zung du thogs: srid pa gangs dkar rtse yi bdag: tshangs mo seng gdong sngon du 'phyo: klu bdud mtsho nag gnyan srin mo: chu srin gdong can rgyab tu 'brang : gdug pa'i lus la rtsub pa yi: bshan pa chen mo gtso 'khor gsum: rig 'dzin bdag gi bos pa'i tshe: tshangs pa'i gnas dang klu yi yul: 'dzam gling 'di ru gar mchis kyang : ma thogs yud kyis gnas 'dir byon: khyed rnams las kyi rdzu 'phrul can: gzugs med mngon par shes pa rtogs: gang la ci bgyis khyod kyis shes: bdag ni rnal 'byor ma nyes so: tshe gcig byang chub sgrub pa la: bdud dang dam sris glags 'tshol so: 'gong po dam sri'i sna 'dren ma: srin mo dmar rgyan nam: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: gzugs phung sde brgyad khram du thob: bstan dgra dmar rgyan nam dam nyams shor ra re: steng phyogs tshangs pa 'phrul gyi gnas: skar mda' 'bebs pa drag mo'i gdong : dbang phyug ma hā dhe ba dang : u ma dhe ba'i sras gcig ma: seṅge'i gdong can dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo shor ra re: gza' nad steng grib char du phob: srid pa'i rgyal mo'i dus la bab: bstan dgra dam nyams shor ra re: khrag nad dmar yams me ltar 'phyo: chu srin gdong can dus la bab: dgra bo'i mi nor shor ra re: mdze nad lhog yams rdul ltar phob: dmigs pa'i byad ma gdug can 'di: bsrung yul skyabs 'og gar gnas kyang : ma gsum sring bzhis myur du khug: srid pa'i ma mo'i zas skal du: gtad do ma shor mthu ma chung : dgra bo'i pha sde nang tshan rnams:

seṅge'i gdong can khyod la gtad: lha yi sde dpon dmag tshogs kyis: bsgral ba'i las mdzad rtsal ma zhan: chu srin gdong can khyod la gtad: klu bdud nag po'i dmag tshogs kyis: mdze nad thob cig bang ma bul: dmigs pa'i dgra bo shor ra re: nyes can bstan dgra ma bkums na: lha mo re ti dam g.yel lam: khyed rnams las kyi pho nyar rbad: rgya mtshor gnas pa'i srog len ma: klu bdud pho nyar bskul du rbad: ma mo klu srin gdong pa yis: dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum la: klu yi mdze nad bco brgyad thob: sngon tshe padma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phur bka' bsgos dam bcas bzhin: rnal 'byor bdag la dgra byung na: srung ma dam can ra mda' rgyugs: lo zlar bzhag pa'i go skabs zad: mngon spyod yud kyis 'grub par mdzod: bhyo bhyoḥ ma mo nag mo kha la ral gcig la bhyoḥ rakmo ya ma dzwa la bstan dgra dam nyams kyi dmar rgyan ma sogs sam srog rtsa la thun bhyoḥ rakmo kha rag dunte a byā ta byā thun bhyoḥ dgra bo'i tsitta la bhyoḥ nā ga ti pa ra tsa myog myog: dgra bo'i sha la kying kying : khrag la rbad rbad: rus la shig shig: snying rtsa la 'ur 'ur: kaṃ shaṃ tri de shaṃ thun thun: nā ga du pra ma kā li ha te ru tra sha truṃ rmo lo chod: ti lo sha ya rbad: trig trig byad ma'i srog rtsa khrag rtsa la 'dus 'dus: 'ur 'ur sa ma ya myog myog: nan rbad rbad: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces srid pa ma bdud rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa bskal pa drag spyod kyi rlung ltar 'tshubs nas dmigs yul byad ma'i bla rten rnam shes phral nas: nad kyi rkyal kha phye: mtshon kyi gru gu gtor: klu'i mdze nad phab: lha srung bdud du bsgyur: lus ngag yid gsum thams cad chur bying ba ltar gyur pa'i dmigs pa bya: khyad par klu bdud ti pa ra tsa lcags sdig gi rnams pa can nam: sdom gyi dbyibs su yod pa de dgra bo'i sna bug g.yas nas zhugs te snying gar sleb pas: klu snying kun nag po'i pho brang du gyur par bsgom: sdom gzugs brkyang bskum bgyis pas khog pa'i rtsa mig thams cad khyab cing gang ba'i sbal lcong sbrul gyi rnam par bsam mo: de ltar dmod pa'i las bgyis pas bza' ba dmar rgyan mdze nad kyis gzir bar 'gyur ro: sngags rkang dmigs rim hrag bsdus 'di nyid lha mo rngam sgra ma'i bskor: de ltar zlog dmigs sogs kha sgyur dang 'gres rkang thams cad 'bri gung gzho stod du gsungs pa bzhin: dpal bsam yas su thugs sras nyer lnga la gdams pa gtad pa'i tshe khrigs chags su bkod pa'o: mchims phu dang gzho stod yer pa phug sogs shog dril so sor yin: sa ma yaḥ ma mo thun mong ma yin pa 'di nyid thugs kyi bu lnga la rab tu gdams pa gcig brgyud khyad par can no: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag gi ka ti ka yi dkyil du sbas te sbyar ba'o: sa ma ya: kho bo gnubs ban sangs rgyas ye shes la lo paṇa gyi dga' ston du gnang ba: dpal lha mo dgyes pa'i ka bstod dga' ston khrag 'thung rngam sgra gdangs su mchis so: bhyo bhyoḥ kā li nag mo ma skyes chos sku'i mdangs: kha mo cher bgrad sha za rab 'bar ma: ga shal la sogs g.yang gzhi'i rgyan spyod mdzes: nga ro ston gyis srid gsum khyon yang 'gengs: ca co mi bgyid bya ra'i mel tshe ma: cha lugs rnam par rgyal ba'i dpa' mor bstod: ja chang phud rgod la sogs drag po'i rdzas:

nya rgyas 'gengs pa'i mchod sprin g.yo ba 'di: ta thā ga ta'i bstan srung lha mor 'bul: tha dad mchis kyang gsang sngags rgyal bstan skyongs: da la dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang mo che: nā da ye shes rab dga' gsal stong ma: pa la bstan pa skyong byed sna tshogs gar: pha rol dgra bgegs mthar ba'i dbang mo che: ba spu'i dbyings las spros pa'i las mkhan gyis: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: tsā ri tra sogs nyer bzhi'i dbang mo che: tsha rong gnas sogs skyong ba'i g.yu sgron ma: dza yig spros pa'i pho nya ma mo gsum: wa ltar zhum pa'i dgra bo'i snying nas chums: zha rengs lkugs sogs smyo zhing 'bog par gyis: za gsod dbugs longs dgra bo'i snying khrag gtor: 'a ya he yis 'bod pa'i las mkhan tshogs: ya nga las kyi gshin rjes sa steng g.yo: ra gzengs sdig pa klu'i pho nya bzhin: la la dus la ma 'da' ci bzhin sgrol: sha khrag rgyu lus ngan goms dgra bo 'di: dmar rgyan ma'am mchan/ sa steng 'di nas zhan 'khri chod pa yis: ha ha'i dga' ston dwang ba'i dge mchis nas: a don skye med ye shes rtsal rdzogs shog: ces pa rjes su yi rangs te bstod pa 'di ni sangs rgyas ye shes dpal gyis so: sa ma ya: de nas rjes chog rgyas bsdus ci rigs gzhung nas med rung : rang bzhin chos mthun gyi spyi khog kha tshar btags pas chog go: 'di nyid ma mo'i rgyud phreng 'dzam gling snyan grags dang rgyud kha mthun gong 'og yin pas: slan chad kyang de ka'i bka' srung du'ang 'dod do: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: ḍākki'i rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro'i gnas nas gdan drangs shing shog ser las zhal bshus so// // nya) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gcod yul srung ma rol pa skya bdun bzhugs so: bla ma yum chen dbyings phyug bde chen dpa' mo'i sku la 'dud:

de yang snying thig srung ma btsan rgod rol pa skya bdun gyi gsol mchod brtsam pa la: thog mar bhandha'am zangs gzhong du chos 'byung bsnol ma bya: de yi steng du bshos bu zur gsum g.yas gcus la tsitta gsum gyis brgyan pa bya: chos 'byung gi rtsibs lnga ru dpal gtor g.yas gcus lnga: liṅga re res brgyan: mdun gyi rtsibs su sog kha gru gsum gyi steng du stod zur smad zlum gsum g.yon gcus bzhag: yongs 'khor mtheb skyu nyi shus bskor: rtse mo me ri dang khrag ling gis brgyan: mdun du sman phud rakta gtams: gzhan yang spyan gzigs ci 'byor bsham: sgrub rten mda' mo sgro gsum la dar dmar dang zangs sho zangs khram zangs kyi mda' gzhu ral gri khyad par za 'og khug mar bya pho mtshal lu'i snying dang rdo: mdung rtse pha bang long bu bcas zangs kyi me long yi ge tsa yis brgyan pa gzugs: stag lpags kyi rgyal mtshan nang sku 'bag yang 'chang ba ste sgrub gtor skabs su'o: sgrub gtor thun gtor khyad med par gong bzhin no: rgyas pa spyan gzigs sogs ma lcogs na gtor 'bul bsdus pa: dpal gtor che ba g.yas gcus gcig la 'khor drug gis bskor: mtheb skyu sha dum bcas bshams nas byin rlabs bya: de nas dngos gzhi cho ga'i las rim la 'jug pa ni: rkang gling thod rnga sogs rol mo bye brag dang bcas nas: ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la 'di skad do: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: swa bhā wa sogs: stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ dang keṃ las byung ba'i thod pa'i sku mkhar dmar smug ldem pa'i dbus su paṃ las padma dang ti las baṃ ro smug nag dbugs song drod ma yal ba'i steng du tsa: yi ge baṃ dang bhyo yongs su gyur pa las: ma cig thugs rje khros ma dmar mo sgra sgrogs zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa: phyag g.yas zangs kyi gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar zhing g.yon pas bhandha rakta dmar gyis bkang ba bsnams pa:

sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad rdzogs shing ye shes kyi me dpung dmar nag mched cing rab tu mched pa'i dbus su gsal ba'o: rtsa sngags: oṃ baṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti rā ga ha ri ni sa a we sha ya sarba pā shaṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ las sngags: oṃ dzra kro ti ma ma ru lu ru lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ srog sngags: oṃ badzra bāai ro tsa na ma ma yo gi ni hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā: zhes gang rung bzla: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid rje btsun ma gsal ba'i mdun du zangs ri dang khrag mtsho rba rlabs rab tu g.yo ba'i dbus su yi ge ram̐ dang e he tsa tri yongs su gyur pa las gnod sbyin chen po 'bar ba btsan gyi sde dpon: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dmar la gtum pa ya sos ma mchu mnan pa sku la dar dmar gyi rtse ber dang zangs khrab gsol ba dbu la zangs rmog ru dar lnga yis brgyan pa phyag g.yas zangs gri 'bar ba klad la bskor zhing g.yon pas zhags dmar ru mtshon bsnams pa: sked la stag ral gzig shubs ral gris brgyan te zhabs la swag lham g.yu mthil mnabs nas mtshal stag dmar po mgo dgu la chibs pa: de yi mdun du maṃ las ma mo gdong dmar ma me yi mdog can shin tu khros pa'i nyams dang ldan pa sku gcer mo bha ga dang nu ma rgyas shing khrag gi ral pa nam mkha'i dbyings su bsigs pa phyag g.yas spu gri dang : g.yon pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa: dred mong mi gzan la bzhon nas srid gsum khyab par rgyug pa: gzhan yang yab yum gyi 'khor du: sku yi sprul pa lha btsan dkar po shel khrab gsol nas phyag g.yas dar mdung dang g.yon pas rgyal mtshan bsnams te seṅge la bzhon pa: gsung gi sprul pa brag btsan dmar po bswe khrab gsol nas phyag gnyis gnam lcags kyi mda' gzhu 'gengs shing gcan spyang lag ring la bzhon pa: thugs kyi sprul pa bdud btsan nag po lcags khrab gsol nas phyag g.yas shang lang dang g.yon pas lcags phur thogs te dom nag smyon pa la bzhon pa:

yon tan gyi sprul pa klu btsan mthing nag g.yu khrab gsol nas phyag g.yas sbrul zhags dang g.yon pas nad rkyal thogs te chu srin dmar po la bzhon pa: phrin las kyi sprul pa dmu btsan smug nag mchong khrab gsol nas phyag g.yas tho ba dang g.yon pas tsitta bsnams te rngam pa'i gzig chen la bzhon pa: de thams cad kyang stag ral gzig shubs sogs chas gos rang rang mthun pa'i go mtshon dpa' ba'i rang bzhin tu mi sdug pa'i gzugs du ma dang ldan zhing gcan spyang gi zhon rta rnams kyi dgra bgegs thams cad hab hab za ba'i ngar sgra sgrog ste 'dur zhing 'phyo la 'khyugs pa'o: de'i nam mkha' la rang rang gi gzugs dang mthun pa'i bya sha gzan du ma 'jums pa yang 'khor du bshan pa gcer bu sna tshogs mtshon cha ma nges pa 'dzin cing gar bsgyur ba thams cad dgra bo'i srog la rngam pa: gcan gzan khrag 'thung mang pos sa gzhi 'gengs shing ngar sgra 'byin pa ste rab tu 'jigs pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad me rlung 'tshub ma 'gengs pa'i dbus su gsal ba'o: oṃ e he troṃ ha ri kha ṭa ma ru tse gu na tri ta tsa shu la kha re ṭa dza dza swā hā: zhes pas gsal gdab: de nas dmar gsur btang zhing rol mo 'khrol nas spyan 'dren pa ni: hoḥ rang gi thugs ka'i bhyo las dzaḥyig stong gsum khyab par 'phros: btsan rgod 'khor bcas gnas mchog gang du bzhugs kyang skad cig gis spyan drangs par gyur: dza dzaḥ rje btsun chen mo'i dgongs pa ste: ma cig dmar mo sgra sgrogs kyi: ci ltar bsgos pa'i bka' bzhin du: gnod sbyin btsan gyi sde dpon rnams: ma thogs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dzaḥ de yang dam tshig brtan pa ni: sngon tshe ri bo ma la yar: dbang chen padma'i dam la gnas: u tsa la yi gnas mchog tu: rdo rje phag mo'i dam la gnas: bar bskal bal bod so mtshams su: pad 'byung dam pas bka' la btags: 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro ru: ye shes mtsho rgyal bro yang bor:

phyi mor lho kha zangs ri ru: ma cig lab sgron tha tshig bsrungs: gcod yul bstan pa skyong ba'i tshe: btsan rgod 'bar ba spun du grags: de ltar sngon gyi dam tshig bzhin: ma g.yel ma g.yel gnas 'dir byon: zhi byed gcod yul brgyud pa yi: bka' yi rgya 'di gnyer ba'i phyir: skad cig nyid la spyan drangs gyur: oṃ raṃ bu ghu la he tsa tri dza shu la ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥtri a tsa du na shu bhe tri shu yan dza dzaḥ zhes pas btsan rgod 'khor bcas brten bskyed la byon te thim par bsam: de nas rten la bzhugs te mchod pa 'bul ba ni: bhyoḥ ma cig dmar mo sgra sgrogs kyi: bstan pa srung ba'i bka' nyan pa: gnod sbyin btsan rgod 'khor bcas rnams: zangs ri khrag mtsho'i dbus nyid du: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i gdan la bzhugs: zhi byed gcod kyi bstan pa srungs: dgyes pa'i ched du legs par bstod: dzaḥ gnod sbyin chen po mi bsrun pa: 'bar ba btsan gyi sde tshogs la: dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: dmar chen khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: ngar chen gtar ba'i mchod pa 'bul: sha khrag dmar gyi mchod pa 'bul: rol mo sgra yi mchod pa 'bul: sman raka phud kyi mchod pa 'bul: bdud rtsi dza gad mchod pa 'bul: bha ling gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: mthun rdzas sna tshogs mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags zab chos skyong ba dang : gcod kyi bstan pa bsrung du gsol: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang ba bgyi ba ni: bhyo bhyoḥ ma yum chen thugs las spros pa'i sras: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi: bstan pa skyong ba'i bka' nyan pa: gcod yul zab brgya'i las byed phyir: gnod sbyin chen po 'khor bcas la: dgyes pa dam pa bskyed pa'i ched: rten dang brten par bya ba'i phyir:

zangs ri 'od ldan thugs dam bskang : g.yo zhing rtag tu 'khor ba'i phyir: khrag mtsho mer bas thugs dam bskang : dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs pa'i phyir: bam chen gdan gyis thugs dam bskang : snang srid mched cing zin bya'i phyir: me rlung 'tshub mas thugs dam bskang : sku yi dpa' ba'i chas brgyad phyir: go khrab mtshon chas thugs dam bskang : skad cig stong gsum nyul ba'i phyir: zhon rta gcan spyang thugs dam bskang : dgra bo'i klad la 'jums pa'i phyir: 'dab chags lang ling thugs dam bskang : dgra bgegs snying rtsa 'gum pa'i phyir: bshan pa 'khor tshogs thugs dam bskang : dgra bo bla 'khyams dgug pa'i phyir: gcan gzan 'phyo bas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs nas dgra bgegs sgrol: gcod yul bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: dzaḥ dam tshig chen po bstan pa'i phyir: me long tsa yis brgyan pa 'dis: gnod sbyin chen po'i thugs dam bskang : mda' dar ma yis brgyan pa 'dis: tsa tri ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : tsitta a yis brgyan pa 'dis: lha yi btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : mdung rtse sha yi brgyan pa 'dis: brag gi btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : rdo lung du yis brgyan pa 'dis: bdud kyi btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : zangs sho na yis brgyan pa 'dis: klu yi btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : zangs khrol tri yis brgyan pa 'dis: dmu yi btsan rgod thugs dam bskang : zangs gri mda' gzhu dzas brgyan 'dis: 'khor tshogs bshan pa'i thugs dam bskang : stag gi rgyal mtshan sku 'bag 'dis: spyi dang bye brag thugs dam bskang : spyan gzigs mchod pa sna tshogs 'dis: rol pa 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs shing dgyes bskyed nas: gcod yul bstan pa rgyas par mdzod: bshags pa ni: hoḥ ma 'byor nyams dang 'bag pa dang : phud dang lhag ma 'dres pa dang : spyan gzigs mchod pa chad dang lhag: dus kyi mchod pa gnyer ba dang : tshig gi gdangs la sgra zur nyams:

bskyed rdzogs gdeng dang mi ldan sogs: nyes par gyur pa ci mchis pa: gcod yul skyong la bzod par gsol: sa ma ya shuddhe shuddhe tsa tri shuddhe hoḥ zhes pas nongs par bya: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: zangs ri dgu brtsegs dang bcas nas: bhyo bhyoḥ dzaḥ khrag mtsho mer ba rba rlabs 'khrugs pa'i dbus: zangs ri zangs mkhar ldem pa'i klong shed nas: ma cig bstan pa skyong ba'i mthu bo che: gnod sbyin chen po mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs: me 'od mdangs ldan srin po khros pa'i zhal: zangs khrab rmog zhu go mtshon lus la brgyan: stag mo myur mgyogs ri bkra mgo dgu zhon: mi sha khrag gi dri tshor bzod glags med: bltas pa tsam gyis sa gsum sngangs byed pa: myur mgyogs dregs pa btsan gyi sde dpon che: 'bar ba stag zhon khyod la bdag bstod do: dzaḥ srin po'i bu mo shanting ro gzan ma: dmar 'od zhags pa'i mdangs bzhin las la 'gyu: gcer mo rngam byed khrag gi ral pa bsigs: phyung rdeg 'bar ba'i sgyogs chen dgra la 'debs: dred maung mi gzan zhon mdzad gdong dmar ma: res 'ga' mkha' la 'gyu zhing 'dzam gling bskor: gnas nyul ma mo kun gyi gtso mo mdzad: dam nyams srog la rgod pa'i las byed mkhan: mdza' mo ku 'debs khyod la bdag bstod do: dzaḥ gangs ri rngam lhun g.ya' spang brag dkar bdag: lha yi dge bsnyen tshangs pa dung thod can: nyid zhi khro ba'i rnal 'byor rab 'bar ba: dpa' ba'i chas brgyan dkar po dge bcu sgrub: nag phyogs 'joms byed seṅge dkar mo zhon: srid pa'i lha rabs dgu yi gtso bo mdzad: dam pa bdud kyi gcod yul las kun byed: sham po la sogs gangs gnyan nyer gcig srung : lha btsan chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: dzaḥ brag dmar srin po khros 'dra'i ri dmar bdag: bshan pa'i gzugs la dgra lha'i go cha can: g.ya' spang gangs gsum 'gyu ba'i mi dmar po: gcan spyang sngon mo lag ring myur mgyogs bzhon:

me zhags dmar po 'tshub ma'i mdun du rgyug: dgra jag chom po gzhom phyir 'ur gyis 'gengs: res 'ga' la rtse kun tu lam lam 'gyu: skabs su lung gsum nyul zhing bam ro za: brag btsan rgyal ba khyod la bdag bstod do: dzaḥ brag nag ri nag chu nag mun gling bdag: bdud nag nag po stong gi sna 'dren pa: mdog nag dbyar gyi char sprin gtibs pa'i gzugs: nag po'i chas zhugs mtshon cha'i 'khor lo bskor: dom nag smyon pa bzhon nas gling du rgyud: kha rag nag po mgo dgu'i bdud yul nas: dur khrod bdag por rgyu zhing mtshan mo 'gro: nag phyogs sdig can sgrol mdzad bdud kyi ging : bdud btsan nag po khyod la bdag bstod do: rab 'jigs skyi g.ya' ri bo'i khong seng dang : mtsho nag rba rlabs 'khrugs dang chu chen bdag: ma rig glen pa'i tshul ldan blun la chags: dug mtshon g.yo ldan du mas lus la brgyan: mthong na mi sdug gzugs 'chang nag khras khyab: nyon mongs tsha ba'i ngad ldan chu srin zhon: sdong po gser lag can dang ma gro gnas: ma cig jo mo'i bka' dang bstan pa srung : klu btsan brda skyong khyod la bdag bstod do: dzaḥ ri rgyal lhun po'i sul dang gru 'dzin dang : gnya' shing bshol mda' 'dzin sogs dbang chen pa: sa yi las byed mkha' dang 'khor mar rgyu: sde brgyad yongs kyis sna 'dren dmag dpon byed: thog ser tsha grang 'thab pa'i las kun gtor: gza' yi pho nya'i mtshon cha lus la brgyan: the se'i mjug mthud 'phyo ba'i gzig chen zhon: gnyan sa grangs med gnyer ba'i bdag po ste: sa bdag dmu btsan khyod la bdag bstod do: dzaḥ mkha' yi rgyan gyur za byed sder mchu can: sprul pa'i las byed bshan pa nyi khri stong : dgra bo'i bla 'gugs gcan spyang 'dur zhing rgyug: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba'i pho nya dang : gcod yul bka' yi las byed bya ra mkhan: phyi nang skyong ba las byed sprul pa'i tshogs: rab tu rgyu zhing dur khrod tshogs khang bsrung :
dmar mo sgra sgrogs bka' yi bstan skyong ba: zhi byed snying thig spel la 'dun pa'i tshogs: ma lus 'khor dang bcas la bdag bstod do: oṃ e he ma ru tse shu la ma ya a tsa du na tri dza dza swā hā:

zhes mang nyung gang du 'dod kyang thun mtshams sbyor pa dang bstun: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni: dzaḥ 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas mchog dbang ldan yul: zangs mkhar rtse dgu 'bar ba'i gnas mchog nas: ma cig bka' yi bstan pa'i bya ra ba: 'bar ba btsan kyi sde dpon mthu bo che: sgrol ging srog bdag me 'od gdong can dang : srog bdud 'bar ma zangs kyi mche ba can: lha btsan brag btsan bdud btsan klu yi btsan: dmu btsan la sogs bshan pa gri thogs 'bum: gzhan yang bya gcan sprul pa yongs 'khor bcas: gcod yul bka' yi srung ma ma lus rnams: sngon tshe dmar mo sgra sgrogs bka' bzhin du: yum chen mtsho rgyal bstan pa skyong ba dang : da lta sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bu bzhin gnyer: tha tshig bzhin du dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dkar po dge bcu 'bad pa'i rogs dan sgrubs: tshe chos zas nor longs spyod bsod nams spel: 'jig rten dge zhing lo legs bkra shis skrun: nad mug 'khrug rtsod yams nad zhi ba dang : bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs tshar bcad nas: ma rungs gdug pa'i g.yul tshogs gzhom pa'i phyir: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ e he ma ru tse ghu na hri ta tsa shu la ma ya a tsa du na tri dza tri'u gur lenta sad bhyo sarba i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: rakta la khā hi: tsitta la khā hi: go ro tsa na la khā hi: bha su ta la khā hi: i daṃ bha lingta la kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma gang rung ngam byang shar ram btsan gnas sa'i sa phyogs su 'bul: sa ma ya: de nas do gal che na thugs dam bskul zhing phrin las bcol ba ni: drag po'i lcags snod nang du 'bru nag dpal bshos rno ba'i dpal dang ldan pa bya: dbyibs gong gi gtor ma dang 'gras liṅga dang tsitta la sogs rgyan mi dgos: rtsang dmar gyis brgyan: dug khrag sogs khrag sna du mas ngar btags nas mda' hoṃ gyi kha ru bzhag:

'og tu liṅga zhig kyang bzhag: lan gsum bkug nas zhal du bskul dang bstun nas bstab: de nas bden stobs brjod pa ni: hoḥ mdun du e las lcags khang nag po'i dbus su byad ma dgra bgegs mngon sum du gsal bar gyur: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba gsum dang bka' sdod chos skyong gi srung ma dam can gter bdag yul lha gzhi bdag khyad par dregs pa'i sde dpon bdun bshan pa btsan rgod 'bum gyi bka' bden pa'i mthus: bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la: gnod sems log par lta ba'i: sdang bar byed pa'i dgra: gnod par byed pa'i bgegs: bar du gcod pa'i rkyen dmag sna jag sna rkun sna ston pa: ma nyes kha yog 'debs pa shag ngan pa'i sna 'dren byed pa sogs bsam sbyor log par 'chang ba gang yin pa thams cad rang dbang med par gzugs liṅga 'di la khug cig: dza badzra aṃ ku sha ya dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes dmigs pa dgra bo mngon sum du thim par bsam: de nas bsgral ba ni: dzaḥ las byed sprul pa'i bshan pa me ru rtse: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir ral gri phyung rdeg 'bebs: rno dbal 'debs pas byad ma'i srog snying dkrug: las byed chen po'i thugs dam dus la bab: sgrol cig gtubs shig phye mar khrag tu bskyil: mā ra ya nṛ tri sha trun rbad rbad bhandha bhandha tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭḥ dum bur gtub nas cung zad bzhag: skabs su bskul gyi nang du 'bul: de nas las su chas pa ni: bhyoḥ nga ni khros ma nag mo'i sku: nga ni bde chen dkar mo'i sku: nga ni ser mo don grub sku: nga ni dmar mo sgra sgrogs sku: nga ni sna tshogs mthar phyin sku: nga ni lcags gdong drag mo'i sku: nga ni phag gdong za byed sku: nga las che ba su yang med: nga yi bka' nyan las byed pa: stong khams 'di ru drag rtsal can: srog bdag spun bdun las la bskul: dzaḥ ri bo thams cad zangs kyi ri: 'bab chu thams cad khrag gi mtsho:

rtsi shing thams cad mtshon cha'i gling : sgra skad thams cad srog gcod gdangs: steng na sprin dmar chi li li: bar na rlung dmar 'u ru ru: sa gzhi me zhags wa la la: 'od dmar 'tshub ma kyi li li: 'jigs pa'i 'brug sgra di ri ri: glog dmar zhags pa khyugs se khyug: lcags kyi ser ba hri li li: gnam lcags thog dmar sha ra ra: rab tu 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog nas: btsan rgod chen po las la bskul: bzhengs shig drag mo dbyings nas bzhengs: srog bdag dmar mo dbyings nas bzhengs: srog bdud ma mo dbyings nas bzhengs: lha btsan chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: brag btsan chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: bdud btsan chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: klu btsan chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: dmu btsan chen po dbyings nas bzhengs: yang 'khor bshan pa dbyings nas bzhengs: zangs ri 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhengs: gangs ri chen po'i rtse nas bzhengs: brag ri dmar po'i zur nas bzhengs: klu mtsho khol ma'i klong nas bzhengs: mu le mthing gi dkyil nas bzhengs: ri rab 'bar ba'i zom nas bzhengs: bshan pa 'tshogs pa'i mthil nas bzhengs: za byed me ltar 'bar zhing bzhengs: srog bdag chu ltar khol zhing bzhengs: las byed sprin ltar gtibs shing bzhengs: pho nya rlung ltar 'tshub cing bzhengs: sgrol byed rdul ltar bsnyil zhing bzhengs: bzhengs nas dmigs pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol: btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa la: dgra sha khrag gi mchod pa 'bul: bstab bo bstab bo zhal du bstab: dmigs pa'i dam nyams sdig can gyi: pho rgyud mo rgyud rigs rgyud dang : khang khyim phyugs zhing ka cha bcas: srog bdag chen po'i zhal du bstab: srog gcod ma mo'i zhal du bstab: lha btsan chen po'i zhal du bstab: brag btsan chen po'i zhal du bstab: bdud btsan chen po'i zhal du bstab: klu btsan chen po'i zhal du bstab: bzhes shig lhag med bzhes su gsol: dzaḥ rab 'bar srog bdag mthu mo che:

bshan pa sde bdun las la bhyoḥ sangs rgyas bstan dgra bsgral ba'i phyir: gnod sbyin chen po las la bhyoḥ rnal 'byor sgos sgra bsgral ba'i phyir: srog 'phrog ma mo las la bhyoḥ pha rol dmag gi dpung gzhom phyir: lha ging btsan rgod las la bhyoḥ dgra bo'i rigs rgyud gcod pa'i phyir: klu btsan chen po las la bhyoḥ dgra bo'i nor rdzas gzhom pa'i phyir: dmu btsan chen po las la bhyoḥ dgra bo shul med gtong ba'i phyir: yang 'khor bshan pa las la bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo rgyug rgyug dgra la rgyugs: nga yi nor gyi phyi la rgyugs: nga yi rdzas kyi rjes la rgyugs: nga yi ka cha'i phyi la rgyugs: nga dang 'gras pa'i dgra bo la: cho 'phrul sna dgu thongs la shog: btsan dmar bshan pas ku sgra thob: mi dmar liṅga bsgrengs pa thongs: dmag dang chu bo dmar po dang : bud med dmar mos cho nge thob: mi nag 'jigs pas bswo sgra sgrogs: sbrul nag 'bum gyi khang khyim khong : mi ma yin gyi gnam rdo phob: ran 'thag bskor zhing rang me sbor: a tsar mun pas sgo rdung thongs: ming nas bos la ngu brang rdungs: wa chu khrag tu 'bab pa gyis: wa la sprel zhon sgo khyim rgyugs: srod la 'dre mo bong zhon thongs: tho rangs rnga mong khyung zhon thongs: bya than sna tshogs khyim du phob: bya rog 'ug pa 'thab pa thongs: tho rangs sgo khyi ngu bar gyis: nam phyed rta pho 'tsher bar gyis: srod la bya pho ku 'debs thongs: ban de dmar pos khang khyim khong : bon po nag pos sa gzhi khong : gcan spyang cho nge 'dur rgyug thongs: sa rud rdo rud chu rud thongs: thog dang ser bas yul zhing khong : ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra la phob: mi rung sna lnga dgra la phob: gri rigs bco brgyad dgra la phob: mdze rigs sna dgu dgra la phob: dug rigs sna dgu dgra la phob: dgra bo'i 'byung ba 'khrugs su chug: dgra bo smyo shing 'bogs su chug: dgra bo mgo 'khor yid dkrugs la:

brgyal zhing myur du ring bar gyis: rbad pa'i las la mthu ma chung : bskul ba'i las la rgyang ma ring: mngags pa'i las la bang ma bul: bcol ba'i las la rtags ma zhan: dmod pa'i las la rtsal ma zhan: rbad do rbad do dgra la rbad: myur mgyogs chen po'i dus la bab: do nub nam gyi gung thun la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khrid la shog: srog rtsa rbad kyis chod la shog: snying khrag hub kyis 'thung la shog: rnam shes rten dang phrol la shog: dus la bab bo dam ma g.yel: gtor ma gnam lcags ri bo 'di: 'phangs pas dgra yul mgo mjug ldog: sa ru bsres pas lhag med thongs: zor sna snang srid lha 'dres drongs: zor dpung btsan rgod 'bum gyis skyed: zor 'debs bshan pa tshogs kyis gyis: zor 'phang tshur la ma bzlog cig: zor zor rdugs su ma bskyod par: de ring dgra bgegs bsgral bar mdzod: mā ra ya yi dus la bab: bstab bo bstab bo las la yā: oṃ e he troṃ ha ri kha ṭa ma ru tse ghu na hri ta tsa shu la kha re ṭa ma ya a tsa du na tri tri'u gur len ta shu la ra tsa bhyo bhyo dgra la rgyug 'ur wa 'ur ba thun bhyo dgra bo'i snying la bhyo bhyo srog la bhyo bhyo dbugs la bhyo bhyo don snying lnga la bhyo bhyo srog rtsa chod chod 'gas 'gas ya ya bzlog bzlog rbad rbad nan nan raṃ raṃ dza dza bhyo bhyo thun thun bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces pas gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang ngo : dmigs pa ni btsan rgod bshan pa sde bdun 'khor snang srid lha 'dre dang bcas pa dmag thabs su dgra yul bkang zhing dgra bo ming med pa rtsad nas brlags par bsam: slar gtang rag gsol mchod bzang po btang : sa ma ya: yang dag ka cha dang nor rdzas dgra yis khyer ba'am 'phral du dgra byung na brag dmar ram ri dmar ram gnyan sa ru rung : gnyan 'bod dang btsan gtor sogs dgos pa byung na: snga ltar gtor ma zhig bzos khrag sna'i rdzas bcas thogs te ri mthon po'i la btsas rtsar phyin:

rang nyid khros ma nag mor bsgom: thog mar lus sbyin tshar gcig btang : de nas snang srid lha 'dre dbang sdud bya zhing : la btsas nas blangs pa'i rdo la tho bdun bya: byung na dgra bo'i rjes sa la sbrus pa'i liṅga sngar ltar byas la zhal bstab bya: tho thams cad rol pa mched bdun bsgom: zor 'phang ba dang rol pa mched bdun g.yog 'khor dang bcas dgra yul du chas nas dgra bo ming med du brlag par bsgom: zor sngags re re dang tho de yi rdo re re 'phangs te lha srin sde brgyad kyi dpung bskyed par bsam: rdo brgya las mi nyung ba 'phang : dmigs pa zor gzhung gi dmod pa de rnams thams cad dgra la rtags dang ltas ngan sna tshogs 'bebs par bsam: dgra bo la rtags ma byung rmi ltas byung kyang rung : bar zhag 'ga' re de khar 'dug: 'di skabs spobs pa che bar bya: thogs dmigs shes pa gnad yin: cho 'phrul ci byung yo lang sbyor: dgra bo sod rtags byung na lhar la btsas gso zhing btsan gsol brgya tshar las mi nyung bar bya ri bstod btang : dgra bo btsan la gtad na dgra bo'i rkang rjes sa la liṅga bya zhing gong gsum btsan la gtad: kha bsgyur zor zlog bya: rtags nges par 'byung ngo : 'di nyid ma cig mtsho rgyal gyi bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa khyad 'phags te: sngon ti sgro'i srung ma btsan rgod sog ra bya ba de yin: mtsho rgyal la g.yar dam che bas phyi mo ma cig lab sgron zangs ri ru bzhugs skabs de khar gnas shing phrin las bsgrubs: gcod kyi srung ma 'bar ba mched bdun du grags: mched thams cad yab yum lcam dral gyi sras sam sprul pa'i snang brnyan tsam du ma gtogs don la gcig tu 'dod par bshad: nges pa'i rgyu'o: sa ma ya: ma cig thugs bcud bdud rtsi las: 'bar ba gnod sbyin sgrub thabs bzhag: las can de dang 'phrad pa'i tshe: gcod yul bstan pa mtha' rgyas shog: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i mel tshe che: rgya 'di dge bsnyen sde bzhis srungs:

dur khrod tshogs khang-i atsha rgya: sa ma ya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor gdan drangs shing sa bya lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas dag par zhal bshus so// ta) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: gcod gdams thogs bcas thogs med kyi lam khyer zab mo bzhugs so: bla ma gsang ba rigs kyi ḍākki ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mtsho rgyal zab gsang thig le las: snod gnyan ri khrod 'grim pa'i tshe: thogs med snyems thag ma chod pas: thogs bcas mtshan 'dzin cho 'phrul gyis: 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa las: steng 'og thog ces 'byung ba ste: de dag lam khyer gdams pa ni: thog mar lus sbyin gtong ba'i tshe: snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre rnams: sha khrag bdud rtsis tshim byas nas: phan dge byang chub lam zhugs shing : 'byung bzhi rang sar bstan pa dang : snang bzhi tshad la phebs nas su: pha ma'i 'du shes bskyed par bsam: gang zhig nag phyogs lha 'dre'i rigs: da dung gdug sems ldan gyur zhing : phyi lhong thogs bcas brtsam pa na: ngag tu 'di ltar brjod par bya: phaṭḥ rang nyid ye shes mtsho rgyal ni: chos sku yum chen pha rol phyin: sku mdog smug nag 'od du 'bar: ral gri glegs bam snyan thad gdengs: thugs kar zil gnon phyag rgya can: sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: phyid skyil bam gyi gdan la bzhugs: 'od kyis snang srid khyab par 'gengs: srid gsum dbu ma'i zom du gnas: snang srid 'di na 'gran zla bral: nga las che ba su yang med: kun rgyu 'tshogs pa'i dur khrod du: 'khor 'das zil gyis gnon par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas ya gi'i sangs rgyas nas ma ki dmyal ba'i bar gyi 'khor ba ru gnas pa dang : mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad chos sku yum chen mo mtsho rgyal gyi rol par bsam: de yi ngang las rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyis ri rab 'dzin pa ltar:

'byung lngas bsdus pa'i lha 'dre thams cad 'gul bskyod mi nus par bsgom: yang rang gi thugs ka nas gser gyi mchod rten dmar ser 'od 'bum phrag tshwa tshwa'i rnam pa lta bas mi bzod pa 'phros pas ri bo dang mnyam pa stong 'phros pas snang srid lha 'dre rnams rud chen gyis zhing kha mnan pa ltar g.yo 'gul med par bsgom: yang rang nyid kyi thugs ka nas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: gsung gi rol pa yi ge āḥdamar po nyi ma'i mdangs can tsha ba'i ngad g.yo ba grangs med 'phros te gnyan sa dang lha 'dre rnams la phog pas āḥ'od du zhu ste kha ba chen pos ri g.yogs pa ltar phyal gyis mnan nas nam yang bros rgyu mi nus par bsgom: des kyang ma non na rang nyid mu stegs mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog nag mo dpral ba'i mdzod snang shin tu g.yer ba skra kham nag dpyid ka'i bu yug ltar gtibs pa spyan gsum nyi zla'i mdangs ltar steng 'og phyogs bcur gzigs pas snang srid lha 'dre thams cad rngon pas ri dwags ded pa ltar bred yed yed ci bsgo ba'i las bya'o zer bar bsam: g.yas 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang g.yon gnam lcags kyi hom khung thogs nas: de'i nang lha 'dre rnams dbang med du nya bye tshan gyi khor yug tu tshud pa ltar 'phar lding nyug nyug tu 'gugs par bsam:

phaṭḥ ma cig gnas 'gyur mu stegs phra men ma: shin tu mi bzod mdog nag srin mo'i gzugs: dbu skra zings pas 'khor yug gdugs ltar kheb: ral pa'i gseb nas spu gri'i char pa 'bebs: lcags kyu nag phyogs lha 'dre'i snying la bsnun: srid pa'i lcags khang nag po'i sgrom du bsdus: 'byung ba go ldog mchod rten nag pos mnan: srid pa'i rlung yang steng 'og mi thar bsgom: ma mum ram mum ram: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ni na nan phaṭḥ ces pa'i dmigs bya rim pa dgu rim du mnan cing 'byung ba lnga yi kha dog mchod rten lnga mgo mjug ldog ste brtsigs pa'i rnam pas nag po 'og ma'i mgo de lcags kyi dbal phur zhig tu gyur nas 'byung po nag phyogs rnams kyi snying khar zugs pas ma bzod nas dam blangs par snyam: skabs su lus sbyin bya zhing mnyam bzhag bya: lhong tshad rdzogs nas tshar tshad byung na yang bskyar mi dgos: dmigs pa 'di mu stegs spa ma gong khug lugs zer: mtha' gcod dang sgab 'dre bcad skabs kyang sbyar rung : mtha' gcod dang sgab 'dre bcad nas gnyan dmigs su rdo kha dog lnga tho brtsegs: thog mar nag po ser po dkar po dmar po ljang gu ste 'byung ba lnga ru bsgom: phaṭḥre re bzhin nag po 'og ma byas nas mgo mjug ldog par bya: chu rud dang sa rud rbab rgod sogs kyis ltas byung na gnyan sa'i sde brgyad dang gzugs kyi rde'u gnyen dmigs su mnan: gnas skabs su yin na gnas sa'i 'og tu mnan: yang na lham nang du bcug: sde brgyad kha dog ri dang mtshungs dkar po lha dmar po btsan nag po bdud sngon po klu khra bo gza' smug nag dam can nam the'u rang ser po sa bdag smug po dmu skya bo dgra lha sngo skya g.ya' spang skyes gcig: chu thams cad klu rigs te gnyan sa gang yin gyi sa btson rdo btson blang : yun ring gnyan gcod yin na: khyim du log kha bar btson nas mi gtong :
