mthar ngo bo āḥdakar skye med yum chen mo'i thugs kar bstim la rang gsal stong nyid du 'dug pa'o: sa ma ya: yang thogs bcas thogs med zung 'brel gyi gdams pas: 'byung ba tsha grang 'thab pa'i rkyen gyis nam mkha'i thog dang sa gzhi'i 'khyugs bya ba ste cho 'phrul byung na: de dag lam la khyer ba ar gtad pa'o: byung ngam ma byung dngos sam rmi lam brtag pa ni: rmi lam du gser dngul zangs rag lcags dang 'khar ba li sogs ka cha'am mtshon cha'i rigs bkod pa dang ster mkhan byung ba dang mgar ba mang pos bzo brgyab pa dang : khro chu bzhu ba sogs rmis na nges par ser ba 'byung : dngos su mtshon cha bkod pa dang 'bul mkhan dang nyams za zi la sbud pa'i sgra thos pa tshwa tshwa zhun khu'i skad thos pas 'bir ba: skam glog 'khyugs pa stong sgra 'byung ba: nam mkha' dwang ba'am sprin pa khro le ba yang yang byer: nyin phyed lho phyogs nas sprin nag po lcags sdig 'dra ba sbal pa 'dra ba: phag 'dra ba dang sbrul 'khyil ba 'dra ba dang 'brug lang ba 'dra ba: drang srong gi dbyibs 'dra ba nag mo gzhong thogs 'dra ba rdo rje khu tshur 'dra ba sogs: rim par byung ngam re re yang yang 'byung : 'dus shing tshogs pa yang 'byung : yang sprin nag po rngams 'thug la thag shar nag po brkyang ba lta bu byung na thog ser 'byung ba'i rtags yin: de 'dra'i rmi lam dang nyams snang du 'tshub lhong che ba byung na gong gi zil gnon dang : ar gtad mang du bya: khyad par rmi lam nyams su byung ba'i sde brgyad de yang yang bkug: drag tu bcun: skabs su mnyam par bzhag: gal srid thog ser ma byung na mig rgyang tsam mam: tho rangs sprin pa ma lang gong gnyan dmigs nas rde'u bdun blangs la: phaṭḥ rang rig skya med mkha' 'gro ma: ye shes mtsho rgyal drag mo'i sku: mthing nag phyag gnyis mchod rten bsnams: thugs kar āḥlas spros pa'i mtshon: gnam lcags rdo rje dpag tshad tsam:

gcig las gnyis chad stong gsum gang : 'od zhu lha 'dre rgya chings bsdams: nam yang 'gul bskyod med pa'i steng : mchod rten nag po'i zor gyis mnan: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ: zil gnon sngags ni: oṃ ha ri ni sa badzra phaṭḥ thog gnon sngags: oṃ badzra bi na mukti ti gatstsha āḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pa bdun bzlas la rde'u rnams la btab nas gnam lcags mchod rten gyis stong gsum gang zhing sde brgyad rnams skad ngan tse re mnan par bsam: zil gnon skabs 'don sgom ltar zhu lum bya: sa ma ya: yang thog dmigs gnyan po thog bab ni: phaṭḥbyas pas rang gi rig pa de gnam lcags kyi rdo rje rtse dgu zhig tu gyur nas: phar 'phros pas sde brgyad thog thogs dang bcas pa 'brug mo glog 'gyu dang bcas pa la phog pas phye mar brlag cing mtha' yi rgya mtsho'i phar mthar bskrad par bsam: tshur 'phros pas rang lus gnyan sa lha 'dre'i pho brang dang bcas pa la phog pas rang lus kyang thul gyis bsregs nas stong par song : lha 'dre'i pho brang mgo mjug ldog cing nam mkha' 'og tu bab pa gzhi steng du slebs nas skabs su sil bur 'thor ba dang res mos kyis bsgom: de ni chu nang du zla ba shar ba'i gdams pa can no: de dag res mos su bya yang rang nyid gnam lcags rdo rje de yi ra dbus ma'i lte bar mar snang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa kha sbyor gyi bar du lha srin sde brgyad thams cad g.yas g.yon du res mos 'khor bas 'du shes kyi rten rang sar zhig nas 'khor lo ltar 'khor te dran bzod med par bsgom: mthar stong par bzhag: des lha 'dre rnams ngo tshar skye zhing : bdag 'dzin zhig pa dang rnam rtog rang yal du 'gro'o: sa ma ya: yang sangs rgyas gur phub pa ltar ni: rang nyid ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i tshad du gyur nas lha 'dre thams cad zhabs gser gyi 'khor lo'i 'og tu tshud nas g.yo 'gul med par bsgom:

steng nam mkha' thams cad sangs rgyas grangs med pas gang : de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros: sa gzhi thams cad g.yu yi rgya mtsho shin tu dwang pa bsil ba'i ngad dmyal chu bas grang ba: de'i shugs kyis snod bcud thams cad ardza ltar gas: padma ltar shin tu gas: utpal ltar ches gas par gyur: des nang du lha 'dre thams cad tshud pas: kha shin tu bsdams nas bros sa'i sgo med par bsgom: yang gong gi sngags lan bdun bzlas te rde'u cha gcig dang bcas lham nang bcug la kha bsdams nas 'og tu mnan: lha dam lcags kyi khang sgrom lham mdud dug sbrul nag po: rang nyid rdo rje drag mor sgom nas mnan cing bsdams pa'i dmigs pa bya: 'di'i bar tshig 'khor gcig rtsa med du gyur bas phangs kyang ci byar zad/ 'phong gnam la bstan pa gcer bur bya: skabs su lham sprug sprug byas pas snang srid chu ltar khol bar bsam: mthar zor du 'phang ba'i tshe sde brgyad thams cad mtha' lcags ri'i phyi rol du bskrad par bsam: dmigs pa lan bdun bya: mthar stong nyid du bzhag: sa ma ya: yang mtsho rgyal jo mo'i lugs kyi phur khra gong khug ma'i thog srung gnam lcags ur mo'i dmigs pa ni: rang nyid rdo rje drag mo mthing nag gri gug bhandha bsnams pa dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs pa'i thugs dbus su bhyo mthing nag la badzra kī li kī la'i sgra sgrog pa'o: phyi rol snang srid thams cad gnam lcags rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyi gzhal yas rdo rje'i gur bla re sa gzhi bar mtshams me'i bya khyung dang rdo rje rgya gram spu gri ngar ldan drag tu 'khor bas lha srin sde brgyad gang yang bgrod du med par bsgom: grwa mig gi gri gug rnams su rang 'dra'i khro mo grangs med kyis mtshon char phab pas sde brgyad rnams bsngangs te rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyi 'og tu bskrad par bsam: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod pas rdo rje'i thog dang ser ba babs stong gsum mun gtibs pa ltar khengs par bsam:

yang gnas 'gyur te rdo rje dang gnam lcags phur pa'i rang bzhin gur sogs sngar ltar bya: phaṭ phaṭḥ ces phur pa'i rtse ru raṃ 'phros pas snang srid thams cad khro chu dmar lhang gi rang bzhin du gyur: bdag nyid kyang de bzhin mdangs 'gyur: snod kyi 'jig rten dang rang gi rig pa dbyer med du bsre: dam sri rnams de las mi 'da' ba'i rang bzhin can du bsgom: de ni sde brgyad kun gyis glags mi rnyed par 'gyur ro: 'di 'go ba'i nad dang gdon spyi la 'gre: sa ma ya: yang rud dang ri chad la sogs gang la yang badzra ha ri ni sa phaṭ ces pas lan gsum gyis sngags la gnyan sa de'i sa la phu btab nas phyogs su gtor ste: dmigs pa rang nyid drag mo lcags gdong nag mo sku ri rab ltar brjid pa'i thugs ka nas bhyo mthing nag 'phros te 'byung ba gang yin de la phog pas khro chu'i zhun ltar rab tu 'khrigs nas 'gyu lam med par bsgom: rbab sogs yin na phyag g.yas gnam lcags satwa re gdong du lan gsum btab pas phye mar brdung zhing phyogs su byol bar bsgom: ri bshig bya na yang de ltar gnam lcags satwa zor gyis ri bo gang yin de phye mar gtor zhing 'di nas tshig 'khor gcig chad 'dug /sngags lan bdun nyungs dkar la btab nas ri rtser gtor bas zhig par 'gyur ro: ser ba bcad na sngar dmigs pa bya zhing bsgyur: rang gi thugs ka nas bya khyung mthing nag me yi gshog pa can grangs med 'phros pas stong gsum gang : me yi rba shin tu 'khrugs pas re ba thams cad zhu zhing chu tshan gyi rang bzhin du gyur nas: de'i nang du ser ba ser bdag thams cad rba khol gyi rlabs 'khrugs pas sha rus sam snang cha dregs tshogs kyi yid gzugs rnams sil bur 'thor zhing rang yal du song bar bsgom: oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa badzra kī la ya bhyo bhyo bzlog bzlog: ser ba ser byed dang bcas pa rnams satwaṃ bha satwaṃ bha ya:

na sha ya na sha ya: ram̐ bhyoḥ ram̐ drag: ram̐ ser ba chod chod gtub: ser ba ser byad 'brug mo glog zhags thog thogs bdag dang bcas pa'i snying la mā ra ya: bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces pas nyungs dkar sngags la gtor ram thun rgod gtor: dmigs pa rang nyid mu stegs mkha' 'gro gong bzhin la: phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi sgyogs chen thogs te 'phang bas ming med du brlags nas 'og lcags sreg gi sa gzhi la gdab par bsam: phu btab pas zhal nas me 'bar bas: stong gsum thams cad gzhob thul gyis bsregs par bsam: thog dmigs kyi skabs su dang res mos bya: rjes shes ting 'dzin ngang la gnas: sngags 'di ri gcod la mi dgos rung : lam ser bkag pa'i gdams pa'o: man ngag 'di mthar chu ru mtsho rgyal rdo rje gur nas them med grags so: sa ma ya: rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa la: rjes shes gsum gyi gdams pa ni: lus ni lha yi rjes shes bya: ngag ni sngags kyi rjes shes bya: yid la ting 'dzin rjes shes bya: lus la lha yi rjes shes bya: thig le dpa' bo'i rang bzhin la: rtsa ni mkha' 'gro'i yid bzhin 'gyur: rlung ni ye shes sngags kyi sgra: sems nyid skye med chos kyi sku: lha 'dre tshogs drug 'khrul pa'i nyams: gdod nas snang srid sgyu ma las: dngos 'dzin gnyen po btsal du med: rlung gi rlung la bzung med cing : me yi me ni mi 'tshigs shing : chu yi chu la ci ltar brlan: sa yi sa la yang mkhregs mi 'gyur: stong pas stong par glags mi rnyed: nam mkhas nam mkha' bcing du med: stong nyid mtshan mas ga la bshig: de bzhin zab mo gcod yul don: tha snyad rgol bas bshig tu med: snang srid sems su chod pa'i tshe: 'phrul gcod me long btsal mi dgos: rig pa'i klong ni nam mkha'i khyon: sems kyi ris su mi phyed bzhin: phyal gyis mnyam par bzhag pa la: chos sku'i zil gnon zhes kyang bya: blta bas grol na sgom pa med:

gcod dang spyod kyi mtshan 'dzin zad: ma cig bya bral 'di kho na: bdag med yum chen pha rol phyin: shes rab ma nges de ltar snang : brda 'di las kyi ḍākkis skyong : dam med lag tu ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: rig 'dzin las rab rtsal gyis me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing lug lor bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du shog ser nas bshus so// // tha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar bzhugs so: dbyings phyug yum chen gsang ba ḍākki'i sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: de nas dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskang zhing sor chud par bya ba'i phyir: sbyin sreg cho ga la 'bad pa ste: don gsum las: thog mar rdzas bsags pa: dngos gzhi gzhung bsrang ba: tha ma dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'o: thog mar rdzas pa ni: mchod pa rnam lnga: dbang po lnga: sman raka gtor gsum: yam shing : dūrba: ku sha: bilba: til dkar nag: sman sna lnga: 'bru sna lnga: rin chen sna lnga: dar tshon sna lnga: zhun sogs zas sna ma tshang ba med pa: gzhan yang mchod rdzas phun sum 'tshogs par bsham: de nas sa stegs dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa yin: stegs bu mda' gang gru bzhi bya: dbus su rdo rje rgya gram lte ba ram̐ gyis mtshan pa bya: de yi phyi rol mu khyud gcig bskor bya: de yi phyi padma 'dab bzhi pad tshab bzhi phyogs mdog bya: de yi phyi rol mu khyud sna lnga bya: de yi phyi rol rdo rje'i phreng : de yi phyi rol drag po yin na mtshon cha'i phreng ba: zhi ba la rdo rje: rgyas pa la nor bu: dbang la padma'o: mchog la 'khor lo'i phreng ba yin: de yi phyi rol me ri bya: me ri'i mu khyu phyogs bzhir zla phyed rdo rje me dar rlung g.yab phyogs mdog gces: yar gzhi gong gtor sogs las byang dang mthun: thog mar las byang rdzogs nas tshogs btang : mjug grub rjes su:

dngos gzhi sbyin sreg la 'jug pa ni: thog mar ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod pas rdzas thams cad byin gyis brlabs sman raka 'thor: de rjes sngags 'dis dgang gzar thabs shes bsnol nas thams cad reg tsam bya: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ a ha ri ni sa a be sha ya hoḥ oṃ las mchod pa'i rdzas mchog kun: āḥlas zag med bde ba bskyed: hūm̐ las dpag med spel bar gyur: oṃ oṃ: āḥ.āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐: thab bsangs: oṃ badzra yo gi sarba pa paṃ shwa dha ye: de nas me thab bskyed pa ni: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las zhi rgyas dbang drag gi thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba lte bar ram̐ dang rdo rje rgya gram pad 'dab mu khyud rdo rwa me ri phyag mtshan gur ram kha khyer zla phyed rdo rje sogs las bzhi thams cad lhun gyis grub pa: de nas yam shing sna tshogs pa brtsegs thabs can du gsal ba'o: bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐: de yi dbus su ram̐ las skyes pa'i me yi lha mo sreg byed tsaṇḍa lī sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje g.yon bhandha thogs te rlung g.yo chen lta bu'i steng du gsal ba'o: tsaṇḍa lī yi gling bcu gnyis su ram̐ re re mtshams bcu gnyis su yam̐ re re gnas lnga ru 'bru bcu spyi bo dang mu kha ru thabs shes kyi yi ge bcas snang stong sgyu ma'i gar ltar gsal ba'o:

de nas me lha spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : rang bzhin thabs shes rten 'brel las: 'bar zhing mched pa'i tsaṇḍa lī: 'dir gshegs zin bya'i las byed phyir: deng 'dir me yi dal du bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza sarba a be sha ya a āḥ zhes me lha dam tshig pa dang spyan drangs pa'i ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur: rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum kyis dbang dang rab tu gnas shing rigs lnga yab yum 'od du zhu nas me yi lha mo dang dbyer med du gyur nas thim pas gzi brjid 'od du 'bar: lhar yang rang gi thugs ka nas phrin las kyi sgo ma bzhi phyag na ye shes rab 'bar gyi me 'od thogs pa 'phros nas tsaṇḍa lī la phog pas me dpung rang bzhin du mched par gyur: āḥram̐ ram̐ ram̐ swā hā: slar yang thugs ka nas 'byung lnga'i lha mo rlung g.yab thogs pa 'phros nas tsaṇḍa lī yi gzhu la phog pas rlung g.yab shin tu mched cing g.yob par gyur: ha yam̐ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rigs lnga'i lha rnams kyi phyag tu dar tshon sna lnga bsnams nas byin brlabs te phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i gnas su gzugs pas phrin las lnga yi bar chod bsrung bar gyur: haṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ swā hā: las sbyor ni: shar lho nub byang rim pa bzhin: hūm̐: zhi ba'i me sbar shar nas sbar: stag gdong dkar mos me sbar bas: me long ye shes lhun gyis grub: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i me sbar ro: ram̐ shantiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: lho nas me sbar ro: hūm̐: rgyas pa'i me sbar lho nas sbar: phag gdong ser mos me sbar bas: mnyam nyid ye shes lhun gyis grub: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i me sbar ro: ram̐ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: nub nas me sbar ro: hūm̐: dbang gi me sbar nub nas sbar: gzig gdong dmar mos me sbar bas:

sor rtog ye shes lhun gyis grub: khams gsum dbang sdud me sbar ro: ram̐ pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: byang nas me sbar ro: hūm̐: drag po'i me sbar byang nas sbar: phag gdong ljang mos me sbar bas: bya grub ye shes lhun gyis grub: dgra bgegs tshar gcod me sbar ro: ram̐ hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ dbus nas me sbar ro: hūm̐: mchog gi me sbar dbus nas sbar: seng gdong mthing kas me sbar bas: rang byung ye shes lhun gyis grub: bde ba chen pos me sbar ro: ram̐ dharma dhā tu hūm̐ phaṭḥ rlung g.yab rim bzhin du: hūm̐: shar gyis phyogs nas rlung g.yab ma: sangs rgyas spyan mas rlung g.yobs shig: lāṃ lāṃ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: hūm̐: lho yi phyogs nas rlung g.yab ma: mā ma kī yis rlung g.yobs shig: māṃ māṃ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: hūm̐: nub kyi phyogs nas rlung g.yab ma: gos dkar mo yis rlung g.yobs shig: pāṃ pāṃ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: hūm̐: byang gi phyogs nas rlung g.yab ma: dam tshig sgrol mas rlung g.yobs shig: tāṃ tāṃ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: hūm̐: dbus kyi phyogs nas rlung g.yab ma: dbyings phyug ma yis rlung g.yobs shig: mūṃ mūṃ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: de nas mda' dar rim bzhin 'dzugs: hūm̐: dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'i dar: chu khams mi 'khrugs me mtshams srung : oṃ oṃ swā hā: hūm̐: ser po rin chen 'byung ldan dar: sa khams mi 'khrugs me mtshams srung : trām̐ trām̐ swā hā: hūm̐: dmar po snang ba mtha' yas dar: me khams mi 'khrugs me mtshams srung : āḥ.āḥswā hā: hūm̐: ljang gu don yod grub pa'i dar: rlung khams mi 'khrugs me mtshams srung : hrīḥhrīḥswā hā: hūm̐: mthing kha rnam par snang mdzad dar: nam mkha' mi 'khrugs me mtshams srung : hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā: de nas ku sha rgya gram gyi me mgo mnan la/ hūm̐: chos sku yum chen dgongs pa te: dus gsum sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: ku sha la brten rten 'brel rnyed:

de bzhin phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ hūm̐ swā a hā: de nas thabs shes mnyam sbyor ni: mar khu tshar gcig tsaṇḍa lī la mchod: oṃ agni ye swā hā: a dhi bhe a dhi bhe: ma hā shrī ha bhya ka bhya swā hā: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ swā hā: oṃ ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī pū dza sarba a hu ti dzwa la ram̐ ma hā pū dza kha kha khā hi: zhes mchod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas me lha'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ maḥ a yig rang byang mu kha ru: haṃ yig byang chub bdud rtsi'i rgyun: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: phyi mchod rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: dbang po rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: rdzas mchog rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: sman mchog lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: rin chen sna lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: dar sna lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: 'bru sna lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: zas mchog rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa skyed cing bskyed nas su: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sarba pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo rigs lnga'i lha: ye shes lnga ldan sems dpa' mo: dbang lha rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs: rang byung lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sna tshogs bde bas rab g.yo zhing : bzhin gyis khyab cing 'bar ba mo: mchod cing dga' bas rab bskul ma: tsaṇḍa lī la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod do: 'di nyid bla med mchog sbyin sreg go: ༈ de nas lha gzhung gi sbyin sreg ni: oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las phyi snod 'jig rten dbu ma'i zom chen po de yi dbus su: rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du 'bar ba me yi dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa de yi steng du gsher ba chu yi dkyil 'khor zlum la 'khyil ba: de yi steng du lci ba sa yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa de yi steng du mi shigs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab cing 'khor yug gnas pa:

de yi dbus su rim lnga'i pho brang zang thal can gyi srog tu padma nyi zla bam gyi steng du dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: 'di nyid mtshams mkha' 'gro'i mngon rtogs btang : mchod pa'i mtshams su sbyin sreg 'bul ba ni: mar khu la: oṃ agna ye swā hā: me tog la: oṃ badzra puṣpe swā hā: bdug spos la: oṃ badzra dhū pe swā hā: mar me la: oṃ badzra ā lo ke swā hā: dri chab la: oṃ badzra gandhe swā hā: zhal zas la: oṃ nai wi dye swā hā: rol mo la: oṃ shabda swā hā: gzugs la: oṃ a badzra darsha swā hā: sgra la: oṃ badzra wi ni swā hā: dri la: oṃ badzra pu ṣa kṣa swā hā: reg la: oṃ badzra pañtsa ka swā hā: bdud rtsi la: oṃ a mṛ ta swā hā: rakta la: oṃ padma rā ga ti swā hā: gtor ma la: oṃ bha lingta swā hā: yam shing la: oṃ bhrikṣa pu swā hā: ku sha la: oṃ ku swā tsa ra ta swā hā: dūrba la: oṃ shrī ta sa ku swā hā: bilba la: oṃ bha ti so ti swā hā: til dkar nag la: oṃ ti la ti tha swā hā: mar zan la: oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā: dzā ti li shi gur gum tsandan bcas la: oṃ bhai khañtsha dhi hu swā hā: gser dngul g.yu byi ru mu tig la: oṃ mu tig ratna ka swā hā: dar sna lnga la: oṃ pañtsa shrī ka swā hā: 'bras gro sran ma la: oṃ ge sa ra u ta ka swā hā: zas sna thams cad la: oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū dza me gha swā hā: de nas phrin las so so'i sham bu ste: 'di gong 'og thams cad la rab ltar rtsa sngags dang bcas re re bzhin sbyar: zhi ba: bdag sgrub pa po yi zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di phul ba la brten nas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang 'jigs pa brgyad sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: oṃ zhi ba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rgyas pa la: bdag sgrub pa po yis rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di phul ba la brten nas 'byor pa drug gi yon tan tshe bsod kha rje dbang thang srung rta nyams rtogs ye shes kyi snying po bcas rgyas shing gong nas 'phel bar mdzad du gsol:

bhrūm̐ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang la: bdag sgrub pa po yis dbang gi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di phul ba la brten nas 'khor 'das mos bzhi dang khams sum skye 'gro'i 'dod rgu longs spyod snyan grags dpal 'byor dang lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad bdag gi dbang du 'du bar gyur cig swā hā: hrīḥpā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: drag po la: bdag cag sgrub pos drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa rgya chen po 'di phul ba la brten nas bdud bzhi'i bar chad sna tshogs rkyen ngan nyi khri khyad par phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og gnyis sogs nas gzugs can dang gzugs med sogs dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad cing rdul du brlag par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ de nas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i gtor 'bul dang : phrin las bcol ba ni: dmar gtor gcig la 'khor lnga yis bskor ba bshams la: hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: u tsa la yi gnas mchog tu: ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri: rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung : 'bab chu thams cad khrag dang rnag: sgra skad thams cad ngur ba'i sgra: nyin mo sprin nag khu rlangs gtib: mtshan mo dur me 'bar zhing mched: dus drug gnas nyul rlung ltar 'tshubs: 'byung po ro langs mun ltar gtib: ma mo thams cad 'tshogs pa'i gling : khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing : phyag na rdo rje 'jigs pa'i sa: de 'dra ya nga'i gnas mchog tu: khros ma nag mo de ru bzhugs: rdo rje phag mo de ru bzhugs: bde chen dkar mo de ru bzhugs: ser mo don grub de ru bzhugs: dmar mo sgra sgrogs de ru bzhugs: sna tshogs mthar phyin de ru bzhugs: las kyi mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: brgyud 'dzin mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: sha za mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: phra man mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: bhyo maḥ spyi bor phag zhal nam mkhar ngur ba las:

rtog med don dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri zer ba'i tshig brgyad po 'di brda bstod 'bum bskul tshig gnyis mtshams su 'gre'o/ bhyoḥ dbu skra dmar ser dbyings su bskyod pa ni: rang byung skye ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa ni: rigs lnga'i sa lam rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) kha) ma mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri sogs gsham gyi 'gres byang sbyar shes par bya'o/ spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa la: sku gsum don dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) shangs nas drag po'i rlung dmar 'tshubs pa la: ma rig nyon mongs gtor ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) snyan nas 'byung lnga'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa la: ye shes sku lnga rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) mche ba dkar po zur gsum gtsigs pa la: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb pa la: chags sdang dbyings su gtor ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) snyan cha rin chen nor bus brgyan pa la: bdag 'dzin 'khri ba gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) dar dmar cod pan ban bun bskyod pa la: nga bdag 'khrul pa zhig pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba la: skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) phyag g.yon bhan dmar thugs kar bsnams pa la: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum mchan du bcug pa la: sgo gsum thar lam 'byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) glang chen ko rlon stod du g.yogs pa la: sku bzhi phrin las 'grub pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sked la dkris pa la: sa bcu sor rtser son pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba la: ma sring dbang du sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa la: dpa' bo gar dgu rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum:

ka) me long dang ni g.yer khas brgyan pa la: shes rab rtsal snang rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba la: 'khor 'das rang sar grol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) thal tshom raktas 'bur gsum brgyan: snang srid sgyu mar rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) sbrul rigs lnga yi chings rgyan 'khyugs pa la: ma rig ka nas dag pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro gdan 'gyings pa la: dbyings rig cig car rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa la: 'khor 'das sku la rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: zhi ba'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: rgyas pa'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: drag po'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gros bskor ba las: drag po'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) dbus phyogs sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) las kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: gnas yul sku la rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) brgyud 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: dur khrod las kun byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) sha za mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: srog gcod dbugs len byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) phra man mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: 'dzam gling stong khams nyul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ka) bhyo bhyoḥ maḥ steng mkha' spyod rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: 'og sa spyod rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: mtha' 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyogs las byed rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: bka' snang srid lha srin 'khor gyis bskor:

deng 'di ru sbyin sreg mchod pa bzhes: rkyen nyam nga chag che zhi ba dang : gzhi rang rig rgyal sa zin pa dang : lam rgya yan la 'khrul rtog mi 'byung zhing : don gdod ma'i mgon po 'grub gyur nas: dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas thob pa dang : dus rtag tu mi shigs phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa a we sha ya sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pū dza a hu ti khā hi: oṃ badzra ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ ratna ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ padma ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ karma ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ bhi shwa ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ sarba sa ma ya a hu ti agne ye swā hā:

zhes mar dang bcas nas: 'di skabs su lhag ma 'bul: de nas me lha'i gtor ma 'bul ba ni: bhyo bhyoḥ rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: bskul zhing bzhengs pa'i tsaṇḍa lī: phyi nang ḍākki 'khor bcas la: mthun rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: ram̐ gyi dkyil 'khor mthar phyin nas: las bzhi lhun gyis grub par mdzod: oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī agne ye sarba a hu ti bha lingta kha kha khā hi: chad lhag bkang ba ni: oṃ: ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : cho ga lhag chad 'gal zhing 'khrul: khungs dang dbang lung rgyus med cing : bskyed rdzogs phyi nang nor ba dang : rmongs shing bag med ci mchis pa: ma sring tshogs la bzod par gsol: oṃ ḍākki sa twa sa ma y sogs/ ḍākki bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: mda' dar thams cad rim bzhin blangs la: bhyo bhyoḥ chos dbyings mkha' 'gro'i dbyings su bsdu: rnam par snang mdzad bkra shis shog: badzra ḍākki'i dbyings su bsdu: rdo rje sems dpa'i bkra shis shog: ratna ḍākki'i dbyings su bsdu: rin chen 'byung ldan bkra shis shog: padma ḍākki'i dbyings su bsdu: snang ba mtha' yas bkra shis dbyings su bsdu: karma ḍākki'i dbyings su bsdu: don yod grub pa'i bkra shis shog: sna tshogs ḍākki'i dbyings su bsdu: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog: mi dmigs ka dag zang thal a: a āḥ de nas bsngo smon bgyi ba ni: hoḥ bsngo ba yul dang bral ba sangs rgyas yin: bsngo byed mkhan po stong pa rang sar grol: bsngo mkhan dge 'dun mi dmigs a la la: ma gyur thams cad gzhi rnams chos kyi dbyings: de ngo ma shes rang sangs ga la rgyas: 'on kyang nges pa'i don rtogs bden pa'i mthus: kun kyang yum chen go 'phang thob par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' mi dmigs pa bya: rjes shes blo bral rtog med rgyu yi ting 'dzin kho na'i ngang rgyun bsring :

'bras bu gcig shes kun grol gzhi rang bzhin can no: sa ma ya: e ma ma cig thugs bcud snying thig las: ma 'ongs dus kyi bskal pa la: skal ldan las 'phro can la sprod: dge bsnyen sde bzhi'i gter rgya skyong : dam med rnams la ma shor rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing sa bya lor bdud 'dul gsang sngags gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // kha) ma mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: ḍākki rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: deng 'dir sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul: mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang : tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod spel: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus: dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar mdzod: sbyin sreg gi 'gres so// // da) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: me bskul ye shes rab 'bar bzhugs so: gsang ba ye shes ḍākki dbyings kyi lha mor 'dud: de yang phrin las rnam bzhi yi gzhung las: drag po'i cha lag las kyi mtha' sdud: sreg byed me yi pho nya 'gyed pa ni: gzhi shing rtsam sbang phye la sogs me 'grim pa'i rdzas shig la: zangs lcags kyi phye mas ngar btags te sngags 'di yis byin brlab: oṃ badzra wā ra hī ha ri ni sa badzra dzwa la raṃ raṃ ye swā hā: zhes pas byin brlabs nas bud med la sogs kyis mi reg bar bzhag: slar yang hom khung zhig tu me thab brtsigs pa'am sbyin sreg dgos pa la sogs stabs dang bstun: de nas me bskyed pa ni: hoḥ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi me thab srid pa gsum khyab par 'bar zhing mched pa ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas zer rang bzhin 'khyugs pa'i gnam lcags kyi zi ra tshwa tshwa dang bcas pa skar ltar 'khrugs par gyur:

oṃ lo ha ma la kā la ya badzra ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥswā hā: de nas me zhags thogs la bskul ba ni: bhyo bhyoḥ ma bzhengs shig rig 'dzin dbyings nas bzhengs: dgongs shig bdag la byin gyis rlobs: de ring mngon spyod las mdzad phyir: ye shes me dpung mched pa'i lha: bdag la dbang bskur phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyoḥ nga ni khros ma nag mo'i sku: drag mo gnam lcags gdong pa can: phyag na las kyi me zor thogs: tshwa tshwa'i me sgra 'brug ltar sgrogs: snang srid 'bar ba'i 'od kyis 'gengs: 'tshubs pa'i glog zhags chi li li: sreg byed chen mos me sna drongs: phaṭḥ maḥ bde chen dkar mos phrin las mdzad: zhi ba'i me zhags dkar po 'dis: 'jigs brgyad mi mthun rkyen ngan sogs: nad gdon zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra ḍākki dzwa la ram̐: phaṭḥ maḥ ser mo don 'grub phrin las mdzad: rgyas pa'i me zhags ser po 'dis: mnga' thang longs spyod 'phel ba dang : tshe bsod rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ ratna ḍākki dzwa la ram̐: phaṭḥ maḥ dmar mo sgra sgrogs phrin las mdzad: dbang gi me zhags dmar po 'dis: khams gsum ma lus zil gnon zhing : skye 'gro dbang sdud phrin las mdzod: oṃ padma ḍākki nī dzwa la ram̐: phaṭḥ maḥ sna tshogs mthar phyin phrin las mdzad: drag po'i me zhags mthing nag 'dis: snang srid byad zor bzlog pa dang : bdud dgra tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: oṃ karma ḍākki dzwa la ram̐: phaṭḥ maḥ las su chas pa'i za byed ma: snang srid ma mos phrin las mdzod: ma bhyo ha gsum 'phros pa las: spyang bzhon mched gsum zor sna drongs: rbad do bsreg pa'i las la ya: ban byad rnams la me zor ya: bon byad rnams la me zor ya: sde brgyad 'byung por me zor ya: pho gdon rgyal por me zor ya: mo gdon 'dre mor me zor ya: gshed dang za 'drer me zor ya: keg dang sri la me zor ya: phung bdud sgab 'drer me zor ya:

ltas ngan brgyad cur me zor ya: bdud dang dam srir me zor ya: dgra dang bgegs la me zor ya: gnam gyi dal khar me zor ya: sa yi dug mdar me zor ya: nad dang gdon la me zor ya: mi gtsang grib la me zor ya: 'gong po rmangs srir me zor ya: god sri gyod srir me zor ya: mi mthun sna tshogs me zor ya: gdug cing sdang bar byed pa'i tshogs: drag po me yis gzhom par mdzod: oṃ badzra wā ra hā kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa a be sha ya sarba karma hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ phaṭḥdzwa la ram̐ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya rbad rbad swā hā: zhes me zhags gong du 'grim pa'i khang khyim mam yul gru'am gang du mkho ba'i sa thams cad me yis khyab par bya: dmigs pa ni rang nyid khros ma nag mo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i las byed mkha' 'gro grangs med pa'i phyag na gnam lcags kyi thun dang rab tu 'bar ba'i me zor thogs pa spros shing skar ltar 'khrugs pas gnod byed gdon bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad sbur ma me yis bsregs pa bzhin du gzhob cing ming yang med par bsgom: zhes pa las bzhi lhan thab khol du phyung ba mtha' sdud kyi go rim cha lag go: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgyas: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing sa bya lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // na) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las: god brub dmigs rim chu srin kha tham bzhugs so: ma cig ḍākki'i tshogs la 'dud: god sri gcod pa'i rim pa ni: thog mar gdams pa'i las rim ni: gang phyir rkang phran dud 'gro'i rigs: god sri langs dang gcan kha lkug: rtag tu phung brlag gtor ba ni: de dag mnan pa ar gtad na: thog mar god mgo rnyed na rab: ma rnyed sog pa rnyed kyang rung : de dag ma rnyed god rus rigs:

gang rnyed de la liṅga bri: srog chags pho la spyang ki'i gzugs: mo la 'phar ba'i gzugs bris la: lus la sbrul gyi zhags pas dkris: yan lag lcags sgrog dag gis bcing : de yi khog tu god 'dre'i gzugs: liṅga dred mong mgo can bris: khog par yi ge 'di dag gzugs: ma ru sha tri trig na e raṃ pu tre rmu ga ye rmug chum: god sri pho mo'i snying rtsa khrag rtsa ling : dza kun thim thim brub thim: gnod byed gcan spyang 'phar ba sogs sder chags ma rungs pa'i kha chings: hag tham: ag ti mug ti ha dar ha dar kha chings: god sri thams cad tha ram ra brub nan nan dza dza rmug rmug chum chum rbad sod: rmyog rmyog lte bar tri zhes yi ge'i mthar ru sngags des bskor: spyang ki 'phar ba stag gzig dred mong spre'u rnams kyi khrag dang spu mche ba bcas liṅga la sbrags: yugs sa ma'i skra dang dor rtas dkris: ri sna dgu'i rgyud rdo rbab rdos steng nas mnan: gtad pa'i sa sha mi 'dod pa'i gnas: spre'u bya dkar g.yag dkar dge slong drang srong klu dkar gnas sa sogs: mkhas pa'i dbang pos gzhung chen gyis legs par dpyad de de rnams la gtad do: yang na byad ma rang gshed phob ces god sri rang lhu'i kha la gtad: dmigs pa ni: god gcod mtha' ru dbang sdud zhig bya nas: rang nyid ma cig khros ma nag mo'i mdun du lcags khang gru gsum gyi nang du god sri thams cad las bzhi'i pho nyas bkug nas bstims par bsam: ngag tu: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ bdag nyid khros ma'i thugs ka nas: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho'i pho nya 'phros: dmigs pa'i god 'dre gnod byed rnams: gzugs byang liṅga 'di la khug: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ mngon sum du bskyed stim dmigs bya: bkug nas nan gyis bstim zhing bsdam par bya: de nas lha 'dre la ar gtad pa ni: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ hoḥ yul 'dir gnas pa'i lha srin sde brgyad dang : khyad par gnyan sa 'di ru gnas pa yi:

snang srid lha 'dre gzhi bdag khyed rnams la: god 'dre phung sri gtad do ma shor cig: gar srid shor nas sdang sems 'chang srid na: le len khyed la 'ded kyis rdul du brlag: de bas ma shor dam du da zungs shig: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ dmigs pa lha 'dre ngo bo chu srin gdug pa'i lus can gyi kha ru gtad nas nam yang ma shor dam du bzung nas kha bsdams pa'i tshe gser gyi rdo rje dang mchod rten nag pos mnan zhing bsdams par bsam: steng du tho bya: skyer phur gzugs thal mo brdabs nas dmod pa bya: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ gsum gyis skye med ngang du ldog par bya: mkho ba'i chas thams cad me yis khyab par bya: dmigs pa ni: rang nyid khros ma nag mo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i las byed mkha' 'gro grangs med pa'i phyag na gnam lcags kyi thun dang rab tu me zor thogs nas spros shing skar mda' ltar 'khrugs pas gnod byed gdon bgegs tshogs gang yin pa thams cad sbur ma mes bsregs pa ltar gzhom zhing ming yang med par bsgom: ces pa las bzhi lhun thabs khol du phyung ba mtha' sdud kyi go rim cha lag go: sa ma ya: ༈kyikya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos me sprel lor 'bri gung gzho stod ti sgro nas gdan drangs shing bya lor bdud 'dul sngags gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o: sarba maṅga laṃ/ bkra shis par shog/ // pa) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gcod tshogs chog khrigs yum chen dgongs don spyi 'gros dang mthun par bklag chog mar bkod pa mtsho rgyal thugs bcud bzhugs so/ gsam̐ng ba ye shes mtsho rgyal ma cig sogs/ /gsam̐ng sngags ma rgyud zab don gcod yul gyi/ /gsam̐ng mdzod bka' gter brgyud 'dzin ma lus la/ /gsam̐ng gsum rab gus dad pas spyi bor 'dud/ /bdud bzhi dbyings gcod yum chen dgongs pa'i don/ /gsang sngags lam zab zung 'jug snyan brgyud rmad/

/gsang ba ye shes tshogs mchod cho ga'i khrigs/ /gab bsdebs 'khrugs bsal bklag chog 'di na spel/ de la gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog gi gcod tshogs chog khrigs yum chen dgongs don spyi 'gros dang mthun par bklag chog mar bkod pa mtsho rgyal thugs bcud zab mo rdo rje'i tshig rkang snyan brgyud gcod kyi gdams pa zab mo nyams su len par 'dod pa dag gis/ tshe 'di yi bya ba blo yis ling gis btang nas/ phyi ma bde 'gro mtho ris tsam min par sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang la 'god ched/ lus pha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ mtsho rgyal snyan brgyud rgyun gcod ngag 'don khol phyung bzhugs so/ ngo bo ka dag yum chen kun tu bzang*/ /rang bzhin lhun grub longs sku wā ra hī/ /thugs rje kun khyab sangs rgyas padma'i lcam/ /sku gsum dbyer med rang rig mkha' 'gror 'dud/ /gzung 'dzin 'khri ba btsan thabs gcod pa dang*/ /rtogs pa'i gdeng chen mnyes pa'i bogs 'byin phyir/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa lam lhong cha rkyen rmad/ /snyan brgyud bklag chog spel la gnang ba stsol/ de la nges don rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba ka dag gi dgongs pa mngon du gyur zhing sgom pa mnyam rjes ris med du shar ba'i gang zag dbang po mchog ldan rnams la gcod bya dang gcod byed ye ma mchis kyang*/ lta ba go yul du yod kyang nyams len gyi rtsal ma rdzogs shing re dogs rnam rtog gi yo lang 'khrugs pa'i dbang po 'bring dman rnams la lta ba'i bogs 'don zhing 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba gsang gcod zab mo'i nyams len la 'jug la/ thog mar chos brgyad 'dir snang gi bya ba blos btang nas/ gtan bde rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang don du gnyer ba'i ched/ lus dang srog la mi 'phong zhing*/ phung po gzan du bor nas 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod/

mi mthun pa grogs su khyer/ ltas ngan g.yang du len/ bar chad dngos grub tu shes/ lha 'dre sems su rtogs shing bdud bzhi grogs su bsten nas mi 'dod pa thams cad thog brdzis dang rkyen ngan lam du khyer ba'i gdams pa zab mo la 'jug pa ni/ gzhung las/ thog mar gnyan sa gsum las phyi snod 'byung sdud kyi gnas yul: nang bcud sgyu lus kyi dur khrod: gsang ba tshogs drug gi 'dre dgu ste: gsum po gang du mos pa gang zag gi blo dang bstun nas tshogs rdzogs mchod sbyin bya ba'i rim pa ni: lus sems rlung gsum dus gcig dril nas: bzang ngan gyi 'khri ba btsan thabs su gcod pa'i phyir: phaṭḥdrag po gcig bya: zhes dang*/ de yang zil gnon gyi dmigs pa ji ltar bya tshul yang gzhung las/ dang po rang nyid 'gro ba'i snga lam du: nyams dga' ting 'dzin gsal la bzang : bying 'thib rig pa ma gsal ngan: 'gro ma thag tu zil gnon 'phen: rang nyid yum chen gsal ba yi: thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje 'phros: ban de yin na gser gyi rdo rje dang : bud med dngul gyi rdo rje dang : skyes pa lcags kyi rdo rje dang : mda' 'phang ltar 'phros gnas su phab: rdo rje lcags kyu zhags pa yi: 'bros dbang med par zil gnon bsgom: zhes gsungs pa bzhin gnyan sa sogs gal che yin na snga gnon bya bar gsungs pas de ltar bya ba'am dbang sdud zil gnon spyi ltar du/ thog mar ya gi sangs rgyas man chod dang*/ ma ki na rag dmyal khams yan chod du 'khod pa'i lha srin sde brgyad spyi dang bye brag pha mas gtsos pa'i sems can thams cad thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la 'god pa'i phyir/ brtson pa bya'o snyam pa'i snying rje dang*/ spobs pa lhur blangs nas sgyu lus bag chags kyi g.yar khang 'di lta bu nam yang 'dor rgyu las med na/ da res mchod sbyin rtsom par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa brtan po'i ngang*/ rdzogs pa chen po'i lta ba'i gdeng gis rang snang dbang du 'du ba'i phyir mos gus kyi gsol ba 'debs pa grub dbang rje'i zhal gsung las bsdus pa ni/

phaṭḥ kun bzang rdor sems dga' rab rje/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen shrī sing*/ /dzñā na sū tra bi ma la/ /pad 'byung yab yum gnubs mthu chen/ /rtsa gsum gling sogs gcod yul gyi/ /grub thob rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /rang rang mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rdzogs/ /bdag 'dzin ru tra bsnol ba'i steng*/ /mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin phyag rgya can/ /thugs rje'i dgongs pa mkha' ltar brdal/ /ris med gdul bya dbyings su 'dren/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rjes byin rlabs char ltar 'bebs/ /mthu rtsal nus mthu glog ltar 'khyug /rang byung ye shes lhang gis ston/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud smin pa dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad nas/ /rigs drug sems can ma lus kun/ /dpa' bo ḍākki'i sku ru bzhengs/ /rnga dung dril g.yer si li li/ /glu gar bro rdung khrigs se khrig /snang srid kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /gdul bya'i lhag ma ma lus pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par bsgral/ /stong gsum brdal ba dpal gyi zhing*/ /rmad byung phrin las mtha' las 'das/ /snang srid rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing*/ /phung khams rnam dag yi dam lha/ /rang rig rnam dag sangs rgyas dngos/ /bzang zhen ngan rtog 'khrul pa'i blo/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /gnyis med dbyings su 'ub chud nas/ /skye med klong du sangs se sang*/ /'gags med rtsal du sha ra ra/ /rang bzhin ngang du ya la la/ /bde ba chen por a a a phaṭ/ de nas gzhan snang zil gnon gyi dmigs pa 'di bzhin nyams su len par bya'o/ phaṭḥ rang nyid skad cig gi gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi khrag dmar dzar re ba nam mkha'i dbyings su g.yugs pas khams gsum gyi lha 'dre thams cad dbang du sdud cing g.yon pas mi rkang gi gling bu tshag tshag tu 'bud pas srid gsum gyi lha 'dre ma lus pa zil gyis gnon pa'i bdag nyid can du gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rkang dung lan gsum lag mthil du brdabs pas 'byung po phra mo rnams ma dngangs shig /gnyis pas ma skrag cig /gsum pas ma 'jigs shig zer ba'i brda/ thung 'bud lan gsum nyon cig nyon cig nyon cig ces/ yang 'dus 'dus 'dus thung 'bud gsum/ drag 'bud dgyes pa'i ha ha ha zhes gsum dang dgu bus te gnyan 'bod spro na/ 'o 'o/ mtho srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas dma' na rag dmyal khams yan chad kyi bka' snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma srin sde brgyad sna 'dren sdong zla rgyab rten dang bcas pa/ gnas gdon lus gdon nad 'dre lan chags dam sri pho mo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad ri na bun gyis g.yogs pa'am/ smug pa rlung gis bsdus pa'am/ bya gcan thed la rub pa ltar skad cig rang dbang med par gnyan khrod chen po 'dir 'dus shig ces brjod nas rig thog tu lta ba'i ngar bskyed de gcod ḍāṃ ḍār rgyag bcas/ phaṭḥ na moḥ ma dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma: ye shes mtsho rgyal drag mo'i sku: phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi bsnams: g.yon pas mi rkang gling bu 'bud: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: g.yang gzhi mkha' la phyar ba'i tshe: steng gi lha srin zil gyis gnon: bar du phyogs bzhir g.yab pa'i tshe: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du bsdus: drag tu sa la rdeb pa'i tshe: 'og gi bgegs srin dam la btags: mchog chen gling bu bus pa'i tshe: srid gsum lha 'dre da 'dus shig: dbang du bsdus la zil gyis gnon: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro mthu ma chung : mi lpags g.yang gzhi rtsal ma zhan: mchog chen gling bu ngar ma yal:

mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs dpung ma nyung : baṃ tshogs mchod pa bcud ma yal: bya rgod sha thed rol pa bzhin: rang dbang med par da 'dus shig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma mdog ma nges pa phyag g.yas g.yang gzhi me 'bar ba dang g.yon mi rkang gi gling bu thogs pa grangs med 'phros nas snang srid lha srin sde brgyad za la re zhing 'thung la rngam pa rnams ston chen gyi mgron 'tshogs pa ltar rang dbang med par rlung rags pas sbur ma bskyod pa ltar 'dus par bsams la/ phaṭḥ bdag nyid rnal 'byor drag mo'i thugs ka nas: ha ri ni sa las skyes mkha' 'gro ma: g.yang gzhi me 'bar thogs pa grangs med 'phros: g.yang gzhi brdabs nas rkang gling 'bud pa'i tshe: srid rtse mnar med dmyal khams yan chod kyi: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dbang du sdus: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rkang gling lan gsum 'bud/ phyogs kyi mtha' thams cad me dpung 'khrigs nas bros dbang med par bsgom/ de nas rang dang lha 'dres gtsor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad lus ngag yid gsum mi phyed pa'i gdung ba drag pos skyabs su 'gro bar dmigs la/ na mo: skyabs yul gyi sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun: tshogs zhing mchog yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can dang chos srung rgya mtsho la: ma gyur gyi sems can bskyab tu gsol: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ de yi tshe sems can thams cad bde chen mchog la 'god 'dod kyi blos rang dang sems can thams cad byang chub tu sems bskyed par bsams la/ phaṭḥ srid rtse dang mnar med yan chod du: phan byed lha dang gnod byed kyi 'dre: sdang dgra dang byams gnyen ma lus kun: bla med kyi lam la 'god par bya: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces sems can thams cad pha mar ma gyur pa ni gcig kyang med bzhin rang gshis kyi rig pa ngo 'phrod nas bde sdug chags sdang legs nyes thams cad dang bral bar bsgom/

bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni/ phaṭḥ tshogs drug gi nam mkha' yangs pa ru: 'ja' sprin dbus pad sdong 'bar ba'i rtser: skyabs yul gyi gu ru padma 'byung : sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs kyis bskor: byin rlabs kyi 'od phuung sprin ltar gtibs: de 'og tu pad zla'i gdan steng du: ma cig ni ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: gnas gsum gyi ḍākki'i tshogs kyis bskor: dbu rigs lnga dang thor tshugs shigs se shig: phyag ḍā dril gyi snyan 'gyur 'u ru ru: sku rus rgyan dang cod pan spungs se spung : zhabs brkyang bskum gyi gar stabs khrigs se khrig: snang chu zla ltar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas: gnas pho nya'i 'od zer 'bru gsum 'phros: zhing phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun rgyud bskul nas: dpal rtsa gsum dang chos srung bka' sdod bcas: mdun skyabs yul gyi lha dang dbyer med gyur: dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mdun gyi nam mkhar sangs rgyas dang byang sems bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams glo bur sprin gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par bsams la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ phaṭ phaṭḥ phyi tshogs drug gi dbang po rnam lnga mchod: nang dug lnga yi 'byung ba khams lnga mchod: don dam tshig gi ye shes rnam lnga mchod: gzhi blo bral gyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi phung khams skye mched rnams skyabs yul la phul bar bsam/ gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ na mo: gnas spyi gtsug nyi zla padma'i steng : 'ja' tshon 'od phung gtibs pa'i dbus: kun bzang rdo rje sems dpa' dang : dga' rab rdo rje shrī sing : 'jam dpal bshes gnyen padma 'byung : ye shes mtsho rgyal manda ra: sangs rgyas ye shes rtsa gsum gling : grub thob brgyud pa byin rlabs can: bdud kyi gcod yul rin po che: gsol 'debs bu la byin gyis rlobs: ro snyom lam du lhong ba dang : brtul zhugs spobs pa mthar phyin nas:

rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba yis: lha 'drer 'gro don nus pa ru: rig 'dzin bla mas thugs rjes zungs: rje yab yum nyid ltar byin gyis rlobs: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams tho brtsegs kyi rnam pas mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar spyi bor bzhugs pa rnams/ kun tu bzang po nas rim bzhin rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar 'od du zhu/ rigs bdag bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i tshangs bug nas mar thim pas rang rig dang dbyer med du 'dres pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ bem rig phral ba ni/ phaṭḥ rang rig rnam shes ma sar sgo nga tsam: spyi bor skar mda' 'gyu bzhin gyen du 'phros: rje btsun mthing 'od 'bar ma'i thugs kar thim: gsal stong bde chen rnal 'byor ma ru shar: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces rang sems mkha' 'gro'i thugs dang dbyer med du 'dres par bsam/ de nas maṇḍal 'bul ba ni/ rang gi bem po de mdun du gan rkyal du 'gyel ba la gri gug tshad tsam gyis pags pa dang yan lag thams cad so sor phral nas mdun bskyed la maṇḍal 'bul bar bsam mo/ phaṭḥ gri gug gdeng tsam pags pa phyal gyis bshus: bkram pas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir gyur: mgo bo khang bzang bem po ri rab dang : yan lag gling bzhi nying lag gling phran brgyad: don snod bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: khral khrol lhag ma maṇḍal bkod pa'i khyon: mig gnyis nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa: gdul byas tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod sprin 'di: phyogs dus skyabs yul rnams kyi spyan sngar 'bul: rje btsun ma hā gu ru'i spyan sngar 'bul: ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal spyan sngar 'bul: grub thob rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar 'bul: 'gro mgon rtsa ba'i bla ma'i spyan sngar 'bul: dam pa bde gshegs rnams kyi thugs rjes zungs: phan dge bla med mchog la yi rang ngo : snang srid lha 'dre grol bar chos 'khor bskor:

mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen du bzhugs: zag med sgyu lus phul ba'i dge rtsa yis: rje btsun gu ru yab yum 'grub gyur nas: snang srid lha 'dre dbang du 'du bar shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams mnyes shing tshim par gyur nas/ 'gro kun byang chub kyi 'bras bu thob par bsam/ phaṭḥ skyabs yul lha tshogs gu ru'i sku la thim: gu ru 'od zhu mtsho rgyal la thim pas: ḍākki rgya mtsho om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'bru gyur: rang la thim pas snang stong mkha' 'gror gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces pas mdun gyi skyabs yul rnams rang la 'bru gsum gyi rnam par thim/ sku gsum dmigs med kyi dbang thob par mos/ de nas dngos gzhi rig pa skye med du ye shes mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar mo chags pa'i nyams can zhig tu bsgom zhing gzi byin bskyed la/ phaṭḥ rang rig skad cig gsang ba ye shes sku: mthing nag rab 'phros zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: spyan rtsa 'khyil zhing smin ma me ltar 'bar: dbu skra dmar ser srid gsum dbyings la bskyod: phyag g.yas zangs gri g.yon pas bhandha bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan gar stabs ro gdan 'gying : thugs las spros pa'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga yis: gri gug thogs nas pags pa phyal gyis bshus: dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi lag tu thogs: bhandha bcad pas stong gsum khyon tsam gyur: de nang sha khrag spungs pas ltem gyis gang : lan gsum dam tshig phyag rgyas dkrugs pa yis: skye bdun snying po lta bur bdud rtsir gyur: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ yang rang gi thugs ka nas las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma grangs med 'phros nas bhandha'i skyogs thogs te phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rnams su gang bzhugs dang 'khod pa'i mgron la mchod cing sbyin par bsams la: phaṭḥ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byed du ma yi: phyag na bhandha lcang lo'i skyogs thogs nas: dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod sprin du ma 'bul:

snang yul tshogs drug dgongs pa rdzogs gyur cig: phaṭḥ kun tu bzang po rdo rje sems dpa' sogs: rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul: dga' rab shrī singha sogs: rig 'dzin brda brgyud rnams la 'bul: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad 'byung sogs: gang zag snyan brgyud rnams la 'bul: manda ra ba mtsho rgyal sogs: mkha' 'gro gter brgyud rnams la 'bul: bo dhi sa twa chos rgyal sogs: grub thob rje 'bangs rnams la 'bul: sangs rgyas ye shes dhe wa sogs: bka' bab gcod yul brgyud par 'bul: che mchog he ru ka pa sogs: rgyud sde bzhi yi lha la 'bul: phyag bzhi phyag drug zhing skyong sogs: chos 'khor skyong ba'i srung mar 'bul: ma gza' rdor legs zhing skyong sogs: bya ra gter srung rnams la 'bul: lha klu sde brgyad gzhi bdag sogs: dregs pa sha za rnams la 'bul: bgegs rigs dmyal ba yi dwags sogs: lan chags 'byung po rnams la 'bul: bu lon sha 'khon ma sod pa'i: sngon las 'phral rkyen rnams la 'bul: gre bo gson 'dre pho mo sogs: bsam ngan log sbyor 'chang la 'bul: mi min the'u rang yul 'dre sogs: 'byung po nad bdag rnams la 'bul: ban bon dmod pa'i byad ka sogs: rig sngags 'chang ba rnams la 'bul: srid pa bar do'i sems can sogs: yid lus 'gyu ba rnams la 'bul: sgyu lus ting 'dzin mchod sbyin 'di: 'dod pa'i mkho dgur gyur nas kyang : longs spyod mdzod la spyod par shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ phaṭ grangs mang nyung dmigs pa ma zin par bya: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bdud rtsi ru dmigs nas phul: dregs pa sha za'i tshogs rnams la sha khrag gi phung por bskyed nas phul: gzhan yang gang 'dod pa der bsgyur te phul nas dga' mgu ngoms nas re kha khengs shing sngon las 'phral rkyen du gyur pa'i lan chags kyang byang : tshogs rdzogs dge ba 'di yi rgyu la brten nas kun kyang byang chub thob par bsam:

de nas lhag ma'am phran bu'i zag pa'i rigs rnams khas zhan gral du ma 'khod pa rnams la sbyin pa ni: phaṭḥ 'dir 'dus shig glo bur lhags pa yi: khas zhan dang dbang chung zha long lkugs: ma go dang ma thos ma mthong zhing : tshe rabs su rnam smin 'khor ba'i rigs: sdug bsngal gyi rdzing bu bskyil ba rnams: bam tshogs kyi lhag ma 'di khyer la: 'dod yon gyi longs spyod thob nas su: sdang sems kyi 'tshe ba rab zhi zhing : phan dge yi lam bzang ston mdzad des: rigs drug kun sdug bsngal zhi ba dang : byang chub kyi go 'phang thob gyur cig: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ sha khrag lhag med du rol nas khas zhan dang dbang chung rigs rnams kyang byang chub thob nas dbang chen du gyur par bsam: de nas gtang len bya ba ni: phaṭḥ khyed snang srid kyi lha srin gzhi bdag dang : rigs drug gi skye gnas rnam bzhi'i tshogs: grangs med du pha mar 'du shes nas: dus de tsam zhig drin lan 'jal ba la: gdon khyed rnams la nyes tshogs ci mchis pa: bdag sems bskyed 'dis smin nas 'khor bar shog: nged rnal 'byor la bde skyid gang mchis pa: khyed gnod byed la phan dge 'byung bar shog: rgyu dge bcu yi las 'bras dkar po 'dis: khyed gnod byed kyi sdug bsngal zhi bar shog: lar gcod yul gyi tshogs rdzogs mchod sbyin 'dis: rkyen lha 'dre'i re kha khengs par shog: rgyu 'khrul snang gi lha 'dre stong gzugs la: bdag gnyis 'dzin gyi re dogs chod par shog: gzhi snang srid kun chos skur grol nas kyang : lam tshogs drug kun sgyu mar shes pa yi: gcod zab don gyi 'bras bu smin pa yis: rgyu de bzhin gyi byang chub lam 'god shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ:

ces pas rang gi tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rigs drug mgron du gyur pa thams cad la phog pas bde skyid phun sum tshogs: gzhan gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rang la thim pas skye ba dang tshe rabs kyi lan chags thams cad lus 'd-i thog nas 'khor bar bsam: sems bskyed de yi 'bras bus tshe rabs kyi sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing mkha' spyod o rgyan gyi gnas su skye bar 'gyur ro: smon lam ni/ hoḥ ma gyur thams cad gzhi dag chos kyi sku/ /ma bsgoms ma bcos ye nas rang sangs rgyas/ /'on kyang de don ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gro/ /kun kyang yum chen go 'phang thob par shog phaṭḥ gcod yul zab mo'i nyams len gyis: 'gro kun srid mtsho las sgrol zhing : rnam mkhyen thar pa'i lam zhugs nas: kun kyang byang chub myur thob shog: phaṭḥphaṭḥphaṭḥ ces bsngo smon spyi dang 'khor gsum yongs dag dmigs med 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po ye grol ka dag nges don gcod yul dgongs pas rtsis zin par bya'o/ zhes nyams len snying po'i rnal 'byor la rgyun du brtson pa'i sgrub sde ba rnams kyi ched spros pa nye bar 'tshams pa'i dbang du byas te gter gzhung rgyun khyer gzhir bzhag gcod yul spyi mthun bzhin go rim 'khrugs bsdeb cung zad dang bcas kha skong dgos nges re zung rigs mthun gzhan nas blangs te gcod yul zab mor mos pa spyod pa'i skal bzang can ku su la'i 'jam dbyangs 'gro ba kun 'dul gyis bsgrigs chags su bgyis pas 'phan sprul bstan 'dzin 'gyur med dpal bzang pos sug bris bgyis pas 'gro kun bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ba) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gcod yul gsol 'debs byin rlabs sprin gyi phung po bzhugs/ phaṭḥ rang nyid skad cig gis gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar gsal khro 'dzum chags pa'i nyams can/ spyan gsum bar snang la hrig hrig gzigs pa/

zhabs stangs stabs kyis 'jig rten thams cad rmang nas ldeg cing rab tu g.yo bas/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho phrin las kyi pho nyar 'gyed pa/ phyag gnyis cang te'u dang dril g.yer gyi sgra skad 'ur sil du bsgrags pas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing thams cad rab tu g.yos te/ rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho'i sku gsung thugs kyi rol pa chen po mngon du byed pa'i thugs dam gyi rgyud drag tu bskul bas/ bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la ye shes thugs rje'i byin 'od kyis rtog bral rang byung gi rig pa rjen par ston cing snang srid thams cad lhun 'byams brdal ba chen por dbang bsgyur ba'i brtul zhugs dang rdzu 'phrul thogs med stsol ba'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ phaṭḥ chos dbyings bde chen yum gyi klong*/ /rang byung lhun grub kun tu bzang*/ /thog ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur/ /mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar kun tu zhal/ khyab brdal 'od kyi phung po can/ /srid zhi kun gyi srog gcig pu/ /thugs bcud dgongs brgyud bye ba 'bum/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /gsang sgrom me ri 'bar ba'i rtser/ /rdo rje sems dpa' longs spyod rdzogs/ /dug lnga brdzis pa'i khri steng na/ /skyil krung rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /ye shes 'od lnga'i tshom bu 'khrigs/ /gsang mdzod brda brgyud 'bum sdes bskor/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/

/bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas/ /dga' rab rdo rje sprul pa'i sku/ /'od lnga'i mdangs ldan rus pas brgyan/ khyab 'jug bu mo gcer bu chibs/ /thod rnga rdung zhing rkang gling 'bud/ /snyan brgyud bka' bab 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /so sa gling gi dur khrod nas/ /'jam dpal bshes gnyen dmar smug bzhad/ /seng chen bsnol ba'i khri steng du/ /skyil krung rdo rje sdigs mdzub can/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan thibs se thib/ /dbang sgyur rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya nag bsil chen dur khrod nas/ /shrī singha smug nag gtum/ /gcer bu thor tshugs sgro phod can/ /glang chen brjid pa'i gdan la 'gying*/ /ral gri phyar zhing thod khrag gsol/ /gtum drag rig 'dzin 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rigs 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya gar bha seng dur khrod nas/

/dzñā na sū tra sngo nag gtum/ /ḍā dril 'khrol zhing stangs stabs kyis/ /stag mo grus ma'i steng na rol/ /rma bya'i gdugs dang bsil yab lding*/ /rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga nas/ /paṇa chen bi ma mi tra sngo/ /grub thob rnal 'byor spyod pa'i chas/ /rdo rje rtse lnga tshe bum 'dzin/ /bya khyung rngam pa'i steng na rol/ /'chi med rig 'dzin 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /raksha srin po'i rgyal khab nas/ /padma thod phreng dmar nag sgeg khrag 'thung he ru ka yi chas/ /lha srin sde brgyad bsnol ba'i staing*/ /'gying brjid rdo rje bhandha 'dzin/ /grub thob rig 'dzin bye bas bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /ke'u ri gsang ba yang rdzong nas/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal dkar dmar dgyes/ /dar tshon na bza' rus rgyan bklubs/

/bdud dang 'byung po bsnol ba'i steng*/ /zil ldan ḍā ru dril bu 'khrol/ /brda bsgyur dpag med thibs se thib/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /zla gam dbang gi phug pa nas/ /manda ra ba dmar gsal 'dzum/ /mkha' spyod longs sku'i cha lugs can/ /bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khri steng na/ /bgres rgud bral ba'i tshe bum 'dzin/ /'byung lnga srog 'dzin lha mos bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /yang rdzong shel gyi brag phug nas/ /sangs rgyas ye shes gtum rngam khro/ /bdud 'dul sngags pa'i cha lugs can/ /ru tra dam sri bsnol ba'i steng*/ /rdo rje gdengs shing phur bu 'dril/ /drag sngags rig 'dzin 'bum sdes bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /srid gsum rnam rgyal pho brang nas/ /rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgyal/ /dkar smug khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams/ /dam sri rgyal 'gong bsnol ba'i steng*/

/dor stabs zil gnon phyag rgya mdzad/ /gter brgyud bka' bab bye bas bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro 'dul sprul pa'i pho brang nas/ /grub dbang thugs mchog rdo rje ni/ /dmar smug khro la chags pa'i tshul/ /log rtog bdud bzhi brdzis pa'i steng*/ /dar nag phyar zhing phur bu gdengs/ /rig 'dzin grub thob 'bum gyis bskor/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /tsitta rin chen pho brang nas/ /rigs 'dus rtsa ba'i bla mas rje/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'od du 'bar/ /rang byung ye shes lhang gis ston/ /thugs rje'i dbyings nas bskyod pa'i tshe/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sprin ltar gtibs/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /gangs can bod yul gnas mchog nas/ /grub thob rje 'bangs rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dbang sgyur brtul zhugs rol pa yis/ /rdul phran re yang rgyal ba'i zhing*/ /sku dang tshom bu shigs se shig

/snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba 'dul ba'i zhing khams nas/ /thugs rje sprul pa'i skur bzhengs pa/ /'phags pa'i nyan thos dge slong dang*/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom byang chub sems/ /paṇa grub lo tsā sngags 'chang dang*/ /rnal 'byor grub thob slob dpon sogs/ /rang rang mtshan dpe'i gzi byin rdzogs/ /bdag 'dzin ru tra bsnol ba'i steng*/ /mnyam bzhag ting 'dzin phyag rgya can/ /thugs rje'-i dgongs pa mkha' ltar brdal/ /ris med gdul bya dbyings su 'dren/ /snang srid thams cad dbang du bsdus/ /dpa' bo rig 'dzin sprin ltar gtibs/ /thugs rje ldan pa'i rig 'dzin la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad nas/ /rigs drug sems can ma lus kun/ /dpa' bo ḍākki'i sku ru bzhengs/ /rnga dung dril g.yer si li li/ /glu gar bro rdung khrigs se khrig /snang srid kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ /gdul bya'i lhag ma ma lus pa/ khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par bsgral/ /stong gsum brdal ba dpal gyi zhing*/ /rmad byung phrin las mtha' yas par/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba 'debs/ /skal ldan rnams la dbang bzhi bskur/ /rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol ba dang*/ /thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol ba yis/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa ru/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlobs/ /snang srid rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing*/

/phung khams rnam dag yi dam lha/ /rang rig rnam dag sangs rgyas dngos/ /bzang zhan ngan rtog 'khrul pa'i blo/ /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa/ /gnyis med dbyings su 'ub chud nas/ /skye med klong du sangs se sang*/ /'gags med rtsal du sha ra ra/ /rang bzhin ngang du ya la la/ /bde ba chen por a a a phaṭ/ gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog gi gcod kyi rgyud 'debs rgyas pa 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes/ sgom chen pa sgom bu tshul khrims kyis bskul bar brten/ bka' gter gsar rnying gi mngon rtogs rnams bsdus te/ gcod yul ba skyid grong smyon pas bris pa dge'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // ma) rje btsun khros ma'i phrin las chog khrigs ye shes sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// // phyi snod 'byung ba klong lnga sprul pa'i zhing*/ /nang bcud dug lnga ye shes lnga ru rdzogs/ /gsang ba 'khor 'das dbyer med chos kyi sku/ /ngo bo nyid dbyings rang rig 'dus ma byas/ /sku gsum dbyer med thugs rje khros ma yi/ /sgyu 'phrul rgya mtshor 'jug phyir phrin las gzhung*/ /blo chen rnal 'byor spyod pa'i don du sdeb/ /gnas gsum ḍākkis bka' gnang byin rlabs stsol/ dgyes ma thugs rje khros ma'i sgrub mchod kyi phrin las bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa las/ thog mar sgrub rten dkyil 'khor gyi bsham bkod spyi 'gros ltar rgyas bsdus dpag ste bkod/ dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ dang po bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ bka' bsgo zhing bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: ma cig yum chen khros pa'i thugs ka nas: bar med khyab par 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'phros: gnod byed bgegs tshogs gtor ma len phyir khug: bdag gi bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: mchod sbyin 'di khyer rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru glags blta na: bdag nyid dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro thugs khros nas: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon cha thun du brdeg: me ltar 'bar ba'i bgegs dpung bsregs gtor gzhom: de bas bgegs tshogs 'byung po phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ṇi sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ gnyis pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: bdag nyid khros ma rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha me ri drag po thog ltar 'phros: gnod byed tshar gcod mtshams gcod las grub nas: tshur 'dus mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: om̐ badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gsum pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ skyabs yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dza/ zhes gsal btab ste mi phyed pa'i gdung ba drag pos/ na mo: bde chen rab dga' ye shes g.yo ba'i mchog: grol lam pho nya'i bde stong bskyed pa'i phyir: nyon mongs rab dben chags med zung 'jug can: mchog gi dpal mo'i sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: bzhi pa sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde chen mchog la 'god 'dod kyi blos/ hoḥ dga' ba rab g.yo mchog gi dga' ba ster: dga' bral lhan skyes dga' ba'i gzi 'od 'byin: dga' ma dbyangs can dpa' mo bsgrub pa'i phyir: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ lnga pa yan lag bdun pa ni/

bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dir gshegs padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dge tshogs kun tu bzang po'i rgyur bsngo'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ drug pa mchod pa byin rlob ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: phyi nang mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon khengs shing : 'dun pas bsgyur zhing blo yis sprul pa'i tshogs: phyi mchod sna bdun nang mchod sman raka phud: pañtsa mchog gi mchod pa bla med spel: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa rakta bha lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na king ni ri ti bha su ta āḥhūm̐: zhes gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis 'od zer gyi phyi nang gsang mchod rnams sku gsum bdud rtsi'i nus rtsal rdzogs par spel: bdun pa byin dbab cing brda sgo dbye nas dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: dbying phyug ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: lta ba klong yangs ye shes 'char sgo phyes: nyon mongs a 'thas srid pa'i sgo bcad nas: dran rig gnyug ma'i yid kyi lha zhal mjal: 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma 'grub bar du mi btang srog ltar bsgrub: om̐ badzra a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ om̐ pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra tsitta hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas dngos gzhi las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ bhrūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: hūm̐ e las chos 'byung gru gsum pa: dbyings kyi rang bzhin gdengs kha che: rtse mo phra ba thur du zug: de dbus zla gam zlum po'i nang : rang bzhin lhun grub gzhal yas gsal:

om̐ sarba ga ga he dhā tu ko3 haṃ: sarba kṣa ye bhi wa shu mūm̐ hrīḥlam̐ tam̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa gdan dang lha bskyed pa ni/ paṃ padma maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: kro ti ḍākki nī: hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ ko lakṣa ka ro ṭa: hūm̐ bhyoḥ gzhal yas phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: mtshan tshang gdan bcas bskyed pa'i dbus: ma cig thugs rje khros ma'i sku: mthing nag khro zhing rab tu rngam: ngur ba'i phag zhal spyi bor brgyan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum la gshe: sgeg pa dgod pa dpa' mo'i chas: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rtse gsum tri shul gru mor brten: chas ni dur khrod rgyan dang ldan: brkyang bskum gar gyi nyams gyur can: 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du bskyed: hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ri ni sa las: bzhi ldan phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang drag mo'i chas: bskyed pa'i gtso mo lta bur gsal: om̐ badzra ratna padma karma buddha badzra wā ra hī hūm̐ bhyoḥ gsum pa sgrub don ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ mi mngon mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: ma cig thugs rje khros ma la: rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor: yang 'khor ḍākki bye ba 'bum: zhing dang nye zhing ma lus nas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes pas spyan drangs dbyer med bsgom: bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: chos dbyings ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: mos pa'i bu la dbang bskur phyir: nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: gus pas phyag 'tshal gdung bas dad: yum chen dam pas dgyes brtse bas: sgo gsum dag pa chen por bsgyur: rab tu dwang bas bstod par bgyi: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan:

na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ sarba ḍākki pū ra hūm̐: badzra a gad ṭa hūm̐: na mo kro ti kau rī hūm̐: na mo badzra sarba kā ya wākka tsitta shuddhe hoḥ na mo ḍākki nī lam kau rī rā ga sarba wi ṭa hūm̐: lnga pa phyi mchod 'bul ba ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod lha mo rab dga' bcu drug gi: dpag yas sprin ltar gtibs pa'i 'dod yon tshogs: chags pa'i dbyangs dang dga' ba'i brda skad kyis: bskul bas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: badzra lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa t-i pū dza āḥhūm̐: drug pa nang mchod ni/ hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo ya kha 'khyil ba'i nang : bdud rtsi bcud ldan dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang po: bum ril snod du rakta chi li li: dung khang zhal bur bha ling ri ltar spungs: rin chen snod du dza gad phyu ru ru: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings la bsnyegs: sman phud la sogs kha mngar skyur ba'i ro: ster ba'i rdzas bcud bla med mchod pa 'di: yum chen thugs rje khros ma dgyes phyir 'bul: sku sprul bde chen dkar mo dgyes phyir 'bul: gsung sprul dmar mo sgra sgrogs dgyes phyir 'bul: thugs sprul gsang ba ye shes dgyes phyir 'bul: phrin las sna tshogs mthar phyin dgyes phyir 'bul: yang sprul ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes pas dgongs shing brtse bas bzhes nas kyang : bla med gsang ba'i ye shes don rtogs shing : dgyes pa'i grogs su ḍākki'i dbugs dbyung stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta n+yaṃ sarba ga ṇa la tsakra pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: kha kha khā hi khā hi: bdud rtsi lag mchod bya bar mos na mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes ltar sbyar bas chog bdun pa gsang ba'i mchod pa ni/

hūm̐: bla med mchog gi bdud rtsi ni: zag med bde ba bskyed pa'i rdzas: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: brgyad pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ye nas rmad byung ngo bo'i rdzas: rang byung ma 'gags ye shes kyi: dmigs med mchog gi mchod pa 'bul: mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ oṃ dharma dhā tu pū dza hoḥ dgu pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ 'og min mkha' spyod zhing mchog nas: thugs rje bskul ba'i yum chen mo: drag mo khros ma nag mo'i sku: shin tu gtum pa'i rngam byed ma: sku la dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: mtshon cha 'bar ba phyag na thogs: drag mo khro gnyer sgeg pa mo: zhabs gnyis gyad 'gros sa gsum g.yo: gtum mo g.yul las rgyal byed ma: rab 'jigs dpa' mo nyid la bstod: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dkar mo zhi ba'i 'od zer can: ser mo rgyas pa'i gad rgyangs can: dmar mo dbang gi mdangs chags ma: ljang mo bdud las rab rgyal ma: yang sprul mo rnams 'tsher du 'bar: rgyan rnams sku la rab tu rdzogs: gtsigs pa'i gdong la khro gnyer rngam: 'jigs pa'i gar rnams shin tu bsgyur: khro zhing rtse bas dgod pa mo: rigs bzhi yang sprul tshogs la bstod: bcu pa 'dzab bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: lhun grub rang gsal thugs rje can rnams dgongs: bdag gis thun mtshams 'jug pa ma grub bar: ye shes dbyings nas thugs dam gsal thob la: rdo rje'i 'dzab rgyun g.yel med mthar phyin stsol: badzra sa ma ya tsitta hūm̐ swā hā: dzap bzlas ni/ rang nyid yum chen thugs rje khros ma nag mor gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag spus bris pa tsam gsal zhing sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba'i tshe: sngags kyi rang sgra las bung ba rtsi bcud la myong ba'i dgongs pa ltar rang sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsam: sngags phreng de nyid gnyis mched kyi rnam pas lus kyi nang thams cad khengs:

slar yang ba spu'i bu ga nas 'phros pa'i snang srid thams cad khyab ste: phyogs bcu'i zhing mu med par mchod pa phul: de rnams kyis byin rlabs thams cad 'ub kyis 'dus te: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gi rnam par rang la thim pas dbang bzhi thob: sgrib bzhi dag: sku bzhi'i sa bon rgyud la skyes par bsam: de nas bsnyen sgrub gcig dril ni/ om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa sarba karma hūm̐ phaṭḥ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig brjod/ de nas 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen g.yo ba mchog gi mdzes 'phro ma: gsang gsum rab dga'i cha rdzogs sngo bsangs ma: gang gus gdung bsal nā da rab tu g.yo: mthong na mi mthun spang ba'i ga na'i dpyid: 'dzan po kun kyang yid kyu'i rab dkar bsu: chu gter rlabs su 'dar ma'i phreng ba yi: ka ti ka yi 'khor lo rab bskul ba: ra sa me yi brdas bskul sgra skad kyis: rtsi bcud myong ba'i ro mchog ci bzhin du: zag med lha mo khyod kyi phrin las mdzod: cha shas 'dab brgya'i utpal dri bsung gis: g.yo la rtag tu kun snang ngoms med bzhin: yid bzhin dpa' mo khyod kyis bsu bar mdzod: om̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas dbang bzhi blang*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ tshogs mchod rgyas pa gzhung gi mu tig rtsal phreng ltar bya bar 'os kyang*/ bsnyen sgrub dus bzhi sogs la 'jug pa bde phyir gter chen nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes ltar bstan pa la bcu gcig las/ dang po tshogs kyi byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir sku gsum yig 'bru 'phros: mchod rdzas la phog byin brlabs bcud mchog spel: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas:

gsang ba ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: phag mo rigs bzhi ma sring bye ba 'bum: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba'i las byed tshogs: bka' srung gter bdag mchod 'os mgron gyur rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchod rdzas bcud mchog spel: 'dir tshogs skal ldan sgrub la mchog thun stsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ gsum pa mchod bskang bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid thob ste: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bzhi pa bsgral bstab ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag mo phag gdong gsal ba'i mdun: shor med lcags khang nang du nṛ tri las: dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: bden stobs ni/ na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: gsang ba ḍākki mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: bka' srung gter bdag srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra rnams: rkyen ngan bar chod glo bur bgegs kyi tshogs: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dgra bo sgrol ba'i mtshon: rdo rjes mtshan pa zangs gri thog ltar 'bebs: byad ma gnod byed mgo lus dum bur gtub: phye mar brlag cing sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra ta ma ka ra ti ka ya gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad nṛ tri rbad rbad: bstab pa ni: hūm̐: gsang ba'i dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams:

ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dgyes par bzhes shig bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom nas: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: lnga pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe 'grub par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: ma 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: u tsa la yi gnas mchog tu: ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri: rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung : zham chu thams cad khrag dang rnag: na bun thams cad dug rlangs 'thibs: 'byung bas phaiṃ phaiṃ rang sgra sgrogs: nyi zla 'thab pa skar ltar 'khrugs: khro chu'i ser ba bun ltar g.yo: me yi tshwa tshwa char du 'bebs: mtshon gyi bu yug glog dmar 'tshubs: nyin mo lha brgyad dur khrod 'debs: mtshan mo klu brgyad dur khrod 'debs: skabs su sde brgyad dur khrod 'debs: 'jigs byed khro bcu ya nga zhing : phyag na rdo rje 'jigs pa'i gnas: srid pa 'gyu bar ga la nus: gnas nyul phal cher sngags thabs spyod: de 'dra 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog tu: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ste: rdo rje rnal 'byor de ru bzhugs: ma cig mtsho rgyal de ru bzhugs: mkha' 'gro sde lnga de ruu bzhugs: las kyi mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: bde chen dkar mo de ru bzhugs: ser mo don 'grub de ru bzhugs: dmar mo sgra sgrogs de ru bzhugs: sna tshogs mthar phyin de ru bzhugs: bzhugs pa'i dur khrod pho brang nas: de ring gnas 'dir tshogs la byon: tshogs bdag dbyings phyug skur bzhengs la: so so'i phrin las thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: ma skye med ka dag mkha' 'gro ma: dbyings rig bde chen dpa' mo'i sku:
