zangs thal gnas lugs khros pa las: bdud yul gcod pa'i ma cig ma: dug lnga dbyings grol ma cig ma: sna tshogs brjod bral ma cig ma: tshogs drug shar grol ma cig ma: dmigs med rgya yan ma cig ma: cir snang kun grol ma cig ma: bskyed rdzogs lhug bzhag ma cig ma: 'khor 'das rtog bral ma cig ma: mkha' khyab phyogs bral ma cig ma: kun snang ye grol ma cig ma: bya bral rdzogs chen ma cig ma: ma cig kun gyi yum chen ma: a ni rang sgra 'gags med ma: ye shes chen po'i ngo bo ma: mtsho rgyal bde chen dpa' mo'i sku: gar dgu'i ngang las khros pa mo: sku mdog mthing nag ston pa las: skye med rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dbu skra me ltar 'bar ba las: rig 'dzin sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: dar gyi cod pan 'phur ba la: sna tshogs gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: thod skam phreng bas brgyan pa las: rigs lnga'i dbang rtags mkha' 'gro 'bum: khros pa'i rngam zhal bgrad pa las: snang srid zil gnon mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba la: dug lnga gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyag g.yon bhan dmar bsnams pa la: nyon mongs stong pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: glang ko stod du g.yogs pa la: chos dbyings rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: zhing lpags sked du dkris pa la: so sor rtog pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: stag gi sham thabs byas pa la: mnyam nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro 'bum: sbrul gyis yan lag brgyan pa la: mai long lta bu'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: rus pa'i rgyan drug spras pa la: bya ba grub pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: kha ṭwāṃ mchan du bcug pa la: khrag 'thung spyod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: khrag zhag thal chen brgyan pa la: sna tshogs mthar phyin mkha' 'gro 'bum: g.yer kha me long brgyan pa la: grol bzhi'i lam ston mkha' 'gro 'bum: me dpung klong du bzhugs pa la: bag chags sreg pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ti ra'i gdan la bzhugs pa la: bdag 'dzin gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum:

dkar mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la: zhi ba dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ser mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la: rgyas pa lhun grub mkha' 'gro 'bum: dmar mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba la: khams gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro 'bum: ljang mo'i dpung gis bskor ba la: mngon spyod las mdzad mkha' 'gro 'bum: sna tshogs sprul pas bskor ba la: ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro 'bum: 'khor dang sprul pa yang 'khor rnams: tshogs mchod gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor can gyi nyams rtogs spel: 'gro kun chos la 'god pa yi: dbang bsgyur mkhyen stobs yongs rdzogs nas: phrin las rnam bzhi mthar phyin te: don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod:

ces tshogs gtor 'bul: bdun pa bka' srung dam can mchod pa ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung rig pa'i dbyings klong du: dur khrod tshogs khang ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: zab gsang ye shes dgyes pas gnas 'dir bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems gnyan po bzhes: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: ma g.yel bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: bhyoḥ ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: phyag g.yas sna tshogs mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams: ratna mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang ldan: klu yi chu rta sngon po chibs: sga srab dar stan khrigs se khrig: rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i shugs 'chang ma: gsang ba gter gyi grogs mdzad ma: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: las bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grog: ka cha dkor nor gnyer du gtad: dus drug srung zhing phyi la 'brongs: zab chos bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: sngon tshe gu ru'i bka' bzhin du: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ gu hya ḍākki yo gi ni ma mo ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: ༈ hūm̐: lha btsan dmag dpon myur mgyogs pa: sku mdog dkar smug zhi ba'i chos: dar thod dkar zhing ru mtshon dkar: zhags dkar 'dzin cing rta dkar zhon: sprul pa mi dkar bye ba 'bum: yang sprul lcags spyang dkar po 'gyed: hūm̐: mi bdud 'joms pa khra mgo nag: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dgra satwa dang : spu gri ru mtshon nag po g.yab: rta nag bzhon cing mi nag 'gyed: yang sprul dmar nag grangs med 'gyed:

hūm̐: btsan rgod a bswe mig dmar ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis srog bdag gzugs: btsan dar spu gri zhags pa dang : mche gtsigs dgra bo'i glo snying rol: rta dmar bzhon cing mi dmar 'gyed: yang sprul zangs 'phar lhang lhang zug: hūm̐: klu bdud nā ga kha thun ni: mthing nag mun pa'i tsha ngar can: phyag gnyis sbrul zhags sdig pa bsnams: chu srin rgyal mtshan dug zor 'dzin: rta sngon bzhon c-ing mi sngon 'gyed: yang sprul dug sbrul sa gzhi khengs: shan pa gnod sbyin sde bzhi'i tshogs: sngon tshe gzho stod ti sgro ru: ban bon rgyud bsrung khas blangs bzhin: dmar gyi gtor ma khrag zhag dang : mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: de ring bskul rbad las bcol bzhin: zab gsang bstan pa rgyas pa dang : rgyu sbyor bar chad rkyen sel ba: lo nyes sad ser zhi ba dang : 'byor drug bstan pa rgyas pa yi: phrin las myur du 'grub par mdzod: bka' yi tha tshig gnad nas bskul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnams: ma thogs myur du 'grub par mdzod: om̐ bswo a tri kha thun na tri sha ru du tri nā ga na phur dza dzaḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: brgyad pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon 'das dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu: rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin lung gi pho nya mo: tha tshig 'dzin pa'i ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam bca' bzhin du mthun rdzas mchod gtor bzhes: sangs rgyas bstan srungs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: nad yams mu ge g.yul 'khrug mtshon rtse thul: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las thogs med sgrubs: dgra bgegs sgrol zhing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ bhyoḥ phyi yi bstan skyong rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad: nang gi bstan skyong dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: gsang ba'i bstan skyong mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshogs:

bod khams bstan skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis te: gangs ri g.ya' rtse lu ma skyed mos tshal: gnas yul dur khrod chu rlung bas mtha' dang : nags tshal grong mkhar mchod rten gtsug lag khang : sa 'og sa steng sa bla la sogs pa: phyi nang dben khang sgrub gnas la gnas pa'i: bstan skyong ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: 'ja' tshon char bsil rol mo'i sgra dang bcas: 'dir gshegs bka' yi dam rdzas gtor ma bzhes: 'jig rten bde zhing dal yams 'khrug rtsod zlog: char chu dus 'bebs lo phyugs srid rnams spel: sgrub mchog bdag la rtsa rlung nyams rtogs spel: mthong thos dran reg smin grol mthar phyin nas: gsang sngags bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod: bcu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang bar chad thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: bgegs srin dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu gcig pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: bde chen g.yo ba mchog gi mdzes 'phro ma: gsang gsum rab dga' cha shas sngo bsangs ma: gang gus gdung bas nā da rab tu g.yo: mthong na mi mthun spang ba'i ga na'i dpyid: 'dzan po kun kyang yid kyu'i rab dkar bsu: chu gter rlabs su 'dar ma'i phreng ba yi: ka ti ka yi 'khor lo rab bskul ba: rā sa me yi brdas bskul sgra skad kyis: rtsi bcud myong ba'i ro mchog ci bzhin du: zag med lha mo khyod kyi phrin las mdzod: cha shas 'dab brgya'i utpal dri bsung gis: g.yo la rtag tu kun snang ngoms med bzhin: yid bzhin dpa' mo khyod kyis bsu bar mdzod: oṃ: ha las grub pa'i bum pa bdud rtsi bcud: riḥ bhandha zag med mkha' dbyings khyon dang ldan: niḥ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma sring 'ja' ltar lhags: saḥ 'dod yon kun ldan mchog gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi pha la hūm̐: a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐:

rjes chog ni/ dang po gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul cir yang ston mdzad pa: 'gro ba kun skyob ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dug gsum 'joms mdzad phag mo khyod la bstod: ces bstod/ gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ om̐: ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : cho ga lhag chad 'gal zhing 'khrul: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang nor ba dang : rmongs shing bag med ci mchis pa: ma sring tshogs la bzod par gsol: om̐ ḍākki sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pa la ya: sogs? ḍākki'i yig brgya brjod cing bzlas/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang srid thams cad mkha' 'gro'i zh-ing : rang lus 'byung ba gdos bcas bral: sgra rnams brag cha'i gdangs bzhin snang : 'gyu ba dran rig ka dag ngang : rol rtsal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: gsal stong 'dzin med lam du shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo bya yul dang bral ba sangs rgyas yin: bsngo byed mkhan po stong pa rang sar grol: bsngo yul gdod nas mi dmigs a la la: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ ma gyur thams cad gzhi dag chos kyi sku/ /ma bsgoms ma bcos ye nas rang sangs rgyas/ /'on kyang de don ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gro/ /kun kyang yum chen go 'phang thob par shog / ces dmigs med bde ba chen por 'khor gsum yongs dag dbyings rig zung 'jug la mnyam par bzhag go /drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma: nam mkha'i lus can rdo rje ḍākki'i gtso: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar 'dod rgu mchog sbyin mo: ma sring ḍākki'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog: de ltar rje btsun khros ma'i sgrub mchod chog khrigs ye shes sgo 'byed ces bya 'di ni/ snyi gdung rnal 'byor pa phrin las lhun grub dang*/ spang ston bde chen gling pa'i dbon karma 'gro don mthar phyin dang*/

spo bo'i grub chen sgom bu tshul khrims sogs kyis bskul ngor/ chos bdag rig 'dzin padma lhun grub rnam rol gyis gzhung gi 'khrugs bsdebs dang*/ rigs mthun gyis kha skaung bcas/ yang rdzong rdo rje'i gter phug tu bris pa dza yantu/ de ltar rje btsun khros ma'i sgrub thabs 'di nyid ma phyi dbu med gcig lag tu son kyang yig nor mang ba bar 'dzud sogs ci rigs dkyus su tshud de rtsa ba'i sa bcad dang go rim sogs dpyad mi bzod pa mang bas rang blos ci dpog gis zhu dag dang sa bcad gsar du bkod nas dag par bgyis pa'i khul yin yang nor 'khrul byung na mkhyen ldan rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ zhes pa'ang gnam lcags gu hyas so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // tsa) rje btsun khros ma'i rgyun khyer bde chen rab 'bar ces bya ba bzhugs so// // rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug pa gsum/ dang po sngon 'gro ni/ skyabs yul yid kyis gsal gdab ste/ skyabs yul rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dza/ zhes mi phyed pa'i gdung ba drag pos/ na mo: bde chen rab dga' ye shes g.yo ba'i mchog: grol lam pho nya'i bde stong bskyed pa'i phyir: nyon mongs rab dben chags med zung 'jug can: mchog gi dpal mo'i sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde chen mchog la 'god 'dod kyi blos/ hoḥ dga' ba rab g.yo mchog gi dga' ba ster: dga' bral lhan skyes dga' ba'i gzi 'od 'byin: dga' ma dbyangs can dpa' mo bsgrub pa'i phyir: dga' chen khyod bdag bsten par sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ lnga pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dir gshegs padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/

/dge tshogs kun tu bzang po'i rgyur bsngo'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ aḥ ka dag skye med chos sku'i klong*/ /lhun grub snang ba yum lnga'i dal/ /ma 'gags thugs rje khros ma'i sku: mthing nag khro zhing rab tu rngam: ngur ba'i phag zhal spyi bor brgyan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis gtum la gshe: sgeg pa dgod pa dpa' mo'i chas: phyag gnyis gri gug thod khrag bsnams: rtse gsum tri shul gru mor brten: chas ni dur khrod rgyan dang ldan: brkyang bskum gar gyi nyams gyur can: 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du bskyed: rang rtsal rigs bzhi'i 'khor tshogs dang*/ /rtsa gsum ḍākki 'phro zhing 'du/ /thugs kar kun tu bzang mo yi/ /snying dbus dga' ba 'khyil ba'i klong*/ /hūm̐ mthing mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng*/ /g.yon 'khor 'od kyis zhing kun khyab/ /rgyal mchod 'gro ba'i las nyon sbyangs/ /tshur 'dus gzi byin nus stobs rgyas/ /rtsa khams thams cad mkha' 'gro'i sku/ /rlung khams thams cad nā da'i sgra/ /thig le bde ba chen por ru/ /dag pa'i dga' bzhi ye shes rtsal/ /'bar ba'i bde stong nyams rtogs 'ur/ /phyi nang snod bcud snang grags sems/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs/ /rdo rje gsum gyi da lar sad/ om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ ci nus dang*/ 'byin 'jug rlung la bslab cing bde stong nyams rtsal sbyong*/ mthar rdzogs rim bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang srid thams cad mkha' 'gro'i zh-ing : rang lus 'byung ba gdos bcas bral: sgra rnams brag cha'i gdangs bzhin snang : 'gyu ba dran rig ka dag ngang : rol rtsal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: gsal stong 'dzin med lam du shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes bsdu la ldang*/ bsngo smon ci rigs bya'o/ zhes pa 'di'ang ma hā gu ru padma 'byung gnas kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi gnas chen rnams su mchod mjal skabs bar gseng du rab byung 17mchu zla'i dmar phyogs la gu hyas sug bris bgyis pa'o//

// tsha) a phyi'i bskang bstod ni/ ka dag dbyings las ma g.yos kun bzang mo/ kha dog ma nges rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro shar/ /ga ru gdul bya'i snang ngor sprul pa'i sku/ /nga yi skyabs gyur dbyings phyug mched lnga'i sku/ /ca co ma yin dad pas spyan 'dren na/ /cha lugs mdzes ldan lta bas mi ngoms bzhin/ /ja hong mtshams sprin rlung gis bskyod ltar mtshungs/ /nya rgyas dar 'bol brtsegs pa'i gdan la bzhugs/ /ta gan la sogs dgyes pa skyed pa'i rdzas/ /tha dad dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin/ /da lta dam tshig bsre phyir bdag 'bul na/ /na chung grogs ltar bsten gyis snying ma rengs/ /pa sangs dung zla ltar dkar dwang ba'i blos/ /pha mtha' brgal ba'i bstod dbyangs rol mo'i sgras/ /ba spu g.yo nus gdung shugs kyis bstod nas/ /ma ltar gus pas bsten na brtse ma zhan/ /tsa tur dus mchod ma bgyid bsnyen sgrub chag /tsha grang le los gsang gsum dam 'gal kun/ /dza drag snying nas bshags dang sdom bgyid na/ /wa ler sring ltar dgongs la skyong bar mdzod/ /zhwa mo'i tog ltar rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gdung*/ /za ma tsam yang mi yengs skyong ngo zhes/ /'a 'ur khas blangs rdo rje'i yal gam gson/ /ya rab bran ltar bsten gyis mthu ma chung*/ /rā sa na sogs gzung 'dzin rgyu ba'i khams/ /la 'ur dhū tir drangs la 'ching mdud dgrol/ /sha khrag zag zad zag med dga' bzhi'i 'gros/ /sa lam myur bgrod pho nya khyod kyis mdzod/ /ha ha bde skyong rang rig gnyug ma'i gshis/ /a phyi khyod dang dbyer med ma gyur bar/ /a mas bu bzhin da dung srung skyob dang*/ /a ti theg rtse'i rnal 'byor la gnas shaug / a phyi'i bstod gsol kā li'i phreng*/ /a ma dran pas yid drangs nas/ /a mtshar ci dran gu hyas bris/ /a rogs 'phya yong ma ston cig/ // dza) mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba 'dod rgu yid 'jo gter bum bzhugs so/ bla ma drag po thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/

de yang las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bskang bar 'jug pa ni/ mthun rdzas dgyes mchod legs par bshams nas/ rim gnyis gzhung gi sbyor ba la 'jug pa ni/ hūm̐/ ka dag skye med ye shes ngang nyid las/ kha ru brjod pa'i mtshan ma mi dmigs kyang*/ /ga ga gsal stong dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /nga bdag gzung 'dzin phra rags zhi ba'i phyir/ /ca sogs dbyangs snyan phyi mchod gar mo 'bul/ /cha lugs yid gar mchis pa'i spyan gzigs dang*/ /ja chang nang mchod sman gtor khor yug khengs/ /nya rgyas 'bum phrag zung 'jug gsang mchod bstar/ /rta sngon la sogs dkor cha sna tshogs kyis/ /tha dad mos pa'i snang ba tshim pa'i phyir/ /da la dkyil 'khor skyong ba'i tshul bzung ma/ /na ra las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /pa sangs ltar dkar zhi ba'i cha lugs 'dzin/ /pha rol khams gsum skye 'gro dbang du sdud/ /ba spu'i gseb nas sprul pa nyi khri 'gyed/ /ma rungs bdud rgol zhi ba'i mkha' 'gro ma/ /tsa ra ka yi srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /tsha gzer nyi ma 'bum gyi ngad phyungs la/ /dza lam bdud kyi rgol ba zhi bar mdzod/ /wa le rnal 'byor ma la gsol btab mthus/ /zhwa ltar gtsug rgyan rlangs chen dpal seng gdung*/ /za ma tsam yang dbyer med rtag tu skyongs/ /'a cag rig 'dzin gdung ba'i rnal 'byor la/ /ya yol mi dmigs 'dod rgu'i dngos grub stsol/ /ra ltar gyong ba 'khor ba'i rigs drug tshogs/ /la la tsam las mtho ris dka' lags pas/ /sha stag ye shes mkha' 'gros 'dren par mdzod/ /sa gsum skye dgu'i mgon gyur dpal lha mo/ /ha lo'i dri bsung char ltar 'gyed tshims nas/ /a wa dhū ti'i 'ching ba kun grol shog /

ces ti sgro las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bskang ba bsdus pa tshigs su bcad du smra ba 'di nyid rlangs chen dpal gyi seṅge'i gdung rigs las bskrun pa'i sngags 'chang gnam lcags rdo rjes shing sbrul lo hor zla gsum pa'i tshes la dge/ wa) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ lhan thabs zangs ri mched bdun gyi gsol mchod bzhugs so// // om̐ badzra shu la ya satwaṃ/ de yang rol pa mched bdun gyi gsol mchod brtsam pa ni/ ho/ rang nyid thugs rje khros ma nag mo gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas yar stod zangs ri rtse bdun gyi gnas nas btsan rgod 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ shu la rā dza sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ bhyo/ kā la thugs rje khros ma nag mo yis/ kha lo sgyur byed btsan rgod mthu bo che/ /ga ru bzhugs kyang 'dir gshegs mchod pa bzhes/ /nga rgyal gtum pa'i tshul 'dzin mthu bo che/ /ca co smra ba'i dgra bgegs 'byung po rnams/ /cha lugs btsan rgod tshul 'chang khyod kyis sgrol/ /ja chang phud sogs mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /nya rgyas lta bur gcod yul bstan pa spel/ /rta mchog chas ldan bzhon nas stong gsum bskor/ /tha dad gcig tu ma nges cha lugs 'chang*/ /da lta rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i bstan pa srungs/ /na ra chu bo'i rgyun bzhin yengs med du/ /pa sangs 'gyu bzhin dge ba'i phrin las sgrubs/ /pha rol 'joms mdzad gnod sbyin khyod la bstod/ /ba glang rta mchog la sogs gzugs 'gros dang*/ /ma lus lus pa med pa'i spyan gzigs kyis/ /tsa las spros pa'i btsan rgod thugs dam bskang*/ /tsha ba'i 'od ldan me 'od gdong pa can/ /dza las spros pa'i mtshon cha phyag na bsnams/ /wa skyes dgra bgegs tshogs la rdeg byed pa/ /zhwa gos bswe khrab chas ldan khyod la bstod/ /za byed rngam pa'i 'khor tshogs me ltar 'bar/ /'a ler yang 'khor tshogs ni rlung ltar 'tshubs/

/ya nga bag tsha spu zings rnam 'gyur ston/ /ral gri mtshon cha sna tshogs dgra la 'bebs/ /la las snang srid skye 'gro rtsis la 'debs/ /sha khrag dgyes byed gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyis/ /sa steng srid pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang*/ /ha cang bskul ba'i las la ma g.yel bar/ /a ti'i bstan pa skyong ba'i phrin las mdzod/ om̐ badzra tsa shu la yaksha sarba dharma pā la i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ zhes phrin las rgyun khyer mchod bstod 'di rnal 'byor slob ma rnams kyi ngor 7 rig 'dzin gnam lcags rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // zha) kyai maḥ rtog med rang byung shes pa de: ma chos sku yin par ma shes nas: rtog pas bdag tu bzung ba de: ma chos kyi sku la mthol lo bshags: dug lnga rang byung rang shar la: rtog pa shar grol ma shes nas: ma rtogs 'jol nyog spyod pa de: ma longs spyod rdzogs skur mthol lo bshags: 'gyu ba rtog tshogs sbun pa de: sna tshogs rang grol ma shes nas: yid dpyod 'khrul phyir 'brang ba de: ma sprul pa'i sku la mthol lo bshags: byar med lhun rdzogs shes pa de: 'bad rtsol bral bar ma shes nas: ma rtogs dgag sgrub byas pa de: ma ngo bo nyid skur mthol lo bshags: 'khor 'das phyogs ris bral ba de: kun gzhi bde chen ma shes nas: bdag gzhan ris su bcad pa de: ma ye shes mkha' 'gror mthol lo bshags: ma dmigs gtad mtshan 'dzin bral ba de: sa lam bral ba ma shes nas: blos byas sbyang bgrod byas pa de: ma sa lam rdzogs la mthol lo bshags: ma byung tshul skye 'gag bral ba de: phyin drug rdzogs pa ma shes nas: rtsol sgrub spang blang byas pa de: ma phyin drug rdzogs la mthol lo bshags: ma yum chen gzhi med rtsa bral la: yul snang bral bar ma shes nas: gnyis 'dzin 'dre 'dul byas pa de: ma re dogs med la mthol lo bshags: ma skye 'chi 'jigs brgyad bral ba de: gdeng tshad yin par ma shes nas:

hūm̐ phaṭ nga rgyal bsags pa de: ma gcod byed bral bar mthol lo bshags: don gcad bya gcod byed bral ba de: 'gro don yin par ma shes nas: zab lam grub mtha' bzung ba de: ma 'gro don rdzogs la mthol lo bshags: da bshag bya 'chags byed yul ma grub: byar med bde chen ma cig ma: yum chen bzang mo skye med āḥ gnas lugs rdzogs pa chen po phaṭḥ yi ge brgya pa brjod: ces gsungs so// // za) bsngo smon bya ba ni: phaṭḥ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyin pa yis: zag med bde bas tshim par shog: bag yod tshul khrims bsrungs pa yis: mtshan tshang sku lus thob par shog: bzod pas khong khro spangs pa yis: byams dang snying rje 'byongs par shog: ma yengs rtse gcig bsam gtan kyis: ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog: le lo spangs pa'i brtson 'grus kyis: sa bcu lam lnga bsnyegs par shog: shes rab chen pos rgyud sbyangs pas: rtag tu ye shes 'grogs par shog: byams pa chen pos rgyud bskul nas: sems can pha mar rtogs par shog: snying rje chen pos shul mtshon pas: rigs drug 'khrul snang grol bar shog: dga' chen khyab bdag ston pa yis: 'gro ba'i mgon du bdag gyur shog: btang snyoms bdag gzhan ris bral gyis: phyogs med 'gro don nus par shog: tshogs lam thabs kyi dge bskul bas: 'phags pa'i nor bdun rnyed par shog: sbyor lam shes rab rtsal sbyangs pas: yang dag lam mchog rnyed par shog: mthong lam 'pho ba chen po yis: nam yang phyir mi ldog par shog: sgom lam a ti'i sa thob nas: bla med rgyal sa zin par shog: kun bzang pad 'byung man chad dang : rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chod kyis: dge ba'i smon lam gang btab pa: gcod thun 'di ru 'grub bar shog: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces dmigs med ngang la mnyam par bzhag: sa ma ya: gter gzhung las bris so// // 'a) gcod bsngo sangs rgyas myur lam bzhugs so: phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' grub thob gcod kyi brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad bdag dang snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre thams cad dgongs su gsol/

lha 'dre khyed rnams kyis dang po bdag la cho 'phrul gdug rtsub bstan cing gnod pa bskyal ba dang*/ phyis nas gus par 'dud cing phan btags pa dang*/ bdag gis kyang khyed rnams la spyod lam 'jam pos lus sbyin par btang ba dang*/ spyod lam rtsub mos gnod pa bskyal ba la sogs pa/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas lha 'dre byang chub kyi lam la bkod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ lha 'dre khyed rnams kyi rgyud la yod pa'i bsam sbyor nyon mongs pa'i gdug rtsub thams cad zhi nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig khyed rnams kyis bdag la tho 'tshams shing gnod pa bskyal ba dang*/ phyis nas chos byas shing gud par 'dud pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ rgyal po byams pa'i stobs dang*/ gnod sbyin sha za spun lnga bzhin du/ bdag gi 'khor gyi 'dus pa dang por gyur cig khyed rnams kyi las ngan gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa skad cig nyid la byang zhing dag nas/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par gyur cig /rnal 'byor pa bdag gis kyang lha 'dre khyed rnams la lus sbyin par btang ba dang*/ byams pa'i sems kyis khyed rnams rjes su bzung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la brten nas/ rgyal po zla 'od dang*/ rgyal bu dge don bzhin du/ pha rol du phyin pa thams cad myur du rdzogs nas/ rang gzhan thams cad don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig / ces thun re'i mjug tu bsngo ba re thon na legs par mngon no/ dge legs 'phel lo// // ya) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ gshin gcod 'phrul gyi lde mig gshin po rjes 'dzin chog khrigs bltas chog tu bkod pa bzhugs so/ ma cig khros ma'i zhabs la gus btud de/ /gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog gi /gcod kyi gshed 'dul kun bsdus 'khyer bde 'bri/ /ma cig khraus ma'i tshogs kyis byin gyis rlobs/

/'di la ro gcod skor rnams logs su gsal/ /gshed 'dul mchod gtor gzhung ltar la/ /rang nyid mdun du hom khung bca'/ /rang nyid zhabs su hom khung bsgom mi rung*/ 'og sha) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ bsun bzlog gi ngag 'don chog khrigs bar chad kun sel bzhugs so/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ bsun bzlog gi ngag 'don chog khrigs bklag chog tu bkod pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro mchod gtor las dkyil tshogs mchod spyan gzigs gar mkhan la sogs gzhung dang lag len bzhin mngon par 'du byas la/ bdag bskyed las gzhung bsrang zhing dzap bzlas dang chos srung spyi dang bye brag gi gtor 'bul tshogs mchod bsgral bstab sa) gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las/ sbyin sreg ye shes rab 'bar gyi zhi ba'i sbyin sreg khol du phyung ba dag byed bdud rtsi'i zegs ma zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ nyon mongs rang mtshan 'dzin pa'i nad gdon bgegs/ /za byed ye shes ḍākki tsaṇḍa lī'i/ /rnam thar sum ldan rdo rje hom zhal du/ /bstabs pa'i srid zhi dbyings grol yum la 'dud/ de la gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog las zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rtsom pa la gsum/ sbyor ba yo byad kyi bsham bkod/ dngos gzhi phrin las kyi rim pa/ rjes las kyi mtha' bsdu ba'o/ dang po gang du bya ba'i gnas der gzhi bdag la gtor ma byin nas bka' bsgo/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i lag g.yas pa sa la bzhag ste rtsa sngags brgya rtsa bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs nas stong nyid du rgyas btab/ dus ni zhi bar shis pa'i yar tshes lta bu la snga dro'i cha dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs sam spyi ltar du kha shar du phyogs la/ zhi ba'i thab stegs gru bzhi pa ba byung gis byugs pa'i khar/ bri thab la tshangs zur gyi thig btab/ rgyar khru gang*/ mchu dang kha khyer la sor bzhi re/

nang du cha gcig la nor 'dzin pa tra/ de'i nang du cha phran gcig pa la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i padma 'dab brgyad lte bar rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ phyi'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes spras pa/ kha dog thams cad kun nas dkar por byas pa'i phyir ba byung bdud rtsi lnga dri bzang dang bcas pas byugs/ me tog dkar po bcal du bkram/ de yi steng tsher ma dang srog chags med pa zhi ba'i thab shing zlum bskor du brtsegs/ shar lho ru zhi ba'i me dar dkar po 'dzugs/ slob dpon gyi mdun du bsang chu rdor dril dkar blugs nang mchod rnams bsham/ slob dpon chas gos dkar po dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan/ 'jam pa'i stan la thab dang zhal sprod byas pas g.yas su mchod rdzas la/ gtso bo'i zhi gtor me lha'i mchod gtor so so'i mdun nyer spyod dang sman raka bcas bkod/ g.yon du 'das ma 'das so sor dbul rgyu'i bsreg rdzas kyi go rim ni/ dpal 'bar/ rlung g.yab ljang gu/ mar khu/ zhi ba'i yam shing sman shing ngam 'o ma can gyi shing sogs la ring thung sor bcu gnyis pa pad kha can/ dūrba/ ku sha/ bilba/ til dkar nag /sman sna lnga/ 'bru sna lnga/ rin chen sna lnga/ dar tshon sna lnga/ shing tog /me tog zhun sogs zas sna ma tshang ba med pa zhi ba'i snod du so sor bshams pa'am gcig tu bshams kyang rung la/ de yang nad yams sdig sgrib sogs zhi zhing bsnyen sgrub kyi kha skong kho na la til dang*/ gdon zhi ba la yungs dkar/ rtogs sgrib zhi ba la ku sha dang skra sen/ tshe yi bar chad zhi bar dūrba/ rgyal pos chad pa dang pha rol gyi gdug rtsub zhi bar zas mchog sogs/ las rim gang yin gtso bor ston pa'i rdzas rnams ci 'byor du bsags/ gzhan ci ltar dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya'o/ yar gzhi gong gtor sogs las byang dang mthun/ dngos gzhi sbyin sreg la 'jug pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi las gzhung bsrangs shing bzlas pa'i mjug tshogs mchod bsgral bstab dang bcas pa bya/

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum gyi dang po lha'i nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pas rdo dril bsang sbyang ni/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rigs lnga'i rang bzhin thabs kyi rdo rje las sems can thams cad smin par byed pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'phro bar gyur: oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐: zhes rdo rje lan gsum gsor/ āḥlas dbyings phyug yum lnga'i rang bzhin shes rab dril bu'i rnam pas sems can thams cad rig pa sad par byed pa'i chos sgra rgyun mi chad par gyur: oṃ ma hā ghaṇḍe hoḥ zhes dril bu dkrol/ rdor dril thabs shes kyi phyag rgya snying khar bsnol zhing*/ hūm̐: thabs shes zung 'jug chos nyid mtshon: ma lus 'gro rnams sad pa dang : sems can smin par bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol: oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe hūm̐ āḥ thugs kar 'khyud rgya bya zhing*/ rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig /dril bu gsung gi dam tshig /phyag rgya sku yi dam tshig ste/ gong gi rdor dril kha sbyor bas byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid nga'o snyam pas dam tshig gsum dran par byas la 'di nas bzung sreg blugs kyi bya ba mthar ma phyin bar rdor dril sa la mi 'jog pa sbyin sreg gi dam tshig tu bshad do/ thog mar mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas la ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod pas rdzas thams cad bum chu 'thor/ de rjes sngags 'dis dgang gzar sogs rdzas thams cad la reg tshul bya/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ a ha ri ni sa a be sha ya hoḥ oṃ las mchod pa'i rdzas mchog kun: āḥlas zag med bde ba bskyed: hūm̐ las dpag med spel bar gyur: oṃ oṃ: āḥ.āḥ hūm̐ hūm̐: thab bsang ba ni/ oṃ badzra yo gi sarba pa paṃ shwa dha ye: dpal 'bar gyi shar nas me sbar la/ hūm̐: zhi ba'i me sbar shar nas sbar: stag gdong dkar mos me sbar bas: me long ye shes lhun gyis grub: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i me sbar ro:

ram̐ shantiṃ ku ru ye swāhā: rlung g.yab thogs la/ hūm̐: shar gyis phyogs nas rlung g.yab ma: sangs rgyas spyan mas rlung g.yobs shig: lāṃ lāṃ yam̐ yam̐ ye swā hā: de nas me dar 'dzugs pa ni/ hūm̐: dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'i dar: chu khams mi 'khrugs me mtshams srung : oṃ oṃ swā hā: de nas mar khu tshar gcig tsaṇḍa lī la mchod/ oṃ agni ye swā hā: a dhi bhe a dhi bhe: ma hā shrī ha bhya ka bhya swā hā: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ swā hā: oṃ ha ri ni sa dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī pū dza sarba a hu ti dzwa la ram̐ ma hā pū dza kha kha khā hi: de nas ku sha rgya gram gyi me mgo mnan la/ hūm̐: chos sku yum chen dgongs pa te: dus gsum sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das: ku sha la brten rten 'brel rnyed: de bzhin phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ hūm̐ swā a hā: de nas me thab bskyed pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las zhi ba'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba lte bar ram̐ dang rdo rje rgya gram pad 'dab mu khyud rdo rwa me ris bskor ba'i dbus su rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gi mtshan pa zh-i ba'i dkyil 'khor lhun gyis grub par gyur: bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐: de yi dbus su ram̐ las skyes pa'i me yi lha mo sreg byed tsaṇḍa lī sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas rdo rje g.yon bhandha thogs pa gsal ba'o: tsaṇḍa lī yi gling bcu gnyis su ram̐ re re'i mtshams bcu gnyis su yam̐ re re gnas lnga ru 'bru bcu spyi bo dang mu kha ru thabs shes kyi yi ge bcas snang stong sgyu ma'i gar ltar gsal ba'o:

de nas me lha spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang : rang bzhin thabs shes rten 'brel las: 'bar zhing mched pa'i tsaṇḍa lī: 'dir gshegs byin za'i las byed phyir: deng 'dir me yi dal du bzhugs: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥmūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ dza sarba a be sha ya a āḥ mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dag na: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med dang : mchod yon zhabs bsil zhal chab sogs: bdud rtsi dag pa lha mo'i tshogs: glu gar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: bde ba'i nyams dang ldan phyir 'bul: oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de nas byon skyems 'bul ba ni/ oṃ agna ye swā hā: zhes phul/ de nas me lha'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma a yig rang byung snod mchog tu: haṃ yig byang chub bdud rtsi'i rgyun: rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug gis: bde ba chen po'i mchod pa 'bul: phyi mchod rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: dbang po rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: rdzas mchog rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: sman mchog lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: rin chen sna lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: dar sna lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: 'bru sna lnga yi mchod pa 'bul: zas mchog rnam lnga'i mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: dgyes pa skyed cing bskyed nas su: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: me tog la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra puṣpe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: bdug spos la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra dhū pe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: mar me la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra ā lo ke pra tītstsha ye swā hā: dri chab la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra gandhe pra tītstsha ye swā hā: zhal zas la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra nai wi dye pra tītstsha ye swā hā:

rol mo la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: zhes tshig dang bstun la nyer spyod rnams phul/ de bzhin gzugs la/ oṃ a badzra darsha swā hā: sgra la/ oṃ badzra wi ni swā hā: dri la/ oṃ badzra pu ṣa kṣa swā hā: reg la/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ka swā hā: de nas nang mchod bdud rtsi 'bul ba ni/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā hā: rakta la/ oṃ padma rā ga ti swā hā: gtor ma la/ oṃ bha lingta swā hā: de nas bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo rigs lnga'i lha: ye shes lnga ldan sems dpa' mo: dbang lha rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs: rang byung lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sna tshogs bde bas rab g.yo zhing : bzhin gyis khyab cing 'bar ba mo: mchod cing dga' bas rab bskul ba: tsaṇḍa lī la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod do/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ mar khu la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā: zhes mar khu lan bdun sogs phul zhing mthar oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī nad gdon sdig sgrib shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de bzhin du yam shing la/ oṃ bhrikṣa pu swā hā: ku sha la/ oṃ ku swā tsa ra ta swā hā: dūrba la/ oṃ shrī ta pa ku swā hā: bilba la/ oṃ bha ti so ti swā hā: til dkar nag la/ oṃ ti la ti tha swā hā: zho zan la/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ dzā ti li shi gur gum tsandan bcas la/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye dhi hu swā hā: gser dngul g.yu byi ru mu tig la/ oṃ mu tig ratna ka swā hā: dar sna lnga la/ oṃ pañtsa shrī ka swā hā: 'bras gro sran ma la/ oṃ ge sa ra u ta ka swā hā: zas sna thams cad la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū dza me gha swā hā: zhi ba spyi yi 'dod gsol ni/ bdag sgrub pa po yis zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la sbyin sreg gi mchod pa 'di phul ba la brten nas nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong dang 'jigs pa brgyad sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod cig:

oṃ zhi ba shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rdzas sngags brgya rtsa sogs kyi mtshams so so'i mthar sbyar/ de nas yungs dkar thab tu gtor te/ bsreg byed chen mo 'khor dang bcas pas bsreg rdzas lha'i zhal du stob pa dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs te/ bdag gi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol la/ oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐ gyis me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ gsum pa 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa ni/ me thab tu bud shing cung zad bsnan/ las bum gyi chus bsang sbyangs la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs? stong pa'i ngang las phyi snod 'jig rten dbu ma'i zom chen po de yi dbus su: rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyi steng du 'bar ba me yi dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa de yi steng du gsher ba chu yi dkyil 'khor zlum la 'khyil ba: de yi steng du lci ba sa yi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa de yi steng du mi shigs nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab cing 'khor yug gnas pa: de yi dbus su ram̐ lnga yi pho brang zang thal can gyi srog tu padma nyi zla bam gyi gdan dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur/ hūm̐: gzhal yas phyi nang mtshan rdzogs dbus: ma cig thugs rje khros ma'i sku: mthing nag khro zhing rab tu rngam: ngur ba'i phag zhal spyi bor? sogs dang*/ yang gsang ye ltar na/ hūm̐: de dbus pad nyi zla gam ti ra'i steng : baṃ yig dmar ser zangs gri 'bar bas mtshon: gnas 'gyur rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod? sogs skabs thob kyis kha bsgyur ro/ gang ltar las byang gang yin gyi spyan 'dren mthar mchod yon 'bul ba ni/ rtsa sngags kyi mthar/ sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: sogs dang*/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de nas bzhugs phyag mchod pa'i bar song nas/ mchod sngags dang sbrags mchod rdzas so sor thab tu dbul la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā:

bdug spos la/ oṃ badzra dhū pe pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: mar me la/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: dri chab la/ oṃ badzra gandhe pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: zhal zas la/ oṃ nai wi dye pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: rol mo la/ oṃ shabda pū dza me gha sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ya shrī ye swā hā: zhes tshig dang bstun la nyer spyod rnams phul/ de bzhin gzugs la/ oṃ a badzra darsha swā hā: sgra la/ oṃ badzra wi ni swā hā: dri la/ oṃ badzra pu ṣa kṣa swā hā: reg la/ oṃ badzra pañtsa ka swā hā: skabs 'dir gzhung so so'i sman raka sogs nang mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo ya kha 'khyil ba'i nang : bdud rtsi bcud ldan dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang po: bum ril snod du rakta chi li li: dung khang zhal bur bha ling ri ltar spungs: rin chen snod du dza gad phyur ru ru: ga ṇa tshogs kyi mchod pa dbyings la bsnyegs: sman phud la sogs kha mngar skyur ba'i ro: ster ba'i rdzas bcud bla med mchod pa 'di: yum chen thugs rje khros ma dgyes phyir 'bul: sku sprul bde chen dkar mo dgyes phyir 'bul: gsung sprul dmar mo sgra sgrogs dgyes phyir 'bul: thugs sprul gsang ba ye shes dgyes phyir 'bul: phrin las sna tshogs mthar phyin dgyes phyir 'bul: yang sprul ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: dgyes pas dgongs shing brtse bas bzhes nas kyang : bla med gsang ba'i ye shes don rtogs shing : dgyes pa'i grogs su ḍākkis dbugs dbyung stsol: oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: zhes sman dang*/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa ma hā rakta la khā hi: rakta 'bul/ gtor ma dgang blug tu bzhag la/ oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi:

gzhan yang gsang mchod dang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa bstod pa dang bcas pa skabs thob kyi gzhung so so ltar song rjes dgang blugs 'bul ba ni/ lha tshogs ljags hūm̐ gzar bu ram̐ mtshan las: bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir drangs te gsol bas mnyes: nam mkha' gang ba'i 'od dkar rab 'phros te: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams sgrub par bsam: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa sarba karma hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces gzhung lan bdun gyis mar khu blugs gzar gyis bkang ba'i dgang blugs kha sbyar te g.yas su bskor nas/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ ram̐: ye shes klong yangs 'khyil ba'i hom khung du: dam rdzas bdud rtsi 'bar ba'i bsreg rdzas 'bul: dam tshig bzhin las ci bder bzhes nas kyang : thogs med las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: hoḥ thog med bsags pa'i sdig ltung nyams chag dang : sngon las 'phral rkyen byad phur rbod gtong sogs: mi mthun dgra gdon rkyen ngan bar chad kun: ma bcos rig pa'i ngang du zhi gyur cig: oṃ sarba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de bzhin du bsreg rdzas gzhan rnams kyang rtsa sngags kho nas phul zhing brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su 'dod gsol gong ltar bya ba'am/ bye brag bsnyen sgrub kha skong la/ bdag cag ma rig pa'i dbang gis ting nge 'dzin ma gsal zhing bzlas brjod lhag chad du gyur pa sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi sgrib tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa myur ba nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs gang zhi ba'i 'dod gsol sbyar/ mthar mchod pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: phyi mchod lha mo rab dga' bcu drug gi: dpag yas sprin ltar gtibs pa'i 'dod yon tshogs: chags pa'i dbyangs dang dga' ba'i brda skad kyis: bskul bas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin du pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/

ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de nas sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: rakta 'bul ba ni/ ma hā rakta la khā hi: gtor ma dgang blug tu bzhag la/ oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ dmar gtor gcig la 'khor lnga yi bskor ba bshams/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ ma 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: u tsa la yi gnas mchog tu: ri bo thams cad rus pa'i ri: rtsi shing thams cad mda' dang mdung : 'bab chu thams cad khrag dang rnag: sgra skad thams cad ngur ba'i sgra: nyin mo sprin nag khu rlangs gtib: mtshan mo dur me 'bar zhing mched: dus drug gnas nyul rlung ltar 'tshubs: 'byung po ro langs mun ltar gtib: ma mo thams cad 'tshogs pa'i gling : khro bcu rgyu bar mi nus shing : phyag na rdo rje 'jigs pa'i sa: de 'dra ya nga'i gnas mchog tu: khros ma nag mo de ru bzhugs: rdo rje phag mo de ru bzhugs: bde chen dkar mo de ru bzhugs: ser mo don grub de ru bzhugs: dmar mo sgra sgrogs de ru bzhugs: sna tshogs mthar phyin de ru bzhugs: las kyi mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: brgyud 'dzin mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: sha za mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: phra man mkha' 'gro de ru bzhugs: bhyo maḥ spyi bor phag zhal nam mkhar ngur ba las: rtog med don dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ra ri zer ba'i tshig brgyad po 'di brda bstod 'bum bskul tshig gnyis mtshams su 'gre'o/ bhyoḥ dbu skra dmar ser dbyings su bskyod pa ni: rang byung skye ba med pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: thod skam lngas yis dbu la brgyan pa ni: rigs lnga'i sa lam rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ ma mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: ḍākki rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: deng 'dir sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul:

mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang : tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod spel: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus: dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar mdzod: sbyin sreg gi 'gres byang 'og tu so sor spros rgyu yin yang bsdus tshe dkyus ltar byas pas chog spyan gsum sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs pa la: sku gsum don dang ldan pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ shangs nas drag po'i rlung dmar 'tshubs pa la: ma rig nyon mongs gtor ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ snyan nas 'byung lnga'i 'brug sgra sgrog pa la: ye shes sku lnga rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ mche ba dkar po zur gsum gtsigs pa la: dug gsum rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rkan sgra rdeb pa la: chags sdang dbyings su gtor ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ snyan cha rin chen nor bu'i brgyan pa la: bdag 'dzin 'khri ba gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ dar dmar cod pan ban bun dpyod pa la: nga bdag 'khrul pa zhig pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkhar 'phyar ba la: skye shi rtsad nas gcod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ phyag g.yon bhan dmar thugs kar bsnams pa la: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ kha ṭwāṃ rtse gsum mchan du bcug pa la: sgo gsum thar lam 'byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ glang chen ko rlon stod du g.yogs pa la: sku bzhi phrin las 'grub pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sked la dkris pa la: sa bcu sor rtser son pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsol ba la: ma sring dbang du sdud pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa la: dpa' bo gar dgu rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ me long dang ni g.yer khas brgyan pa la: shes rab rtsal snang rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba la: 'khor 'das rang sar grol ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ thal tshom raktas 'bur gsum brgyan pa la:

snang srid sgyu mar rtogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ sbrul rigs lnga yi chings brgyan 'khyugs pa la: ma rig ka nas dag pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum ro gdan 'gyings pa la: dbyings rig cig car rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa la: 'khor 'das sku la rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ shar phyogs rdo rje mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: zhi ba'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ lho phyogs rin chen mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: rgyas pa'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ nub phyogs padma mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: drag po'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gros bskor ba las: drag po'i phrin las rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ dbus phyogs sangs rgyas mkha' 'gros bskor ba la: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ las kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: gnas yul sku la rdzogs pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ brgyud 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: dur khrod las kun byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ sha za mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: srog gcod dbugs len byed pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ༈ phra man mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba la: 'dzam gling stong khams nyul ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma mkha' 'gro'i brda skad di ri ri: dur khrod me yi dkyil 'khor du: ḍākki rgya mtsho 'khor bcas la: deng 'dir sbyin sreg mchod pa 'bul: mi mthun 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang : tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod spel: lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du bsdus: dgra bgegs dam sri zhi bar mdzod: bhyo bhyoḥ maḥ steng mkha' spyod rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: 'og sa spyod rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: mtha' 'jig rten rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: phyogs las byed rigs kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum: ma mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas:

bka' snang srid lha srin 'khor gyis bskor: deng 'di ru sbyin sreg mchod pa bzhes: rkyen nyam nga chag chen zhi ba dang : gzhi rang rig rgyal sa zin pa dang : lam rgya yan la 'khrul rtog mi 'byung zhing : don gdod ma'i mgon po 'grub gyur nas: dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas thob pa dang : dus rtag tu mi shigs phrin las mdzod: oṃ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ni sa a we sha ya sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba pū dza a hu ti khā hi: oṃ badzra ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ ratna ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ padma ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ karma ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ bhi shwa ḍākki nī sarba a hu ti pū dza khā hi: oṃ sarba sa ma ya a hu ti agne ye swā hā:

de nas so rtsi dang gos zung kyang 'bul bar spro na/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badzra wasatra ye swā hā/ gos zung yang 'bul/ bzod gsol ni/ oṃ: ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : cho ga lhag chad 'gal zhing 'khrul: khungs dang dbang lung rgyus med cing : bskyed rdzogs phyi nang nor ba dang : rmongs shing bag med ci mchis pa: ma sring tshogs la bzod par gsol: oṃ ḍākki sa twa sa ma y sogs/ ḍākki bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ yig brgya bzlas shing bzod par gsol/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor gyis: zhi bar gyur pa'i las kun mdzad: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu stsal lags pas: bde gshegs yul du gshegs slad du: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: ci bde bar ni gshegs su gsol: rtsa sngags dang*/ badzra mu zhes rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la gnyis las dang po me lha gshegs su gsol ba ni/ blugs gzar gyis mar khu dang*/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas me gso zhing*/ slar yang lha mo tsaṇḍa lī cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur pa'i cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsams la/ oṃ agna ye swā hā: lan bdun 'bul zhing*/ oṃ agni ye swā hā: a dhi bhe a dhi bhe: ma hā shrī ha bhya ka bhya swā hā: de nas rdzas lhag rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba las/ yam shing la/ oṃ bhrikṣa pu swā hā: ku sha la/ oṃ ku swā tsa ra ta swā hā: dūrba la/ oṃ shrī ta pa ku swā hā: bilba la/ oṃ bha ti so ti swā hā: til dkar nag la/ oṃ ti la ti tha swā hā: zho zan la/ oṃ sarba samba de swā hā/ dzā ti li shi gur gum tsandan bcas la/ oṃ bhai ṣa dzye dhi hu swā hā: gser dngul g.yu byi ru mu tig la/ oṃ mu tig ratna ka swā hā:

dar sna lnga la/ oṃ pañtsa shrī ka swā hā: 'bras gro sran ma la/ oṃ ge sa ra u ta ka swā hā: zas sna thams cad la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū dza me gha swā hā: zhes rdzas rnams so sor phul/ sngar mchod pa'i skabs mchod rdzas lhag ma rnams tshig dang bstun te thab tu dbul la/ oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de bzhin pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gandhe/ ne wi dye/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hā: de nas sman raka gtor ma yang 'bul la/ oṃ agne de wa sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: oṃ agne de wa ma hā rakta la khā hi: me lha'i gtor ma dgang gzar khar bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gis byin brlabs la/ bhyo bhyoḥ rab 'jigs 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: bskul zhing bzhengs pa'i tsaṇḍa lī: phyi nang ḍākki 'khor bcas la: mthun rdzas dgyes pa'i mchod gtor 'bul: ram̐ gyi dkyil 'khor mthar phyin nas: zhi ba'i las kun 'grub par mdzod: oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī agne ye sarba a hu ti bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas gtor ma me nang du bzhu/ de nas so rtsi dang gos zung kyang 'bul bar spro na/ oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ zhes so rtsi dang*/ oṃ badzra wasatra ye swā hā/ gos zung yang 'bul/ bstod pa ni/ phyag rgya dril stabs dang bcas/ hūm̐: bde gshegs gtso bo rigs lnga'i lha: ye shes lnga ldan sems dpa' mo: dbang lha rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs: rang byung lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bhyoḥ sna tshogs bde bas rab g.yo zhing : bzhin gyis khyab cing 'bar ba mo: mchod cing dga' bas rab bskul ba'i: tsaṇḍa lī la phyag 'tshal bstod: bzod gsol ni/ hūm̐: tsaṇḍa lha mo 'khor bcas la: sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyi: 'gal 'khrul nyams pa gang mchis pa: de dag khyed kyis bzod par gsol: oṃ kro ti tsaṇḍa lī ma dag pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: de nas gshegs gsol ni/ hūm̐: dbang gi lha mo tsaṇḍa lī:

sbyin sreg mchod pa 'di 'bul gyis: khyed kyis sems can don mdzad nas: pho brang nyid du gshegs su gsol: badzra mu: me lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa lte ba'i a thung la thim par gyur/ de nas rjes shul mi dmigs par bsdu la me rang gzhil btang*/ long khyab med tshe 'o chab kyis me gzhil te ri rtser rlung la bskur ram btsa' sad ser srung sogs la bed spyod bya srol yod/ nang du logs la rjes kyi bya ba gzhung ltar bya'o/ de ltar gsang ba ḍākki yid bzhin nor mchog gi sbyin sreg gi cho ga ye shes rab 'bar las 'dir bsnyen sgrub kha skong sogs nye bar mkho ba'i dbang du byas te zhi ba'i sbyin sreg kho na khol du phyung ba dag byed bdud rtsi'i zegs ma zhes bya ba 'di'ang sprul sku bstan 'dzin 'gyur med kyi bzhed skong du gnam lcags pa o rgyan gsang sngags bstan 'dzin gyis rab byung bcu bdun pa'i shing mo bya yi lor dbo zla ba'i gser mig can gyi khyim du res gza'i rgyal po shar gyi thig le dang sgyu skar gyi bu mo brgyad ldan ma lhan cig tu dga' ston brtse zhing dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i mgrin 'gyur ngom pa'i dus shrī lnga ldan yam bu'i rgyal khab kyi lte ba go dha wā ri'i gnas dang lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dur khrod sogs gnas yul dur khrod kyi mkha' 'gro ma dngos su 'du ba'i nye ba'i tshandho ha du mas brgyan pa'i gnas mchog ga la ba der sngar ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis bsad pa'i mi ro bslangs shing rgyal khams chos la bkod pa'i gnas mchog der gnas pa'i gnam lcags sgom grwa a ti sna tshogs rang grol gling du sbyar ba'i dge bas ma rgan 'gro rnams padma 'od kyi pho brang du rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogs gral du tshom bu gcig tu 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ha) gsang ba yid bzhin ḍākki nor mchog las/ bsnyen yig dmigs gnad zin bris bzhugs so//

// chos sku'i zhing du skye med kun bzang yum/ /longs spyod rdzogs sku 'gags med wā ra hī/ /sprul sku'i rol gar dzñā na sa ga ra/ /sku gsum rgyal ba'i yum des shis pa stsol/ de yang gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang ma cig gi sras mchog rgyal ba don 'grub sogs snyan brgyud gcod kyi gdams pa zab mo la skye ba du mar bka' bab kyi las 'phro sad pa/ rdo rje'i lung gis gsal bar bsngags pa'i 'gro 'dul dus bab kyi gter chen o rgyan rtsa gsum padma gter bdag gling pa'i gter byon/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi dmigs gnad zin bris su bkod pa la gsum las/ dang po bsnyen pa ni/ phyi nang gsang gsum mtshams tshul bzhin du bcad de bdag bskyed la dgos pa'i sman raka gtor mchod tsam bshams pa las sgrub rdzas mi dgos/ dngos gzhi bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i gnas lnga'i lha dang*/ gtsug tor nam mkha'i 'khor lo la gu ru padma dmar smug he ru ka yi cha byad ḍā dril 'khrol zhing brtul zhugs kyi nyams dang ldan pa/ lha lcam yum dang sbyor ba gzhan yang rtsa khams nyi khri chig stong*/ ba spu bye ba ther 'bum/ khor yug dur khrod la sogs par gnas yul gyi zhing skyong dang*/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du sku gsung thugs kyi snying pos mtshan pa 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings dang dam tshig phrin las kyi gnas rnams nas/ ye shes las grub kyi tshul du mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs pa gnyis med du mos pas/ phyi snod bcud kyi 'byung lnga/ nang bcud kyi sha khrag drod dbugs/ gsang ba dug lnga'i rnam rtog ste/ thams cad ye shes lnga yi bdud rtsir 'khyil ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la gnyis su med pa'i dgyes pa bskyed cing*/ khams gsum 'khor ba zad par rol pa'i mos pas mchod pa rnams 'bul/

bstod pa ni/ chos nyid dbyings las rang nyid thugs rje rol pa'i brda rtags kyi phyag rgya rdzogs pas/ srid gsum dbyings su bsdus pa'i phrin las rmad du byung ba la nges shes dran pas rtse gcig tu bsgrub par dam bca' ba'o/ bzlas pa ni/ dbu gtsug tu padma thod phreng gi thugs kar zla steng om̐ smug nag dang*/ spyi bor buddha mkha' 'gro yab yum gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thugs kar zla steng baṃ yig dkar gsal gyi mthar/ sngags phreng dkar 'tsher g.yon du 'khor ba dang*/ de bzhin du mgrin par padma mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams kyi thugs kar nyi steng ni dmar sngags phreng gis bskor ba dang*/ snying gar rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams kyi thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du ha mthing nag phreng bas bskor ba dang*/ lte bar rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams kyi thugs kar zla steng ri yig ser po'i mthar sngags phreng rang mdog dang*/ gsang bar karma mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi steng sa yig ljang gsal sngags phreng gis bskor ba'o/ gzhan yang rtsa khams ba spu'i grong khyer thams cad du sna tshogs mkha' 'gro bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i thugs kar dza yig rang mdog can du gsal ba'o/ om̐ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mgo drangs te bskul bas/ spyi bo'i bla ma la mos gus dung dung bskyed cing thugs srog las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ khyad par rnga yab gling nas padma thod phreng rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ gnyis med du thim pa'i thugs rjes gzi byin lhag par bskyed cing snang srid thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i sku gsal snang la 'dun pa rtse gcig tu gtad cing*/ thugs srog om̐ las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba bdag gi tshangs bug tu zhugs/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi gtsug nas thugs srog sngags phreng la thim pas byin rlabs gzi 'od 'bar zhing rang sgra dang bcas nas sngags phreng g.yon du kyi li li 'khor bas bde stong gi ye shes mchog tu rgyas te rdo rje'i glu dang bro yang brdungs pas sbyor mtshams nas byang sems thig le'i rgyun babs pas rtsa 'khor gang*/

de ltar dbu gtsug nas byin rlabs ye shes kyi bde rgyun bar med du babs pas/ 'khor lo'i lha tshogs bde stong rgyas te byang sems babs pas/ mgrin pa'i rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi dbu gtsug nas thugs kar thim pa sogs snying kha lte gsang gi bar du 'gres/ mthar rtsa khams ba spu'i bu ga tshun chad bde stong du phril phril 'ja' 'od du kyil kyil/ zer dang zer phreng shig shig par gyur te/ rlung mkhris bad kan sogs 'byung ba lnga yi nad thams cad zhi/ gti mug las gyur pa'i klu/ 'dod chags las gyur pa'i ma mo/ zhe sdang las gyur pa'i gshin rje/ nga rgyal las gyur pa'i lha/ phrag dog las gyur pa'i bdud sogs dug lnga'i gdon tshogs thams cad rang sar grol/ sha khrag drod dbugs rnam shes te khams lnga yi snyigs ma sbyangs/ bum gsang shes rab rig rtsal gzhi rdzogs te dbang lnga thob/ dug lnga ye shes lnga yi ngo bor rgyas thebs te gsal 'tsher lhun sdug cis kyang mi shigs pa rdo rje'i 'od skur mngon sum du grub par mos la/ bag chags snang yul shes pa skad cig kyang mi spro bar ye shes chen po'i rlung sbyor gyi ngang nas om̐ badzra yo gi ni ā yurdzñā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ zhes bzlas/ de yang sum 'bum bzhi 'gyur bzhi 'gyur bzla zhes pa ni/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud las/ rdzogs ldan dus su yi ge 'bum bzlas te/ /gsum ldan dus na sngags pas 'bum phrag gnyis/ /gnyis ldan dus na 'bum phrag gsum nyid dang*/ /bye ba phrag gsum 'bum bzhi rtsod dus sbyar/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'dir gsum 'bum bzhi 'gyur te/ 'bum phrag bcu gnyis bzla ba grangs kyi bsnyen pa dang khyad par rtsa ba gsum gyis byin brlabs pa'i mtshan ma thon pa gal che'o/ gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ sgrub rdzas rnams gzhung bzhin bshams la/ bskyed rim ni/ bdag mdun tsam du snang srid snod bcud thams cad chos nyid rol rtsal yin phyir/

rang byung rig pa'i gsal cha sgyu 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs pa'i spyan 'dren mchod bstod kyi mthar/ bdag mdun dzap khang dbye zhing bdag nyid rig pa ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor sbyang gzhi'i bag chags la ma 'gags pa'i 'od gsal rang snang lhun grub kyi gnas lngar mkha' 'gro rigs lnga sogs sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams ma lus pa sku yi dbyings su rdzogs par gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed sbyang bya'i gzhi lus med phyir sgrub rdzas ting 'dzin las kyi dkyil 'khor te dkyil 'khor yang rang las mi mtho zhing*/ lha yang gling bzhi ri rab gnon pas padma 'dab bzhi nyi zla baṃ ro'i lte bar gtso 'khor lnga po gsal ba'i thugs kar zla steng gtso mor baṃ dang*/ rigs bzhi la ha ri ni sa rang mdog can gyi mthar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor bar gsal/ bdag bskyed kyi gnas lnga'i thugs srog las ye shes lnga'i 'od zer 'phros pas mdun bskyed 'bum phrag sde lnga'i rang srog gnad nas bskul zhing*/ sngags phreng rang sgra dir gyis 'khor bas bzod dka'i bde chen cher 'bar te rang 'od kyi spros pa'i dpa' bo yab dang mnyam par sbyor zhing*/ zhabs gar stabs kyi bro brdungs pas srid gsum 'jig rten srid pa rmang nas ldeg cing 'bum phrag sde bzhi'i gtso mo la g.yon bskor du kyi li li 'khor bas gling bzhi rgya mtsho lcags rwa'i mthar thug tshun chad yom yom shig shig tu g.yos shing 'bar ba'i gzi 'od kyis gnas yul zhing skyong gi tshogs dang lha 'dre mi gsum zas nor longs spyod dang bcas pa thams cad dbang du sdud de/ gnyis med kyi gzi byin bskyed pa'i gsal snang ma nyams par sgrub sngags om̐ badzra yo gi ni a yurdzñā na hri da ya siddhi hūm̐: zhes bzhi khri bzhi 'gyur bzla/ zhes pa 'bum gcig dang khri drug bzla ba ste grangs bsnyen dang mtshan ma ni dngos nyams rmi lam gyi shes par 'gyur la/

spyir 'di la gnad gsum ste/ thog mar bsnyen dus bdag bskyed kyi gsal snang rab tu 'bar bas mdun bskyed zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ bar du srog gi 'khor lo bskor bas dam tshig las kyi mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ thun mthar mkha' 'gro thams cad 'du ba'i srog snying 'od kyi thig le dmar gsal gzi 'od dang ldan pa bdag gi thugs kar thim pas stong khams kun na che btsan 'gran zla dang bral ba'i gzi byin bskyed pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'i srog 'phrog pa'o/ de la spro bar mos tshe rang snang rlung sems dbang sdud kyi sngags/ om̐ badzra wā ra hī aṣṭa pa shaṃ ma ma siddhi hūm̐: dang*/ gzhan snang mkha' 'gro bdag gi dbang du bya ba dang khams gsum mos bzhi skye 'gro dbang du sdud pa'i sngags/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni lo ka dzñā na sarba rā ga pa shaṃ thun thun dzaḥ sogs kyang sbyar bas chog /sgrub pa grol mtshams dbang bzhi blang ba'i mthar snod bcud 'od du zhu ba mdun bskyed la thim/ de yang 'od du zhu ste dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i bdud rtsir dmigs la lhag med du btung ngo*/ gsum pa las sbyor ni/ mdun bskyed dang 'brel ba'i dgra gdon zhi ba dang*/ bsgrub bya'i tshe dpal bskyed pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa/ rbod gtong byad ma rdul du brlag pa sogs mchis kyang*/ 'di sgrub pa thon nas las sbyor bdag bskyed kho na la brten na spros bcas za za'i rnam g.yeng chung zhing rnal 'byor pa rnams 'jug pa bde phyir bdag bskyed gnas lnga'i lha dang thugs srog bcas pa bsnyen dus ltar la/ bye brag dus gnad dang sbyar na/ tho rangs byang chub kyi sems 'phel zhing rlung sems nam mkha'i khams rgyas pa'i dus der mchog gi dngos grub bsgrub phyir spyi bo'i buddha mkha' 'gro'i sa bon mthar/ om̐ buddha ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces g.yon bskor du kyi li li 'khor ba'i zil gyis rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskul zhing de yi thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis rab 'byams rgyal ba'i byin bcud bsdus te gzi byin 'bar ba'i 'od kyi thigs pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du 'dzag pa/

sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro la thim pas bde stong gi ye shes 'bar ba'i shugs kyis snod bcud 'byung ba'i tshe bkrag thams cad bsdus shing sbyor mtshams byang sems kyi 'khor lo lnga sogs phung khams thams cad mer gyis gtams pas bde stong gi ngang du gzugs sku'i 'dzin pa thams cad med par dran rig gi rgyun yengs med du bskyang ba'o/ nam langs zhi ba'i dus su snying gar rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog gi mthar/ om̐ badzra ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭḥkyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba'i mthu byin bsdus te gzi 'od 'bar ba'i shugs kyis nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad sangs kyis dag /thugs rje'i stobs bskyed de 'od zer rgya cher mchis pas snod bcud kyi 'byung ba'i dug gzhil/ bcud kyi skye 'gro'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ bdag gzhan gsal stong dbyer med kyi ngang nas bzlas pa'o/ snga dro rgyas pa'i dus su mgrin par rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog gi mthar/ om̐ ratna ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭḥkyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas kyi byin bcud sdud cing 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud kyi tshe dpal nus bcud bsdus te gnyis su med pa'i gzi byin gyis srid pa'i dpyi gnon gyi ngang nas bzla'o/ dgong mo dbang gi dus su lte bar padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog mthar/ om̐ padma ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭḥkyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba'i mthu byin bsdus te nus pa'i stobs bskyed/ rjes chags kyi 'od zer dmar po rmongs byed chags byed g.yeng byed kyi nus pa dang ldan pa lcags kyu'i dbyibs can dpag med 'phros pas/ snang srid lha 'dre mi gsum gyi srog snying bkug ste rang dbang med par 'dar phri li li rjes chags kyi mes zhu ba 'od kyi sbubs su drangs te gnyis med du thim pas/ bde chen bzod med du 'bar ba'i rngam bro brdungs pas snang srid snod bcud thams cad dmar 'od du ltem ltem zhu ba bdag dang gnyis su med pa bde stong ye shes kyi ngang nas bzla'o/

srod drag po'i dus su gsang ba karma mkha' 'gro'i thugs srog gi mthar/ om̐ karma ḍākki nī hūm̐ phaṭḥkyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros nas bde gshegs zhi khro rab 'byams kyi mthu byin bsdus te nus pa'i stobs bskyed/ 'bar ba'i 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa rno zhing ngar ba lci zhing 'thas pa ka gdung tsam grangs med 'phros pas stong khams 'ub kyis gang*/ srid pa gsum gyi bdud rigs log 'dren thams cad thal ba bun bun tshe srog dbang thang gi lhag ma rnam shes dang bcas pa 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la thim pas 'khor bar phyir mi ldog par bsams la bzla/ de dag gi bsnyen tshad ni/ khri phrag re re sogs skabs dang bstun/ zhes dngos bstan las bzhi 'gyur gyis nges pa ma bshad do/ gzhan yang dam tshig chag nyams skong zhing phal gyi log shes bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa dang*/ sha za mkha' 'gro dbang du bsdus shing dug dbal gzhom pa dang*/ drag po las la 'gyed pa sogs skabs bstun mde'u rtse bsgyur bas chog go /spyi tsam du phrin las bzhi ka'i pho nyar bsngags pa las sbyor dang nor sgrub sogs skabs su gang bab sbrel shes par bya'o/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i snying po ni/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor thams cad mthar phyin nas sbyang gzhi 'byung 'dus kyi phung po sbyong byed gnas lnga'i 'khor lo sogs bsgom mi 'tshal bar/ phung khams snang srid zang thal phyi nang ma grub pa'i klong du rang rig ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro zhal phyag mtshan ma las 'das pas/ gdod ma'i gshis lugs khong khrol bri gang spro bsdu dang bral ba la gang shar gyi rtogs pa'i sna mi bskyil bar gnas dang zas gos spyod lam gang la'ang nges pa med par ye grol cog bzhag gi ngang nas 'bras bu gzhi thog tu ma 'byor bar lam mthar dbyung bar gces so/

de ltar rang gzhung mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi gzhung pod du rje btsun bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin gab sbas med par skyid grong smyon pas go bder bkod pa zhes yang zab mkha' 'gro'i dmigs gnad 'di yi dbu ldeb gcig ma tshang ba zhig 'dug pa la/ dpyad pas rtsa ba chos rje gling pa'i khros ma'i bsnyen yig cig yin 'dug kyang rang lugs la yang de nyid mtshams sbyor mdzad kyi yod pa mngon pas gsang ye kho nar sbyar chog pa'i dbang du byas te mtshan smos pa dang mchod brjod sogs ldeb gcig kha snon zhus te gzhan gzhung tshig sor bzhag gi lha mtshan bsnyen sgrub sngags sogs kha bsgyur dgos pa rnams gsang ba ye shes gzhung dang bstun nas phri snon cung zad bcas gsung gi rig 'dzin rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyis rnam 'phrul sgo chen mchog sprul rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i skyes mthar 'bod pa'i phyogs nyul gyi sprang po wa gind+ra nā ga dzu nas bal po pham mthing pa'i gdan sa mkha' spyod rdo rje phag mo'i gandho la dang nye ba'i char gnam lcags sgrub sde ru sbyar ba dge bar gyur cig/ // a) mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi zin bris 'dod 'byung ratna'i bum chen zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ rgyam̐l bstan dha na ko sha'i mtsho dkar dbus/ /rgyam̐l kun klong gcig gong bur bltams pa yi/ /rgyam̐l bsngags thugs rje'i rang mdangs phyogs kun gsal/ /rgyam̐l ba mtsho skyes rdo rje gtsug rgyan bkod/ /gam̐ng de'i thugs rje'i snang cha 'gags med du/ /gam̐ng shar rmad byung sa nas rang bab shar/ /gam̐ng 'dul 'gro rnams mkha' spyod lam ston pa'i/ /gam̐ng gi mtshungs med gsang ba ye shes bstod/ /dem̐ yi phrin las mos snang ngor/ /dem̐ ltar drags gzugs dam can rje/ /dem̐ bstan srung ba'i skya bdun gyis/ /dem̐ yang bka' yi gnang ba stsol/ ces thog mar snang srid sa ler gzigs cing bzang ngan 'khrul rgyas ma 'ching ba'i sbyor ba de nyid kyi mtho srid rtse dang mnar med yan gyi gzugs can gzugs med kun rnam dkar bde ba'i dpal la dgod pa'i phyir/

gcod ces bya ba'i gdams par 'bad pa ni/ dang po dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rang snang su bsgyur ba'i phyir gnas yul byin chen ḍākki 'du ba'i gling dkyil dben khrod du/ rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i legs tshogs mngon par 'du bya ba ni/ thog mar rab sa stegs/ 'bring ras bris/ tha ma 'bru tshom mam mkha' 'gro'i sgrub dkyil gyi dbus su lhan thabs lding khri rim gnyis kyi dang po'i khar/ dbus su bla 'khor dang me long sindhu ra'i ha ri ni sas mtshan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i sku bsham/ mdun gyi shar ngos su bum pa bum rdzas kyis gtams pa kha rgyan mgul chings rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tsaklis brgyan pa bsham/ dbus kyi g.yas char lho phyogs su gtor ma stod zur smad zlum pad 'dab bzhi ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro'i tsaklis brgyan pa bsham/ dbus kyi rgyab char nub ngos su sngags phreng dmar po'i dkyil du padma mkha' 'gro'i tsaklis brgyan pa bsham/ dbus kyi g.yon char rigs lnga'i prog zhu la las kyi mkha' 'gro'i tsaklis brgyan pa bsham/ 'og gi rim par/ mkha' 'gro'i rgya rtags kyi dbang dang 'brel ba'i/ rus rgyan/ gri gug /bhandha/ kha ṭwāṃ/ cod pan sogs dngos 'byor ram/ yang na tsakli dang*/ me dpung hūm̐ bhyo pheṃ gyis spras pa'i tsakli sogs bsham/ bsdu na lding khri'i khar g.yon ngos su bum pa bcud ldan gyi khar rigs lnga'i kha rgyan dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tsaklis tho brtsegs ltar brgyan sgro mdangs gzung thag lhan du 'jog /sngags phreng dmar po dang me long ha ri ni sas mtshan pa mchur 'phyang bar bya'o/ g.yas zur du gtor ma sngar gyi stod zur can la bla 'khor 'jug pa ni/ mkha' 'gro rgya rtags kyi dbang 'brel rnams cha gang 'os su bkod/ de yi mthar rnal 'byor ri khrod 'grim pa'i cha rkyen rnams bsham pa ni/ shar du ḍā ma ru dang dril bu/ lhor stag lpags kyi gdan/ khra thor/

thod snod 'tsho bas phrom gyis gtams pa/ thab snod btung ba bcud kyis 'gengs pa rnams bsham/ nub tu g.yang gzhi rkang gling*/ dom ra rnams bsham/ byang shar du kha ṭwāṃ/ gtsod ru bsham/ de mthar shar du phyi mchod/ lhor tshogs gtor mañdzi thod skam gyi tog yod pa'i khar thod ting ngam bhandha'i nang du/ tshogs dang g.yas g.yon du tshogs chang*/ tshogs sha/ bza' btung kyi rigs phun sum tshogs par bsham/ nub ngos cung mtho bar g.yas g.yon du sman raka /dbus su dpal gtor/ phyogs bzhir pad 'dab bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mtheb skyu bzhi dang ril bu bya/ de dang zung du mda' dar dmar po'i mgul du za 'og gi khug mar rdzas li khri sogs ka la'i dbyangs ring ltar bya/ byang du btsan rgod skya bdun gyi gtor ma lcags sam bhandha'i snod du chos 'byung bsnol ma/ de steng dmar gtor g.yas gcus tsitta gsum gyis brgyan pa/ chos 'byung gi g.yas g.yon rgyab kyi rtsibs rnams su dmar gtor g.yas gcus liṅga re res brgyan pa/ mdun gyi rtsibs sog kha'i steng du stod zur smad zlum me ris brgyan pa ni yum gyi gtor ma yin pas gtso bo'-i phyed char sleb tsam bya/ de dang zur du mkha' 'gro'i bskul gtor chad brtan rnams rang gzhung spyi mthun ltar bsham mo/ de nas gzhan la gdong mi bstan cing dam bca' drag po bya ba sogs ni gzhan spyi dang mthun la de nas bde ba'i mal du 'khod de/ dkar bgegs phul grub rjes rtsa bar 'ja' lus mkha' spyod kyi las byang dang*/ ka la'i dbyangs ring sogs bya ste thun lnga bzhi sogs bgo zhing sgrub rtags mnga' brnyes par bya ste grol kha gcod dbang dpa' mo rol rtsed kyi sgrub rdzas rnams bdag 'jug tu rol nas ri khrod 'grim pa'i chas sogs nar mar brten te ri brgya sogs gcod gdams gsang ba 'khor lo ltar bya zhing lhong rnams su thogs bcas thogs med kyi gdams pa phul du phyin par bya'o/

dpe ris khrid dang sgrub tshogs kyi bca' lag rnams grub zin to/ da ni nad pa sogs gnad 'gag che sar tshogs las bya ba ni/ nad pa'i sngas su yar gzhi gong gtor g.yas g.yon du sman raka /mtha' gang bder bka' srung gi gtor ma/ bskul gtor chad brtan dkar bgegs bam tshogs dang*/ bstab pa'i chas gtor chung drug /sha dum drug liṅga drug bcas bshams/ de nas thog mar gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i rta ring*/ skyabs sems/ na mo dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ de nas dkar gtor phul/ bgegs dgug pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo/ ma cig nas dkyus ltar bsnyen mtshams bskyal/ bsnyen pa ci nus mthar/ mchod bstod dang btsan rgod skya bdun gyi gsol kha rnams bya'o/ de nas gong nas nad pa'i sngas su bca' grab ma byung na/ 'di mtshams nad pa mdun du khrid la/ pang ngam sngas steng du/ bam tshogs/ tshogs sha/ tshogs chang rnams bshams la/ de nas lus sbyin gyi na moḥ skyabs yul gyi sogs nas dkyus ltar bya ste nad pa'i rnam shes mdun mkhar ma cig la bstim/ phung po maṇḍal dang tshogs su dmigs/ dbang sdud kyi mtshams rnams su g.yang gzhis brab cing*/ bya rgod sha thed rol ba bzhin: rang dbang med par da 'dus shig: bar brjod/ de nas gzhung gi tshogs la 'jug pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ bdag nyid sogs nas kha kha khā hi bar brjod de/ tshogs zhing byang chub myur lam bya/ de nas lus sbyin gyi mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byed du ma yi/ sogs nas drag gcod bar 'don/ tshogs bar pa dum bu lnga bcad de/ 'bum bskang ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyo ma: rang nyid yum chen thugs ka nas/ sogs nas dkyus ltar bskang bya skong byed skye med klong du hoḥ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces tshogs bar pa rnams mchod de/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyaiḥm mi min ye shes sogs nas ma khams gsum 'khor ba ma stongs bar: bar dang*/ zangs ri'i bskang ba bya/ 'di mtshams nad pa gan rkyal bcug la/ de nas/

bhyo bhyoḥ ma yum chen sogs bya zhing*/ de nas thod ting zur gsum du sngar gyi sha dum tshogs dum/ ling chung gtor chung rnams bran te nad pa'i steng du bshams la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen nas/ bhyoḥ ma mi min ye shes sogs/ hoḥ bstab bo bstab bo sogs kyis steng du mchod/ yang sha gtor tshogs ling cha gcig nad pa'i gzhogs g.yas su bshams te bran la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen dang*/ bhyoḥ ma mi min dang*/ hoḥ bstab bo sogs kyis shar du phuul/ yang sha gtor tshogs ling cha gcig nad pa'i mgo'am sngas su bshams te bran la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen dang*/ bhyoḥ ma mi min dang*/ hoḥ bstab bo sogs kyis lhor phuul/ yang sha gtor tshogs ling cha gcig nad pa'i gzhogs g.yon du bshams te bran la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen dang*/ bhyoḥ ma mi min dang*/ hoḥ bstab bo sogs kyis nub tu phul/ yang sha gtor tshogs ling cha gcig nad pa'i gsang ba'am mal rdo'i steng du bsham zhing bran la/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen dang*/ bhyoḥ ma mi min dang*/ hoḥ bstab bo sogs kyis byang du phul/ yang sha gtor tshogs ling cha gcig mtshams nad pa'i gzugs thog zhig tu bshams la bran te/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bhyoḥ rang nyid yum chen dang*/ bhyoḥ ma mi min dang*/ hoḥ bstab bo sogs kyis mtshams bzhir phul/ gal che na lan mang bsog go /de nas lus sbyin gyi/ phaṭḥm 'di nas lho nub mtshams sogs nas/ skra nyag ma tsam yang med par mdzod: ces brjod/ sgrub pa'i skabs ma gtogs bsgral las mi dgos da ni tshogs la rol ba ni/ kyeḥ ma dngos grub kun gyi bdag nyid ma: de nas tshogs chang btung ba ni/ oṃ: skye med chos sku ngo mtshar che: de nas lhag ma rnams gcig tu bsdus te gzhung gi hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra men ma: sogs nas om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha hi: ces brjod de phul/ de nas lus sbyin gyi/

phaṭ 'dir 'dus shig glo bur lhag pa rnams: sogs nas/ kun kyang byang chub myur thob shog: sogs nas nad pa la lus sbyin smon lam zung 'jug gis/ phaṭḥ rang rig ye shes mtsho rgyal nas sogs nas pad 'byung yab yum go 'phang thob par shog: 'bum bskang ni/ phaṭḥ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i sbyin pa yis sogs nas gcod thun 'di ru 'grub par shog: yang lus sbyin gyi/ phaṭḥ rang rig gi ngo bo ka dag 'di: sogs rnam shes phab pa nas sogs dkyus ltar nas kun kyang byang chub myur thob shog: de nas nad pa grol dgos na grol/ mi dgos na nad pa'i sdong grogs su dmigs te las bskul bya ba ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag sogs/ de nas bka' srung ni/ dzaḥ 'jigs su rung ba sogs i daṃ bar brjod bar gnad 'gags ma che bar yin na phyin chod bskul ba mi bya/ de nas gzhung gi hūm̐: rab 'bar me rlung gyi kha raṃ khā hi bar brjod/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sogs chad mdo phul/ hūm̐: bod skyong sogs brtan ma phul/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro sogs rta bro bya/ de nas mchod bstod bzod gsol dang*/ hūm̐: zab dbyings bde chen gyis dngos grub bskul/ bsdu chog bsngo smon bkra shis rnams bya'o/ des tshogs las grub zin to/ ༈ da ni gcod 'dul bya ba ni/ gzhung las gshin po'i dge bcu la bar du gcod pa/ gson po'i gshin chags su bgyis pa rnams tshogs su rol ba dang*/ hoṃ du btab pa zor du 'phang ba gsum las/ dmar gcod/ khra gcod/ nag gcod gsum ste/ de khra gcod dam gcod 'dul zhes te hoṃ du btab pa nyid bya ba yin te/ gzhung las/ byang ling gsum la za 'dre srog gcod gshed dang gsum bris gshed sgro'i nang du bcug /pho shi rnams kyi ro gos/ mo shi rnams kyi mdun dkris/ bu tsha shi ba dang bud med kyi mdun 'geb sogs rang rang gi skabs dang bstun/ zhes gsungs pas/ gos sham gyis yang 'thus pa 'dra/ bca' gzhi bsags pa ni/ shog ling che ba gcig dang*/

shing byang chung ngu gsum gyi rgyab tu za 'dre khug /srog gcod khug /shi gshed khug ces dang mdun ngos dgra gzugs snying gar nṛ dang phyi rol khram gyis bskor ba bri/ de dang zung du zan ling gsum/ byang rdzi shing byang gcig la mgo mjug la khram dang rked du nṛ bris pa gcig bya/ de bdun shog ling khug lteb kyis btums la ling khrus rnams gzhan spyi gzhung ltar bya/ de nas mar gzhi spo leb zur gsum bzhin legs po'i dkyil du ma traṃ bris bca' ba'i steng du lcags kyi hoṃ chung bzhag pa'i nang du liṅga bdun po byad thag gis dkris te 'phang*/ phyi rol lcags ri'i khar rtsang btsugs/ kha nas ras nag kha gang gis bkab/ steng du mda' gsum om̐ gyi khar/ mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma zur gsum pa gtso bor lnga bzhag /phyi'i mtha' nas gshed sgro rlung thub gshed bring zhags pa 'dom dgu/ gshed satwa kha che gshed gri ngar ma gshed zor 'gugs mo sogs bsgral chas cha tshang gis bskor/ gong non gang 'os kyi bsnyen mtshams su mkha' 'gro'i sgrub pa ka la'i dbyangs ring btang*/ dus drug tu bskul dgos shing khra gcod gzhung la 'jug pa ni/ dus drug lnga la rang bab kyi hoṃ mi shigs par 'don chog /dgong mo'i cha la bab pa'i skabs mdun du g.yang gzhi'i khar dur rdo gsum la khrag gi kha mig gtod de de steng sla nga bzhag khar gri gsum rtse bsnol gyi hoṃ tshul bya ste/ nang du liṅga rnams bkram phyi rol sngar gyi bsgral chas rnams ji lta ba bzhin bkod/ de nas 'don par 'jug pa ni/ mchod g.yog pas gser skyems btegs te zangs sgrom ltar/ hūm̐: dbyings las ma g.yos sogs nas dmigs pa'i byad ma sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces dang gshin gcod ltar phaṭḥrang nyid yum chen ye shes kyi sogs nas mdun du za 'dre shi gshed thams cad 'dus pa'i rten liṅga dang dbyer ma mchis par bskyed pa'o/ de yi phyogs bzhi sogs gsal ba'o/

phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas zangs sgrom gyi mdun du gnam lcags las grub pa'i hoṃ khung nag po zur gsum sogs nas dus kyi pho nya mo gling bzhi yud kyis bskor zhing gshed po'i bla srog rnam shes 'gugs pa las kyi sogs/ dam nyams pa'i byad ma rigs can sogs nas thar pa med pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur/ bkug gzhug tshar gcig shing zan ling gnyis lag g.yon gyis bzung ste/ mchod g.yog pas gshed bring gru la bkon/ gshed satwa gshed gri gshed zor g.yon gyis bzung*/ g.yas kyis gshed sgro kha phye ste/ phaṭḥ na mo drin can rtsa ba dang sogs kyi/ rig sngags kyi bdag mo khro mo rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ khyad par 'og min mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams chen po nas yum chen shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum sde/ rnam dag longs sku'i zhing khams nas/ gsang ba ye shes rnal 'byor 'bum sde/ bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas/ ma cig ye shes mtsho rgyal sa spyod mkha' 'gro 'bum sde/ u tsa la'i dur khrod chen po nas/ ma cig sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro khros ma nag mo/ shar phyogs gtum drag 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ ma cig rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde chen dkar mo/ lho phyogs gad rgyangs sgrog pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ ma cig rin chen mkha' 'gro don 'grub ser mo/ nub phyogs padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ ma cig padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo sgra sgrogs/ byang phyogs kī la sgrog pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ ma cig las kyi sna tshogs mthar phyin/ shar lho rab rgyu dur khrod chen po nas/ brgyud 'dzin 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ lho nub gtum pa'i dur khrod chen po nas/ za byed sha za mkha' 'gro/ nub byang kun tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod chen po nas/ phra men dbugs len mkha' 'gro/ byang shar shin tu rgyu ba'i dur khrod chen po nas/ gnas nyul dus mtshan ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bum sde'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

khyad par sku sprul shel gyi mi mo/ gsung sprul byi ru'i? thugs sprul mthing gi? yon tan gyi sprul pa mchong gi? phrin las kyi sprul pa bswe yi? sgrol byed nag mo lcags kyi gdong can/ phra men ma bya rog 'ug pa'i

sogs nas tshad btsugs ya bo bzung ba/ do bsdo ba/ phod btsugs pa/ 'gran btsal ba/ bdag cag yon mchod rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum khyim sgo lam gsum gzhi lam byes gsum gnod cing sdang bar byed pa'i mi rabs bdun khyad par tshe las 'das pa de nyid gson gyi dus su dang po nad kyi sna 'dren pa/ bar du gdon gyi tshang bca' ba/ tha mar srog gcod cing dbugs len pa/ mdangs 'phrog cing zla ba dang bsdongs nas gson por rnams kyi mi nor la sgab cing sdang sems bar chad brtsams te gshin po 'di nyid yar mtho ris kyi lam bkag cing mar ngan song gsum gyi sna 'dren par byed pa'i za 'dre shi gshed gzugs liṅga la bkod cing bla shog bur bris pa rnam shes sa bon la btab pa 'di rnams kyi bla srog rnam par shes pa gnam sa ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla gling bar mun pa'i bar khyams ban bon srung ma'i skyabs 'og gang du gnas kyang las kyi rnam par smin nas bgugs ma dgos par rang dbang med par 'dir khug dzaḥ liṅga sgro bar bcug /yang zan ling shing ling gnyis bzung ste 'gugs gzhug lan gcig bskyar la sgro bar bcug /yang shing ling zan ling byang rdzi gsum 'dzin nas sgro bar bcug /'gugs gzhug lan gsum song nas zin shing liṅga bdun po rdzogs nas kha dam du bcing*/ nad pa rang nyid cung zad phyogs rnams su g.yug /de nas mchod g.yog gis bzung ste 'di skad kyis pho nya bskul ba sha za gdangs glu/ phaṭ maḥ yum chen khros ma nag mo yi: nas/ phung po gzugs ling 'di la khug: rus sbal nag pos gshed rgya chings: 'di nag gcod ma gtogs mi dgos mchan/ de'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i bla 'gugs kyi bskul rdzogs nas/ sgro ba rdeb tshul bya zhing sprugs bcol la/ phaṭḥ shar phyogs gtum drag dur khrod nas sogs nas gdab cing sprugs pas ming med mdzod: phyogs bzhi dbus lnga'i bskul bya zhing 'gugs gzhug rnga chem bya zhing ma 'thor bar sla nga nang du byo bcug

/gzhung las pho sri kha sbub na khug /mo sri gan rkyal 'dug na khug /ces gsungs/ thun cung re 'thor la ci tsam khug pa tshur blang lcags steng du bzhag ste ma khug pa rnams gong ltar sprugs sbran te pho nya bskul/ khug tshar nas shog ling dril te byad thag gis dkris shing hoṃ nang bzhag la steng nas hoṃ khar phur pa 'dzugs shing 'di skad do/ mjug gi hoḥ rang nyid yum chen khros ma nag mo gsal ba'i mdun du sogs rgya chings rus sbal nag po ri yi khog par gnam lcags kyi hom yangs par mgo bo chu srin sogs nas 'dzin par gyur zhes tshig bsgyur te hom mi bying par bzhag /ces nyin re bzhin de ltar dang byas pas nyin gcig gyu ba phyir nyin ma gyu na mgo g.yogs yin pas yang yang bkug rgyud las byang rdzi ma gyu bar liṅga gyu na mgo g.yogs yin gsungs gab khung 'phud thabs gzhan dang mtshungs/ thon nyin de ltar gyu ba rnams tshur blangs te gris khraṃ ris btod cing lcags ting du bsog /rang gzhung las gnas gdon yin pas bsgral dgos/ ces gsungs pas de ltar snga ma thams cad rdzogs nas bsgral ba ni gri gug thogs nas phaṭ ma drag mo chos 'byung e yi klong sogs nas/ shi gshed ming yang med par mdzod: rtsa sngags bgrang za 'dre shi gshed kyi snying dkar nag mtshams su rbad kyis bcad de gtubs par bsam kho yi rnam shes gri gug gi khong seng nas thon te yum chen kun tu bzang mo'i thugs kar thim par gyur/ phaṭḥ gzhung las byang ling bsgral thon te bstab pa'i mjug tu bsreg ces gsungs pas bstab pa ni/ phaṭḥ gti mug sha yi mchod pa 'bul: zhe sdang phung po'i zhal du bstab: sogs nas/ gshed 'dul phrin las 'grub par mdzod: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ mer bsreg pa ni hoṃ khar rtsang shing brtsigs te ling ro steng du bzhag nas me sgron la/ phaṭḥ ma mdun du gru gsum mchod pa'i dal sogs nas/ dge bas 'gro kun las grol shog
