/ gzhung las/ sātstsha nag po gdab ste dur gyi phyogs gsum du bzhag /yang na sol ba rlung ri gru gsum du gtor ces gsungs pas gang 'grig bya chog des khra gcod tshang zin te/ dur gcod bya ba ni/ gzhung las/ thog mar ro de ma 'gul bar thar lam dkar por 'jug cing dbu ma zhi gcod la sngon 'gro skyabs 'gro brgyud 'debs byas zhes gsungs pas/ hoṃ yangs su bam tshogs bzhag la gsol 'debs tshangs pa'i rta ring bya/ de nas rlung ro dal bus la rang nyid lus drang por bya/ phra mos ngo sprod ni/ phaṭḥ na moḥ 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams rmi lam bzhin sogs/ phaṭ kyis bskul bas yar 'phros shig phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ gsum bdun gyis rnam shes de skad cig skar mda' gyen du 'phang ba ltar rnam shes ngo bo a dkar ram gsal stong 'od zer 'phro ba zhig tu bsgoms la sangs rgyas yab yum gyi thugs kar thim par bsam/ gzhung las dmar gcod ces bya ste tshogs su rol ba'i las bya ba ni/ spar thub thog nas lus sbyin tshar gcig btang*/ rang nyid khros ma dngos su bsam mdun du bem po tshogs dang dbyer med du bzhag /dbang sdud phyin chad g.yang gzhi tshig mtshams re la yang brdeb/ za 'dre shi gshed rnams gtub ro dang bcas gnyis med du thim par bsam/ zhes gsungs pas gcod gdams gsang ba 'khor lo ltar/ na moḥ skyabs yul gyi sangs rgyas chos dge 'dun sogs nas dkyus ltar gcod rdzogs par bya de nas tshogs gtubs te steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad la 'gyed/ rang gis kyang za ste tshogs zhing byang chub myur lam 'don de nas drag gcod bya ste/ phaṭḥm 'di ni lho nub mtshams sogs nas skra nyag ma tsam yang med par mdzod bar brjod do/ de nas 'bum bskul bya nas ro bsgul dgos pas/ phaṭḥ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol nas sogs nas rkang gling gtser zhing bzhengs te/ phaṭḥ ma skye med ka dag mkha' 'gro ma: sogs nas dkyil 'khor gnas su byin gyis rlobs:

phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces brjod/ de nas phung po byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phaṭḥ skye med sku yi byin rlabs om̐ sogs nas snang srid khyon du khengs par bsgyur/ ti ra bam gyi tshogs 'khor 'di sogs nas dkyus ltar gshed 'dul phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas lus sbyin gyi/ phaṭḥ 'dir 'dus shig glo bur lhags pa rnams: sogs nas dkyus ltar kun kyang byang chub myur thob shog: de nas ro bsgul ba ni/ spros pa la dga' na gcod gzhung ltar phaṭaḥ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma mtsho rgyal khros ma sogs nas de'i phyogs bzhi dbus lnga ru 'gugs byed las kyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang pho nya gsal ba'o/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de nas god gcod gzhung ltar/ phaṭḥ bdag nyid khros ma'i thugs ka nas dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho pho nya 'phros pas dmigs pa'i god 'dre gnod byed rnams phung po gzugs ling 'di la khug phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ nas lcag gis brab ste rang nyid khros ma nag mo'i zhabs g.yas nas spros pa'i las byed kyi khro mo grangs med kyi phyag na gnam lcags kyi thun dang rab tu 'bar ba'i me zer 'phros shing skar mda' 'khrugs pas gdon 'dre shi gshed thams cad sbur ma me yis bsregs pa ltar gzhom zhing ming yang med par bsgom/ phaṭ phaṭ/ rdog tho gsum brgyab/ de nas thogs bcas thogs med lam 'khyer ltar dmigs pa kha sgyur bya ba ni/ phaṭ/ rang nyid khros ma nag mo'i phyag g.yas kyi gri gug las rang 'dra'i khro mo grangs med kyi mtshon cha'i char dang rdo rje'i ser ba gnam lcags phur pa rno ngar dang ldan pa stong gsum mun pa 'khrigs pa ltar 'phros pas gnod byed za 'dre shi gshed thams cad thal ba'i rdul phran lta bur brlag par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ phyag g.yas kyis ro'i thong ga nas bsdus te gan rkyal du 'phang ngo*/ de nas lus sbyin ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: zhi 'dzum sogs nas 'khrul med kyi mngon sangs rgyas par shog:

bar bya ste ro gdon 'tshe ba bcas mi dmigs rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang la gnas bzhin khyer te dur du phyin nas 'og gi bya 'bod song nas rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas rnam shes sogs myur thob shog: de nas bya 'bod mos na khram rnams gzhung gi yig chung ltar brgyab ste ro'i lce dang nywa bzhi'i sha rnams bcad de rgod rkang gi gling bu bus la 'di skad do: hūm̐: ma 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: sogs nas baṃ baṃ phaṭ bar brjod/ rkang dung 'bud cing rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas 'od zer lnga ldan lcags kyu ltar 'phros pas gnas yul lam mkha' spyod kyi bdag po rnams dur khrod kyi bya rgod du sprul te skad cig 'dus nas ro de lhag med bzhes par bsam/ gzhung las/ gal te za 'dre 'khor na gtub kyang brdung bya 'bod kyi gong du lha 'dre la sngar gyi 'gyed bya zhes gsungs/ des dur gcod grub zin to/ da ni gnad 'gag che na rnal 'byor nus ldan gyi nag gcod gling bzhi go ldog ces zor du 'phang ba'i las 'di nam yang mi bya zhes gsungs pas/ spros pa ma ltos mgo chung gi bya ba byas na rang dang yon bdag gnyis ka khe nyes che bas gar thod du mi bya zhing gal te dgos chad che na gzhung las gnas gdon byang bu la bstim zhing bsgral/ lus gdon ro la bstim zhing bsgral dgos zhes gsungs pas/ gnas gdon bsgral phyir sngar bshad kyi khra gcod bca' lag ci bzhin bsag go /lus gdon bsgral ba ni gzhung las/ spar chog thon nas ro de sa bdag rus sbal nag po zhig tu bsgom/ de yi khog tu za 'dre lan gsum bkug cing 'bros dbang med pa'i chings brgyab lha 'dre'i 'gyu srang ma sleb bar bam tshogs bca' lag mi bya zhes gsungs pas/ dang po dbu ma dkar gcod kyi rnam shes spar de nas/ phaṭ rang nyid yum chen ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal khros ma sogs nas gsal bar gyur/

phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ/ de nas liṅga thams cad sgro ba dang g.yang gzhi lhan du ro la brab cing*/ phaṭ ma yum chen khros ma nag mo sogs nas dkyus ltar gdab cing sprugs pas ming med mdzod: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces bya ste tshig mtshams su ro la gdab bo/ gzhung las gnas gdon gyi gshed rnams bye mas chu len pa ltar byang bu la thim par bsam zhes gsungs/ de nas gshed sgro yar gzhi'i gral du bzhag /lus gdon ro la bstims nas chings rgyag pa ni/ phaṭḥ ma yum chen khros ma nag mo yi: sogs nas rus sbal nag pos gshed rgya chings/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ bdag nyid khros ma nag mo gsal ba'i mdun du sa bdag rus sbal nag po gnam lcags las grub pa de yi khog par za 'dre shi gshed thams cad tshud nas nam yang 'chor ba med par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ de ltar bsam zhing spros pa la dga' na bton kyang 'thus/ de nas ro gan rkyal 'phang*/ gzhung las lha 'dre'i 'du srang ma sleb bar bam tshogs bca' lag mi bya/ zhes gsungs pas/ gnyan dmigs su phyin na bam ro gan rkyal bzhag ste tshogs su dmigs pa ni/ phaṭḥ ma 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na: sogs nas dkyil 'khor gnas su byin gyis rlobs: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ skye med sku sogs khengs par gyur: phaṭḥ ti ra bam gyi nas gshed 'dul phrin las 'grub par mdzod: bar bya bsgral ba ni/ drag po'i chos 'byung e yi klong sogs nas shi gshed ming yang med par mdzod: ces dmigs pa gzhung ltar bya gzhung las/ tshogs dang lus sbyin thon rjes su/ /gtor na bstab pa'i mjug tu bya/ /dmar lam ar gtad zor gdab ni/ /sgyed pu gsum ni srid gsum bsgom/ /lcags snod 'jig rten khams su bsgom/ /me ni bskal pa'i me dpung bsgom/ sa ma ya/ zhes gsungs/ da ni drag las zor mda' ar gtad ni thog mar lha 'dre lha bdud btsan gsum 'gyu lam mam/ yang na gnas mal nas sgyed rdo dkar nag dmar gsum blang zhing 'tsham pa zhig tu sum tshugs bca'/

'og tu dug shing gi me sbar khar lcags kyi sla nga btsugs/ de nas rang nyid kyis dgra satwa lcags kyu gshed zor thogs te lag g.yas bcad de shar du bzhag /lag g.yon bcad de lho ru bzhag /rkang g.yas bcad de byang du bzhag /rkang g.yon bcad de nub tu bzhag /mgo bo bcad de dbus su bzhag /mdun du bem po khrag rnams bskyur te lcags snod du blugs cung zad khrag me yi dros par byas te rlangs pa thon tsam nas srid gsum me yi rang bzhin du gyur/ snang srid lha 'dre thams cad srid pa khrag gi rgya mtsho sogs dmigs pa gzhung ltar bya/ phaṭḥ ma nga ni sogs nas brlags par gyur: ces phyogs bzhi dbus lngar khrag gtor ba sogs gzhung ltar 'don bsgom sbrags mgo zor 'phen pa ni ske mtshams nas bzung ste/ ma bdag nyid khams gsum sogs bshig pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces yan lag rnams kyang so sor 'don bsgom sbrags te zor kha brtag pa gzhung ltar bya/ de nas yan lag rnams tshur phyogs gcig bsdus te khrag 'pho ma rnams ro steng du blugs/ ro yi byang khog gnam lcags khang sgrom du bsgom 'dre sde brgyad dur sri sri rigs thams cad tshud par bsams te lha 'dre la gtad pa ni/ phaṭḥ rang nyid thugs rje nas gtad do gnyer ro dam ma g.yel: phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ ces gzhung ltar dmigs pa bya ste steng du sgyed pu gsum gyi tho bya/ gom pa dgu'i mtshams su tho gcig bya ste khyung nag gis sgab 'dre bcad ting 'dzin bcas kyi ngang du log par bya ro chas rnams yon bdag la mi sbyin pa gnad yin/ zhag gsum bzhi tsam khyim du gcod bya shin tu bka' gnyan pas gar thod du mi bya/ don gcod gcig shes kun grol gyi ngang du gnas par bya/ des nag gcod tshang zin to/ da ni sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ yar gzhi gzhung ltar bsags mar gzhi sbyin sreg yig chung ltar bya ste rgyud 'debs nas bzung btsan dang bskang ba rgyas pa rnams 'dzud de dkyus ltar bstab pa bya/

de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung gi bsang sbyang me sbar rlung g.yab me mgo mnan me mtshams bcad/ me lha spyan 'dren bya mchod pa'i mtshams nas gzhung ltar mchod pa cha gcig la agne dang om̐ haṃ kā laṃ pa swā hā/ zhes me lha'i rtsa sngags lnga bdun skabs ltar ci nus sbyar ba'i mthar mchod sngags kyis mtha' brgyan te mchod pa cha gcig tshang bar phul nas phrin las bcol ba me lha'i byon skyems de nas sbyin sreg gi gzhung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed chog dkyil 'khor lha bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa dang rtsa sngags om̐ badzra yo gi ni'i mthar/ om̐ haṃ kā laṃ pa sogs kyi mthar mchod sngags sbyar te mchod pa thams cad song nas phrin las bcol bar mtshams kun la'o/ de thams cad song nas gsang ba ye shes gzhung gi bstod pa bya de nas sngar ltar me lha'i bskyed chog nas bzung mchod pa phrin bcol bya ba gshegs skyems yin/ de nas lhag ma btang bskul dang btsan gyi bskul bya tshogs lhag phran bu dang sreg rdzas rnams 'bul/ me lha'i gtor ma 'bul/ me zhags bya ba 'di skabs sbyar/ de nas chad mdo brtan skyong rta bro dngos grub bskul/ bsdu chog bsngo smon bkra shis rab gnas mtha' rgyas bya/ zhes ḍākki gsang ba ye shes kyi zin bris phra zhib tu bsags pa 'di yang dgos zhes sngags btsun kirti'i ming gis gtsos grwa slob mang pos bskul ngor gar dbang brgyud 'dzin ārya'i ming gis bla ma'i zhal rgyun dang gzhung tshig nyams med gtsor bzhag ste rnam gsum dag pas hol gtam du bris pa'o// //

ki) gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs bzhugs so: tshe gcig 'ja' lus lam la gshegs pa yi: zab lam mtsho rgyal bdag la gdams pa 'di: ma bsgoms sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i man ngag ste: kun gyi nang nas yang bcud khyad par 'phags: kho mo bdag gi snying khrag dum bu nyid: brda ru ma btab ring phan tsittar sbas: ci phyir yis ni ma 'ongs skal ldan don: nye ba'i thugs sras lo tsā'i dwang ma nyid: sangs rgya ye shes rgyal tshab bu la gdams: mi brjed ri mor brda yi yi ger gzugs: gsang rgya brda yi sgrom bu'i dbus su bskyil: mchims phu 'di yi ke'u tshang du sbas: sngags bdag las kyi ma mor gnyer byang gtad: ma 'ongs nyi shu'i yang mtha' la nye dus: sa rtags dus dang dang lung bstan shar ba'i tshe: skyes bu khyed nyid ma nges tshul bzung nas: sgrib med mkha' la dus bdag 'gyu ba bzhin: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling zhes yongs grags nas: rgya bod khams kun 'dul gdul bya'i zhing gyur te: 'brel tshad don ldan 'gro mang thal sbyar 'dus: smon lam dbang gis brda der mngon nas su: yang zab snying thig 'di nyid 'don par gyis: sa ma ya: dang po skyabs sems ni: na moḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyabs yul 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge 'dis ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: gnyis pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: ma cig yum chen khros ma'i thugs ka nas: bar med khyab par 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'phros: gnod byed bgegs tshogs gtor ma len phyir khug: bdag gi bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: mchod sbyin 'di khyer rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru glags blta na: bdag nyid dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro thugs khros nas: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon cha thun du brdeg: me ltar 'bar bas bgegs dpung bsregs gtor gzhom:

de bas bgegs tshogs 'byung po phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ṇi sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ gsum pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: bdag nyid khros ma rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha me ri drag po thog ltar 'phros: gnod byed tshar gcod mtshams gcod las grub nas: tshur 'dus mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: om̐ badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ bzhi pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla bhandha'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: ? nas shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū p sparshe āḥhūm̐ om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra ma ra ni ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta ā hūm̐: lnga pa byin dbab cing brda sgo dbye nas dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: lta ba klong yangs ye shes 'char sgo phyes: nyon mongs a 'thas srid pa'i sgo bcad nas: dran rig gnyug ma'i yid kyi lha zhal mjal: 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma 'grub bar du mi btang srog ltar bsgrub: om̐ badzra a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ oṃ pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra tsitta hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung ba rim brtseg ni: hūm̐: ye nas chos rnams bdag med stong pa'i dbyings: āḥ ma 'gags zang thal rang bzhin rol rtsal spros: om̐: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ngang nyid las: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐ hūm̐ baṃ:

de las rlung me chu sa dbang chen gzhi: bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang dang sa bon dang : phyag mtshan gnas gyur lha tshogs gtso bor gsal: om̐ swa bhā wa dharma e yam̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: pam̐ padma sūrya a tsand+ra ru tra ti ra baṃ hūm̐ baṃ ha ri ni sa badzra dzñā na hoḥ gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐ e: mthing nag khyab gdal lhun grub rang bzhin la: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs rang byung gzhal yas khang : 'od zer sna lnga sgyu ma ltar shar ba'i: tshad med bzhi ldan gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang : drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen pu shu ldan: ka gdung dral lcam 'phan dar sna tshogs 'phyangs: rta babs chos 'khor nyi zla nor bus brgyan: dbus su rang byung rin chen sna lnga'i tog: thog steng rgyan dar phyi rol sgau khyud ldan: rdo rwa pad phreng dur khrod me ris bskor: phyi nang bkod pa yongs rdzogs pho brang gsal: hūm̐: de dbus pad nyi zla gam ti ra'i steng : bam yig dmar ser zangs gri 'bar bas mtshon: gnas 'gyur rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod yum chen sku: dmar gsal mdangs ldan byi ru'i dbang lhun mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags pa'i gar stabs can: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i spyan gsum smin ma 'bar: ral pa'i thor tshugs thod skam rigs lngas mtshan: spyi bor phag zhal mthing nag phem sgra ngur: dar dmar cod pan mkha' la bun bun bskyod: phyag g.yas zangs gri nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar: g.yon pas bhandha kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: rin chen snyan rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu 'khrol: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha'i sgra dang ldan: 'khor ba stong phyir mgo phreng ga shal 'phyangs: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum mkha' la gar stabs tshul: ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du gsal: gtso mo'i phyogs bzhi pad nyi bam gyi steng : ha ri ni sar bskyed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma:

dkar ser dmar ljang bde spyod gar stabs can: gtso ltar 'gying ba'i phyag mtshan rgyan cha 'phyangs: tshad med bzhi ldan bde gshegs dpa' mo'i tshul: snang stong ngang la ma bcos lam gyis gsal: ham̐'u: gzhan yang phyi nang ma sring gnas nyul ma: zhing rdul grangs dang til gang phyes pa ltar: bde spyod bsgrub phyir na bun mkha' lam gang : dgyes pa'i brda gar glu dbyangs dang bcas nas: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa ni: hūm̐: mkha' spyod bde chen o rgyan pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ma sring ḍākki 'bum: sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir: gsang sngags pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: ti ra nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: byams gdung bu ltar brtse bar dgongs mdzad phyir: ma cig yum chen tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: gus pas 'dud de dgyes pa'i mchod pa ni: phyi mchod sna lnga nang mchod sman raka dang : gtor mchod ga ṇa tshogs kyi lhun po spungs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol mthun rdzas spyan gzigs tshogs: ma sring mnyes pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: gsang ba ye shes 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe? shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū p sparshe pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: gsum pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐ baṃ bhyo: chos dbyings lhun grub gsang ba'i dbyings klong nas: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ma: padma rā ga lhun po'i mdangs 'khyud pa'i: cha shas rab rdzogs gzhon nu gcer mo ldem: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i zhal ras mdangs bzang g.yo: lcang lo 'khyil zhing thor tshugs rab tu mdzes: bhandha skam po'i phreng ba tshal gyis spras:

'jam pa'i le brgan cod pan dbyings la bskyod: sa gsum sngangs mdzad spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rin chen las grub snyan cha zlum la 'khyil: phyag g.yas zangs gris nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: g.yas pas bhan dmar sgrub la dngos grub gter: kha ṭwāṃ mchan bcug dug gsum zur du 'joms: phyag zhabs gdu bu rin chen las grub 'khrol: mgul rgyan mu tig chun pos spras legs ma: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha seng seng sgrogs: drug cu mgo phreng sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem: nu ma bha ga rab rgyas bde ba g.yo: lha tshogs ldan pa'i g.yas brkyang gar ldan 'greng : sgeg pa'i dpa' mor gzhon nu'i cha shas rdzogs: pad nyi bam steng dgyes mdzad dbyangs can ma: sku las mched pa'i ye shes me ri 'bar: sa bcu rnal 'byor sems mdzad dbyings phyug ma: gsang ba ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba'i dbyings phyug dkar gsal dwangs 'dzum ma: rgyas pa'i dpa' mo bzhin bzang 'od ldan ma: dbang gi las mdzad chags pa'i bcud g.yo ma: drag po'i las mdzad rab tu gtum pa mo: las bzhi bdag mo kun kyang gtso mo'i chas: phyag mtshan rgyan ldan gar stabs shigs se shig: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang ya la la: g.yo ba rab bzhad brda skad di ri ri: spyod pa'i rnal 'byor 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs bsgyur: zab lam gsang ba'i bde ba kun ster ma: mthong na mi bzod shes rab cha shas rdzogs: byams gdung bu la brtse ba'i ma chen mo: gsang ba'i rig ma phrin las bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: dbyings phyug dpa' mo ma sring tshogs bcas la: gus pas btud de rtse gcig bstod pa'i mthus: 'chi med 'ja' lus tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol: om̐ badzra yo gi ni ā yurdzñā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags 'chi med rdo rje gzung ngo : rlung sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra wā ra hī aṣṭa pa shaṃ ma ma siddhi hūm̐: rgyun bsnyen sngags ni: om̐ badzra yo gi ni a yurdzñā na hri da ya siddhi hūm̐:

nor sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra yo gi ni puṇye ratna pa shaṃ thun thun: dbang sdud sngags ni: om̐ badzra yo gi ni lo ka dzñā na sarba rā ga pa shaṃ thun thun dzaḥ phrin las kun sgrub sngags ni: om̐ badzra yo gi ni sarba karma sa dha na ye swā hā: zhes pa'i gong 'og gi sngags rnams rang mos bzhin khol phyung du bsgrub kyang chog: sngags kyi grangs rtags ni 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung : 'on kyang rgyun du nyams len bgyis na lus ma bor bar mkha' spyod gshegs te 'ja' lus 'grub par 'gyur ro: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir sku gsum yig 'bru 'phros: mchod rdzas la phog byin brlabs bcud mchog spel: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin rlabs bya: dang po spyan 'dren mchod bskang bshags pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: phag mo rigs bzhi ma sring bye ba 'bum: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba'i las byed tshogs: bka' srung gter bdag mchod 'os mgron gyur rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchod rdzas bcud mchog spel: 'dir tshogs skal ldan sgrub la mchog thun stsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ de nas mchod pa ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid thob ste: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi:

de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag mo phag gdong gsal ba'i mdun: shor med lcags khang nang du nṛ tri las: dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: bden stobs ni: na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: gsang ba ḍākki mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: bka' srung gter bdag srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra rnams: rkyen ngan bar chod glo bur bgegs kyi tshogs: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dgra bo sgrol ba'i mtshon: rdo rjes mtshan pa zangs gri thog ltar 'bebs: byad ma gnod byed mgo lus dum bur gtub: phye mar brlag cing sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra ta ma ka ra ti ka ya gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad nṛ tri rbad rbad: bstab pa ni: hūm̐: gsang ba'i dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dgyes par bzhes shig bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom nas: sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma btang ba ni: hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra man ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe 'grub par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: dang po thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: dbang phyug ḍākki skur bzhengs la: mthu rtsal stobs kyi thugs dam bskul: las bzhi kun 'grub phrin las bcol: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag byang chub mchog thob ste: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: gnyis pa chad mdo ni:

hūm̐: sngon tshe bskal pa tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi: gsum pa brtan ma ni: hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyi: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srung lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ti ma ma khā hi: bzhi pa rta bro bya ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro rdung bas: phyi nang bar chod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: dgra bgegs dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: drug pa dbang dang dngos grub blang ba ni: hūm̐: zab yangs bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog thun kun stsol nas: dbang bzhi ye shes thob par mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra yo gi ni kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu ṇa siddhi hrīḥ gu ya sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bdun pa bkra shis bya ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma: nam mkha'i lus can rdo rje ḍākki gtso: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar 'dod rgu mchod sprin mo: ma sring ḍākki tshogs kyis bkra shis shog:

brgyad pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: nam mkha'i klong yangs cho 'phrul sgyu ma bzhin: bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor mi dmigs chu zla ltar: ka dag dbyings rig ngang du badzra mu: dgu pa bsngo smon ni: hoḥ ji snyed phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun thugs rje'i bdag: brtse bas dgongs phyir smin mdzad smon lam tshogs: 'grub ste ci lta'i bdag gi dge tshogs kun: mtha' yas ma gyur byang chub 'thob phyir bsngo: ces bla med yang dag gnyug ma dran rig 'od gsal de kho na thams cad nyid kyi gshis lugs su bzhag: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra ma cig mtsho rgyal gyis: ma 'ongs skal ldan bu la rab dmigs nas: zab lam snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bzhag: 'di ni yang snying kun gyi mthar thug ste: mang du ma spel 'phang ba'i srog ltar bzung : ma 'ongs yang mtha' dus kyi tha ma la: lo tsā sangs rgyas ye shes rnam par 'phrul: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa'i ming can la: chos 'di sprod cig bka' srung dregs sde gsum: bdud rigs dam nyams lag tu ma shor rgya: dpal gyi mchims phur mi nub a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: thim rgya: mi nub rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos dkyil 'khor bsam yas mchims phu nas gdan drangs shing : chu stag lor sbas yul gsang sngags chos gling gi lha sdengs nam mkha' 'brug grags su shog ser las zhal bshus so// // 'di nyid gter gzhung du 'dug kyang dbu mjug sogs bar gyi yig chung rnams ma tshang bar snang bas slad khungs thub gter gzhung rnyed na 'dir bcug tu gsol// // khi) gsang ba ye shes kyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so// // gsang ba ḍākki bdag med rdo rje'i sgra/ /dbyangs can zag med bde ba'i yum la 'dud/ gsang ba ḍākki'i rnal 'byor la 'jug par 'dod na/ sngon du mdun gyi nam mkha' la gsang ba ḍākki'i dkyil 'khor gsal gdab la/

mos gus gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar gdab/ ā/ skye med mkha' dbyings rnam dag pho brang nas/ /dus gsum rgyal kun zag med spyod pa'i yum/ /gsang ba ḍākki dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol/ /rig stong me long shar phyogs dur khrod nas/ /gsang ba ḍākki rdo rje mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol/ /grags stong mnyam nyid lho phyogs dur khrod nas/ /gsang ba ḍākki rin chen mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol/ /dran stong sor rtog nub phyogs dur khrod nas/ /gsang ba ḍākki padma mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol/ /gsal stong bya grub byang phyogs dur khrod nas/ /gsang ba ḍākki karma mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol/ /ma 'gags phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi dur khrod nas/ /yul brgyad ma spangs sna tshogs mkha' 'gro la/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'chi med 'ja' lus stsol/ /sha khrag phud la dgyes zhing dgra la rngam/ /bar chad kun sel chos skyong srung ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so phyi nang bar chad sol/ /gsang ba ḍākki'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gsol 'debs skyabs 'jug bsgrubs pa'i nus rtsal gyis/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad ni/ /'ja' lus mkha' spyod zhing der 'khod par shog / ces pa gsang ba ḍākki'i gsol 'debs 'di yang*/ dkon mchog dam chos kyis bskul ngor/ rlangs smyon gyis sbyar ba'o// // gi) gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa bde chen gsang lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bde chen ye shes gsang ba'i lam/ /ston mdzad ye shes mkha' 'gro la/ /btud nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs/ /bkod la bkas gnongs byin rlabs stsol/ de la gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'ja' lus mkha' spyod sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa las/ thog mar dben pa'i gnas su mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'du bya la mchod gtor sogs ci 'byor bsham/ de nas rang gi mdun du nyer mkho ḍā dril nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad tshang bar byas la/ dang po skyabs sems ni/ skyabs yul gsal gdab pa la/ rang gi snying kha'i 'od zer gyis bskul ba'i rgyal yum ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dza/ na mo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas skyabs yul 'gro ba'i mgon: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: bdag gi dge 'dis ma gyur 'gro kun tshogs: 'ja' lus go 'phang thob par sems bskyed do: gnyis pa yan lag bdun pa ni/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /'dir gshegs padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul/ /sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rang*/ /bla med gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /dge tshogs kun tu bzang po'i rgyur bsngo'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par gyur/ de nas dkar gtor sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor bsang sbyang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bhrūm̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chags bgegs kyi gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo?khaṃ swā hā/ gsum pa bgegs bskrad pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: ma cig yum chen khros ma'i thugs ka nas: bar med khyab par 'gugs pa'i pho nya 'phros: gnod byed bgegs tshogs gtor ma len phyir khug: bdag gi bsgo ba'i bka' la nyan par gyis: mchod sbyin 'di khyer rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'di ru glags blta na: bdag nyid dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro thugs khros nas: skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i mtshon cha thun du brdeg:

me ltar 'bar bas bgegs dpung bsregs gtor gzhom: de bas bgegs tshogs 'byung po phyir dengs shig: om̐ badzra wā ra hī kro ti kā li ha ri ṇi sa hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭaḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni/ hūm̐ bhyo: bdag nyid khros ma rigs lnga'i thugs ka nas: mtshon cha me ri drag po thog ltar 'phros: gnod byed tshar gcod mtshams gcod las grub nas: tshur 'dus mi shigs rdo rje'i gur khang gyur: om̐ badzra dzwa la rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: hūm̐: phyi snod gling bzhi nyi zla bhandha'i snod: nang bcud dbang po rnam lnga sman raka dang : gtor mchod bha ling ga ṇa tshogs kyi rdzas: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol spyan gzigs la sogs pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: ? nas shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū p sparshe āḥhūm̐ om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐: om̐ ru tra ma ra ni ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta ā hūm̐: zhes lan gsum/ drug pa byin dbab cing brda sgo dbye nas dam bca' bzung ba ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: dbying phyug ḍākki ma sring rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bsgrub pa'i gnas 'dir dbang bskur byin chen phob: lta ba klong yangs ye shes 'char sgo phyes: nyon mongs a 'thas srid pa'i sgo bcad nas: dran rig gnyug ma'i yid kyi lha zhal mjal: 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: ma 'grub bar du mi btang srog ltar bsgrub: om̐ badzra a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ oṃ pra be sha ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra tsitta hri da ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ dngos gzhi la dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum 'byung ba rim brtseg ni/ hūm̐: ye nas chos rnams bdag med stong pa'i dbyings: āḥ ma 'gags zang thal rang bzhin rol rtsal spros:

om̐: sna tshogs sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul ngang nyid las: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐ hūm̐ baṃ: de las rlung me chu sa dbang chen gzhi: bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas khang dang sa bon dang : phyag mtshan gnas gyur lha tshogs gtso bor gsal: om̐ swa bhā wa dharma e yam̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: pam̐ padma sūrya a tsand+ra ru tra ti ra baṃ hūm̐ baṃ ha ri ni sa badzra dzñā na hoḥ gnyis pa gzhal yas khang dang lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ e: mthing nag khyab gdal lhun grub rang bzhin la: 'byung lnga rim brtsegs rang byung gzhal yas khang : 'od zer sna lnga sgyu ma ltar shar ba'i: tshad med bzhi ldan gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa: rtsig pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang : drwa phyed mda' yab rin chen pu shu ldan: ka gdung dral lcam 'phan dar sna tshogs 'phyangs: rta babs chos 'khor nyi zla nor bus brgyan: dbus su rang byung rin chen sna lnga'i tog: thog steng rgyan dar phyi rol sgau khyud ldan: rdo rwa pad phreng dur khrod me ris bskor: phyi nang bkod pa yongs rdzogs pho brang gsal: hūm̐: de dbus pad nyi zla gam ti ra'i steng : bam yig dmar ser zangs gri 'bar bas mtshon: gnas 'gyur rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: gsang ba ye shes mkha' spyod yum chen sku: dmar gsal mdangs ldan byi ru'i dbang lhun mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis chags pa'i gar stabs can: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i spyan gsum smin ma 'bar: ral pa'i thor tshugs thod skam rigs lngas mtshan: spyi bor phag zhal mthing nag phem sgra ngur: dar dmar cod pan mkha' la bun bun bskyod: phyag g.yas zangs gri nam mkha'i mthongs la phyar: g.yon pas bhandha kha ṭwāṃ gru mor brten: rin chen snyan rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu 'khrol: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha'i sgra dang ldan: 'khor ba stongs phyir mgo phreng ga shal 'phyangs: gcer mo bha ga nu ma rab tu rgyas: g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum mkha' la gar stabs tshul: ye shes 'bar ba'i me dpung klong du gsal:

gtso mo'i phyogs bzhi pad nyi bam gyi steng : ha ri ni sar bskyed pa'i mkha' 'gro ma: dkar ser dmar ljang bde spyod gar stabs can: gtso ltar 'gying ba'i phyag mtshan rgyan cha 'phyangs: tshad med bzhi ldan bde gshegs dpa' mo'i tshul: snang stong ngang la ma bcos lam gyis gsal: ham̐'u: gzhan yang phyi nang ma sring gnas nyul ma: zhing rdul grangs dang til gang phyes pa ltar: bde spyod bsgrub phyir na bun mkha' lam gang : dgyes pa'i brda gar glu dbyangs dang bcas nas: skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dza phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: mkha' spyod bde chen o rgyan pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ma sring ḍākki 'bum: sgrub la dbang bskur byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir: gsang sngags pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra yo gi ni ā yurdzñā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bzhi pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yum: rigs lnga bde chen lhun grub rang bzhin 'bar: dbyings las ma g.yos rnal 'byor ḍākki tshogs: ti ra nyi zla padma'i gdan la bzhugs: byams gdung bu ltar brtse bar dgongs mdzad phyir: ma cig yum chen tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: phyi mchod sna lnga nang mchod sman raka dang : gtor mchod ga ṇa tshogs kyi lhun po spungs: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol mthun rdzas spyan gzigs tshogs: ma sring mnyes pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di: gsang ba ye shes 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra puṣpe? shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ rū p sparshe pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba a haṃ pañtsa pū dza āḥhūm̐: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi:

de nas bdud rtsi 'bul zhing 'di skad do: om̐ āḥhūm̐: chos sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: longs sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sprul sku ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnubs ston sangs rgyas ye shes zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: ḍākki de ba dha ra'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: rgyal sras dbang chen rdo rje'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: dpal ldan zhing skyong mgon po'i zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: sngags srung e ka dzā ṭi zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: gter srung mchims phu brag btsan zhal du om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ āḥhūm̐: sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub rnams: deng 'dir dbang bskur bdag la stsol: om̐ kā ya siddhi wākka siddhi tsitta siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ baṃ bhyo: chos dbyings lhun grub gsang ba'i dbyings klong nas: thugs rje'i cho 'phrul sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur ma: padma rā ga lhun po'i mdangs 'khyud pa'i: cha shas rab rdzogs gzhon nu gcer mo ldem: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i zhal ras mdangs bzang g.yo: lcang lo 'khyil zhing thor tshugs rab tu mdzes: bhandha skam po'i phreng ba tshal gyis spras: 'jam pa'i le brgan cod pan dbyings la bskyod: sa gsum sngangs mdzad spyi bor phag zhal ngur: rin chen las grub snyan cha zlum la 'khyil: phyag g.yas zangs gris nyon mongs rtsad nas gcod: g.yas pas bhan dmar sgrub la dngos grub gter: kha ṭwāṃ mchan bcug dug gsum zur du 'joms: phyag zhabs gdu bu rin chen las grub 'khrol: mgul rgyan mu tig chun pos spras legs ma: rus pa'i rgyan drug g.yer kha seng seng sgrogs:

drug cu mgo phreng sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem: nu ma bha ga rab rgyas bde ba g.yo: lha tshogs ldan pa'i g.yas brkyang gar ldan 'greng : sgeg pa'i dpa' mor gzhon nu'i cha shas rdzogs: pad nyi bam steng dgyes mdzad dbyangs can ma: sku las mched pa'i ye shes me ri 'bar: sa bcu rnal 'byor sems mdzad dbyings phyug ma: gsang ba ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba'i dbyings phyug dkar gsal dwangs 'dzum ma: rgyas pa'i dpa' mo bzhin bzang 'od ldan ma: dbang gi las mdzad chags pa'i bcud g.yo ma: drag po'i las mdzad rab tu gtum pa mo: las bzhi bdag mo kun kyang gtso mo'i chas: phyag mtshan rgyan ldan gar stabs shigs se shig: khro 'dzum dgyes pa'i mdangs bzang ya la la: g.yo ba rab bzhad brda skad di ri ri: spyod pa'i rnal 'byor 'khrul 'khor sna tshogs bsgyur: zab lam gsang ba'i bde ba kun ster ma: mthong na mi bzod shes rab cha shas rdzogs: byams gdung bu la brtse ba'i ma chen mo: gsang ba'i rig ma phrin las bzhi la bstod: hūm̐: dbyings phyug dpa' mo ma sring tshogs bcas la: gus pas btud de rtse gcig bstod pa'i mthus: 'chi med 'ja' lus tshe yi rig 'dzin stsol:

bdun pa 'dzab bskul ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba dbyings kyi dbang phyug ḍākki'i tshogs: ye shes thugs dam 'dzab kyis rgyud bskul la: zung 'jug bde chen 'ja' lus bsgrub pa'i phyir: ma sring khyed rnams srog ltar bzung lags na: zab lam dpa' mos rtag tu grogs gyis shig: phung khams 'od lus chos sku 'grub pa yi: ma khyod bdag gi dpung gnyen mchis pa'i phyir: bzlas pa sngags kyis thugs dam gnad nas bskul: thog mar gsal snang dang nga rgyal sbrel la sku la sems 'dzin pa dang yid bzlas 'ba' zhig bya/ skabs 'gar 'jam rlung kha sbyor du bzung zhing rlung bzlas sam rdo rje'i bzlas pa la bslab/ de nas skyo tshe ngag bzlas bya ba la/ bsnyen dmigs ni/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i spyi bo ru/ /rigs bdag padma thod phreng gsal/ /rang gi thugs kar pad nyi'i steng*/ /hūm̐ yig pad rag zhun ma'i mdangs/ /tha mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /rtsa khams ba spu'i grong khyer du/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍākki'i tshogs/ /til gyi gang bu lta bur gsal/ /spyi bo'i rigs bdag bla ma la/ /gdung shugs drag po'i gsol btab mod/ /sku las bde stong ye shes kyi/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs spyi bo nas/ /rim zhugs rang srog sngags phreng la/ /phog pas g.yon bskor drag tu 'khor/ /spro bas 'od kyis srid zhi khyab/ /bsdus pas gzi byin lhag par 'bar/ /gtso 'khor ma lus thams cad kun/ /bde chen ye shes nyams 'ur bas/ /rdo rje'i glu dbyangs 'u ru ru/ /dga' bzhi'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig /rtsa khams ba spu tshun chad kun/ /bde dang stong par phri li li/ /dug lnga dbyings su sangs se sang*/ /dbang bzhi rgyun 'bab na ra ra/ /'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li/ /zer dang zer phreng ya la la/ /snang ba sku ru lams se lam/ /sgra grags sngags su di ri ri/ /dran rtog chos skur sangs se sang*/ /ma rig nyon mongs ka nas dag /'ja' lus zang thal chen paus ngang*/

/rtsal snang mkha' 'gro'i dā lar rdzogs/ man ngag gsum ldan gyi dgongs pa las/ rtsa sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni ā yurdzñā na su khaṃ pa shaṃ siddhi dza dzaḥ sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni a yurdzñā na hri da ya siddhi hūm̐: zhes ci nus dang*/ khyad par gyi las sbyor dmigs gnad rnams gud du shes par bya'o/ rlung sgrub sngags dmigs ni/ rang nyid phag mor phyi gsal nang gsal dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i sku dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi/ 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa gsal btab bzhin bum can sbyor ba bzhi ldan du bzung*/ de yang tho rangs rdo rje mkha' 'gro chu rlung dkar po'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bzhin bum can dang bar rlung bzung ba la ci nus su 'bad par bya/ des zhe sdang gi rtog pa 'gag /sku yi yon tan thams cad rgyud la skyes par bsam/ de bzhin du nam langs rin chen mkha' 'gro sa rlung ser po/ nyin phyed sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro nam mkha'i rlung mthing kha/ phyed yol padma mkha' 'gro me rlung dmar po/ srod la karma mkha' 'gro rlung rlung ljang gu'i rang bzhin du gyur nas/ 'ja' 'od zug bzhin du rlung rngub pa dang nar gyis drangs nas lus la bskyil bar bsam/ de ltar byas pas dug lnga'i rtog pa 'gag /sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi yon tan thams cad 'char bar gsungs pa bzhin nyams su blangs/ thun lnga la rlung bum pa can brgya dang bcu yan chag med 'dzin/ ma nus na bar rlung bzung zhing rlung sems dbang sdud kyi sngags 'di bzhin bzlas/ om̐ badzra wā ra hī aṣṭa pa shaṃ ma ma siddhi hūm̐: nor sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni puṇye ratna pa shaṃ thun thun: dbang sdud sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni lo ka dzñā na sarba rā ga pa shaṃ thun thun dzaḥ phrin las kun sgrub sngags ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni sarba karma sa dha na ye swā hā:

zhes pa'i gong 'og gi sngags rnams rang mos bzhin khol phyung du bsgrub kyang chog: 'bum phrag gcig gis 'grub rtags 'byung : 'on kyang rgyun du nyams len bgyis na lus ma bor bar mkha' spyod gshegs te 'ja' lus 'grub par 'gyur ro: zhes gsungs so/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying stong tshig brjod/ de nas 'dod don gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen g.yo ba mchog gi mdzes 'phro ma: gsang gsum rab dga' cha shas sngo sangs ma: gang gus gdung bas nā da rab tu g.yo: mthong na mi mthun spang ba'i ga na mdzod: 'dzan po kun kyang yid kyu'i rab dkar bsu: chu gter rlabs su 'dar ma'i phreng ba yi: ka ti ka yi 'khor lo rab bskul ba: rā sa me yi brdas bskul sgra skad kyis: rtsi bcud myong ba'i ro mchog ci bzhin du: zag med lha mo khyod kyi phrin las mdzod: cha shas 'dab brgya'i utpal dri bsung gis: g.yo la rtag tu kun snang ngoms med bzhin: yid bzhin dpa' mo khyod kyis bsu bar mdzod: om̐ ha ri ni sa siddhi pha la hūm̐: zhes pas dbang bzhi blang*/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ tshogs mchod rgyas pa gzhung gi mu tig rtsal phreng ltar bya bar 'os kyang*/ bsnyen sgrub dus bzhi sogs la 'jug pa bde phyir gter chen nyid kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes ltar bstan pa la bcu gcig las/ dang po tshogs kyi byin rlabs ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: tshogs 'khor sbyang phyir sku gsum yig 'bru 'phros: mchod rdzas la phog byin brlabs bcud mchog spel: ma sring mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ gnyis pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: 'og min mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes rdo rje rnal 'byor ma: phag mo rigs bzhi ma sring bye ba 'bum: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol:

gzhan yang phyi nang skyong ba'i las byed tshogs: bka' srung gter bdag mchod 'os mgron gyur rnams: zhal zas tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob mchod rdzas bcud mchog spel: 'dir tshogs skal ldan sgrub la mchog thun stsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya āḥ gsum pa mchod bskang bshags pa ni/ hūm̐: dbyings phyug gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : bka' gter skyong ba'i srung ma 'khor bcas la: 'dod yon zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: dgyes par bzhes nas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: mchog thun dngos grub myur ba nyid thob ste: nyams chag bshags shing mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi khā hi: bzhi pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid drag mo phag gdong gsal ba'i mdun: shor med lcags khang nang du nṛ tri las: dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum lta bur gsal: bden stobs ni/ na moḥ mchog gsum rtsa ba phyag rgya ting 'dzin sngags: gsang ba ḍākki mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: bka' srung gter bdag srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bden pa chen po'i mthu stobs nus pa yis: sangs rgyas bstan dgra rnal 'byor sgos dgra rnams: rkyen ngan bar chod glo bur bgegs kyi tshogs: dgra gzugs tha ma'i liṅga 'di la khug: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dza dzaḥ dgra bgegs nṛ tri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ bsgral ba ni/ hūm̐: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dgra bo sgrol ba'i mtshon: rdo rjes mtshan pa zangs gri thog ltar 'bebs: byad ma gnod byed mgo lus dum bur gtub: phye mar brlag cing sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra ta ma ka ra ti ka ya gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad nṛ tri rbad rbad: bstab pa ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba'i dbyings phyug dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: ma rungs dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: dgyes par bzhes shig bdud bzhi'i tshogs bcom nas:

sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi bar mdzod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: lnga pa lhag ma bsngo ba ni/ hūm̐: gnas nyul dus bdag phra men ma: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba yi: 'bar ma pho nya'i tshogs rnams la: lhag ma bka' yi pha 'bab 'bul: bstan srung mel tshe 'grub par mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: drug pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: mthing nag e yi pho brang nas: dbyings phyug ḍākki'i skur bzhengs la: mthu rtsal stobs kyi thugs dam bskul: las bzhi kun 'grub phrin las bcol: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bdag cag byang chub mchog thob ste: 'ja' lus mkha' spyod 'grub par mdzod: ces tshogs gtor 'bul/ bdun pa chad mdo bsgrag pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i dus: snying thig sbas dang bton pa'i tshe: khas blangs bzhin du gtor ma bzhes: yang zab bya ra 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi: brgyad pa brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐: bod skyong ma sring bcu gnyis kyis: mthun rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la: yul srungs lo legs bkra shis spel: dus 'khrugs nad yams zhi bar mdzod: om̐ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le ti ma ma khā hi: dgu pa rta bro brdung ba ni/ hūm̐: mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i bro ra ru: ma sring 'dus pa'i bro brdungs pas: phyi nang bar chod thal bar rlog: las bzhi lhun grub chen por gyur: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: bgegs srin dam sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: bcu pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐: zab yangs bde chen 'khor lo'i pho brang nas: gsang ba ye shes ḍākki rgya mtsho'i tshogs: thugs dam rgyud bskul mchog thun kun stsol nas: dbang bzhi ye shes thob par mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra yo gi ni kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: gu ṇa siddhi hrīḥ gu ya sarba siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:

rjes chog la drug /dang po gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ? sogs kyis mchod la/ hūm̐: skye med rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las: skye ba'i cho 'phrul ci yang ston mdzad pa: 'gro ba kun skyob ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dug gsum 'joms mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod/ gnyis pa bzod gsol ni/ om̐: ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : cho ga lhag chad 'gal zhing 'khrul: bskyed rdzogs phyi nang nor ba dang : rmongs shing bag med ci mchis pa: ma sring tshogs la bzod par gsol: om̐ ḍākki sa twa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: sogs? ḍākki'i yig brgya brjod cing bzlas/ brtan bzhugs spyi ltar bya/ gsum pa dkyil 'khor bsdu ldang ni/ hoḥ snang srid thams cad mkha' 'gro'i zh-ing : rang lus 'byung ba gdos bcas bral: sgra rnams brag cha'i gdangs bzhin snang : 'gyu ba dran rig ka dag ngang : a a āḥ rol rtsal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: gsal stong 'dzin med lam du shar: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bzhi pa bsngo ba ni/ hoḥ bsngo bya yul dang bral ba sangs rgyas yin: bsngo byed mkhan po stong pa rang sar grol: bsngo yul gdod nas mi dmigs a la la: lnga pa smon lam ni/ hoḥ ma gyur thams cad gzhi dag chos kyi sku/ /ma bsgoms ma bcos ye nas rang sangs rgyas/ /'on kyang de don ma rtogs 'khrul pa'i 'gro/ /kun kyang yum chen go 'phang thob par shog / ces dmigs med bde ba chen por 'khor gsum yongs dag dbyings rig zung 'jug la mnyam par bzhag go /drug pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin ma: nam mkha'i lus can rdo rje ḍākki'i gtso: dbyings phyug dpal 'bar 'dod rgu mchog sbyin mo: ma sring ḍākki'i tshogs kyis bkra shis shog: me tog gi char dbab c-ing shis pa brjod/ dge rtsa bsngo zhing smon lam gdab pa ni/ ji ltar lha mo khyed nyid dang*/ /bdag nyid rab tu mnyam sbyar phyir/

/'di nas 'jig rten 'og tu yang*/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi gzugs can du/ /bdag nyid 'byung zhing 'gyur bar shog /bde zhing bde ba bsten pa dang*/ /bde ba chen por bdag 'gyur shog /'chi tshe dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /me tog phreng dang rgyal mtshan gdugs thogs shing*/ /glu gar rol mo'i sprin gyis mdun bsus te/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i grong du khrid par shog /snang cha bde chen gar dbang he ru ka /stong cha rnam kun mchog ldan phag mo yum/ /zung 'jug dbyer mi phyed pa'i bden pa des/ /don gnyis 'dod pa yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog / ces o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter lus med mkha' 'gro'i chos bzhi'i nang tshan gsang ba ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bklag chog tu bkod pa bde chen gsang lam zhes bya ba 'di'ang lam 'dir mos pa mi phyed pa'i blo gros can rang slob o rgyan gsang sngags 'gro 'dul gyis gsang sngags phur pa gling gis lo gsum sgrub sde'i nyams bzhes bya sla ba'i ched du chog khrigs dgos zhes bkas bskul ltar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i nye ba'i tshandho ha bal yul yang le shod e waṃ sgrub sde zung ldan du phyogs nyul gyi dā ri dra mant+ra gu hya shā sa dhā ra 'bod pas gter gzhung rtsa ba sor bzhag gi kha 'gengs dgos pa rnams rang gzhung khros ma'i chog khrigs ye shes sgo 'byed sogs rigs mthun gzhan las blangs te rab byung bcu bdun chu mo lug gi lor cho 'phrul zla ba'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i nyin grub par bgyis pa la nyes 'gal mchis na ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol zhing dge bas rang rig ye shes mkha' 'gro'i rang zhal dngos su mjal ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ // ngi) changs bu brgya rtsa/ 'bri rgyu/ ci) mu khri'i gnas sgo 'byed pa'i tshe 'tshub lhong byung skabs rtsa gsum gling pas thol byung du gsungs pa'i gcod dmigs ni/

phaṭḥ gnas mi mngon nam mkha'i dbyings rum nas/ /pha padma 'byung nas byin rlabs can/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus/ /lus 'dus byas phung po tshogs su bzhes/ /rkyen ro snyom lam du lhongs bar shog phaṭḥ gnas rten 'brel bden tshig pho brang nas/ /ma ye shes mtsho rgyal byin rlabs can/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus/ /lus 'dus byas phung po tshogs su rol/ /rkyen ro snyom lam du lhongs bar shog /phaṭḥ gnas 'gro 'dul phrin las kyi pho brang nas/ /pha sangs rgyas ye shes byin rlabs can: bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus/ /lus 'dus byas phung po'i tshogs su rol/ /rkyen ro snyoms lam du lhong bar shog: phaṭḥ gnas rang rig sku gsum gyi pho brang nas/ /pha rtsa brgyud bla ma byin rlabs can/ /bdag gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs/ /bka' snang srid lha 'dre dbang du sdus/ /lus 'dus byas phung po'i tshogs su rol/ /rkyen ro snyoms lam du lhong bar shog /phaṭḥ gzugs can gyi dgra phaṭḥ gzugs med kyi bgegs phaṭḥ snang srid kyi cho 'phrul phaṭ/ /nga bdag gi 'gong po phaṭ/ /re dogs kyi 'dzin pa phaṭ/ /gcig chod de thog tu phaṭ/

ces gsungs te rkang dung lan gsum btang bas 'tshubs lhong rang yal du song*/ zhal gsung rnam thar nas khol du phyung ba'o// // chi) thog mar gcod kyi gdams pa zhal shes ming mtshon tsam la/ thog mar gsang ba ye shes ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ srung 'khor/ de nas gsol 'debs byin 'bebs/ de nas gzhung bsrang bsnyen sgrub arghaṃ sogs kyis bstod/ de nas tshogs bshams bka' srung zangs btsan dang*/ chos skyong gang 'os bya/ zangs btsan mngon rtogs bskang ba'i gong nas/ bstod pa la 'jug nas bskul ba mtshams bar tshogs byin rlabs bskang tshogs dang gsang ba ye shes gnyis med spyi mtshams byin rlabs dang byin rlabs/ spyan 'dren dang spyan 'dren shes par bya/ mkha' 'gro 'bum bskang btsan gyi bskang ba nas ci 'tshams/ gcod tshogs kyi bstab pa nas rim bzhin bya/ ༈ de nas sbyin sreg 'jug pa la/ bsang sbyang*/ me sbar rlung g.yab me mgo mnan/ me mtshams bcad/ me lha spyan drangs/ mchod pa'i mtshams nas gzhung gi mchod rdzas cha gcig 'bul/ rtsa sngags/ agne dang om̐ haṃ kā laṃ pa sogs dang phrin las bzhi bcol/ me lha'i bstod pa bya/ de nas phrin las gzhung bsrang ba ni/ sbyin sreg gzhung gi bskyed chog zin nas lha bskyed dang*/ gsang ba ye shes mngon rtogs nas mchod pa'i mtshams/ me lha spyan drangs/ mchod 'grigs sngar ltar ro/ rtsa sngags/ om̐ badzra yo gi ni dang*/ om̐ haṃ kā laṃ pa sogs dang*/ las bzhi'i sham bu dang gsang ba ye shes nas bstod pa bya/ tshogs lhag btang*/ bskul gtor gyi rigs bshams de nas gsang ba ye shes bskul gtor 'bul lo/ mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul/ btsan bskul/ mkha' 'gro spyi bskul/ de nas tshogs lhag phran bu dang sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams 'bul/ me lha'i gtor ma 'bul/ me zhags la spro na bya/ rdzas gzhi sbyin sreg nas bsdu/ gong gi gsang ba ye shes nas bsdu/ bskang tshogs nas smon lam gyi rgyas gdab bo//

// ji) gcod kyi sa 'bebs grangs don bsdus pa bzhugs so/ ma cig lab kyi sgrol ma'i sku la 'dud/ mi la na tsha mang ba gshin dur thon dus sa 'bebs byed sa sa mig btsal nas/ dang po dkar 'gyed dmar 'gyed dmigs pa bya de nas mda' dar g.yas dang 'jor ba g.yon/ dar ras srog mthun pa'i skad dar brgyab cing*/ lho phyogs la kha gyu nas 'don sgom sbrags/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ rang nyid skad cig gis khros ma nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs shing skra grol ba dur khrod chas brgyad dang ldan pa'i thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i sa 'og spyod pa'i lha gser gyi mdangs dang ldan pa gcig 'phros/ sa 'og tu spyod pa'i 'dir gnas pa rnams gom pa dgu yi sar dgyes par 'god/ 'og rgya mtsho'i kha nas klu'i nor bu bsam 'grub rgya mtsho'i 'od yar thim par gyur/ rkang pa g.yon pas sa mig nas mnan/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ rang nyid khros ma'i sku smad gser gyi phur pa la ye shes lnga yi 'od 'bar ba gcig tu gyur/ sa mig 'di la sgab 'dre byed pa'i sa srin gnod byed sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs can de la bdag dang yon bdag gi nad gdon bar chad thams cad thim par gyur/ sku smad phur pa'i dbal gyi 'od zer nas dug lnga ye shes me yi 'od kyis bsregs/ phur gsham nas rlung bus pas 'byung bzhi brtsegs pa'i 'og tu btags/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ rang bzhin mkha' 'gro ma rigs lnga gtso 'khor rim par bsdus shar nas g.yas bskor byas/ kyai ma/ shar rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /dkar mo dung gi thor tshugs can/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor du dkar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ /shar phyogs sa g.yang dngos grub rnams/ /'od dkar po'i rnam par bcud bsdus la/ /sa gzhi 'di la thim par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyai/ ma lho rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/

/ser mo gser gyi thor tshugs can/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor du ser mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ /lho phyogs sa g.yang dngos grub rnams/ /'od ser po'i rnam par bcud bsdus la/ /sa gzhi 'di la thim par mdzod/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyai/ ma nub padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /dmar mo byi ru'i thor tshugs can/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor du dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ /nub phyogs sa g.yang dngos grub rnams/ /'od dmar po'i rnam par bcud bsdus la/ /sa gzhi 'di la thim par mdzod/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyai/ ma byang las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /ljang mo g.yu yi thor tshugs can/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor du ljang mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ /byang phyogs sa g.yang dngos grub rnams/ /'od ljang gu'i rnam par bcud bsdus la/ /sa gzhi 'di la thim par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ kyai/ ma dbus sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ /sngon mo mu men thor tshugs can/ /dar dang rin chen rus pa'i rgyan gyis spras/ /'khor du sngon mo 'bum gyis bskor/ /ma mkha' 'gro'i mthu dang byin rlabs kyis/ /dbus phyogs sa g.yang dngos grub rnams/ /'od sna tshogs rnam par bcud bsdus la/ /sa gzhi 'di la thim par gyur/ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ sa 'di gser gyi phung po 'od 'bar ba zhig tu gyur phaṭ phaṭ phaṭḥ dmigs pa ni rang gi rkang pa g.yon 'og mthil nas sa bcud 'byung ba lnga'i snying po 'od lnga mdangs ldan du drangs nas spyi bo man chad gang*/ tshe bsod nams rgyas shing 'chi med lus thob par bsam/ zan gyi rus sbal gzugs dang sa bcas rnams yon bdag gis bzung kha shar du gyu la 'phang ngo*/ lnga'am gsum/ kyai/ ma hā gser gyi rus sbal 'di/

/srid pa mnyes pa'i zhal ngo de/ /shar du bstan pas bar chad zhi/ /lho ru bstan pas bsod nams rgyas/ /nub kyi gshin lam ma ldang zhig /byang gi dgra lam ma gdon cig /shar lho mtshams su dga' dge'o/ om̐ ma hā gser gyi rus sbal bhrūm̐ rakṣa swā hā/ zhes 'phang gyu phyogs yag na mi bsgul/ ngan na lnga'am gsum 'phen/ lho ru kha gyu na bzhag /rin chen sna lnga 'bru sna steng du blugs/ kyai/ ma hā gser gyi rus sbal 'di/ /dbang chen sa yi bdag po yin/ /mgon byed skyob byed lo lha yin/ /sa 'di gdan du bting ba yin/ /steng gi gza' skar ma 'khrug cig /'og gi 'byung bzhi ma 'khrug cig /bar gyi sde brgyad ma 'khrug cig /lha klu gzhi bdag ma 'khrug cig /kun gyi srung du 'gyur bar shog / ces brjod pas mda' dar g.yab/ /sa bcas sa mkhan rang gis khyer/ /chas ka la sogs log na sbyin/ /de nyid dkar gsum bzhag pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor la sogs dgos na 'di dus sa rko thabs lto 'phye dang bstan pa'i phyogs kyang 'dzoms/ dred dang phyi ba'i sbar mos drud/ de nas skag le rgyag dus sbal pa sogs 'dzoms na legs/ gzhan yang snang brgyad dang nyes pa kun sel sogs/ spyi mthun bzhin thon na legs/ de ro dur gcod byed dus dgos pa yin kyang sngags gcod zung 'jug ces bya lags/ 7 karma rā ga a syas mdzad/ /dgong mo thun mtshams mar me'i ngogs/ /brtson 'grus rgya mtshos yi ger bkod/ /nyes 'gal mchis na gcod yul brgyud la bshags/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // nyi) man ngag bya 'bod byed tshul ni: ro yi sngas mgor rdo rje rgya gram bzhag: ro yi phyogs bzhir rdo leb la sol bas bris la bzhag: rtsam pa dang mar bsres la me gsur bya: sngags ni: om̐ ha psa psa tri pu ra bug pa hūm̐ phaṭ: zur phud lnga sogs dri za dang : phung po bdag 'dzin byed pa rnams: dri gsur 'di yis tshims gyur nas: bde dang thar pa thob par shog:

ces lan gsum: de nas bye ma la sngags 'di mang bar btab la ro thog tu gtor: om̐ pa ri sha ma sha ma pa ri swā hā: zhes dang sngags 'di phye mar phur la sngags la btab gtor: ti) nges don gcod kyi kyi rnam bzhag yum gyi dgongs don ni/ 'bri rgyu/ thi) rje btsun 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs 'chi med gter bum zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs dus rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /tshe dbang bcud sbyin 'phags ma'i zhabs pad la/ /mi phyed gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs gsol na/ /'di bzung tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin stsol/ /'phying bar bang so'i gsang gter bcud/ /jo mo'i nang sgrub zab pa'i phul/ /lha dang bla ma dbyer med pa'i/ /rjes gnang ji bzhin nyung gsal bkod/ skyid grong rig 'dzin chen po thugs mchog rdo rje'i zab gter las byon pa'i mtsho rgyal nang sgrub 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i smin grol gdams pa'i snying po dril ba 'di la gnyis/ sgrub pa'i thabs dang*/ slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'o/ dang po la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa'o/ dang po ni/ gtsang zhing dge ba'i gnas su stegs bu khebs ldan gyi steng dkyil 'khor padma 'dab bzhi phyogs mdog can nam 'bru dkar gyi tshom bu gtso bo gcig la 'khor nyer gcig bkod pa'i khar mañdzu'i steng du bum pa gang chu dang nyer lnga rdzas kyis btams pa mgul chings dkar po can bzhag /de'i steng bhandha a mṛ tas gang ba dar dmar gyis bkab pa'i steng me long dri med shel rdo bkod/ g.yas su tshe ril/ g.yon du mda' dar/ rgyab tu tshe chang*/ mdun du sman raka gtor gsum/ zhi mchod g.yas skor/ byang shar du las bum/ tshogs gtor sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams kyang tshogs par bya'o/ de nas thog mar khrus dkar bgegs mtshams gcod spyi 'gro ltar bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

na mo: rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su: snang ba mtha' yas tsaṇḍa li: las kyi dbang mo nā gardzu: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dang : bla ma rje btsun 'phags ma la: bdag sogs gus pas skyabs su mchi: 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor gzhom du gsol: lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ na mo: bdag gis 'phags ma khyod sgrub pas: tshogs gnyis yongs su smin nas kyang : bde gshegs mdzad pa bdag gis bsgrub: pha rol phyin drug la gnas pa'i: 'gro kun mchog tu 'god par bgyi: lan gsum/ tshogs bsags pa ni/ hoḥ 'phags ma dkon mchog 'khor bcas la: rab tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: las dang nyon mongs ci mchis bshags: 'gro don mdzad la rjes yi rang : chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge ba bsod nams ci bsags pa: 'gro kun yongs la bsngo bar bgyi: mchod pa byin brlab ni/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bhrūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs su: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥdang ni: a las thod par om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhu ba las byung nyer spyod dang : 'dod yon sman raka gtor ma sogs: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni: zad med nam mkha' gang bar gyur: nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis brlab bo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ dang po bdag mdun dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: bdag gzhan snod bcud mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : steng 'og phyogs kun rig 'dzin 'bar ba'i dal: 'od zer lnga ldan kun nas rab 'khrugs pa: mi shigs sra brtan gser 'khor rtsibs stong ldan: pad dkar zla steng tāṃ yig dkar ser ni: ring cha tsheg drag can las lnga ldan gyis: 'od zer 'phro 'du yid bzhin 'phags ma'i sku: dkar gsal gser 'od zhi 'dzum spyan gsum ldan: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas mchog sbyin rgya: g.yon pa utpal dkar po'i yu ba nyid:

mtheb srin gyis 'dzin snyan g.yon me tog rgyas: phyag zhabs mthil du zhi ba'i spyan res mtshan: zhabs gnyis phyed skyil bcu drug lang tsho can: dbu skra mthon mthing ser 'bol spyi bor bcing : zar bu 'phyang zhing dar sngon cod pan 'phur: dar dkar stod g.yogs dar dmar smad dkris klub: dbu rgyan snyan rgyan phyag gdub zhabs gdub dang : do shal dpung rgyan se mo do la sogs: rin chen rgyan mdzes 'od sku drwa ba'i gzugs: 'ja' zer 'od lnga 'phro ba'i klong na 'gying : tsitta pad dmar 'dab brgyad kha zum pa'i: nang du gser 'khor rtsibs brgyad dbus dang ni: rtsibs steng zla dkyil tāṃ yig sngags 'bru re: rang sgra dang bcas g.yas su 'khor bar gyur: om̐ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā: tāṃ yig las 'phros 'od kyis mdun gyi dal: pad dkar 'dab stong zla dkyil tāṃ yig las: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe sbyin lha mo ni: rab dkar zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi 'dzum zhal: phyag g.yas mchod sbyin utpal dmar po'i steng : dus gsum sangs rgyas ye shes 'od phung 'bar: g.yon pas mnyam bzhag tshe bum bcud kyis gtams: rdo rje skyil krung zhi ba'i spyan bdun ldan: longs spyod rdzogs sku dar dang rin chen mdzes: dbu gtsug mgon po 'od dpag med pas mtshan: gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi byin 'od du 'bar: 'khor yugs 'dab stong 'phags ma nyer gcig la: sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dpa' bo dang : 'byung lnga'i bcud 'dzin tshe lha rig 'dzin sogs: til gang phyur ltar thugs rjes rol par gsal: thugs rje kun sgrol thugs kar rtsibs brgyad la: zla steng tāṃ yig sngags phreng g.yas su 'khor: gnas gsum zla ba padma nyi zla la: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gsal de las 'od 'phros pas: mdun bskyed rgyud bskul thugs rje'i 'od zer gyi: rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing kun rab tu g.yos: dwangs ma'i gzi 'bar sangs rgyas byang sems tshogs:

'phags ma thugs rjes kun sgrol skur bzhengs nas: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang kun gang ste: bdag mdun gnyis la thim pas dbang rdzogs gyur: gnyis pa ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ om̐: chos dbyings skye ba med pa las: thugs rjes smon lam las sprul pa'i: 'phags ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas rnams: dad pas bdag gis spyan 'dren na: brtse bas dgongs te gshegs su gsol: sgrub pa'i skal ldan bdag cag la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ ārya tā re badzra sa mā ya dzaḥ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ āḥ pho brang gzhal las 'od du 'bar: padma ge sar zla ba'i steng : bcom ldan 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams kun: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: ārya tā re sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum: 'gro drug bu bzhin skyong ba'i ma: rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo: lha mo thugs rje'i ngang can ma: brtse gdung mkhyen stobs nus par ldan: yid bzhin ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa: mi mthun phyogs rnams kun skyobs ma: skyabs chen ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ārya ta re a ti pū hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ lnga pa mchod pa 'bul ba phyi mchod ni/ hūm̐: dri med dag pa bdud rtsi'i chu: yan lag brgyad ldan dge ba'i rdzas: zhabs bsil dang ni mchod yon sogs: 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ ārya tā re arghaṃ pra tītstsha ye swā hā:

de bzhin pā dyaṃ dang mañdza ma nam sbyangs pas mchod/ spro na maṇḍal gang rung lan gsum sogs 'bul/ hūm̐: stong gsum 'jig rten phyogs dus thams cad du: 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa'i bye brag ni: dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul te: rgyal yum 'phags ma'i tshogs la 'bul bar bgyi: 'gro kun tshogs gnyis yongs su smin par shog: om̐ āḥhūm̐ tā rā dhe ba ḍākki nī badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhai nai wi dye shabda hūm̐: nang mchod ni: hūm̐: srid par gtogs pa'i 'jig rten rab 'byams na: gzugs sgra dri ro reg chos ji snyed pa: rdo rje 'dod ma'i tshogs su mngon sprul nas: 'dod yon mchod pa dbang po rnams la 'bul: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: ye shes dbang po drug gi dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe dharma mu dra pra tītstsha ham̐'u: gsang mchod ni: sku lnga rigs 'dus rje btsun 'phags ma la: dug lnga ngo bo rnam par dag pa yi: ye shes lnga yi bde ba'i mchod pa 'bul: kun tu bde ba'i mchod pas mnyes gyur cig: om̐ tā rā dzñā na sarba pū dza sa ma ye swā hā: sman raka gtor mchod ni/ hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi 'di: slob dpon gnyan dang yi dam lha: 'phags ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dam can gter bdag rnams la mchod: dgyes par dgongs la dngos grub stsol: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi: zhes mchod/ kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐: zhes dngos grub blangs/ hūm̐: thabs shes rten 'brel rgyu las byung ba yi: bde mchog bde spyod rakta'i mchod pa 'bul: 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bdag 'dzin 'khor ba stongs par mdzad du gsol: tā rā dhe ba ḍākki nī ma hā rakta pū dza ye hūm̐: hūm̐: bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni: ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro:

'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi phung por gsal: dpag tu med pa'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis: rje btsun 'phags ma'i tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig: tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa'i dbang thob shog: om̐ tā rā dhe ba ḍākki nī a mṛ ta ma hā bha lingta ta pū dza kha kha khā hi khā hi: drug pa bstod pa ni/ āḥ dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum: 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum: yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma: lha mo khyod la rtag tu 'dud: 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma: tutta ra yis 'jigs brgyad sgrol: tu re'i nad rnams kun las skyobs: sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag ni deng nas byang chub bar: sku gsung thugs kyi rjes bzung nas: tshe dpal ye shes rgyas pa dang : bar chad bdud las rgyal bar mdzod: bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba ni/ thugs srog mtha' mar snying po 'bru brgyad pa: g.yas su 'khor bas lnga ldan 'od zer 'phros: mdun bskyed lha mo'i rgyud bskul sngags phreng bskor: de las 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros: sangs rgyas byang sems rig 'dzin 'jig rten gyi: zhing kun g.yos shing tshe bcud dwangs ma ni: a nṛ dza yi rnam pas stong khams kun: nyi zla'i 'od 'bar them mer gang ba rnams: mdun bskyed la thim stobs dang gzi byin 'bar: sangs rgyas zhing khams ma lus gcig tu rdzogs: mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od stong phyogs bcur 'phro: thugs kyi bdud rtsi lnga ldan 'od zer rgyun: bar mi chad par bdag nyid thugs kar thim: nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chod kun zhi zhing : gzi brjid 'od 'bar 'khor 'das stobs bcu rdzogs: snang srid brtan g.yo kun la dbang bsgyur bas: bskal bzang stong gi bstan pa ma rdzogs bar: tshe gcig bya ba byed pa'i yon tan ldan: thugs rjes stobs kyis bden pa 'grub gyur cig: om̐ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzlas bsnyen sgrub sogs kyi skabs dzap dmigs zhib cha ni gter chen nyid kyis mdzad pa las shes par bya'o/

brgyad pa tshe 'gugs ni/ mda' dar g.yab la/ hūm̐: 'og min zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dbyings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ā yu siddhi āḥ snang srid rnam dag pho brang nas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam thugs rje'i dby-ings nas bzhengs: 'khor 'das kun nas tshe khug la: sgrub mchog tshe yi dngos grub stsol: om̐ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma a yurdzñā na puṇye puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: rtsa sngags brjod/ rtsa gsum tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: 'ja' dang 'od du me re re: sku dang tshom bur shigs se shig: bkrag dang gzi mdangs ya la la: byin rlabs char rgyun si li li: sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi me re re: ma rig rtogs pa sangs se sang : gzugs phung 'od du ya la la: bdag nyid rdo rje'i sku thob nas: 'gyur med dbyings su rgyas thob cig: om̐ tā re sogs brjod/ dgu pa thun mtshams kyi bya ba ni/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus 'bul/ nongs bshags ni/ hūm̐: thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul rje btsun 'phags ma'i sku: rgyal kun bskyed yum yid bzhin rnal 'byor ma: mi phyed gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol 'debs na: ma gdung bu bzhin brtse ba'i thugs rjes gzigs: bdag ni bla med theg chen sgor zhugs nas: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams chag rnams: gnong 'gyod drag pos 'phags ma'i spyan sngar bshags: nyes ltung sgrib tshogs byang zhing dag pa dang : tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ zhes dang yig brgya brjod/ bcu pa mdun bskyed brtan bzhugs ni: hūm̐: chos kyi dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang : mkhyen brtse thugs rje'i rol pa phyag rgya sngags: lhag med rtag tu gsal mdzad brtan par bzhugs: bde legs yid bzhin 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog:

om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: zhes brjod pas me tog 'thor ro/ gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ dang po tshogs mchod ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i tshogs rdzas bsang chus bran la byin brlab ni/ hūm̐: bdag nyid lha yi thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros me rlung chus: rnam rtog bag chags bsregs gtor bkrus: om̐ āḥhūm̐ 'phros bdud rtsi zhu: 'dod yon nam mkha' mnyam par spel: om̐ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: bde chen dbyings phyug gsang ba bha ga'i klong : rnam dag dam tshig gsum gyi sgo 'byed ma: a ma mtsho rgyal thugs rje khros ma'i sku: lā sye dkar mo 'phags ma tshe yi dpal: dbyer med ngo bo nyid sku bcom ldan ma: kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje'i spyan mnga' ba: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor du: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: dug lnga rnam dag ye shes lnga yi bcud: zhal zas bdud rtsi'i tshogs mchod dam pa 'di: zhal du bstab bo rol gcig kha raṃ khā hi: thugs dam bskangs la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi: bshags pa ni/ hoḥ dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: bdag cag bla med snying po'i sgor zhugs nas: nongs par spyad pa'i nyes pa ci mchis pa: kun nas yangs pa chos dbyings bha ga'i klong : 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyis bskangs shing bshags: g.yar dam sor chud mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ces dang yig brgya brjod/ tshogs la rol pa'i mthar lhag ma byin brlabs la/ hūm̐: dbang phyug dpal gyi bka' nyan rnams: bka' yi gtor ma 'di longs la: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las sgrubs: pha ma rigs drug sems can dang : lan chags bgegs rigs thams cad la: bka' yi pham phab 'di bsngos pas: zad med bdud rtsi longs spyod shog: ces bsngo/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ om̐: ye shes lha tshogs dgyes pa'i 'od rab 'byin: 'byung lnga dbang sdud mchog gi bde stong ma:

yid bzhin tshe 'phel kun skyob lha mo dgongs: sgrub mchog bu la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dpal bcu'i dbang thob las bzhi'i grub chen brgyad: ma lus deng 'dir thogs med mthu stobs kyis: 'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las rab sgrol zhing : tshe gcig 'ja' lus chos sku mngon gyur stsol: rtsa sngags kyi sham bur/ ma ma kā ya wākka tsitta sa ma ya a dhiṣṭha na a be sha ya a āḥ zhes brjod bdud rtsi sogs dngos grub kyi rdzas la longs spyod do/ de nas mchod bstod mdor bsdus dang nongs bshags gong smos ltar bya/ tshogs zhing sogs rten la brtan bzhugs bya zhing bsdu rim ni/ hūm̐: chos rnams gzhi med rtsa ba bral: rig stong ye shes snying po can: spro dang bsdu bar mi dmigs kyang : kun rtog sbyang phyir dbyings su muḥ zhes lta ba rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la: gnas sh-ing thun mtshams khyer so lam du slong : smon lam ni/ hūm̐: de bzhin dbyings kyi klong chen ma: bla med dkyil 'khor dbang bzhi 'dzin ma'i mthus: rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i mthu stobs yongs rdzogs te: 'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog: shis brjod ni/ rang byung dpal gyi lha lam rdo rje'i sku: thugs rje thogs pa med pa'i byin rlabs mthus: dus gsum rgyal ba'i tshe dpal rdo rje'i srog: skal ldan bdag la rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: zhes me tog gi char du bsnyil zhing dge bsngo spyi ltar bya/ dbang bskur gyi rim pa ni gnam lcags dbang chog phyogs bsgrigs ye shes rgya mtsho bskyil ba'i klung chen du bzhugs pa lags so/ 'phags ma'i thugs rje zla ba'i 'dzum zer gyis/ /sdig dang 'chi bdag mun pa mthar bskrad do/ /ring 'tsho'i chu gter rdo rje'i srog spel nas/ /bstan 'gro phan bdes yun du skyong gyur cig /ces pa'ang bla ma dang lha gnyis su med pas rjes su gnang ba stsal ba ltar khyer bde'i yan lag tu 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas dben khrod kun bzang bde gling du bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//

di) sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo las/ tshe sgrub gsol 'debs zhes bya bzhugs/ hrīḥ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su/ /chos sku tshe bdag snang ba mtha' yas la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /gru 'dzin ri bo tā la'i zhing khams nas/ /longs sku tshe bdag spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /lho nub padma 'od kyi zhing khams nas/ /sprul sku tshe bdag padma 'byung gnas la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /po ṭā la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /tshe 'dzin sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /spyi gtsug pad zla 'ja' 'od gur khang nas/ /rig 'dzin chen po mi 'jigs rdo rje la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /mi 'da' dam tshig gnyan gyi pho brang nas/ /bstan srung ḍākki tshe ring mched lnga la/ /mos gus gdung bas gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs/ /mi shigs rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ tā re tu re tuttā re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ? ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes mi 'jigs rdo rjes sbyar ba'o/ sa phyogs bkra shis dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/ // ni) yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshe yi sgrub pa bzhugs// // rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum la 'dud/ sa ma ya/ phyi ltar dbyings kyi yum chen te/ /nang ltar rdo rje phag mo 'phros/ /gsang ba spyan chab las su 'khrungs/ /'gro kun 'jigs pa skyob byed ma/ /gang zhig sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la/ /'jigs brgyad dus min skye 'chi bral/ /'chi med rdo rje'i go 'phang 'grub/ /nam zhig sgyu lus bor ma thag

/bde chen dag pa'i zhing khams su/ /ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon 'gyur/ /de phyir yid bzhin 'khor lor brtson/ sa ma ya/ rdzas la/ bum pa rgyan can bum chus bkang*/ /phyi nang mchod pa legs par bkram/ /rang nyid bde ba'i stan la 'khod/ /de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ na mo/ ka dag skye ba med pa chos kyi sku/ /zag med mchog dga'i ye shes rab bskul ba/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi/ na mo/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can kun/ /tshe 'phrang bdud las rab grol nas/ /skye 'chi bral bar sems bskyed do/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid/ /blo yis blangs te sprul pa'i tshogs/ /ḍākki mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur/ oṃ sarba pañtsa rakta ba lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐/ om̐ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ om̐ badzra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐/ zhes byin gyis brlabs nas/ gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni/ hrīḥtāṃ bhrūm̐/ skye med chos dbyings bum pa gzhal yas khang*/ /phyi nang 'od zer 'ja' tshon gtibs pa'i klong*/ /sna tshogs padma ge sar zla steng du/ /rang sems tāṃ yig dkar po'i 'phro 'du las/ /gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs rje btsun sgrol ma dkar/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo dkar gsal ston zla'i mdangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan bdun 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /rin chen rgyan cha zur phud thor tshugs mdzes/ /phyag gnyis skyabs sbyin utpal thugs kar 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis sems ma'i skyil krung dung ltar 'khyil/ /dar ljang stod g.yogs mthing gsal tshangs skud mdzes/ /rā ga'i mdangs ldan lha rdzas smad du gsol/ /rin chen rgyan cha longs spyod rab tu rgyas/ /snang stong 'ja' tshon chu zla'i rnam par gsal/ /de ltar thugs ka'i sa bon 'od zer gyis/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel spyan drangs gyur/

oṃ tā re tuttā re sa mā ya dza dzaḥ de nas spyan drangs/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hrīḥ skye med mkha' spyod rnam dag zhing khams nas/ /rje btsun sgrol dkar yid bzhin tshe 'phel ma/ /byams ldan brtse bas thugs rjes gnas 'dir gshegs/ /tshe bdud bar chad bsal phyir brtan par bzhugs/ /mos blo dga' tshal dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dug lnga'i dbang gyur srog bcad mthol lo bshags/ oṃ tā re tuttā re sa mā ya dza dzaḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya a āḥ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ badzra shuddhe hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hrīḥ phyi mchod lha mo spyan gzigs nam mkha'i khyon/ /yid las sprul pa'i sna tshogs dpag yas gtibs/ /rab 'byams zhing rdul mnyam pa spros pa'i tshogs/ /yum chen rje btsun sgrol ma'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda pū dza hoḥ nang mchod ni/

hrīḥ dung chen yangs pa mtshan ldan snod mchog tu/ /rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /mkha' gsang rmad byung ma hā rakta dang*/ /bsrubs mchog stong sbyar ba liṃ brjid chags dang*/ /zag med bde stong dga' bzhi lugs ldog rtsal/ /phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid la sogs/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma la 'bul/ /bzhes nas 'ja' lus rdo rje'i dngos grub stsol/ om̐ sarba pañtsa rakta bha lingta ma hā pū dza ātma ko3 haṃ/ oṃ tā re tuttā re i daṃ bha lingta pū dza me gha ga ṇa tsakra āḥhūm̐/ a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/ hrīḥ spyan chab las 'khrungs rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'gro kun brtse ba'i ma/ /'jigs pa brgyad skyob ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkar gsal dri med ston ka'i mdangs dang ldan/ /'gro kun nyon mongs bag chags bsal ba'i brda/ /zhal 'dzum spyan bdun phyogs bcur gzigs pa ni/ /ma rig mun pa'i sdug bsngal bsal ba'i brda/ /phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin mnyen lcug ldem pa ni/ /ngar 'dzin dug lnga 'jigs brgyad skyob pa'i brda/ /g.yon pas utpal mdangs ldan 'dzin pa ni/ /sgrub la 'chi med dngos grub stsol ba'i brda/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan rin chen brgyan pa ni/ /'gro la 'dod rgu dngos grub ster ba'i brda/ /lha rdzas sngo dmar stod smad g.yogs pa ni/ /sna tshogs thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dul ba'i brda/ /zhabs gnyis sems ma'i skyil krung bzhugs pa ni/ /bdud bzhi zil gnon tshe 'phrang bsal ba'i brda/ /'od lnga'i zla ba'i rgyab yol brten pa ni/ /thugs rje'i bsil bas tsha gdung bsal ba'i brda/ /brda yi don rgyan rje btsun ma la bstod/ hrīḥ ma yengs mi bsgom lhug pa'i gzer bzhi yis/ /mi gtong yun du khyod nyid sgrub lags na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/

zhes che chung ran pa bung ba tshang zhig pa lta bur bzlas pas/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad sgrol ma'i skur gyur par bsgom/ yang 'od zer rnam par gyur nas rang la sib sib thim par bsam zhing mthar dmigs med ngang du bzhag /de nas dngos grub len pa ni/ hrīḥ skye ba med pa'i thugs rjes yongs la gzigs/ /spyan chab las 'khrungs rgyal kun skyed pa'i yum/ /mchod bstod bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin nus pa'i rtsal/ /tshe chos zas nor snyan grags mnga' thang stobs/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje bum pa'i sku/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes sgrub bum gnas lngar dbang blangs/ de nas bdud rtsi myong*/ 'gro ba'i don du ril bu dril/ tshe 'o drangs/ 'jigs pa brgyad dang bdud bzhi zlog /'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku ru 'grub/ rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje bris// // pi) sgrol dkar tshe 'gugs bzhugs so/ hrīḥmaḥ po ṭā la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo 'jigs skyob tshe 'phel ma/ /spyan chab las 'khrungs 'khor 'das las grol ma/ /yid bzhin 'khor lo ḍākki tshe 'phel ma/ /dkar gsal mdangs ldan dri med ston zla'i mdangs/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan bdun zla ba'i 'od/ /g.yas g.yon skyabs sbyin utpal bsnams mdzad ma/ /rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan lha rdzas stod smad g.yogs/ /nor bu la sogs rin chen rgyan dang ldan/ /zhabs gnyis sems skyil bdud bzhi tshe bdud 'gems/ /zla ba'i 'od la sku rgyab bsil sbyin brten/ /brda rtags rgyan rdzogs ma yis tshe dbang khug /bstan pa'i las mdzad tshe ring mched lnga la/ /ḍākki rigs lnga mda' dar rang rtags bsnams/ /'byung lnga'i bcud bsdus tshe bsod snang ba khug /bdag cag rnams kyi tshe yi bar chad sgrol/ /mos blo dga' tshal dwang bas dngos grub brnyes/ /rig 'dzin drang srong grub thob rje 'bangs rnams/
