/rab 'byams zhing rdul mchog stsol tshe khug cig /chos longs sprul sku rtsa brgyud bla ma dang*/ /lo ha badzra mi 'jigs rdo rje sogs/ /chos bdag rig 'dzin rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams/ /rtsa rlung thig le'i bcud bsdus tshe khug cig /gling bzhi gling phran steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams/ /rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /tshe srog nyams bkang chad pa mthud nyams gsos/ /rnal 'byor bdag la tshe yi dbang bzhi stsol/ /'chi med 'ja' lus rdo rje'i srog 'grub shog /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re ma ma ā yurdzñā na puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes sngags sgrogs/ zhes pa 'di'ang sgrol dkar gyi tshe 'gugs dgos zhes yang yang bskul ngor/ rtsa gling zlos gar gsum pa gsang sngags ming gis bdud 'dul sngags gling du sbyar ba'o// // phi) sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs mchod bzhugs so/ rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum la 'dud/ de yang rgyu bsod nams tshogs kyi longs spyod bya ba ni/ phyi nang bskang rten gzhung bzhin bshams/ lhag bsam rnam dag mos 'dun du/ spos rol dbyangs snyan 'di skad do/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rang rig yum chen gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ /tshogs rdzas ma dag sbyong byed ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ /mnyes byed 'dod rgu bdud rtsi rgya mtsho ru/ /mi zad ka dag mchod sprin om̐ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma 'og min mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing*/ /yum rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i tshogs/ /bcud 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs/ /bdag mos pa'i bu la brtser dgongs bzhugs/ /dus nam yang 'bral med phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dgyes byed ga ṇa mchod pa bla med 'di/ /mchog gsum rtsa gsum rigs 'dus lha yi tshogs/ /rgyal yum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul lo bzhes/ /mi shigs 'ja' lus 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ oṃ gu ru dhe ḍākki nī dharma pā la ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi:

hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ /zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg /chos nyid rnam dag sprin phung mchod pa 'dis/ /yum chen sgrol dkar tshe 'phel thugs dam bskang*/ /sman mchod bdud rtsi dmar chen rakta'i tshogs/ /'bru bcud kun 'dus rmad byung ba liṃ ta/ /spyan gzigs mchod sprin ma tshang med pa 'dis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum/ /tshe 'dzin yid bzhin 'khor lo'i thugs dam bskang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dam can gter bdag srung ma'i thugs dam bskang*/ /mchod bstod bsgrubs pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang*/ /thugs dam bskangs la bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ kye ma/ ka dag skye med yum chen dgongs su gsol/ /bdag sogs bag med ma rig dbang gyur pas/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i thugs dang 'gal ba kun/ /rgyal yum sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la bshags/ yig brgya bzlas/ hūm̐/ mdun du tha ma tshogs kyi liṅga la/ /a 'thas log lta'i dgra bgegs myur du khug /ka dag skye med rig pa'i mtshon chas bsgral/ /shar grol mi dmigs gdod ma'i dbyings su phaṭḥ rgyud drug dug lnga'i phung po zhal du bstab/ /re dogs 'dzin bral ye stong kha khā hi/ e ma ho/ rmad byung dag pa mchog gi dngos grub 'di/ /skye 'gag bral ba rang byung a la la ho/ dngos grub tu rol/ de nas lhag ma ni/ hūm̐ bhyoḥ thog ma'i yum chen ma cig rje btsun ma'i/ /dkyil 'khor gnas nyul dam tshig rjes gcod cing*/ /'dod yon bza' btung lhag la dbang ba yi/ /ma sring mkha' 'gro ging sman sde tshogs rnams/ /dam rdzas lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las sgrubs/ utstshiṣṭa bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥmaḥ gnas mkha' spyod bde chen pho brang nas/ /ma rgyal yum yid bzhin 'khor lo ni/ /lha dpa' bo 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ /thugs mi mngon dbyings nas bskul lo bzhengs/

/bcud sman mchog bdud rtsi'i gtor ma 'bul/ /phyi 'byung bzhi bcud kyi bkrag mdangs skyed/ /nang rtsa rlung sems kyi sgron me sbor/ /don gsang ba mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /yum khyed dang 'bral med rjes bzung shog de nas chad mdo ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang snyigs ma'i dus skabs la/ /skye 'gag 'khrul bral rang shar dkyil 'khor du/ /snang yul 'gyu ba'i tha tshig gter gyi bdag /ka dag so ma'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /sems can sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod/ hūm̐/ rgyal kun yum gyur tshe 'dzin sgrol dkar gyi/ /ka dag tha tshig srung ma thams cad kun/ /dam rdzas 'dod yon phud kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ brtan ma skyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni/ /rnal 'byor drod nyul legs nyes stangs 'dzin zhing*/ /rnam 'gyur ma nges yang 'khor 'bum phrag kun/ /sman chab phud kyi gtor ma 'bul lo bzhes/ /yang zab bstan pa skyong ba'i bya ra mdzod/ oṃ badzra ma hā ma ti pra mo li hrīṃḥdzaḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ gtor bro ni/ hūm̐/ rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /rang gsal rig pa'i bro brdungs pas/ /rnam rtog dug lnga'i phung po rnams/ /mi dmigs ka dag rgya yis gdab/ om̐ lam̐ āḥlam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ satwaṃ bha ya nan/ de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i spyi dpal tshe 'dzin yid bzhin 'khor/ /thugs dam bskul lo mchog gi dngos grub stsol/ /mi 'gyur mi 'gags mi 'khrul 'dod don rnams/ /skal ldan sgrub la myur ba nyid du stsol/ oṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī kā ya wākka tsitta sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ bkra shis ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku'i bkra shis ka dag gdod ma'i dbyings/ /chos nyid zad sar mthar phyin bkra shis shog /longs sku'i bkra shis sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum/ /rtsa rlung snang ba bde stong bkra shis shog

/sprul sku'i bkra shis ma cig mtsho rgyal ma/ /gdul bya smin grol gegs med bkra shis shog /yum chen khyed nyid sgrub pa'i bsod nams kyis/ /bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog hūm̐ hrīḥ phyi nang snod bcud ye shes lha tshogs rnams/ /mi dmigs ka dag rgya yan lhug pa āḥ yum chen bsgrubs pa'i dge ba yis/ /ma gyur 'gro drug sems can kun/ khyod kyi go 'phang myur thob shog / ces pa 'di'ang rig 'dzin mi 'jigs rdo rje'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i kha skong du/ rig 'dzin rje rin po che de nyid kyi rjes 'jug o rgyan ming gis mos 'dun che bas bris so// // bi) dag snang sgrol chog tshogs gnyis myur lam gsal byed kyis brgyan pa bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru ārya tā re ye/ /bla ma yum chen 'phags mar 'dud/ spyi don gsum gyi dang po ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med par bcom ldan 'das ma mngon sum du bzhugs par bsams la/ kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon phyag gi dkyil 'khor dang : 'jig rten dbang phyug spyan las legs 'khrungs pa'i: ma rgyud rgya mtsho'i sprul gzhi myur zhi yum: bcom ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid nyer gcig gar: rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las myur ma dpal: dbyer med rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma rjer: phyag 'tshal gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbang bskur stsol: na moḥ skyabs yul rgya mtsho'i ngo bo rje btsun mar: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba'i ma gyur 'gro: rje btsun 'phags ma'i go 'phang sgrub par bgyi: lan gsum/ hoḥ rje btsun 'phags ma rgyal ba sras bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul sdig ltung snying nas bshags: yi rang bskul zhing bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs: dge tshogs 'phags ma'i go 'phang 'thob phyir bsngo: gnyis pa ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: gnas yul rnam dag g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing :

kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos bkang ba'i dbus: tāṃ: rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs 'phags ma'i skur: gsal ba'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i yi ge dang : thugs srog 'od kyis rgyal ba sras bcas kun: rje btsun 'phags ma'i rnam par spyan drangs la: sgyu 'phrul lha mo nyer gcig rol gar bcas: dbang po mngon sum bzhin du lhun ner gsal: zhes mdun mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod bstod lan gsum bya dgos pa'i dang po ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang : bdag lus longs spyod dge tshogs maṇḍal 'bul: bdag gzhan myur du tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag nas: 'di nas byang chub snying po thob kyi bar: 'bral med thugs rjes zungs shig rje btsun ma: bstod pa rgyas pa'am/ rgyal ba kun gyi spyan sngar thugs bskyed rgyal ba'i yum gyur ma lus rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrub ma/ /myur ma dpa' mo dbyangs can ma dang bsod nams mchog gter rnam rgyal rig byed ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gzhan gyi mi thub gzhan las rgyal dang seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma 'jig rten gsum rgyal nor ster ma/ /bkra shis don byed dgra dpung 'joms mdzad khro gnyer ldan mdzad rab zhi ma dang 'bar ba'i 'od can ma/ /dpag med gnon ma rma bya chen mo mi pham rgyal mo ri khrod ma dang 'od zer can mar 'dud/ /'gro kun srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol phyir byang chub thob 'dod bdag kyang khyod la re'o rje btsun ma/ zhes tshar gnyis brjod/ ces skyabs par zhal gyis bzhes nas phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin gyi 'og tu bdag sogs 'khor bcas tshud par bsams la sngar bzhin mchod bstod gnyis pa la bstod pa gsum/ gsum pa la bstod pa bdun brjod rjes su gong gi kyaiḥ 'od dpag med mgon sogs nas dbang bskur stsol: ces dang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i gnas gsum las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser rim cig car: bdag gi gnas bzhir thim pas dbang bzhi thob:

'phags ma dgyes bzhin 'od zhu rang la thim: rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma'i skur gsal bas: gsal stong zung 'jug don gyi 'phags mar blta: om̐ tā re tutta re tu re swā hā: zhes bzlas/ gsum pa ni: om̐ padmo sa twa sa ma ya sogs nas sa twa āḥ sa nongs pa bshags/ hoḥ ma dag nyes tshogs 'phags ma'i spyan sngar 'chags: sgo gsum rnam dag ye shes lam la spyod: dus gsum dge tshogs zag med dbyings su bsngo: zung 'jug 'phags ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog: byang chub bar du bla ma rje btsun mas: 'bral med thugs rjes skyong ba'i bkra shis shog: ces pa'ang rgyun khyer dang grangs bsog la nye bar mkho phyir 'gro 'dul pad rgyal gling pas phrin las kyi gnas chen seng rdzong gu ru'i bzhugs khri'i ke'u tshang nas gsal byed cung zad bcas bris pa siddhi rastu// // mi) sgrol ma'i tshogs bsdus ni/ om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ tshogs gzhong rnam dag padma 'bar ba ru/ /tshogs rdzas ngo bo ye shes bdud rtsi'i sprin/ /zag med 'dod yon rgyan gyi rol mo mchog /mi 'dzad nam mkha' mdzod kyi 'khor lor gyur/ tāṃ/ po ṭa la sogs rab 'byams zhing kun nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur tā re ma/ /rnam 'phrul nyer gcig rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor sprin/ /ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /'dod yon zag med tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes/ /mi mthun 'gal 'khrul nyams chag nyes ltung bshags/ /gzung 'dzin nyon mongs ye shes chen por stobs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin chen dbab tu gsol/ /lhag ma bshal chur re kun mnyes shing tshim/ /phyi nang 'gal rkyen bar chad mtha' dag sol/ /'jig brgyad zhi sogs las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol/ /dag pa mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i grogs mdzod cig /ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ /slad nas dam tshig dbang gis 'byon mdzod la/ /byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes su zungs/ /don gnyis bsam kun 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/

ces pa'ang sgrub bla mgon po lha dar gyi bzhed skong du padma rnam par rgyal bas bris pa dge/ // tsi) sgrol chog zhi ba'i sbyin sreg /'bri rgyu/ tshi) mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs kyi gsol 'debs padma'i do shal bzhugs so/ na mo/ dzñā na ḍākki nī ye/ skye med ka dag chos sku kun bzang mo/ /'gag med lhun grub longs sku wā ra hī/ /thugs rje'i rtsal snang arya tā re la/ /gsol ba 'debs so dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ /sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mkhar chen bza'/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo dbyings phyug manda ra/ /thugs rje'i rang rtsal mon bal dha ki bcas/ /gsol ba 'debs so 'khrul snang rang grol stsol/ /snang srid gdod nas rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i dal/ /bde stong rol pa 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs gar sgyur ma sring srung ma la/ /gsol 'debs so brtul zhug mthar phyin stsol/ /phung khams skye mched gdan gsum lha skur rdzogs/ /rlung sems las rung rtsa mdud dbu mar grol/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i gtsug tor rtse mo'i sa/ /'khor lo tshogs chen zhing du byang chub shog / ces pa 'di yang sgo chen dgon gyi byang 'dren pa tshe dbang bdud 'dul nas tshul 'dis cha lag tshang bar bri rogs zhes dar bcas bskul ba yid 'jag thog slar yang 'phen sprul nas zhu skul bzhin sngags rig 'dzin pa padma'i myu gu gu hyas bris pa'o// // dzi) zab yangs nam mkha'i chos sde las: mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs padma'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so: sham/thā/: maya: dus gsum rgyal yum mtsho rgyal sku la phyag 'tshal lo: mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sgrub thabs ye shes sgra dbyangs 'di la 'jug par spro na: sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes chog gsum las: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing mchog nas ma cig rgyal yum mtsho rgyal mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ

na moḥ dbyings rig ngo bo ka dag spros dang bral: ye shes rab dga' bde chen g.yo ba mo: bde dga' rgya mtsho'i grol lam mchog gi sku: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal sku la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ ma gyur 'gro ba mkha' khyab sems can kun: tshe rabs thog med a 'thas 'khor bar 'khyams: 'khor 'das cig car rig pa'i yo lang gis: kun khyab byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum: yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal: sogs? gsum pa bgegs la bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐: nyon cig nga bdag gzung 'dzin bgegs kyi rigs: lta log ru tra srid pa'i 'dre bo che: zag med ting 'dzin 'dod yon 'dis tshims nas: dga' bral bde ba'i dpal la longs spyod kyis: kun mkhyen sor rtog shes rab dbang bsgyur bas: bdag med stong pa nyid du phyir dengs shig: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa badzra hūm̐: nyon mongs bgegs tshogs u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ bzhi pa mtshams gcod pa ni: hūm̐ ma: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka nas: mi shigs chos bdun 'bar ba mtshon cha'i gur: gu yangs lta ba'i rgyal po'i btsan sa zin: phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub srung 'khor gyur: dzñā na badzra rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐: lnga pa mchod pa byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: snang srid snod bcud kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: phyi nang gsang gsum dngos 'dzin dri ma rnams: dmigs med ka dag rig stong rjen pa'i ngang : rang byung ye shes lnga yi byin gyis rlobs: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: drug pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos chos dbyings pho brang nas: kun tu bzang mos byin phob cig: rang byung ye shes e klong nas: rgyal yum sgrol mas byin phob cig: e waṃ bde chen zung 'jug nas:

ye shes mtsho rgyal byin phob cig: zag med dga' bzhi'i pho brang nas: rigs bzhi'i ḍākkis byin phob cig: las sgrib rnam dag klong yangs nas: ma mo tsaṇḍas byin phob cig: phrin las so sor mnga' sgyur ba'i: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs byin phob cig: bdag dang gnas khang rten rnams la: mchog thun phrin las rnam pa bzhis: 'bral ba med par dngos grub stsol: badzra dzñā na ḍākki a be sha ya a āḥ bdun pa brda sgo brda phyag ni: hūm̐ ma: lhan skyes kun brtags ma rig sgrib pa rnams: rang byung so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis: ye grol ka dag klong du brda sgo dbye: rang rig rang gsal ngang du mjal phyag 'tshal: dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭḥ dharma dhā tu a ti pu hoḥ dngos gzhi las rim bstan pa las: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'khor 'das snang srid bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun: ye nas kun gzhi chos sku'i ngo bo la: gzung 'dzin re dogs gnyis snang spang blang bral: stong gsum dag pa rab 'byams ngo bo nyid: dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa lha bskyed ni: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las zang thal klong yangs nas: 'byung ba rim brtsegs sa bon spro bsdu las: ma bcos lhun grub rang byung gzhal yas khang : thig le nyag gcig chos dbyings pho brang dbus: sna tshogs ge sar nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor steng : rang rig ma bcos ye shes mtsho rgyal sku: gzhon nu sku lus bcu drug lon pa'i tshul: mtshan bzang dpe byad dkar dmar mdangs dang ldan: gser g.yu mu tig rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: sngo dmar ljang gu'i na bza' rnams kyis bklubs: sa le sbram gyi ska rags rdor mdud bcings: dpral bar ratna'i me tog 'od lngas mtshan: dbu skra thor tshugs rigs bdag pad 'byung mtshan: lhag ma tsho gsum sku rgyab sked par bslebs: phyag g.yas mchod sbyin sde snod glegs bam bsnams: g.yon pas bhandhar bdud rtsi tshe bum 'dzin:

g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum nu ma bha ga rgyas: lang tsho rab rgyas thugs kar pad nyi'i steng : rje btsun sgrol ma myur ma dpa' mo sngo: zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum rol: skyabs sbyin padma longs sku'i rgyan chas spras: de yi thugs kar pad nyi zla gdan steng : yum chen sher phyin kun tu bzang mo mthing : dbyer med rgyan spangs mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: spyi bor sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro wā ra hī: phyogs bzhir rigs bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang ni: ka la siddhi shākya de ma dang : manda ra ba bkra shis khye'u 'dren: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs: snying rje byams pa dga' ba btang snyoms kyi: so so'i rang rtags phyag mtshan g.yas na bsnams: g.yon pas bum pa zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum bzhengs: mtshams bzhir sgo ma phyogs mdog rus rgyan rdzogs: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu ma: gzigs sham la sogs dpa' chas gar stabs can: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: steng 'og bar gsum bla ma yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter gyi bdag: e ka dzā ṭi dbyings phyug chos sgron rnams: rang bzhin gnas nas nyi zer rdul 'khrigs ltar: gnas 'dir spyan drangs badzra sa mā dzaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐ ma: mi dmigs 'og min zhing khams su: snang ba sna tshogs sku yi bkod: lhun gyis grub pa gsung gi rol: ka dag spros bral thugs kyi ngor: sku gsung thugs mchog spyan drangs nas: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir byon cig dbang mchog bskur: khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir: byin rlabs 'od dpung thibs se thib: dngos grub char rgyun si li li: rol mo'i sgra dbyangs di ri ri: dri zhim spos ngad chi li li: dam tshig bzhin du ci bder gshegs: log 'dren bgegs tshogs ma lus sel: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

bzhi pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: ma chags skyon bral padma nyi zla'i gdan: dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bral ba rang thog tu: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rang sar 'dzin: dam ye gnyis su med par bzhugs su gsol: dzñā na ḍākki sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med sku gsum lhun gyis grub: gang 'dul der ston thabs kyis 'gro rnams sgrol: ye thog mi 'gyur mkha' 'gro'i rang zhal las: gcig 'dres ngo mtshar chen pos mjal phyag 'tshal: a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ drug pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: snang srid rnam dag lha mo bcu drug tshogs: 'dod yon ma tshang med pa'i blos blangs nas: phyi nang gsang gsum dngos yid sprul byas te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul bar bgyi: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe pū dza hoḥ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā rakta a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya dharma dhā tu pū dza hoḥ bstod pa ni: hūm̐: chags med skyon bral lang tsho rgyas pa'i sku: bcu drug gzhon nu dri med zla ltar rgyas: e waṃ bde stong rgyal sras bcas yum la: dbyangs can ye shes mtsho rgyal phyag 'tshal bstod: mdog sngo skyabs sbyin ge sar phreng ba 'dzin: 'jigs pa brgyad skyob 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsgral: yid bzhin mchog gi thugs rje glog ltar myur: rje btsun myur ma dpa' mor phyag 'tshal bstod: snang srid 'khor 'das ye nas 'khrul ma myong : dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi yum chen mo: gang 'dul thabs kyis zab mo'i chos sgo 'byed: yum chen bzang mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yas babs mas brtan dga' bzhi'i 'byung ldog bskyed: zab lam dhū ti'i rlung sems dbu mar tshud: skye 'chi bgres rgud bral ba ye shes sku:

ḍākki mkha' 'gro rigs lngar phyag 'tshal bstod: las bzhi lhun grub phrin las mnga' sgyur ba: tshad med bzhi ldan rang rtags phyag na bsnams: snying rje khros tshul stong nyid nga ro 'byin: ta krita sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las bka' yi srung ma mthu rtsal can: ma rungs gdug pa dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa: dam ldan sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: bka' srung ma mo'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor 'das gdod nas rang bzhin rnam par dag: gnas lugs don la cha lugs so sor ston: snang stong sgyu ma sku yi ngo mtshar che: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: brgyad pa 'dzab dgongs ni: rang nyid mtsho rgyal thugs ka ru: rgyal kun 'dus sku rje btsun ma'i: thugs dbus yum chen kun bzang mo: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gnas gsum las: sa bon pam̐ tāṃ aḥs mtshan mthar: so so'i sngags 'khor 'od zer gyis: dus gsum rgyal kun thugs rgyud bskul: spro bsdus 'gro ba'i don gnyis byas: ha ri ni sa yongs gyur las: zag med bde ba chen po yi: dga' bzhi las byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun: babs pas mchog gi dbang bzhi thob: snang bzhi mthar phyin 'od skur grub: spyi dril rtsa sngags ni: oṃ padma yo gi ni dzñā na ḍākki tā re sa manta ha ri ni sa sarba siddhi hūm̐: rtsa bsnyen so so ni: pam̐ padma yo gi ni dzñā na ḍākki siddhi hūm̐: oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā: oṃ dharma ma hā su kha dzñā na hūm̐: oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa buddha badzra ratna padma karma dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shāntiṃ puṣṭiṃ pa shaṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ yig brgyas skyon bshags dbyangs gsal kha skong rten snying rgyas gdab: bsnyen bstod mdor bsdus mchod 'os lha ru ldang : sa ma ya: gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa ni: tshogs kyi yo byad 'du byas la: dang po tshogs la byin rlob ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas:

gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros bsregs gtor bkrus sbyangs pas: 'bru gsum byin rlabs ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min gnas dang o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing : sa spyod gnas yul rtsa khams zhing mchog sogs: a ma mtsho rgyal sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha: ma sring mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum dang bcas: 'dod yon tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rtsa khams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams: rigs lnga phyag rgyar rdo rje'i brdas bskul bas: bde ba g.yo zhing byang sems tshogs kyi mchod: a haṃ sems gsum 'dres pa'i dngos grub stsol: sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ: ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la khā hi: gsum pa bskang zhing bshags pa ni: hūm̐: gzugs snang dag pa bde ba can gyi zhing : dgos 'dod kun 'byung kun bzang mchod sprin gtibs: kun kyang ma tshang med pa'i bskang rdzas 'di: ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs bdud rtsi rnams: e waṃ gsang ba zab mo'i gter 'byed pa: a ma mtsho rgyal ma yi thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas gzhan las byin rlabs myur mdzad ma: rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : ye nas 'khrul ma myong ba'i dbyings yum ma: yum chen kun tu bzang mo'i thugs dam bskang : gti mug rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: chos dbyings sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : zhe sdang rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: me long rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : nga rgyal rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: mnyam nyid rin chen mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : 'dod chags rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: sor rtog padma mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : phrag dog rtog pa rang bzhin gnas dag pa'i: bya grub las kyi mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : zhi ba'i las mdzad byams pa tshad mthar phyin: sgo ma lcags kyu ma yi thugs dam bskang :

rgyas pa'i las mdzad snying rje mtha' ru phyin: sgo ma zhags pa ma yi thugs dam bskang : dbang gi las mdzad dga' ba tshad mthar phyin: sgo ma lcags sgrog ma yi thugs dam bskang : drag po'i las mdzad btang snyoms tshad mthar phyin: sgo ma dril bu ma yi thugs dam bskang : rang lus rtsa khams 'khor lo gnas dag pa'i: sa ya drug 'bum mkha' 'gro'i thugs dam bskang : gnas yul dur khrod kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro bye 'bum thugs dam bskang : legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod ma: ma mo e ka dzā ṭi'i thugs dam bskang : dam ldan sgrub la bu bzhin skyong nus pa'i: dbyings phyug chos kyi sgrol ma'i thugs dam bskang : o rgyan padmas bka' yi gnyer du bskos: bka' srung gter srung rgyud srung thugs dam bskang : spros bcas spros med spros bral bskang rdzas rnams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: don gnyis lhun grub 'bras bu mthar phyin shog: de nas bshags pa ni: kye ma rigs drug sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir: thog med dus nas da lta'i bar dag tu: mi dge mtshams med so thar byang sems sngags: ma rig nyon mongs dbang gis bsgribs pa yi: dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis pa: a ma mtsho rgyal lha tshogs spyan sngar bshags: byang zhing dag nas mngon rdzogs sangs rgyas shog: oṃ badzra sa twa

sogs?yi ge brgya pa brjod: bzh-i pa tshogs bsgral ni: hūm̐: khams gsum 'khor ba'i brub khung thar med nang : ngar 'dzin bdag lta ru tra nyam thag 'khod: na mo: skyabs gnas bslu med mkha' 'gro'i bden pa'i mthus: bdag lta'i ru tra 'byung po 'dir khug la: khyod nyid phyi nang gsang ba'i lta ba de: ma rig gnyis 'dzin nga bdag ru tra la: khyod kyi gnyen po ro gcig khros pa'i sku: cig car rig stong rjen pa'i phur bu 'debs: rten 'brel bcu gnyis 'phang lo 'dra ba zhig: ma bcos ka dag gnas lugs rang sa zungs: gnyis snang khyab brdal rang bzhin de ru phob: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍākki kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ lnga pa zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings klong yangs mkha' 'gro'i zhal phyes shig: ma dag dug lnga bsgral ba'i phung po 'di: rang mdangs ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs nas: sku lnga mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs zhal du 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzñā ḍākki ha ri ni sa sarba ma hā māṃ sa rakta keṃ ni ri ti la khā hi: tshogs la rol pa ni: hoḥ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos: sogs? drug pa lhag ma ni: oṃ e ra li hriṃ hriṃ phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan sha za shugs 'gro dang : laṅka ging dang gnas nyul mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rin chen mdzes pa'i rgyan cha du mas spras: bhandha'i skyogs bzang lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: rgyal khams yongs la sgrub bstan spel ba dang : ma sring mkha' 'gro rnams kyis sun kha zlog: utstshiṣṭa bha lingta khā hi: bdun pa bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs ye shes mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: dgongs pa chos dbyings klong nas skur bzhengs shig: ma dag log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs: zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan bshig dam nyams la: ye shes mkha' 'gro khyed kyi rdzu 'phrul 'gyed: gtor zor thugs rje'i me dpung mtshon cha bsnams: hūm̐ phaṭ bhyo bzlog sgra skad di ri ri: lus ngag yid gsum mthu rtsal gzi brjid bskyed:

kla klo mu stegs mtha' dmag gdug 'dre zlog: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki wā ra hī sa ma ya gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya bhyo zlog: brgyad pa chad mdo ni: hūm̐: sngon tshe bar dang tha ma'i bskal pa la: dgongs brda brgyud kyi bka' lung 'bog pa'i tshe: ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal dam bsgrags pa: so so'i khas blangs dam bca' de bzhin du: gtor ma bzhes la bka' yi tha tshig srungs: dam ldan sgrub pa po la nyams rtogs spel: gsang sgrub sgra dbyangs bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ badzra dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni sa bha lingta khā hi: dgu pa brtan ma skyong ba ni: bhyoḥ bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdud mo ma bzhi gnod sbyin sman mo'i tshogs: re re'i 'khor tshogs bye ba 'bum 'bum 'gyed: lhab lhub mdzes pa'i na bza' sku la gsol: rin chen rgyan cha mang po si li li: sgra dbyangs rol mo mang po di ri ri: 'dir gshegs bka' yi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bod khams yongs kyi mtha' dmag so kha srungs: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'khu ldog zhi: gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang : mthun rkyen sgrubs la 'gal rkyen bar chad sol: las bzhi gang bcol phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ ma ma ting ting shag shag le le taṃ taṃ bha lingta khā hi: bcu pa rta bro ni: hūm̐: stong gsum gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og: gnod byed dam sri pho mo'i gdan steng du: ye shes lnga yi glu blangs bro brdungs pas: ma dag 'khor ba'i sa bon steng nas skems: mtshan 'dzin spang blang re dogs bag chags kun: a ti'i lta bas bro brdung rang sar grol: oṃ laṃ: āḥlaṃ: hūm̐ laṃ sarba satwaṃ bha ya nan nan: bcu gcig pa tshe sgrub ni: hūm̐: rtsa gsum mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal thugs rgyud kyi: tsaṇḍa li dang sgrol dkar manda ra'i: thugs srog 'od 'phros drang srong tshe lha'i tshogs:

thugs dam rgyud bskul 'chi med sku 'grub gyur: oṃ ḍākki ha ri ni sa āḥyurdzñā na tshe bhrūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ zhes bzlas: 'gugs shing bcu gcig pa dbang blang ba ni: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings bum pa rin chen gzhal yas khang : kun bzang sgrol dkar mtsho rgyal manda ra: phag mo gos dkar rigs bzhi'i ḍākki tshogs: mkha' 'gro tshe lha rnams kyis tshe khug la: lha klu mi dang drang srong tshe'i rig 'dzin: khams gsum srid gsum 'byung bzhi'i bcud drangs nas: thabs shes a nṛ hūm̐ gsum snying po'i bcud: mi 'gyur g.yung drung mi shigs sku rdo rje: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bcas rnams la: 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis rlobs: oṃ dzñā na ḍākki ha ri ni kā ya wākka tsitta sarba ā yurdzñā na siddhi a la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bcu gnyis pa bsdu rim ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha rnams mtha' nas rim pa bzhin: 'od zhu gtso bo'i sku gsum lha rnams kyang : 'ja' ltar gshegs nas thugs srog hūm̐ la thim: hūm̐ yang nā da mi dmigs ngang du āḥ slar yang snang grags rig gsum sku gsum ldang : bkra shis ni: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang yum chen mo: gnas lugs chos skur rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rje btsun sgrol ma yum: gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gyi: thugs rje phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: rigs lnga'i bkra shis ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga: dug lnga rang sar grol ba'i bkra shis shog: sgo ma'i bkra shis tshad med bzhi dang ldan: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis ral gcig dbyings phyug mas: sa lam bar chad sel ba'i bkra shis shog: zab chos bkra shis yang gsang ye shes sgras: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i bkra shis shog: ces brjod bsngo ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bsngos bzhin tu:

de bzhin bdag gi dge ba ci mchis pa: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bskyed rdzogs zab mo yis: mkha' khyab sems can sangs rgyas 'thob phyir bsngo: smon lam ni: hūm̐: ma gyur 'gro ba mkha' khyab sems can kun: a ma mtsho rgyal khyed kyi mthu byin gyis: phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sa thob nas: tshom bu gcig tu 'tshogs pa'i smon lam shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pa zhes pa'i gter chen nyid kyi mtshan byin rlabs thob pa sku yi sprul pa'i zlos gar lnga pa nges don chos dbyings grol gyis rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug lor mchog gyur zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nub mor mtsho rgyal sgrub thabs phyi nang gsang gsum mtha' gtad bcas brda yi bskul ba las byung ba'i dus dman nyams chag skyon gyis lo brgyad gsang rgya btab cing*/ shing phag lor mdo khams sa yi thig le sgo chen ri khrod kyi grwa padma tshe 'dzin nas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas gsang sgrub cha shas tsam brda las phab pa'o/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // wi) gdugs dkar/ gzhan du yod/ zhi) gdugs bzlog /gzhan du yod/ zi) pra yi lha mo'i shwa mo kun gsal sgron me nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bzhugs so// ḍākki pra rgyal sku la 'dud/ ces pa 'di yang pra lha gsal nas/ gser skyems btang la/ stong pa'i las rang nyid skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal byed pra yi lha mo spyan drangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung gsal ba'i dbyings klong nas: dur khrod tshogs khang ti sgro'i gnas mchog nas: ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: zab gsang ye shes dgyes pas gnas 'dir bzhugs: dam rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems gnyan po bzhes: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bu bzhin skyongs: ma yengs bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad du gsol: gsal byed sngags/ oṃ ka ra ka ra da nga ra da nga ra thib thib tha ye swā hā/ gsal byed sngags stong tsam brjod la/

bhyoḥ kā li kā li dhe wi kā li badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ ci nus mthar spro bar mos na gser skyems dang bcas/ bhyoḥ ma cig las kyi mkha' 'gro ma: dkar gsal 'dzum mdangs ya la la: sku la dar dkar go zu gsol: rin chen thor tshugs shigs se shig: dar dpyangs cod pan pu ru ru: phyag g.yas sna tshogs mda' dar 'dzin: g.yon pas 'phrul gyi me long bsnams: ratna mdzes pa'i rgyan 'phyang ldan: klu yi chu rta sngon po chibs: sga srab dar stan khrigs se khrig: rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i shugs 'chang ma: gsang ba gter gyi grogs mdzad ma: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra ma: las bzhi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas kyis: dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes/ /rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me ston/ /gtsug lag lha dang rtsis kyi bdag /lo zla zhag dus tshes kyi bdag /yul ri'i gzhi gnas ma lus la/ /dam rdzas gser skyems mchod pa bzhes/ /rno mthong gsal ba'i sgron me ston/ /brtag bya'i bya ba gang 'di dag /legs nyes blang dor ma 'dzol bar/ /the tshom med par mngon sum du/ /ye shes spyan ldan khyed kyis ston/ /sngon tshe gu ru'i bka' bzhin du/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ mthar ye dharma brjod la/ bdag gis brtag bya'i bden pa brdar bas legs nyes ci yong gsal por blang dor nor ba med par ston cig / bzlas shwa dang phreng ba sogs la phu btab/ the tshom med par dbab par bya'o/ phreng ba la bcad pa'i grangs ni sum tsho ru gcod dgos pa yin/ shwa yin na dung shwa la sngags/ shwa dang phreng ba gang byas kyang chog (1) shwa mig gcig la babs na/ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ gangs dkar rtse la seng chen 'gying*/ /g.yu ral sprugs pas gling bzhi srung*/ /chos rgyal bla ma rgyal po sogs/ /ban bon mi chen khong la bzang*/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ mi nor zas nor longs spyod mnga' thang phyugs gsum 'phel/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ mi khyod gtso bo mi chen gyi rgyud yin pas/

lag gang gi nor spyod/ rgyab gang gi gos gyon/ kha gang gi zas za/ spang gang gi rta rgyugs/ mig gang gi ltad mo blta/ bde skyed ldan pa'i mo 'di bzang ba yin/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ lus kyi bang mdzod la srog gi g.yung drung 'khyil/ lo gsum bar du btsan dug rjen zas byos kyang mi 'chi/ mi mgo tho bas brdungs kyang mi 'chi/ tshe srog brag las sra bas bzang ngo*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bu dang bu mo yi mtsho rdol bas legs/ /bza' mi 'grogs yun ring*/ bza' mi bzang la mang ngo*/ ༈ bu chung gi srid phywa/ tshe ring phan thog pas bzang*/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ btsan phyug 'phan dar bzang*/ lam phywa ni/ gser sder g.yu gzhong nor bu'i rdzas kyis bkang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra med gnyen dang 'phrad pas bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs ngo che la phun sum tshogs pas bzang*/ zas sha chang gnyis la ngoms shing za/ bsang gsol dang g.yang skyabs lha mo'i gsol kha/ rten 'dzugs byas na bzang*/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ blo 'di lha yi byas/ bsam don 'grub pas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la btsan gsol dang g.yang skyobs byas na shin tu bzang*/ ༈ khang pa dang e 'phrod ce na/ mi dang lha gnyis ka 'phrod/ dga' mgu yi rang*/ mi dar phyug dar khyim dang rwa ba gang bkra shis pas bzang*/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ don gang zhus na yang gnang bar 'dug pas bzang*/ ༈ don phywa ni/ ngo so grogs dang bcas par gang bsam 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ dga' spro dang bcas par myur bar sleb pas bzang*/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong grogs lha yis byas mi kha gleng gyod med pas bzang*/ ༈ nyen gyod yod med ni/ nyen gyod med/ gtam snyan stong gsum khyab/ ༈ slob dpon dang e 'phrod ce na/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs myur du zhus na shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ lha rje la gtang rag gzab/ shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ bu chung 'di chos pa e yong zhe na/ bu chung 'di chos byas na shin tu bzang*/

༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg rim 'gro e 'phrod ce na/ shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ srog lhas 'tshos/ tshe nyi zla ltar mnyam pas mi shi bas bzang*/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ bdud dang ma mo gson 'dre gdon/ bdud bzlog /ma mo'i mdos/ 'dre mo bkar yas sogs bya/ ༈ bor stor e rnyed ce na/ g.yang sgo ma ral pas myur du btsal na rnyed pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra jag rkun gsum e thul zhe na/ dgra pham rang rgyal kha lon pas bzang*/ ༈ sems can bsten pas e 'phrod ce na/ shin tu 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ rnyed pas bzang*/ ༈ srid e chags zhe na/ srid pa pho rgyud song bas bzang*/ ༈ shags kha rgyal lam zhe na/ kho'i mgo la mu gab zhwa gyon nas 'dug pas rang rgyal la kha smras med pas bzang*/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ chang ni zhim pas gser skyems bdud rtsis gtams dang 'dra bas bzang*/ ༈ rtse mo'i rigs e 'phrod ce na/ dga' bar 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ kha char myur du 'bebs pas bzang*/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor shin tu 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa e 'phrod ce na/ lam 'phrang med pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ mi khyod la dgra lhas mgon pas phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar 'gro lam la dgra med pas bzang*/ (2) shwa mig gnyis pa babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho la khrag gi char pa 'bebs/ gangs dkar rtse la gnam lcags thog rdo lhung zer bas ngan/ rgyal bka' sgrog /cho ga 'tshogs/ mtshan 'bar gso/ rgyun bsten gsol mchod rigs/ bka' phur gshin gsum/ gdugs dkar bzlog bsgyur/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg /spong dag sogs la 'bad pa gal che/ ༈ khyim ni e 'phrod ce na/ ngan pas gser gyi ka ba 'gyel/ g.yu yi gdung ma chag /yas kyi bdud g.yos/ mas kyi sri langs/ shi chad 'ong bas shin tu'ang ngan/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ gzhis la 'dug na shi chad 'byung*/ byis su 'gro na bor stor 'byung*/ g.yas nas rnyed na g.yon nas 'chor/

lus kyi stobs shor/ kha yi gtam zad pas ngan no/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ mi 'phrod pha me'i dur sri langs/ nad drag po 'ong nyan che/ rgyal bka' dag sgrog sogs rim 'gro stobs chen dgos/ ༈ srid phywa e 'phrod ce na/ bud med kyi srid phug tu 'dre mos gnod pa 'byung bas ngan/ ༈ bu chung gi srog phywa ni/ shing kha'i bye'u chung khras bcom pa dang 'dra/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ shi chad dang god kha yong ngo che bas ngan/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ blo 'dre yis bslus pas bsam don mi 'grub pas ngan no/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs phyi nas tshur yong med khar phar 'chor nyen yod/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ mi la mdze 'ong*/ phyugs la god kha yong*/ 'pho skyas yang yang yong bas ngan/ ༈ khang pa e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod pas sa 'dir bkra mi shis/ nam phugs mi nor rjes med du 'gro bas ngan no/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ mi gnang kha 'gyod snying stong 'ong bas ngan no/ don med stong log byed/ phed stong phrag par khur bas shin tu ngan/

༈ mgron phywa ni/ mgron mi 'ong bas ngan/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong nyes yong bas ngan/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod pas shin tu ngan/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ phan las gnod pa mang bas mi 'phrod/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod sman dpyad bshol na legs/ ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ chos mgo mi thon mi kha che bas ngan/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ 'dre ngan gyi srog bcad nyen che bas ngan/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ gza' dang rgyal pos gdon/ gza' mdos dang*/ rgyal mdos/ gu ru zhi drag gi tshogs 'bum btang na legs/ ༈ bor stor e rnyed ce na/ bor stor m-i yis khyer des bya'o/ ༈ dmag jag e thul zhe na/ 'chi bdag 'dra ba myur du slebs pas mgo chag rkang grug yong bas rang pham/ mi nor thams cad mi la shor bas shin tu ngan/ sems can e 'phrod ce na/ phan mi thogs pas mi 'phrod ngan/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ mi rnyed gal te rnyed na gyod dang kha mchu god kha 'ong bas ngan/ ༈ srid e chags she na/ mi chags srid kyi mtsho mo skam pa'i ngo*/ ༈ shags kha 'byed na e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod shin tu ngan/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ chang mi zhim pas ngan/ ༈ bzo rigs e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod bshol na legs/ ༈ lo e legs she na/ mi legs/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs she na/ kha char mi 'bebs than pa 'ong bas ngan/ ༈ rtse mo e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod ngan/ ༈ lam phywa e 'phrod ce na/ bor stor yong bas ngan/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor mi yong bas ngan/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra btsan la khas grags shig 'ong bas ngan/ (3) shwa mig gsum pa la babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad kyi 'og nas gser gyi nyi ma dgu shar/ sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng na rin po che sna dgu'i khri brtsegs pas gang la'ang bzang por shar/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ mi mang phyugs 'phel bu nor gyi char 'bebs pas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ pho phywa ni/ pho lha dgra lha mchod cing bzang*/

༈ srog phywa ni/ tshe ring nad med pas bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ srid phug che/ nad med gnyen gyis byams gces che la yun ring bzang*/ ༈ bu chung srid phywa ni/ lo lnga'am bcu tshun la bar chad mi 'ong*/ dbang thang che zhing mi chen 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ gser gzhong mar khus gang*/ zas nor longs spyod 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ shin tu legs pas rab kyi mchog yin bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs phun sum tshogs par 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ rmang gzhi rin chen gser las byas/ 'gyur med g.yung drung rin chen yin/ mi nor zas gsum 'dzoms/ longs spyod 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ 'phral du ma gnang yang phug tu gnang ngo 'dug ༈ khang phywa e 'phrod ce na/ lha bzang po 'khor bas mchod nas bsten na bzang*/ nor stor ngo 'dug ༈ don phywa ni/ don ci bsam 'grub rang nyid dga' bas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ kha zas ja chang myur du bzos dang myur du sleb/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong grogs lha yis byas pas tshong khe zhing tshong kha rgyal bas bzang*/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ni/ nyes 'gyod med pas bzang*/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ slob dpon 'di rang gi chog /shin tu bzang*/ ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ tshe ring nad med 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam sna lha yis khrid pas bzang*/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ gzhan la ma shor na 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg e 'phrod ce na/ lha rje la gtang rag gzob dang*/ 'phrod ngo che bas bzang*/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ nad gzhi che bas rim 'gro la 'bad na sos pa gda' skad/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ bdud btsan gyis gdon/ bzlog pa drag po/ btsan mdos/ brgya bzhi/ mgo gsum bcas sgrub/ ༈ bor stor rnyed dam mi rnyed ce na/ gser gyi mdzo g.yag ri nas shor na sna thag ka bar btags pas lho phyogs nas btsal na rnyed pas bzang*/ ༈ dmag jag rku gsum e thul ce na/

ru dar gnam la phyar bas bswo sgra sgrog /mtshon cha dgra la btab pas mi nor gnyis thul ba'i ngo shar bas bzang*/ ༈ sems can 'di bsten na 'phrod dam zhe na/ 'phral du dge zhing*/ phugs su phan thogs/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ rnyed de phan thogs shing bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bu ru 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ gtam lab e 'phrod ce na/ 'phrod de rang nyid rgyal gtam snyan thos ngo yod/ ༈ chang e zhim zhe na/ rdo dkar por khroṃ bris la lums nang du bzhag na chang zhim par 'gyur bas bzang*/ ༈ bzo rigs byas na/ legs pas bzang*/ ༈ lo legs sam zhe na/ so nam rnams la legs pas bzang*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ shin tu 'bebs pas bzang*/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor 'phel phan thog pas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam dar bas 'jam dgra med pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra lha dar bas dgra ming mi grags bzang*/ (4) shwa mig bzhi par babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ ri bo mthon po'i rtse yi na bun dang 'dra/ yong yong 'dra yang yong dus med/ tha ma 'ja' bzhin yal nas 'gro bas ngan no/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ mi nor bang mdzod 'thor nyen che bas ngan/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ gnya' gnon dang dgra rkun ma nyes kha yog yong nyan 'dug /dgra rkun dang dug la 'dzems dgos/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ tshe yi dmu thag chad pas skyon che/ bla bslu dang*/ 'chi bslu/ tshe dbang tshe sgrub rtags thon bcas sku rim la 'bad/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ce na/ nyen 'gyod yong shi chad god kha 'ong bas ngan no/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ tshe stod skyid la tshe smad sdug byis pa chung gsum sos dka' bas ngan no/ ༈ bu chung gi mo la/ bla tshe the'u rang dang gson 'dres rkus pas ngan no/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ shi god bor stor yong 'dug pas ngan/ bya ba legs lam gang byas kyang mgo thon mi yong ngan/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ bya ba mang la 'go thon pa gcig kyang med pas ngan no/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ kha smras dang gleng 'gyo mang bas ngan/

༈ khang pa e 'phrod ce na/ khang stong che bas mi nor gnyis ka phung bas ngan/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ mi gnang gzhan la zhus na legs/ ༈ don phywa ni/ gang bsam mi 'grub ngan/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ mgron lam chu yis gcod pas yong ngo med/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ pham par 'dug pas ngan/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod bzhag na legs/ ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ chos byas na bar chad mang bas ngan/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod pas gzhan la zhus na legs/ ༈ nad pa e sos she na/ nad pa la kha'i bya sgro dang 'dra bas gar 'gro nges pa med pas ngan/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ sde brgyad dang klu yis gnod/ bka' brgyad/ klu 'bum/ bsang gsol/ rim 'gro stobs chen 'grub na legs/ ༈ bor stor rnyed dam zhe na/ blo rgyab tu bskyur/ re ba ma che mi rnyed pas ngan no/ ༈ dmag jag rku gsum e thul zhe na/ dmag dpon rkang pa chags dmag mi shi chad 'ong bas mi thub bshol na legs/ ༈ sman dpyad e 'phrod ce na/ sman dpyad gtar bsreg bshol na legs/ ༈ sems can e 'phrod ce na/ mi 'phrod/ ༈ mdza' grogs e rnyed ce na/ mi rnyed/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bu yin na ming spos lus bsgyur ba sogs ma byas na srog 'tsho dka' bu mo yin na 'bring*/ ༈ gzhan la gtam rgyal lam zhe na/ rang gzhan gnyis ka phung ba'i rgyu yin pas bshol na legs/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ chang nang du the'u rang 'dug pas chang mi zhim/ ༈ bzo rigs e 'phrod ce na/ dge bar mi 'gyur bas ngan/ ༈ lo legs sam mi legs zhe na/ lo nyes mu ge che bas ngan no/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs she na/ 'brug glog sgra che yang char mi 'bebs/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ dkor dang grong chog rag dka' bas ngan/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ dgra rkun gyis gnod ngo 'dug pas ngan/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra 'chi bdag 'dra ba yong*/ mi gsod nor 'chor 'gro bas ngan no/ (5) shwa mig lnga pa la babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ mi nub rgyal mtshan phyar/ snyan grags stong gsum gang bar khyab pas bstan pa dar la yun ring bas shin tu bzang*/

༈ khyim phywa ni/ khyim bdag sa yi lha mo bstan mas byas pas lo legs bkra shis nor 'phel mi tshe bskyel bas bzang*/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ khyod la pho lha dgra lhas mgon/ ci byas lam du 'gro/ dga' ba'i nam langs/ skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ tshe ring nad med shin tu bzang*/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ khyod kyi srog lcags khang dgu rim du tshud/ mgo tho bas brdungs kyang mi 'chi bas bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bud med bzang mo bag gsar la bu dang bu mo spel bas bzang*/ 'phral bas phugs skyid pas bzang*/ ༈ bu chung gi mo la/ bu chung 'di nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling gsal/ btsun pa byas na bla ma 'ong*/ skye bo byas na dpon po 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ rang la nor med pas sdug bsngal mi dgos nor lha gnyan pa dzambha lhas byed 'tsho skyong shes na de kas chog ༈ blo phywa ni/ 'phral phugs kun la bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ rang gi gang 'dod grogs dang 'phrad pas bzang*/ ༈ sa cha yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ bzang*/ ༈ khang pa bzang ngan ni/ mi rgyud bzang la phyi dal che/ ༈ zhu ba e yong ce na/ don 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ myur du 'ong*/ yun bsring phyi dal che/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ni/ nyes 'gyod med la gang 'dod 'grub/ ༈ don phywa ni/ gang byas lam du 'gro/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong grogs lha yis byas pas rang mi rgyal ba'i ka med 'phral lhod la phugs brim pas bzang*/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce na/ slob dpon ni tshe rabs mang po'i slob dpon yin shin tu bzang*/ ༈ bu chung chos phywa ni/ bu 'di tshe rabs du mar sbyang 'phro yod pas chos byas na bzang*/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce na/ sman pa 'di bzhugs na ngo so che shin tu bzang*/ brtson 'grus bskyed/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg e 'phrod ce na/ 'phral du 'bring zhing*/ phugs su dge /gang byas lam du 'gro zhing bzang skad/ ༈ nad pa e sos zhe na/ nad gzhi che srog skyon med pas bzang*/

༈ gdon phywa ni/ rgyal btsan dang gri bos gnod/ gu drag gi dbang dang gtor bzlog bsnyen sgrub sogs rim 'gro stobs chen la 'bad dgos/ ༈ stor ba e rnyed ce na/ nye 'khor du 'dug 'phral du song rtsad chod rnyed/ ༈ dmag jag pham rgyal ci yong zhe na/ rang thob par 'ong*/ ༈ sems can e 'phrod ce na/ 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ mdza' grogs e rnyed ce na/ mdza' grogs 'di tshe sngon gyi grogs yin pas bzang*/ ༈ srid e chags zhe na/ srid pho ru yin na bzang*/ ༈ gtam dang rgyal kha e lon zhe na/ rang bsten srung ma mchod na rang rgyal kha lon/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ 'dre mo bkar yas byas na bzang*/ ༈ bzo rigs e 'phrod ce na/ 'phrod la bzang*/ ༈ lo e legs she na/ 'bru 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ kha char dus su 'bebs pas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam lha mchod lam bde grogs bsten pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra med byas pa'i gnyen dang 'phrad/ gtam snyan thos pas shin tu bzang ngo*/ (6) shwa mig drug pa la babs na/ ༈ bstan pa'i chos phywa ni/ sa padma 'dab brgyad kyi steng g.yu yi dpag bsam ljon shing skye/ ljon shing rtse la bya rgyal khu byug gi gsung snyan phyogs bcur sgrog pas sang phod da tsam gtam snyan rgyal khams yongs la khyab pas bzang*/ ༈ khyim phywa ni/ 'dod 'jo'i ba la be'u skye/ zas nor longs spyod 'phel/ ma yi pang la bu skye/ zas nor dbang du 'du/ las ci byas kyang bzang*/ ༈ skyes pa'i pho phywa ni/ bla ma mi dpon rje 'bangs ser skya yongs la bzang*/ ༈ srog phywa ni/ tshe srog rdo rje'i brag las sra/ dmu thag lha dang 'brel/ na tsha rkyen 'gyod med/ ban bon stong gi mthu kha yod kyang mi thub pas bzang*/ ༈ srid phywa ni/ bud med 'di la klu mo 'khor bas/ bu nor 'phel zhing 'phral phugs kun la bzang*/ bu chung srid phywa ni/ thu ba g.yas nas pho lhas skyob/ g.yon nas mo lhas bskyab pas bzang*/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ gang bsam shin tu bzang*/

༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs ngo che/ bsam pa 'grub pas bzang*/ sa mkhar yul 'dzin rmu thag gsham du sbrel/ ༈ nor phywa ni/ longs spyod g.yang 'phel mi dar lha dar yin/ khang pa dpag bsam lo 'dab rgyas/ nor lha mchod na phyugs lug 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ nyes 'gyod yod med ni/ g.yang 'gugs dang lha srung mchod na nyes 'gyod med/ ༈ blo phywa ni/ thang dkar rgod la shor/ gshog drug rgyas pas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ grogs phywa ni/ grogs gang bsam pa 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ sa mkhar yul 'dzin gyi mo la/ rmu thag gnam du sbrel nor phyugs longs spyod g.yang mtsho 'khyil/ mi dal lha dal yong*/ mi rabs bcu gsum bar brtan cing bkra shis par 'gyur/ dpag bsam ljon shing la lo 'bras rgyas pa 'dra bas shin tu bzang*/ ༈ zhu ba e gnang zhe na/ thugs dpal be'u sgo phyes/ zhabs pad mi 'dzum mdangs gsal/ mi khyod ci 'dod gyur du gnang*/ shin tu dge ba'i ngo yin/ ༈ don phywa ni/ bsam pa'i don yang 'grub/ kha mdog mdang skyes snying dga' mul le/ don 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ mgron phywa ni/ mgron zas khur bcas myur du 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ tshong phywa ni/ tshong rgyal nor dang bcas 'phral phugs kun la phan thogs pas bzang*/ ༈ slob dpon e 'phrod ce ni/ slob dpon thugs rje byin rlabs che/ tshe rabs gsum gyi slob dpon 'di/ bka' drin che bas shin tu 'phrod/ phan shin tu thogs/ ༈ sman pa e 'phrod ce ni/ sman pa'i sman rkyal bdud rtsis bkang ba gzhan la ma shor 'di rang gis chog ༈ bu chung gi chos phywa ni/ 'di phyi gnyis ka la phan pa'i chos yong bas bzang*/ ༈ sman dpyad gtar bsreg 'phrod dam zhe na/ yun ring ma 'gyang myur du bgyis na nad pa sos/ srog skyon med pas bzang*/ ༈ gdon phywa ni/ klu dang sa bdag gis gnod pas/ klu mchod klu gtor thongs/ klu 'bum snang brgyad klu yi spang bkong sa bdag 'khrug bcos byas pas phan/ ༈ bor stor e rnyed ce na/

g.yang sgo ma bye bas myur du rnyed/ ༈ dmag jag rkun gsum e thul zhe na/ dmag dpon gzhu mchog sgril/ dmag dpon gyis dgra 'ded/ dgra bo myur du phung*/ dgra lha gsol mchod byas nas kha pho bsdams pas chog ༈ sems can 'di 'phrod dam zhe na/ shin tu 'phrod pas g.yang 'khor nor phyugs 'phel bas bzang*/ ༈ mdza' rogs e rnyed ce na/ 'dzum gyis mdun bsus/ zas dang skyems kyi ngor/ thag thogs med par bzang thal che/ ༈ srid e chags zhe na/ srid mo ru gda'/ g.yang sgrub byas na pho ru 'ong*/ gser bas bzang*/ ༈ gzhan dang gtam lab e 'phrod ce na/

rang rgyal myur du 'phrod pas bzang*/ ༈ bzo rigs gang la'ang dge/ ༈ chang phywa ni/ lan chags gtor ma gang mang btang na chang zhim por 'ong bas bzang*/ ༈ lo e legs zhe na/ lo legs skya rgyas 'ong*/ ༈ kha char e 'bebs zhe na/ kha char 'phral du ma babs kyang dal du 'bab nas than pa mi 'ong*/ ༈ dkor phywa ni/ bkra shis 'o ma'i mtsho mo 'khyil bas bzang*/ ༈ lam phywa ni/ lam lhas sna khrid byes lam 'grub pas bzang*/ ༈ dgra phywa ni/ dgra dpung zhig nas mtshon cha'i so ngar yal/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad legs lam ci bsam 'grub/ ma rig gsal sgron mun gsal 'od po che/ ye shes lha mig thob pa'i bkra shis shog / ces pa 'di yang dgos ched rnal 'byor rnams/ /ma rig dmus long dug lnga'i las kyis bsgribs/ /chos byed zhen 'dzin bag chags rang nyid bsgribs/ /dud 'gro kha yan las ngan rang bsags bsgribs/ /bla ma dkor gzan rang mgo rang gis bsgribs/ /dge bshes btsun gzugs sdom khrims nyams pas bsgribs/ /yi dam chos skyong phud nyams 'bag pas bsgribs/ /gter srung bka' srung mchod gtor dman pas bsgribs/ /lha srin sde brgyad dmag 'khrug srog gcod bsgribs/ /yul lha gzhi bdag thab 'khon mnol gtsog bsgribs/ /ri rgya rngon bshig mna' tho tha tshig bsgribs/ /sems can ser sna 'jur gegs tshogs bsags bsgribs/ /tha mal sems can a 'thas gol bas bsgribs/ /de yi nyes skyon 'od gsal mun pas g.yogs/ /gcig mgo gcig bskor zog por gsung gsal zhu/ /ma gsal mchog gsum bka' la bden med zer/ /mchog gsum bden med ma yin bslu ba med/ /de phyir the tshom spongs la bden pa brdar/ /mi chos zog rdzun smra dang mtshungs mi 'gyur/ ces so/ sems can rmongs pa gsal byed bdag gzhan kun la phan phyir ḍākki pra yi lha mo'i shwa mo kun gsal sgron me nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'di'ang*/ rtsa gling zlos gar gsum pa gsang sngags bstan rgyal gyis lcags khyi hor zla brgyad pa'i mgo yi nyi mar bris pa dge bar gyur cig
/nyes 'gal mchis na pra gsal lha la bshags so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// //
